She used to adore the idol with five Mantras and the application of excellent scents, garlands, incense, splendid garments, Naivedya offerings with sweet puddings, songs, dances, instrumental music etc. After the ritualistic dismissal of the image of the goddess, she offered various gifts to Brāhmaṇa Gauriṇīs (i.e. married women with husband alive and virgins). Thereafter she used to return to the abode to the accompaniment of various musical instruments being played.

## \|\| 1.177.22 \|\|

*yathāyathā ca tāṃ pūjāṃ tasyā gauryā karoti sā \|*  
*tathātathā tu saubhāgyaṃ tasyāścāpyadhikaṃ bhavet \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. As she continued the adoration of Gaurī, her conjugal felicity went on increasing.

## \|\| 1.177.23 \|\|

*sarvāsāṃ ca sapatnīnāṃ saubhāgyaṃ vādhikaṃ bhavet \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. She surpassed all her co-wives in regard to conjugal felicity.

## \|\| 1.177.24 \|\|

*atha tasyāḥ sapatnyo yāḥ sarvā duḥkhasamanvitāḥ \|*  
*dṛṣṭvā saubhāgyavṛddhiṃ tāṃ tasyā eva dinedine \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. On seeing the day-by-day increase in her fortune and conjugal felicity, all the co-wives became sad and distressed.

## \|\| 1.177.25 \|\|

*ekāḥ procuḥ karma caitadyadeṣā kurute sadā \|*  
*mṛnmayāṃśca samādāya pūjayetpaṃcapiṃḍakān \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. Some said: There is a special religious rite, she is engaged in forever. She collects mud and clay, makes them into five lumps and worships them.

## \|\| 1.177.26 \|\|

*anyāstāṃ maṃtrasaṃsiddhāṃ pravadaṃti maharṣayaḥ \|*  
*anyā vadanti puṇyāni hyasyāḥ pūrvakṛtāni ca \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. O great sages, others said that she was perfect in the Siddhi of her Mantras. Still others said that she had performed meritorious deeds in her previous births.

## \|\| 1.177.27-28 \|\|

*evaṃ tāsāṃ suduḥkhānāṃ mahānkālo jagāma ha \|*  
*kasyacittvatha kālasya sarvāḥ saṃmaṃtrya tā mithaḥ \|\| 27 \|\|*

*tasyāḥ saṃnidhimājagmustasminneva jalāśaye \|*  
*yatra sā pūjayedgaurīṃ kṛtvā tāṃ pañca piṃḍikām \|\| 28 \|\|*

27-28. Thus, they spent a long time in their great sorrow. Once, all of them discussed with one another and came to the water reservoir (pond or lake or river) where she performed the worship of Gaurī in the Pañcapiṇḍikā.

## \|\| 1.177.29 \|\|

*tataḥ sarvāḥ samālokya tyaktvā gaurīprapūjanam \|*  
*saṃmukhī prayayau tūrṇaṃ kṛtāṃjalipuṭā sthitā \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. On seeing them all, she stopped her adoration of Gaurī and hastened to their presence. There she stood with palms joined in reverence.

## \|\| 1.177.30 \|\|

*svāgataṃ vo mahā bhāgā bhūyaḥ susvāgataṃ ca vaḥ \|*  
*kṛtyaṃ nivedyatāṃ śīghraṃ yenāśu prakaromyaham \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. “O highly esteemed ladies, welcome, hearty welcome unto you all. Do mention my duty which I shall quickly carry out.”

## \|\| 1.177.31 \|\|

*sapatnya ūcuḥ \|*  
*vayaṃ sarvāḥ samāyātāḥ kautuke tavāṃtikam \|*  
*daurbhāgyavahninirdagdhāstava saubhāgyajenaca \|\| 31 \|\|*

The Co-wives said:

31\. It was due to eagerness and curiosity that we have come to you. We are being burned by the fire of absence of felicity fanned by your own conjugal felicity.

## \|\| 1.177.32 \|\|

*tasmādvada mahābhāge mṛnmayāṃ paṃcapiṃḍikām \|*  
*nityamarcayasi tvaṃ kiṃ saubhā gyasya vivardhanam \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. So, O highly fortunate and esteemed one, tell us why and how you always worship the Pañcapiṇḍikā made of clay.

## \|\| 1.177.33 \|\|

*kiṃ te kāraṇametaddhi kiṃ vā mantrasamudbhavaḥ \|*  
*prabhāvo'yaṃ mahābhāgeguhyaṃ cenno vadasva naḥ \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. What is the reason thereof? Is it the result of the power of Mantras? O highly esteemed one, if it is not a great secret, do explain to us.

## \|\| 1.177.34 \|\|

*padmāvatyuvāca \|\| \|*  
*rahasyaṃ paramaṃ guhyaṃ yatpṛṣṭāsmi śubhānanāḥ \|*  
*avaktavyaṃ vadiṣyāmi bhavatīnāṃ tathāpi ca \|\| 34 \|\|*

Padmāvatī said:

34\. O fair-faced ladies, what I am being asked about is really a great secret. It should not be expatiated upon. Yet I shall explain it to you.

## \|\| 1.177.35 \|\|

*gaurīpūjanakāle tu yasmāccaiva samāgatāḥ \|*  
*sarvā mama bhaginyaḥ stha īrṣyādharmo na me'sti ca \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. Since all of you have come at the time when I am adoring Gaurī, you are all my sisters. I am never defiled by the vice of jealousy.

## \|\| 1.177.36 \|\|

*ahamāsaṃ purā kanyā pure kusumasaṃjñite \|*  
*vīrasenasya śūdrasya vaṇikputrasya dhīmataḥ \|*  
*tena dattā'smi dharmeṇa vivāhārthaṃ mahātmanā \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. Formerly, I was in the city called Kusumapura. I was the daughter of Vīrasena, an intelligent Śūdra. I was, given, as per Dharma Śāstra, in marriage to an intelligent son of a merchant by the noble-souled one.

## \|\| 1.177.37 \|\|

*tato vivāhasamaye mama dattāni vṛddhaye \|*  
*paṃcākṣarāṇi śreṣṭhāni yoṣitā dīkṣayā saha \|*  
*gaurī pūjākṛte caiva proktā cāhaṃ tataḥ param \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. At the time of the marriage five excellent letters (Mantras) were given to me for my prosperity by a Yoṣit (a maiden) along with my initiation. Thereafter, I was told to perform the adoration of Gaurī.

## \|\| 1.177.38-39 \|\|

*yāvatputri tvamātmānametaiḥ pūjayase'kṣaraiḥ \|*  
*jalapānaṃ na kartavyaṃ tāvaccaiva kathañcana \|\| 38 \|\|*

*yena saṃprāpsyase'bhīṣṭaṃ tatprabhāvādyadīpsitam \|*  
*tatheti ca mayā proktaṃ tasyāścaiva varānane \|\| 39 \|\|*

38-39. (She said:) “O daughter, till you complete the worship of the Ātman by means of these Akṣaras (syllables, Mantras) do not even drink water. Thereby, you will obtain everything desired and desirable.”

O splendid-faced lady, I said to her, “So it shall be (done).”

## \|\| 1.177.40 \|\|

*tato vivāhe nirvṛtte gatā'haṃ patinā saha \|*  
*śvaśura stiṣṭhate yatra śvaśrūścaiva sudāruṇā \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. Then after the marriage celebration was over, I went with my husband to the place where my father-in-law was present and also the terrible mother-in-law.

## \|\| 1.177.41-42 \|\|

*gaurīpūjākṛte māṃ ca nivārayati sarvadā \|*  
*tato'haṃ bhayasantrastā gaurībhaktiparāyaṇā \|*  
*jalārthaṃ yatra gacchāmi tasmiṃścaiva jalāśraye \|\| 41 \|\|*

*tataḥ karddamamādāya mantraiḥ paṃcabhirevaca \|*  
*taireva pūjayāmyeva gaurīṃ bhaktiparāyaṇā \|\| 42 \|\|*

41-42. My mother-in-law was dead against my adoration of Gaurī. She always used to prevent me. Naturally, I who was always devoted to Gaurī became frightened. In the water-pond where I used to go to fetch water, I began worshipping Gaurī with devotion and recitation of the five Mantras. (For the sake of image). I took the clay (and made the lumps).

## \|\| 1.177.43 \|\|

*prakṣipāmi tata stoye tato gacchāmi mandiram \|*  
*kasyacittvatha kālasya bhartā me prasthitaḥ śubhaḥ \|*  
*deśāṃtaraṃ vaṇigvṛttyā so'pi mārgaṃ tamāśritaḥ \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. Then I used to throw them in the water and go back to the abode. Once my splendid husband set out for some foreign land for mercantile activity.

## \|\| 1.177.44 \|\|

*sa gacchanmarumārgeṇa māṃ samādāya snehataḥ \|*  
*saṃprāpto nirjalaṃ deśaṃ suraudraṃ marumaṃḍalam \|\| 44 \|\|*

44\. He took me with him affectionately and proceeding along the desert path we came to an arid region, a frightening desert area.

## \|\| 1.177.45 \|\|

*tathā raudratare kāle vṛṣasthe divasādhipe \|*  
*tataḥ sārthaḥ samastaśca viśrāṃtaḥ sthalamadhyagaḥ \|\| 45 \|\|*

45\. So also the time was equally terrible with the Sun in Taurus. The entire caravan took rest in the middle of the spot.

## \|\| 1.177.46 \|\|

*kūpamekaṃ samāśritya gambhīraṃ jaladopamam \|*  
*etasminneva kāle tu mayā dṛṣṭaḥ samīpagaḥ \|*  
*toyākāro maru ddeśastaścitte vicintitam \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. They resorted to a deep well comparable to a rain-bearing cloud. At the same time something resembling water was seen in the desert region by me when I thought thus:

## \|\| 1.177.47 \|\|

*yattacca dṛśyate toyaṃ samīpasthaṃ tathā bahu \|*  
*atra snātvā śucirbhūtvā gaurīmabhyarcya bhaktitaḥ \|*  
*pibāmi salilaṃ paścātsusvādu sarasībhavam \|\| 47 \|\|*

47\. ‘Here plenty of water is seen near at hand. Here I can take bath, become clean, devoutly worship Gaurī and drink the tasty water of the lake.’

## \|\| 1.177.48 \|\|

*tataḥ saṃprasthitā yāvatpragacchāmi padātpadam \|*  
*yāvaddūrataraṃ yāmi tāvatsā mṛgatṛṣṇikā \|\| 48 \|\|*

48\. (Thinking thus) I started and proceeded ahead step by step. I went on and on a long way. It was only a mirage. I became extremely distressed due to thirst in that desert land.

## \|\| 1.177.49 \|\|

*etasminna ntare prāpto nabhomadhyaṃ divākaraḥ \|*  
*vṛṣastho yena dahyāmi hyupariṣṭācchubhānanā \|\| 49 \|\|*

49\. In the meantime the Sun came to the zenith of the sky, the Sun in Taurus (zodiac) scorched me from above, O fairfaced ones.

## \|\| 1.177.50 \|\|

*adhobhāge sutaptābhirvālukābhiḥ samaṃtataḥ \|*  
*tṛṣṇārtā'haṃ tatastasminmarudeśe samākulā \|\| 50 \|\|*

50\. Down beneath me there were the hot sand particles all around. I became extremely distressed due to thirst in that desert land.

## \|\| 1.177.51 \|\|

*tataśca patitā bhūmau visphoṭakasamāvṛtā \|*  
*tato mayā smṛtā citte kathā bhāratasaṃbhavā \|\| 51 \|\|*

51\. Thereat I fell on the ground and there were boils all over my body. A story mentioned in the Bhārata was then recollected by me.

## \|\| 1.177.52 \|\|

*nṛgeṇa tu yathā yajño vālukābhirvinirmitaḥ \|*  
*kūpāntaḥ kṣipyamāṇena tṛṇaloṣṭāṃbuvarjitam \|\| 52 \|\|*

52\. Nṛga performed Yajña by means of sand particles hurled into a well without water, grass or lump of clay.

## \|\| 1.177.53 \|\|

*bhaktigrāhyāstato devāstuṣṭāstasya mahātmanaḥ \|*  
*tadahaṃ vālukābhiśca pūjayāmi harapriyām \|\| 53 \|\|*

53\. The Devas who can be attracted through devotion became pleased with that noble-souled one. Therefore, I thought I too would be worshipping the beloved of Hara by means of the sand particles.

## \|\| 1.177.54 \|\|

*tena tuṣṭā tu sā devī mama rājyaṃ prayacchati \|*  
*adya dehāntare prāpte manobhīṣṭamanaṃtakam \|\| 54 \|\|*

54\. Indeed, the goddess had become pleased. In this birth she has granted me a great realm and plenty of what I have been desiring.

## \|\| 1.177.55 \|\|

*tatastu paṃcabhirmantraistaireva smṛtimāgataiḥ \|*  
*paṃcabhirmuṣṭibhirdevī vālukotthaiḥ prapūjitā \|\| 55 \|\|*

55\. At that time, the five Mantras were remembered by me and the goddess was worshipped with five handfuls of sand particles.

## \|\| 1.177.56 \|\|

*tataḥ pañcatvamāpannā tatkāle'haṃ varāṃganāḥ \|*  
*daśārṇādhipaterjātā sadane lokaviśrute \|\| 56 \|\|*

56\. At that time, O excellent ladies, I fell down dead and was reborn in the place of the king of Daśārṇa well known all over the world.

## \|\| 1.177.57 \|\|

*jātismaraṇasaṃyuktā tasyā devyāḥ prasādataḥ \|*  
*bhavatīnāṃ kaniṣṭhāsmi jyeṣṭhā saubhāgyataḥ sthitā \|\| 57 \|\|*

57\. Thanks to the favour of that goddess, I am now equipped with the power to recollect previous births. Though I am junior to all of you, I am well nigh at the top in the matter of conjugal felicity.

## \|\| 1.177.58 \|\|

*eta smātkāraṇādgaurīṃ muktvaitānpañcapiṇḍakān \|*  
*karddamena vidhāyātha pūjayāmi dinedine \|\| 58 \|\|*

58\. It is for this reason that I make five lumps of clay everyday and offer them to Gaurī by way of adoration.

## \|\| 1.177.59 \|\|

*etadguhyaṃ mayā khyātaṃ bhavatīnāmasaṃśayam \|*  
*satyenānena me gaurī manobhīṣṭaṃ prayacchatu \|\| 59 \|\|*

59\. Undoubtedly this great secret has been divulged to you all. Thanks to this truthfulness, may Gaurī grant what is desired in the mind.

## \|\| 1.177.60 \|\|

*lakṣmīruvāca \|*  
*tataḥ sarvāḥ sapatnyastāḥ kṛtāṃjalipuṭāḥ sthitāḥ \|*  
*māmūcurvinayādvācā praṇipatya muhurmuhuḥ \|\| 60 \|\|*

Lakṣmī said:

\[Note: Padmāvatī is the incarnation of Lakṣmī\]

60\. Then all those co-wives stood with palms joined in reverence and told me humbly after repeatedly bowing:

## \|\| 1.177.61 \|\|

*prasādaṃ kuru cāsmākaṃ dīyatāṃ mantrapaṃcakam \|*  
*tadeva yena te devī tuṣṭā sā parameśvarī \|\| 61 \|\|*

61\. “Kindly do this favour to us. Let the five Mantras be given to us—those Mantras whereby Parameśvarī, the goddess, was pleased.”

## \|\| 1.177.62 \|\|

*mayā proktāśca tā sarvāḥ prārthayadhvaṃ yathecchayā \|*  
*ahaṃ sarvaṃ pradāsyāmi tatsatyaṃ vacanaṃ mama \|\| 62 \|\|*

62\. All of them were told by me: “Do pray as you please. I shall grant you everything. My words are truthful.”

## \|\| 1.177.63 \|\|

*tato deva mayā proktaṃ tāsāṃ tanmaṃtrapaṃcakam \|*  
*śiṣyatvaṃ gamitānāṃ ca vāṅmanaḥkāyakarmabhiḥ \|\| 63 \|\|*

63\. Then, O Lord, they were made my disciples and the five Mantras were imparted to them. They were fully rendered true disciples mentally, verbally and physically.

## \|\| 1.177.64 \|\|

*viṣṇuruvāca \|*  
*mamāpi vada deveśi kīdṛktanmantrapañcakam \|*  
*yattvayā'nuṣṭhitaṃ pūrvaṃ tayā tāsāṃ nivedi tam \|\| 64 \|\|*

Viṣṇu said:

64\. O goddess of Devas, tell me too. Of what nature is that group of the five Mantras? Those Mantras were used by you for the performance of the worship and subsequently imparted to them.

## \|\| 1.177.65-67 \|\|

*lakṣmīruvāca \|*  
*namaḥ pṛthivyai kṣāṃtīśi nama āpomaye śubhe \|*  
*tejasvini namastubhyaṃ namaste vāyurūpiṇi \|\| 65 \|\|*

*ākāśarūpasaṃpanne paṃcarūpe namonamaḥ \|\| 66 \|\|*

*ebhirmantrairmayā pūrvaṃ pūjitā parameśvarī \|*  
*tena rājyaṃ mayā prāptaṃ sarvastrīṇāṃ sudurlabham \|\| 67 \|\|*

Lakṣmī said:

65-67. (1) O goddess of forbearance, obeisance to the earth. (2) O splendid one in the form of waters, obeisance to you. (3) O radiant one, obeisance to you. (4) O deity in the form of wind, obeisance to you. (5) O five-formed one, O one richly equipped with the ethereal form, obeisance, obeisance.

With these Mantras the great goddess was formerly adored by me. Thereby the kingdom, extremely rare in regard to all women, was acquired by me.

## \|\| 1.177.68-69 \|\|

*tataśca sthāpitā devī kṛtvā ratnamayī śubhā \|*  
*hāṭakeśvaraje kṣetre mayā tatra sureśvara \|\| 68 \|\|*

*tāṃ yā pūjayate nārī sadyo'pi pativallabhā \|*  
*jāyate nātra sandehaḥ sarvapāpavivarjitā \|\| 69 \|\|*

68-69. Then the goddess was made out of splendid Ratnas (gems) and installed by me there in the holy spot of Hāṭakeśvara, O Lord of Suras. A woman who adores it shall become instantly a favourite darling of the husband. She will be rid of all sins. There is no doubt in this regard.

## Chapter 178 - Origin of Pañcapiṇḍā Gaurī

## \|\| 1.178.1-4 \|\|

*lakṣmīruvāca \|*  
*evaṃ rājyaṃ mayā prāptaṃ gaurīpūjā kṛte vibho \|*  
*saubhāgyaṃ paramaṃ caiva durlabhaṃ sarvayoṣitām \|\| 1 \|\|*

*na cāpatyaṃ mayā labdhaṃ tathāpi parameśvara \|*  
*tādṛśe'pi ca saubhāgye tāruṇye tādṛśe sthite \|\| 2 \|\|*

*dahyāmi tena duḥkhena divānaktaṃ sukhaṃ na me \|*  
*kasyacittvatha kālasya durvāsā munisattamaḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

*ānartādhipaterharmyaṃ saṃprāpto gauravāya saḥ \|\| \|*  
*cāturmāsyakṛte caiva mṛttikāgrahaṇāya ca \|\| 4 \|\|*

Lakṣmī said:

1-4. O Lord, as a result of the adoration of Gaurī the kingdom was obtained by me. So also excellent conjugal felicity very rare in the case of all women (was obtained).

Still, O great Lord, no child was begotten by me in spite of such a conjugal felicity and the prime of youth.

I was being burnt day and night due to that grief. I did not get any happiness at all.

Once the excellent sage Durvāsas came to the mansion of the king of Ānarta, out of deference to him for accepting Mṛttikā (clay) and for spending the Cāturmāsya (four months of the rainy season when itinerant recluses do not go out of a fixed locality).

## \|\| 1.178.5 \|\|

*tataḥ saṃpūjito rājñā ānartena yathākramam \|*  
*dattvārghyaṃ madhuparkaṃ ca tataḥ proktaṃ praṇamya ca \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. He was duly honoured by King Ānarta. After offering Arghya and Madhuparka, the king bowed down to the sage and said:

## \|\| 1.178.6-8 \|\|

*svāgataṃ te muniśreṣṭha bhūyaḥ susvāgataṃ ca te \|*  
*nānyo dhanyatamo loke bhūyo'sti sadṛśo mayā \|\| 6 \|\|*

*yau te pādau rajodhvastau keśairme nirmalīkṛtau \|*  
*tadbrūhi kiṃkaromyadya gṛhāyātasya te mune \|\| 7 \|\|*

*api rājyaṃ prayacchāmi kā vārtānyeṣu vastuṣu \|\| 8 \|\|*

6-8. “Welcome to you, O excellent one among sages, a hearty welcome unto you. No other king is as blessed as I am.

The particles of dust of your feet have been removed by my hair and the feet are rendered clean. O sage, you are a guest in our house. Tell me what can I do for you. I shall offer even my kingdom. What to say about other things?”

## \|\| 1.178.9 \|\|

*durvāsā uvāca \|*  
*cāturmāsīvidhānaṃ te kariṣye nṛpa maṃdire \|*  
*mṛttikāgrahaṇaṃ tāvacchuśrūṣā kriyatāṃ mama \|*  
*sa tatheti pratijñāya māmūce pārthivottamaḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

Durvāsas said:

9\. O king, I will conduct my Cāturmāsya rites in your palace. Arrangement regarding Mṛttikā Grahaṇa (taking up clay) and attendance upon me may be made.

The excellent king promised, “So it shall be" and spoke to me:

## \|\| 1.178.10 \|\|

*śuśrūṣā cāsya kartavyā sarva daiva varānane \|*  
*cāturmāsīvrataṃ yāvaddevatārcanapūrvakam \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. “O fair-faced one, he should be attended upon always till the completion of the Cāturmāsya rite, along with the adoration of the deity.”

## \|\| 1.178.11 \|\|

*bāḍhamityevamuktvātha mayā sarvamanuṣṭhitam \|*  
*śuśrūṣārhaṃ ca yatkarma duhiteva pituryathā \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. After saying, “So it shall be” everything was carried out by me in regard to the activities of service unto him, like a daughter unto her father.

## \|\| 1.178.12 \|\|

*cāturmāsyāṃ vyatītāyāṃ yadā saṃprasthito muniḥ \|*  
*tadā provāca māṃ tuṣṭaḥ putri kiṃ karavāṇi te \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. After the completion of the Cāturmāsya rite, when the sage started to go, he asked me "Dear daughter, what shall I do for you?”

## \|\| 1.178.13-15 \|\|

*tataḥ sa bhagavānproktaḥ praṇipatya mayā muhuḥ \|*  
*apatyaṃ nāsti me brahmaṃstena dahyāmyaharniśam \|\| 13 \|\|*

*īdṛśe sati rājño'pi yauvane ca mahattare \|*  
*tattvaṃ vada muniśreṣṭha yena syānmama saṃtatiḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

*vratena niyamenātha dānena ca hutena ca \|*  
*tataḥ sa suciraṃ dhyātvā māmuvāca smayanniva \|\| 15 \|\|*

13-15. Thereupon, after bowing down repeatedly, the holy sage was told by me, “O Brāhmaṇa, I have no child. Therefore; I experience a burning sensation day and night.

This is the condition when the youth of the king is at its zenith and perfect. So, O excellent sage, advise me on that course whereby I shall get a child. Let it be a Vrata, an observance, a gift or a Homa.”

Thereupon, he thought for a long time and spoke to me smilingly:

## \|\| 1.178.16 \|\|

*anyadehāṃtare putri tvayā gaurī prapūjitā \|*  
*taptābhirvālukābhiḥ sā mṛtyukāla upasthite \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. “Dear daughter, in your previous life at a time when you were about to die, you adored Gaurī by means of hot particles of sand.

## \|\| 1.178.17 \|\|

*tadbhaktyā labdharājyāpi dāhena pariyujyase \|*  
*gaurī yattāpasaṃyuktā bālukābhiḥ kṛtā tvayā \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. Although you attained a kingdom by her worship, yet you still continue to experience the burning sensation in the manner that Gaurī was made to experience by you through the hot particles of sand.

## \|\| 1.178.18 \|\|

*na devo vidyate kāṣṭhe pāṣāṇe mṛttikāsu ca \|*  
*bhāveṣu vidyate devo mantrasaṃyogasaṃyutaḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. The Lord is not present in wood, stone or earth. The deity is present in the feeling of devotion in conjunction with the Mantras uttered.

## \|\| 1.178.19 \|\|

*bhāvabhaktisamā yuktā maṃtrasaṃyojanena ca \|*  
*devī mantrasamāyātā tvayā vālukayā'rcitā \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. Urged by emotional purity and devout feelings with the Mantras added on, the goddess who came to you through the invocation of Mantras was adored by you with sand particles.

## \|\| 1.178.20 \|\|

*tvatkāye tena saṃtāpaḥ sarvadā'yaṃ vyavasthitaḥ \|*  
*tasmādratnamayīṃ gaurīṃ kṛtvā tvaṃ paṃcapiṃḍikām \|*  
*hāṭakeśvaraje kṣetre saṃsthāpaya śubhānane \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. Therefore, the burning sensation continues in your body forever. Hence you must make a Pañcapiṇḍikā wholly of Ratnas and install it in the holy spot of Hāṭakeśvara, O lady of splendid face.

## \|\| 1.178.21 \|\|

*vṛṣasthe bhāskare paścāttasyā upari srāvi yat \|*  
*jalayantraṃ divārātraṃ dhārayasva prayatnataḥ \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. The installation shall be when the Sun is in Taurus. Thereafter, assiduously fix over it a Jalayantra that drips down water day and night.

## \|\| 1.178.22 \|\|

*tato yathāyathā tasyāḥ śītabhāvo bhaviṣyati \|*  
*tathātathā ca te dāhaḥ śāṃtiṃ yāsyatyaharniśam \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. As the idol continues to get the coolness, your burning sensation will get reduced day and night.

## \|\| 1.178.23 \|\|

*dāhāṃte bhavitā garbhastataḥ putramavāpsyasi \|*  
*rājyabhārakṣamaṃ śūraṃ triṣu lokeṣu viśrutam \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. When the scorching feeling has completely disappeared, you will conceive a son of heroic nature, capable of bearing the burden of the kingdom and of being well-known in the three worlds.

## \|\| 1.178.24 \|\|

*anyāpi kāminī yātra evaṃ tāṃ pūjayiṣyati \|*  
*jyeṣṭhe māse tathā sāpi yathā tvaṃ prabhaviṣyati \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. Any other lady who adores the idol here in the month of Jyeṣṭha shall also be in the same position as yours.”

## \|\| 1.178.25-27 \|\|

*lakṣmīruvāca \|*  
*tato mayā punaḥ prokto bhagavānsa munīśvaraḥ \|*  
*mānuṣatve na me rāgo viraktirmahatī sthitā \|\| 25 \|\|*

*nadīvegopamaṃ dṛṣṭvā jīvitaṃsarvadehinām \|*  
*tanme vada mahābhāga yatkiṃcid vratamuttamam \|\| 26 \|\|*

*mānuṣatvaṃ na yena syātsamyakcīrṇena saddvija \|*  
*tataḥ sa suciraṃ dhyātvā māmāha parameśvara \|\| 27 \|\|*

Lakṣmī said:

25-27a. Then the holy, leading sage was told again by me: “I am completely unattached. I have no passionate liking for human birth. I have this feeling because I have noticed that the life of all embodied beings is like the current of a river. Hence, O highly esteemed one, tell me some excellent Vrata by adopting and practising which I can cease to be in human form, O excellent Brāhmaṇa.”

27b. Then, O great Lord, he thought for a long time and said to me:

## \|\| 1.178.28-30 \|\|

*asti putri vrataṃ puṇyaṃ gaurī tuṣṭikaraṃ param \|*  
*yena cīrṇena vai samyagyoṣiddevatvamāpnuyāt \|\| 28 \|\|*

*gomayākhyā mahādevī kṛtā vai gomayena sā \|*  
*tato golokamāpannāḥ sarvāstā varavarṇini \|\| 29 \|\|*

*tāṃ tvaṃ kuruṣva kalyāṇi yena devatvamāpsyasi \|*  
*tato mayā punaḥ proktaḥ sa muniḥ surasattama \|\| 30 \|\|*

28-30a. “Dear daughter, there is a meritorious Vrata that delights Gaurī much. If that is practised well, a lady shall attain divinity.

The great goddess named Gomayā has been prepared with cow-dung (by many ladies). O lady of excellent complexion, all of them have attained Goloka. O lady of excellent features, perform that rite yourself. You will attain divinity.”

30b. Then, O excellent one among Suras, the sage was once again addressed by me:

## \|\| 1.178.31 \|\|

*kasminkāle prakartavyā vidhinā kena sanmune \|*  
*sarvaṃ vistarato brūhi yena tāṃ prakaromyaham \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. “O excellent sage, on what occasion (month-days) and along what line of procedure should that rite be performed? Mention everything in detail so that I can duly perform it.”

## \|\| 1.178.32 \|\|

*durvāsā uvāca \|*  
*nabhasye cāsite pakṣe tṛtīyādivase sthite \|*  
*prātarutthāya paścācca bhakṣayeddaṃtadhāvanam \|\| 32 \|\|*

Durvāsas said:

32\. On the third lunar day in the dark half of the month of Nabhasya, the devotee gets up early in the morning and then washes the teeth.

## \|\| 1.178.33 \|\|

*tataśca niyamaṃ kṛtvā upavāsasamudbhavam \|*  
*gaurīnāmasamuccārya śraddhāpūtena cetasā \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. Then the devotee observes all regulations pertaining to fast and utters the name of Gaurī with the mind sanctified by perfect faith.

## \|\| 1.178.34 \|\|

*tato niśāgame prāpte kṛtvā gaurīcatuṣṭayam \|*  
*mṛnmayaṃ yādṛśaṃ caiva tadihaikamanāḥ śṛṇu \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. At nightfall Gaurī-Catuṣṭaya (four images of Gaurī) is made out of clay. Listen with attention to how it should be done.

## \|\| 1.178.35 \|\|

*ekā gaurī prakartavyā paṃcapiṃḍā yathoditā \|*  
*prahareprahare prāpte tāsu pūjāṃ samācaret \|*  
*yairmaṃtraistānnibodha tvamekaikasyāḥ pṛthakpṛthak \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. At the beginning of every Prahara (watch of the night) an idol should be made in the form of Pañcapiṇḍa as mentioned before. Then the adoration is to be performed. Listen the Mantras to be recited separately.

## \|\| 1.178.36 \|\|

*himācalagṛhe jātā devi tvaṃ śaṃkarapriye \|*  
*menāgarbhasamudbhūtā pūjāṃ gṛhṇa namostu te \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. “(Mantra) O goddess, O favourite of Śaṅkara, you were born in the abode of Himācala, from the womb of Menā. Accept my adoration. Obeisance to you.”

## \|\| 1.178.37 \|\|

*dhūpaṃ dadyāttataścaiva karpūraṃ śraddhayā saha \|*  
*raktasūtreṇa dīpaṃ ca ghṛtena parikalpayet \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. Then the devotee offers incense and camphor with faith. The Dīpa (lamp) is to be offered with (the wick of) red thread and ghee.

## \|\| 1.178.38 \|\|

*jātipuṣpaiḥ samabhyarcya naivedye modakānnyaset \|*  
*raktavastreṇa saṃchādya arghyaṃ dattvā tataḥ param \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. After adoring with Jāti flowers, sweetmeat is offered as Naivedya covering it with a red cloth. Thereafter, Arghya is to be offered.

## \|\| 1.178.39-40 \|\|

*yasya vṛkṣasya puṣpaṃ ca tasya syāddantadhāvanam \|*  
*mātuliṃgena tasyāstu mantreṇānena bhaktitaḥ \|\| 39 \|\|*

*arghyaṃ dadyātprayatnena gandhapuṣpākṣatānvitam \|*  
*śaṃkarasya priye devi himācalasute śubhe \|*  
*arghyamenaṃ mayā dattaṃ pratigṛhṇa namo'stu te \|\| 40 \|\|*

39-40. The general rule is that the devotee should use as toothpick a twig of the same tree from which the flower has been taken. For this goddess Mātuliṅga (Pomegranate) is to be used with this Mantra for Arghya offering along with scents, flowers and raw rice grain: O goddess, O beloved of Śaṅkara. O splendid daughter of Himālaya mountain, Arghya has been offered by me; do accept it. Obeisance to you.”

## \|\| 1.178.41 \|\|

*tadeva prāśanaṃ kuryāttataḥ kāyaviśuddhaye \|*  
*praharāṃte ca saṃpūjya ardhanārīśvaraṃ tataḥ \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. For the purity of the body, the same is taken in after the end of every Prahara and the deity Ardhanārīśvara is to be worshipped.

## \|\| 1.178.42 \|\|

*surabhyā pūjayedbhaktyā mantreṇānena pārvati \|*  
*vāmamardhaṃ śarīrasya yā harasya vyavasthitā \|*  
*sā me pūjāṃ pragṛhṇātu tasyai devyai namo'stu te \|\| 42 \|\|*

42\. Then the devotee worships with (scents?) uttering this Mantra: “O Pārvatī, Obeisance to you who constitute the left half of the body of Hara. May that goddess accept my worship.”

## \|\| 1.178.43 \|\|

*agaruṃ ca tato bhaktyā dhūpaṃ dadyāttathā śubhe \|*  
*naivedye guṇakāṃścaiva nālikereṇa cārghakam \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. Then, with devotion Again is offered as incense Gaṇakas (threads) are placed on the Naivedya offering. The Arghaka is offered with coconut.

## \|\| 1.178.44-45 \|\|

*mantreṇānena dātavyaṃ tadeva prāśanaṃ smṛtam \|*  
*ardhanārīśvarau yau ca saṃsthitau parameśvarau \|\| 44 \|\|*

*arghyo me gṛhyatāṃ devau syātaṃ sarvasukhapradau \|*  
*tṛtīye prahare prāpte śatapatryā prapūjayet \|\| 45 \|\|*

44-45. It should be offered with this Mantra: The Prāśana (what is taken in) is the same. “O Ardhanārīśvaras, O two great deities, you are the bestowers of happiness on all. Ṃay the Arghya be received.”

In the third Prahara, the devotee worships with Śatapatrī (lotus leaves).

## \|\| 1.178.46 \|\|

*umāmaheśvarau devau maṃtreṇānena pūjayet \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. The devotee shall worship the deities Umā and Maheśvara with this Mantra:

## \|\| 1.178.47 \|\|

*umāmaheśvarau devau yau tau sṛṣṭilayānvitau \|*  
*tau gṛhṇītāmimāṃ pūjāṃ mayā dattāṃ prabhaktitaḥ \|\| 47 \|\|*

47\. “May the deities Umā and Maheśvara who are invariably present at the time of creation and dissolution accept this adoration of mine offered with great devotion.”

## \|\| 1.178.48 \|\|

*guggulotthaṃ tato dhūpaṃ naivedyaṃ ghārikātmakam \|*  
*jātīphalena cārghyaṃ ca tadeva prāśanaṃ smṛtam \|\| 48 \|\|*

48\. The incense is from Guggula and the Naivedya is in the form of Ghārikā (a fried pie). The Arghya consists of Jātī fruit and the same is remembered as Prāśana (things taken in or eaten).

## \|\| 1.178.49-51 \|\|

*tataścārghyaḥ pradātavyo maṃtreṇānena bhaktitaḥ \|*  
*graṃthicūrṇena dhūpaṃ ca arghyaṃ madanajaṃ phalam \|\| 49 \|\|*

*tadeva prāśanaṃ kāryaṃ tataḥ kāyaviśuddhaye \|\| 50 \|\|*

*umāmaheśvarau devau sarvakāmasukhapradau \|*  
*gṛhṇītāmarghyametaṃ me dayāṃ kṛtvā mahattamām \|\| 51 \|\|*

49-51. Thereafter the Arghya is to be given devoutly with this Mantra: “May the deities Umā and Meheśvara who bestow all desires and happiness, take great pity on me and accept this Arghya.” The incense is in the form of Granthicūṛna (fragrant powder of Granthiparṇa); the Arghya is Madana fruit. For the sake of the purity of the body, the same is taken in.

## \|\| 1.178.52 \|\|

*caturthe prahare prāpte tāṃ gaurīṃ paṃcapiṃḍikām \|*  
*bhṛṃgarājena saṃpūjya maṃtreṇānena bhaktitaḥ \|\| 52 \|\|*

52\. In the fourth Prahara, the devotee worships Gaurī Pañcapiṇḍikā by means of Bhṛṅgarāja, uttering this Mantra with devotion:

## \|\| 1.178.53 \|\|

*pṛthivyādīni bhūtāni yāni proktāni paṃca ca \|*  
*paṃcarūpāṇi deveśi pūjāṃ gṛhṇa namo'stu te \|\| 53 \|\|*

53\. “O goddess of Devas, your five forms are Pṛthivī etc., that have been mentioned as the five Bhūtas (five elements). Accept this adoration. Obeisance to you.”

## \|\| 1.178.54 \|\|

*naivedye ghṛtapūpāṃśca dadyāddevyāḥ prabhaktitaḥ \|*  
*graṃthicūrṇena dhūpaṃ ca hyarghyaṃ madanajaṃ phalam \|*  
*tadeva prāśanaṃ kāryamarghyamaṃtramidaṃ smṛtam \|\| 54 \|\|*

54\. By way of Naivedya, the devotee should give pies cooked in ghee to the goddess with great devotion. The incense is in the form of Granthicūrṇa. The fruit of Madana is used for Arghya. The same is to be taken in as Prāśana. The following is remembered as Arghya Mantra:

## \|\| 1.178.55 \|\|

*paṃcabhūtamayī devī paṃcadhā yā vyavasthitā \|*  
*arghyamenaṃ mayā dattaṃ sā gṛhṇātu sure śvarī \|\| 55 \|\|*

55\. “Let that goddess of Suras accept this Arghya offered by me to the goddess who appears in five ways consisting of the five Bhūtas.”

## \|\| 1.178.56 \|\|

*evaṃ sarvā niśā sā ca gītavādyādiniḥsvanaiḥ \|*  
*tāsāṃ caivāgrato neyā naiva nidrāṃ samācaret \|\| 56 \|\|*

56\. In this manner, the entire night should be passed in front of them (i.e. the five Piṇḍikās) while listening to vocal and instrumental music etc. all the time. The devotee should not go to sleep (during that night).

## \|\| 1.178.57 \|\|

*tataḥ prabhāte vimale prodgate ravimaṇḍale \|*  
*snātvā saṃpūjayedvipraṃ saha patnyā prabhaktitaḥ \|\| 57 \|\|*

57\. When the day has dawned and the solar disc devoid of impurities has risen, the devotee with great devotion should complete bath and adoration and honour a Brāhmaṇa, along with his wife.

## \|\| 1.178.58 \|\|

*vastrairābharaṇaiścaiva svaśaktyā nṛpanaṃdini \|*  
*gauryai bhakṣyaṃ ca dātavyaṃ miṣṭānnena śucismite \|\| 58 \|\|*

58\. O princess of pure smiles, the Brāhmaṇa should be honoured with garments and ornaments according to one’s capacity. Food along with sweet pudding should be given to a Gaurī (girl of eight years).

## \|\| 1.178.59 \|\|

*tataḥ kareṇumānīya vaḍavāṃ vā sumadhyame \|*  
*gaurīcatuṣṭayaṃ tacca samāropya tathopari \|\| 59 \|\|*

59\. Then, O lady of excellent waistline, either a mare or a she-elephant should be brought and the four images of Gaurī should be placed on her.

## \|\| 1.178.60 \|\|

*gītavāditraśabdena vedadhvaniyutena ca \|*  
*nadyāṃ vā'tha taḍāge vā vāpyāṃ vātha parikṣipet \|\| 60 \|\|*

60\. The procession is to be taken out with the accompaniment of singing and playing musical instruments and the chanting of the Vedas. The images are to be immersed in a lake or a tank.

## \|\| 1.178.61 \|\|

*maṃtreṇānena sadbhaktyā tavedaṃ vacmi sundari \|\| 61 \|\|*

61\. The following Mantras should be uttered with excellent devotion. O beautiful lady, I shall mention it to you:

## \|\| 1.178.62 \|\|

*āhūtāsi mayā devi pūjitāsi mayā śubhe \|*  
*mama saubhāgyadānāya yatheṣṭaṃ gamyatāmiti \|\| 62 \|\|*

62\. “O goddess of great splendour, you have been invoked and adored by me. Now may it please you to grant conjugal felicity to me and to proceed ahead as you please.”

## \|\| 1.178.63 \|\|

*lakṣmīruvāca \|*  
*evaṃ mayā kṛtā deva sā tṛtīyā yathoditā \|*  
*nabhasye māsi saṃprāpte bhaktyā paramayā vibho \|\| 63 \|\|*

Lakṣmī said:

63\. Thus, O Lord, the adoration was performed by me on that third lunar day in the month of Nabhasya with great devotion.

## \|\| 1.178.64 \|\|

*dvitīye ca tathā prāpte tṛtīye ca viśeṣataḥ \|*  
*yāvatpaśyāmi pratyūṣe tāvadgaurīcatuṣṭayam \|*  
*jātaṃ ratnamayaṃ tacca mayā yatparipūjitam \|\| 64 \|\|*

64\. The second and third Praharas passed by and at the time of dawn what do I see? The four images of Gaurī that had been adored by me had become embellished with jewels.

## \|\| 1.178.65 \|\|

*prasthitāṃ māṃ nadītīramuddiśya ca visarjanam \|*  
*kariṣyāmīti sā prāha vyaktībhūtā sureśvarī \|\| 65 \|\|*

65\. Thinking ‘I shall perform the Visarjana (ritualistic dismissal)’ I set off towards the banks of the river. Then the goddess of Suras manifested herself and said:

## \|\| 1.178.66-68 \|\|

*mā putri jalamadhye'tra mama mūrticatuṣṭayam \|*  
*paribhāvaya madvākyaṃ śrutvā caiva vidhīyatām \|\| 66 \|\|*

*hāṭakeśvaraje kṣetre sthāpaya tvaṃ ca mā kṣipa \|*  
*akṣayaṃ jāyate yena sarvastrīṇāṃ hitāya ca \|\| 67 \|\|*

*tvaṃ prārthaya varaṃ sarvaṃ dadāmyahamihārcitā \|*  
*abhyarcitā girisutā mayā proktā sureśvarī \|\| 68 \|\|*

66-68. “O daughter, do not cast my four images into the water. Listen to my words, Ponder over them and carry out the injunctions.

Do not cast them away. Install them in Hāṭakeśvara Kṣetra. It will remain everlasting and be conducive to the welfare of all women. Do request for the boon. On being adored here I shall grant you everything.”

The goddess of Suras, the Daughter of the Mountain was adored by me and told thus:

## \|\| 1.178.69-72 \|\|

*yadi yacchasi me devi varaṃ tuṣṭā sureśvari \|*  
*tadahaṃ mānuṣe garbhe mā bhūyāsaṃ kathaṃcana \|\| 69 \|\|*

*bharttā bhavatu me viṣṇuḥ śāśvatābhīṣṭadaḥ sadā \|*  
*nānyatkiṃcidabhīṣṭaṃ me rājyaṃ tridivaśobhanam \|\| 70 \|\|*

*anyāpi kurute yā ca vratametatsamāhitā \|*  
*sarvairtratairyathātuṣṭistathā devi prajāyate \|\| 71 \|\|*

*tathā tasyāḥ prakartavyamakenānena pārvati \|*  
*tatheti gaurī māmuktvā tataścādarśanaṃ gatā \|\| 72 \|\|*

69-72. “O goddess of Suras, if you are pleased and if you wish to grant me a boon, let me not be born in human womb at all. Let Viṣṇu, the bestower of what is always desired, be my husband. Nothing else such as splendid heavenly kingdom, is desired by me. If any other woman performs this Vrata with great concentration, O goddess, let the satisfaction be the same as with the performance of all the Vratas (collectively). O Pārvatī, you must bring that about solely through this one Vrata.”

Gaurī told me “So be it” and then vanished.

## \|\| 1.178.73 \|\|

*sā devī ca mayā tatra tacca gaurīcatuṣṭayam \|*  
*hāṭakeśvaraje kṣetre śubhe saṃsthāpitaṃ vibho \|\| 73 \|\|*

73\. O my Lord, that goddess, namely the four images of Gaurī, were installed by me in the splendid Hāṭakeśvara Kṣetra.

## \|\| 1.178.74 \|\|

*tatprabhāvānmayā labdho bharttā tvaṃ parameśvara \|*  
*śāśvataścākṣayaścaiva mukhaprekṣaśca sarvadā \|\| 74 \|\|*

74\. By her power, O great Lord, you are obtained by me as my husband. You are eternal and everlasting. You are always my Mukhaprekṣa (one who eagerly looks at the face of another).

## \|\| 1.178.75 \|\|

*etatta sarvamākhyātaṃ yatpṛṣṭāsmi sureśvara \|*  
*satyenānena deveśa tava pādau spṛśāmyaham \|\| 75 \|\|*

75\. O god of Suras, I have entirely told you what I had been asked. O Lord of Devas, as the proof of the veracity of this I touch your feet.

## \|\| 1.178.76 \|\|

*sūta uvāca \|*  
*tacchrutvā vacanaṃ tasyāḥ śaṃkhacakragadādharaḥ \|*  
*vihasyātha mahālakṣmīṃ tāmuvāca praharṣitaḥ \|*  
*muhurmuhuḥ samāliṃgya vakṣasaścopari sthitām \|\| 76 \|\|*

Sūta said:

76\. On hearing her words the weilder of conch, discus and club became delighted. He laughed and repeatedly embraced her keeping her close to his chest and said:

## \|\| 1.178.77 \|\|

*sādhumādhu mahābhāge satyametattvayoditam \|*  
*jānatāpi mayā pṛṣṭā bhavatīṃ varavarṇini \|\| 77 \|\|*

77\. “O highly esteemed one, excellent! excellent! It is the truth that has been mentioned by you. O lady of excellent complexion, you were asked by me, though I already knew it.”

## \|\| 1.178.78 \|\|

*sūta uvāca \|*  
*etadvaḥ sarvamākhyātaṃ yatpṛṣṭo'smi dvijottamāḥ \|*  
*caturbhujā yathā gaurī saṃjātā paṃcapiṃḍikā \|\| 78 \|\|*

Sūta said:

78\. Thus, O excellent Brāhmaṇas, everything that I was asked has been narrated to you all as to how the four-armed Gaurī became one of five Piṇḍikās.

## \|\| 1.178.79 \|\|

*yaścaitatpaṭhate bhaktyā prātarutthāya mānavaḥ \|*  
*na sa lakṣmyā vimucyeta na ca daurbhāgyamāpnuyāt \|\| 79 \|\|*

79\. A man who gets up early in the morning and read this devoutly will never be bereft of Lakṣmī (prosperity and glory) nor will he meet with bad luck.

## \|\| 1.178.80 \|\|

*tasmātsarvaprayatnena paṭhanīyamidaṃ śubham \|*  
*ākhyānaṃ gaurikaṃ viprā yanmayā parikīrtitam \|\| 80 \|\|*

80\. Hence, O Brāhmaṇas, this splendid narrative of Gaurī expatiated upon by me, should be read with all efforts.

## Chapter 179 - Rites Preliminary to Yajñas

## \|\| 1.179.1-3 \|\|

*sūta uvāca \|*  
*tathānyadapi tatrāsti puṣkaratritayaṃ śubham \|*  
*hāṭakeśvaraje kṣetre sarvapātakanāśanam \|\| 1 \|\|*

*yasmindṛṣṭe'thavā spṛṣṭe kīrtite vā dvijottamāḥ \|*  
*pātakaṃ nāśamāyāti bhāskareṇa tamo yathā \|\| 2 \|\|*

*punaṃti sarvatīrthāni snānāddānādasaṃśayam \|*  
*puṣkarālokanādeva sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate \|\| 3 \|\|*

Sūta said:

1-3. Further, there are other holy sites also in the Hāṭakeśvara Kṣetra that are destructive of all sins. They are the three Puṣkaras.

If they are visited, touched or glorified, O excellent Brāhmaṇas, sin is dispelled like darkness by the Sun.

All the (other) Tīrthas undoubtedly sanctify through holy bath and offering of gifts. But one is relieved of all sins merely by visiting the Puṣkaras.

## \|\| 1.179.4 \|\|

*ṛṣaya ūcuḥ \|*  
*śrūyate puṣkaraṃnāma tīrthaṃ trailokyaviśrutam \|*  
*brahmaṇā nirmitaṃ tatra yacca yojanamātrakam \|\| 4 \|\|*

The sages said:

4\. The Tīrtha named Puṣkara, well-known in all the three worlds in heard about (by us). It was created by Brahmā. It extends to a Yojana.

## \|\| 1.179.5 \|\|

*uttare candrabhāgāyā nadyā yāvatsarasvatī \|*  
*dakṣiṇe karatoyāyāḥ sīmeyaṃ puṣkaratraye \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. On the north of the river Candrabhāgā it extends upto Sarasvatī. On the south the limit of the three Puṣkaras is Karatoyā.

## \|\| 1.179.6 \|\|

*asmākaṃ tu purā sūta tvayoktaṃ viyati sthitam \|*  
*etannaḥ kautukaṃ sūta tatkathaṃ hāṭakeśvare \|*  
*tatra kṣetre samāyātaṃ tasmāttvaṃ vaktumarhasi \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. This was formerly spoken to us, O Sūta, as being present in the sky. This is our curiosity. How has it come to Hāṭakeśvara Kṣetra? It behoves you to explain.

## \|\| 1.179.7 \|\|

*sūta uvāca \|*  
*satyametanmahābhāgā yadbhavadbhirudāhṛtam \|*  
*tasminkṣetre dvijaśreṣṭhāstacchṛṇudhvaṃ samāhitāḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

Sūta said:

7\. O highly esteemed ones, what has been said by you all is true. Now, O excellent Brāhmaṇas, listen with concentration in regard to that holy spot.

## \|\| 1.179.8 \|\|

*sarvato vistarādvacmi namaskṛtya svayaṃ bhuvam \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. After bowing down to the Self-born Lord, I shall tell everything in detail.

## \|\| 1.179.9 \|\|

*brahmaloke nivasato brahmaṇo'vyaktajanmanaḥ \|*  
*devarṣirnāradaḥ prāpto bhrāṃtvā lokatrayaṃ muniḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. While Brahmā, the Avyaktajanman (One whose origin is unmanifest), was staying in Brahmaloka, Sage Nārada, the celestial sage, came there after wandering over all the three worlds.

## \|\| 1.179.10 \|\|

*sa natvā śirasā pādāvupaviṣṭasta dagrataḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. He bowed down the head and touched his (Brahmā’s) feet. Then he sat in front of him.

## \|\| 1.179.11 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*kasmādvatsa cirāddṛṣṭaḥ kutaḥ prāpto'dhunā bhavān \|*  
*kva bhrāṃtastvaṃ samācakṣva brūhi vatsātra kāraṇam \|\| 11 \|\|*

Brahmā said:

11\. O dear son, how is it that I see you after a long time? Where are you coming from? where have you been wandering? Dear son, tell me the reason thereof.

## \|\| 1.179.12 \|\|

*nārada uvāca \|*  
*martyalokādvibho prāptaḥ sāṃprataṃ ca tvarānvitaḥ \|*  
*tava pādaprapūjārthaṃ satyenātmānamālabhe \|\| 12 \|\|*

Nārada said:

12\. O Lord, I have reached this place hurriedly from the world of the mortals in order to worship your feet. I touch (swear) myself on the truth of this statement.

## \|\| 1.179.13 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*kiṃvadantīṃ mamācakṣva martyalokasamudbhavām \|*  
*kīdṛśāḥ pārthivāstatra kīdṛśā dvijasattamāḥ \|*  
*kīdṛśā vyavahārāśca vartante tatra sāṃpratam \|\| 13 \|\|*

Brahmā said:

13\. Tell me the news of the human world. Of what sort are the kings there? Of what sort are the Brāhmaṇas? What sort of dealings abound there now?

## \|\| 1.179.14 \|\|

*nārada uvāca \|*  
*martyaloke kalirjātaḥ sāṃprataṃ surasattama \|\| 14 \|\|*

Nārada said:

14\. O most excellent one among Suras, there is the onset of Kali in the human world now.

## \|\| 1.179.15 \|\|

*rājānaḥ satpathaṃ tyaktvā tathā lobhaparāyaṇāḥ \|*  
*pīḍayaṃti ca lokāṃśca arthahetoḥ sunirghṛṇāḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. The kings abandon the path of the good; they are greedy. For the sake of money they trouble all the people very ruthlessly.

## \|\| 1.179.16 \|\|

*śauryabhāvaparityaktāḥ paradāravimardakāḥ \|*  
*pūjayanti na te viprānna devānna gurūnapi \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. They have eschewed the noble quality of heroism. They oppress the wives of others. They do not revere or honour Brāhmaṇas, deities and elders.

## \|\| 1.179.17 \|\|

*vedavikraya kartāro brāhmaṇāḥ śaucavarjitāḥ \|*  
*pāpapratigrahāsaktāḥ sandhyāhīnāḥ sunirghṛṇāḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. Brāhmaṇas never hesitate to sell the Vedas. They are devoid of purities. They are greedy to accept gifts even from sinners. They are not regular in the performance of Sandhyā prayers. They are extremely merciless.

## \|\| 1.179.18 \|\|

*kṛṣikarmaratā nityaṃ vaiśyavatpaśupālakāḥ \|*  
*vaiśyāḥ sarve samucchedaṃ prayātā dharaṇītale \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. They are always engaged in agricultural activities. They breed cattle like Vaiśyas. Original Vaiśyas have disappeared from the earth.

## \|\| 1.179.19 \|\|

*śūdrā nityaṃ dharmakāmāḥ śūdrāścaiva tapasvinaḥ \|*  
*lokayātrākriyāḥ sarve prahasaṃti vyapatrapāḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. The Śūdras have become desirous of performing pious rites. These very Śūdras have become ascetics too. All of them are shameless and they laugh derisively at worldly activities engaged in for the sake of earthly existence.

## \|\| 1.179.20 \|\|

*yasya cāsti gṛhe vittaṃ taruṇyaśca tathā striyaḥ \|*  
*tenatena samaṃ sakhyaṃ prakurvanti narā bhuvi \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. On the earth, men cultivate friendly relations with (whatever) person in whose house there is affluence and young women as well.

## \|\| 1.179.21 \|\|

*vidhavānāṃ vratasthānāṃ sarveṣāṃ liṃgināṃ tathā \|*  
*hṛdi sthito mahānkāmo vratacaryābahiḥsthitāḥ \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. Great lust has entered into the heart of widows, persons observing Vratas and even in religious students.

## \|\| 1.179.22 \|\|

*tīrthāni viplavaṃ yāṃtipāpalokaśritāni ca \|*  
*kalebhīṃtāni sarvāṇi pradravanti diśo daśa \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. All the Tīrthas undergo great upheaval. They are resorted to by sinful people. All of them are frightened of the Kali age and they run about here and there in all the ten directions.

## \|\| 1.179.23 \|\|

*ahaṃ tatra sthito yasmātkalikāle pitāmaha \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. O Pitāmaha, I too was affected while staying there because it was the Kali age.

## \|\| 1.179.24 \|\|

*kalikāle viśeṣeṇa svairiṇyo lalitaspṛhāḥ \|*  
*bhartrā vivadamānāśca striyaḥ kārmaṇatatparāḥ \|*  
*vṛthā vratāni kurvaṃti tyaktvā tāḥ svapateḥ kathām \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. In the Kali age unchaste women are too fond of delicate things. Women argue with their husbands and they are interested in their special work or witchcraft. They ignore the interests of their husbands and perform Vratas which are futile.

## \|\| 1.179.25 \|\|

*kalirbaliṣṭhaḥ sutarāṃ varadānena te kṛtaḥ \|*  
*yadā martye bhavedyuddhaṃ kaṃḍūtirjāyate hṛdi \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. The Kali age has been rendered very powerful by your boons. Whenever there is a battle in the human world I get an itching sensation in the heart.

## \|\| 1.179.26-28 \|\|

*svarge vā mastake caiva pātāle cātha pādayoḥ \|*  
*sāṃprataṃ martyaloke ca mayā dṛṣṭamanekaśaḥ \|\| 26 \|\|*

*śvaśrūṇāṃ ca vadhūnāṃ ca tathā janakaputrayoḥ \|*  
*bāṃdhavānāṃ viśeṣeṇa tathā ca svāmibhṛtyayoḥ \|\| 27 \|\|*

*caurāṇāṃ pārthivānāṃ ca dampatyośca viśeṣataḥ \|*  
*svalpodakāstathā meghāḥ svalpasasyā ca medinī \|\| 28 \|\|*

26-28. When there is a battle in heaven there is an itching sensation in the head and when there is a battle in Pātāla, there is an itching sensation in the feet. Now in the human world mutual quarrels and battles have been seen by me many times between mothers-in-law and daughters-in-law, between fathers and sons, between kinsmen, and between masters and servants. There are fights between thieves and kings and even between married pairs (couples). Clouds contain meagre water and the earth produces very little vegetation (food-grain).

## \|\| 1.179.29 \|\|

*svalpakṣīrāstathā gāvaḥ kṣīre sarpirna vidyate \|*  
*evaṃ yuddhāni teṣāṃ ca vīkṣamāṇo divāniśam \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. Cows yield very little quantity of milk. Milk does not contain adequate fat content (ghee).

Thus I observed their battles day and night.

## \|\| 1.179.30 \|\|

*ahaṃ martye paribhrāṃtaścirāttena samāgataḥ \|*  
*bhūyo yāsyāmi tatraiva kaṇḍūtirmahatīsthitā \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. I wandered over the mortal world for long, having come into contact with it after some time. I will go there once more. There is a great itching sensation.

## \|\| 1.179.31 \|\|

*tacchrutvā vacanaṃ tasya nāradasya pitāmahaḥ \|*  
*puṣkarasya kṛte jātaścintāvyāku lateṃdriyaḥ \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. On hearing the words of Nārada, Pitāmaha became worried and all his senses became distressed out of consideration for Puṣkara.

## \|\| 1.179.32-35 \|\|

*martye ca māmakaṃ tīrthaṃ puṣkaraṃnāma viśrutam \|*  
*nāśaṃ yāsyati tannūnaṃ kalikālapariplutam \|\| 32 \|\|*

*tasmādanyatra neṣyāmi kaliryatra na vidyate \|*  
*yena tatra vimuṃcāmi nijaṃ tīrthaṃ ca puṣkaram \|\| 33 \|\|*

*kalikāle ca saṃprāpte sarvaprāṇibhayaṃkare \|*  
*tatra prayāṃtu tīrthāni sarvā ṇyeva viśeṣataḥ \|\| 34 \|\|*

*gate kalau prayāsyaṃti nijasthānamasaṃśayam \|\| 35 \|\|*

32-35. He thought thus ‘My Tīrtha in the mortal world named Puṣkara is well-known. It will certainly be destroyed on being overcome by the Kali age. Hence I shall take it to another place where Kali is not present. I shall leave my Tīrtha named Puṣkara there.

At the advent of the Kali Age that is terrifying unto all living beings, let all the Tīrthas proceed there. When Kali age (being over) departs they will undoubtedly return to their own place.’

## \|\| 1.179.36 \|\|

*evaṃ niścitya manasā hastasthaṃ kamalaṃ tataḥ \|*  
*provāca sādaraṃ tacca svayaṃ dhyātvā pitāmahaḥ \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. After thinking thus in mind, after pondering over it mentally, Pitāmaha eagerly spoke to the Lotus in his hand:

## \|\| 1.179.37 \|\|

*pata tvaṃ padma bhūpṛṣṭhe kaliryatra na vidyate \|*  
*yenānayāmi tatraiva puṣkaraṃ tīrthamātmanaḥ \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. “O Lotus, do fall down to the ground where there is no (influence or existence of) Kali, so that I can bring my Tīrtha Puṣkara there.”

## \|\| 1.179.38 \|\|

*tatastatpreṣitaṃ tena padmaṃ bhrāṃtvā mahītale \|*  
*samaste patitaṃ kṣetre hāṭakeśvarasaṃbhave \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. Then the lotus sent by him wandered over the whole of the earth and fell on the Hāṭakeśvara Kṣetra.

## \|\| 1.179.39 \|\|

*dṛṣṭvā vedavido viprānsvādhyāyaniratāñchucīn \|*  
*teṣāṃ yajñakriyābhiśca yajñopāṃtaiḥ samaṃtataḥ \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. (In the course of its reconnaissance the Lotus saw these things:) The pure Brāhmaṇas, conversant with the Vedas, were enagaged in chanting the texts. Their Yajña rites proceeded without hindrance.

## \|\| 1.179.40 \|\|

*yūpādyaiḥ sarvato vyāpte sadiśe gaganāṃgaṇe \|*  
*ṛgyajuḥsāmaghoṣeṇa tathā cātharvajena ca \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. All the quarters were full of the Yūpas (sacrificial posts). In the courtyard of the firmament there was the chanting sound of the Mantras of Ṛk, Yajus, Sāman and Atharvan.

## \|\| 1.179.41 \|\|

*digmaṇḍale tathā vyāpte nānyaḥ saṃśrūyate dhvaniḥ \|*  
*tathā ca tārkikāṇāṃ ca vivādeṣu mahatsu ca \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. When this chanting sound rose up and spread over the quarters no other sound could be heard.

In some places there were great discussions and argumentation of Tārkikas.

## \|\| 1.179.42 \|\|

*vedāṃtānāṃ samastānāṃ vyākhyāne bahudhā kṛte \|*  
*dṛśyante munayo yatra saṃsthitā niyameṣu ca \|\| 42 \|\|*

42\. The entire range of the Vedāntas was being commented upon (discussed) in various ways. The sages were seen engaged in their regular observances.

## \|\| 1.179.43 \|\|

*ekāhārā nirāhārā ekāṃtarakṛtāśanāḥ \|*  
*trirātropoṣitāścānye kṛcchracāṃdrāyaṇe ratāḥ \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. Some took only a single meal per day. Some observed complete fast. Some took food on alternate days. Others observed fast for three days together. Still others were engaged in Kṛcchra Cāndrāyaṇa rites (expiation).

## \|\| 1.179.44 \|\|

*mahāpārākiṇaścānye tathā māsopavāsinaḥ \|*  
*aśmakuṭṭāśinaścānye dantolūkhalikāstathā \|\| 44 \|\|*

44\. Others observed the Mahāpārāka rites. Others observed fast for the whole of a month. Still others were Aśmakuṭṭāśins (eating only what is ponded between two slabs). A few others were Dantolūkhalikas (i.e. they crushed the grains with their teeth used as mortars).

## \|\| 1.179.45 \|\|

*śīrṇaparṇāśinaścaike phalāhārā maharṣayaḥ \|*  
*taddṛṣṭvā tādṛśaṃ kṣetraṃ saṃyuktaṃ vividhairguṇaiḥ \|\| 45 \|\|*

45\. A few ate withered leaves. There were great sages having fruits for food. (The Lotus) saw the holy spot rich with different kinds of good qualities and features.

## \|\| 1.179.46 \|\|

*tatastatpatitaṃ tatra puṇyaṃ jñātvā mahītale \|*  
*yatra sthāne'patatpūrvaṃ tasmāduccalitaṃ punaḥ \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. It knew that spot as sacred and fell on to the ground. It then rose up from the place where it fell before.

## \|\| 1.179.47 \|\|

*anyasmiṃśca tataḥ sthāne dvitīye dvijasattamāḥ \|*  
*tasmādapi tṛtīye tu tṛtīyaṃ paṃkajaṃ hitam \|\| 47 \|\|*

47\. O excellent Brāhmaṇas, it then fell down on a second spot. Then for the third time, the Lotus rose up and fell on another spot.

## \|\| 1.179.48 \|\|

*tato gartātrayaṃ jātaṃ teṣu sthāneṣu ca triṣu \|*  
*gartāsu ca jala jātaṃ svacchaṃ sphaṭikasaṃnibham \|\| 48 \|\|*

48\. Three pits took shape in the three spots. Crystal clear water filled those pits.

## \|\| 1.179.49 \|\|

*etasminnaṃtare prāptaḥ svayameva pitāmahaḥ \|*  
*tatra sthāne dvijaśreṣṭhā yajñakarmaprasiddhaye \|\| 49 \|\|*

49\. In the meantime, Pitāmaha himself came to that spot, O excellent Brāhmaṇas, for performing Yajña rites.

## \|\| 1.179.50 \|\|

*dṛṣṭvā samaṃtataḥ kṣetraṃ hāṭakeśvarasaṃjñitam \|*  
*nānāvipraiḥ samākīrṇaṃ vedavedāṃgapāragaiḥ \|*  
*tapasvibhistathānekairvratacaryāparāyaṇaiḥ \|\| 50 \|\|*

50\. He surveyed all round the holy place named Hāṭakeśvara full of various Brāhmaṇas who had mastered the Vedas and Vedāṅgas. There were ascetics and many others engaged in pursuing Vrata rites.

## \|\| 1.179.51 \|\|

*aho kṣetramaho kṣetraṃ puṇyaṃ ramyaṃ dvijapriyam \|*  
*tasmāyajñaṃ kariṣyāmi kṣetre'smiṃśca dvijāśraye \|\| 51 \|\|*

51\. (Pitāmaha said to himself) Oh, this holy spot is wonderful! It is meritorious, beautiful and liked by the twice-borns. Hence I shall perform a Yajña in this holy spot resorted to by Brāhmaṇas.

## \|\| 1.179.52 \|\|

*ānayiṣyāmi taccāpi puṣkaratritayaṃ śubham \|*  
*gartāsvetāsu puṇyāsu jyeṣṭhaṃ madhyaṃ kanīyakam \|\| 52 \|\|*

52\. I shall bring that splendid trio of Puṣkaras to these holy pits—the superior, the middling and the inferior Puṣkara.

## \|\| 1.179.53 \|\|

*kalikāle ca saṃprāpte yena lopaṃ na gacchati \|*  
*svayaṃ niścitya manasā copaviśya dharātale \|\| 53 \|\|*

53\. When the Kali age arrives they will not get destroyed. He thought thus in his mind. Then he sat on the ground.

## \|\| 1.179.54 \|\|

*dhyātvā ca suciraṃ kālamānayāmāsa tatra ca \|*  
*puṣkaratritayaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ jyeṣṭhamadhyakanīyakam \|\| 54 \|\|*

54\. He meditated for a long time and brought the three Puṣkaras—the superior, the middling and the inferior.

## \|\| 1.179.55-59 \|\|

*tato'bravītsa hṛṣṭātmā hyetaddhi puṣkara trayam \|*  
*mayā samyaksamānītaṃ kalikālabhayena ca \|\| 55 \|\|*

*ye'tra snānaṃ kariṣyaṃti śraddhayā parayā yutāḥ \|*  
*te yāsyaṃti parāṃ siddhimakṣayāṃ matprasādataḥ \|\| 56 \|\|*

*ye ca śrāddhaṃ kariṣyaṃti kārtikyāṃ susamāhitāḥ \|*  
*kariṣyaṃti gayāśīrṣe teṣāṃ puṇyaṃ mahattamam \|\| 57 \|\|*

*tatrādyātpuṣkarātpuṇyaṃ labhiṣyaṃti śatādhikam \|*  
*mayā yajñaḥ kṛtastatra kārtikyāṃ pūrvapuṣkare \|\| 58 \|\|*

*vaiśākhyāṃ ca kariṣyāmi atrāhaṃ ca dvitīyake \|\| 59 \|\|*

55-59. Delighted within himself he spoke: “These three Puṣkaras have been rightly brought here due to the fear of Kali age.

Those who are endowed with perfect faith and take their bath here, will attain great Siddhi that will never get lost with my favour.

Those who perform Śrāddha here on the Kārttikī day with concentration will attain the great merit of performing the Śrāddha in Gayāśīrṣa.

There, from the first Puṣkara, they will get hundred times more merit. Yajña was performed in the Pūrva Puṣkara on the Kārttikī day. Here in the second Puṣkara, I shall perform the Yajña on the Vaiśākhī day.”

## \|\| 1.179.60-62 \|\|

*evamuktvā tato brahmā hyādideśa sadāgatim \|*  
*mamādeśāddrutaṃ vāyo samānaya puraṃdaram \|\| 60 \|\|*

*ādityairvasubhiḥ sārdhaṃ rudraiścaiva marudgaṇaiḥ \|*  
*gaṃdharvairlokapālaiśca siddhairvidyādharaistathā \|\| 61 \|\|*

*yena me syātsahāyatvaṃ samaste yajñakarmaṇi \|*  
*tacchrutvā sakalaṃ vāyurgatvā śakraniveśanam \|*  
*kathayāmāsa tatsarvaṃ yaduktaṃ parameṣṭhinā \|\| 62 \|\|*

60-62. After speaking thus, Brahmā commanded the Wind-god: “At my behest, O Vāyu, bring Purandara here. Let him be brought along with the Ādityas, Vasus, Rudras, groups of Maruts, Gandharvas, Lokapālas, Siddhas and Vidyādharas. If they come I can be assisted in all the Yajña rites.”

On hearing it completely, Vāyu went to the abode of Śakra and told him everything said by Parameṣṭhin.

## \|\| 1.179.63 \|\|

*satvaraṃ prayayau tatra sarvairdevagaṇaiḥ saha \|*  
*praṇipatya tatastaṃ sa brahmāṇaṃ vākyamabravīt \|\| 63 \|\|*

63\. Then Śakra hurriedly went there along with all the groups of Devas. After bowing to him, he spoke these words to Brahmā:

## \|\| 1.179.64 \|\|

*ādeśo dīyatāṃ deva hyahamākāritastvayā \|*  
*yadarthaṃ tatkariṣyāmi tasmācchīghraṃ nivedaya \|\| 64 \|\|*

64\. “O Lord, may command be given to me. Wherefore have I been summoned? I shall carry it out. So do tell me quickly.”

## \|\| 1.179.65 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*mayā śakrātra cānītaṃ supuṇyaṃ puṣkaratrayam \|*  
*kalikālabhayāccaiva kariṣye tadahaṃ sthiram \|\| 65 \|\|*

Brahmā said:

65\. O Śakra, the highly meritorious trio of Puṣkaras has been brought here due to the fear of Kali age. I want to make them stable.

## \|\| 1.179.66 \|\|

*agniṣṭomatrayaṃ kṛtvā vaiśākhyāṃ ca yathārcitam \|*  
*saṃbhāramāharasvāśu tadarthaṃ sarvameva hi \|\| 66 \|\|*

66\. I wish to perform three Agniṣṭomas as I had performed earlier, on the Vaiśākhī day. Bring all the requisites thereof quickly.

## \|\| 1.179.67 \|\|

*brāhmaṇāṃśca tadarhāṃśca vedavedāṃgapāragān \|*  
*tacchrutvā vinayācchakrastathetyuktvā tvarānvitaḥ \|\| \|*  
*saṃbhārānānayāmāsa tadarhāṃśca dvijottamān \|\| 67 \|\|*

67\. Bring also the Brāhmaṇas who are worthy (qualified) with the full mastery of the Vedas and Vedāṅgas.

On hearing it Śakra said, “So be it". Hurriedly he brought the requisites and the Brāhmaṇas qualified for the same.

## \|\| 1.179.68 \|\|

*tataścakāra vidhivadyajñaṃ sa prapitāmahaḥ \|*  
*yathoktavidhinā sarvaṃ tathā saṃpūrṇadakṣiṇam \|\| 68 \|\|*

68\. Then Prapitāmaha performed the Yajña duly in accordance with the injunctions with the full complement of monetary gifts.

## Chapter 180 - Brahmā Begins the Yajña

## \|\| 1.180.1 \|\|

*ṛṣaya ūcuḥ \|*  
*atyadbhutamidaṃ sūta yattvayā samudāhṛtam \|*  
*brahmaṇā yatkṛto yajñastatra kṣetre mahātmanā \|\| 1 \|\|*

The sages said:

1\. Thus the story narrated by you that in that holy place Yajña was performed by the noble-souled Brahmā is extremely wonderful, O Sūta.

## \|\| 1.180.2 \|\|

*agniṣṭomādayo yajñā ye vartante dharātale \|*  
*yaṣṭavyasteṣu yajñeṣu sa eva hi sureśvaraḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. There are many Yajñas performed on the earth namely Agniṣṭoma etc. In those Yajñas it is the same Lord of Suras who is worshipped.

## \|\| 1.180.3-5 \|\|

*tenaiva yajatā tatra ko hīṣṭaḥ prabravīhi naḥ \|*  
*ṛtvijaḥ ke sthitāstatra yaistatkarma makhodbhavam \|*  
*tatpratyakṣe kṛtaṃ sarvametannaḥ kautukaṃ param \|\| 3 \|\|*

*kā caiva dakṣiṇā dattā tena teṣāṃ dvijanmanām \|*  
*ko'dhvaryurvihitastatra yena tadyajanaṃ kṛtam \|\| 4 \|\|*

*ko hotā kaśca vā'gnīdhraḥ ko brahmā tatra saṃsthitaḥ \|*  
*udgātā kaḥ sthitastatra hyācāryo yajñakarmaṇi \|\| 5 \|\|*

3-5. But when he himself performs the Yajña what could have been his desire? Do tell us. Who were the Ṛtviks who performed the rites requisite for the Makha? Mention these. Our curiosity is great. What was the Dakṣiṇā (monetary gift) given by him to those Brāhmaṇas who had been employed as Adhvaryu? By whom was the worship carried out? Who was the Hotṛ? Who was the Agnīdhra priest? Who remained as Brahmā? Who was Udgātṛ? Who was the Ācārya in the Yajña rite?

## \|\| 1.180.6 \|\|

*sūta uvāca \|*  
*ahaṃ vaḥ kīrtayiṣyāmi sarvaṃ yajñasya saṃbhavam \|*  
*vṛttāṃtaṃ yacca tatrastha māścaryaṃ dvijapuṃgavāḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

Sūta said:

6\. O excellent Brāhmaṇas, I shall explain unto you all the details regarding the Yajña that took place in such a wonderful manner.

## \|\| 1.180.7 \|\|

*ye sadasyāḥ sthitāstatra ṛtvijaśca dvijottamāḥ \|*  
*dakṣiṇā yāḥ pradattāśca tebhyastena mahātmanā \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. The noble-souled one gave monetary gifts to the members of the assembly present there, namely the Ṛtviks and the excellent Brāhmaṇas.

## \|\| 1.180.8-9 \|\|

*yajatā devadevena brahmaṇā'mitatejasā \|*  
*yajñakāmaṃ caturvaktraṃ jñātvā devaḥ śatakratuḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

*sarvaiḥ suragaṇaiḥ sārdhaṃ sāhāyyārthamupāgataḥ \|*  
*tathā ca bhagavāñchaṃbhuḥ sarvadevagaṇaiḥ saha \|\| 9 \|\|*

8-9. All these things were carried out by Brahmā, the Lord of Devas, who performed the Yajña. He had unmeasurable splendour.

On coming to know that the Four-faced One was desirous of performing the Yajña, Lord Śatakratu came there to extend cooperation and help along with all the groups of Suras. So also came Lord Śaṃbhu with all the deities and Gaṇas (goblins and spirits, his attendants).

## \|\| 1.180.10 \|\|

*tāndṛṣṭvā'bhyāgatānbrahmā martyadharmasamāśritān \|*  
*provāca vinayopetaḥ kṛtāṃjalipuṭaḥ sthitaḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. On seeing that all of them assembled there having resorted to the duties of mortals, Brahmā stood humbly with palms joined in reverence:

## \|\| 1.180.11-12 \|\|

*svāgataṃ vaḥ suraśreṣṭhāḥ prasādaḥ kriyatāṃ mama \|*  
*niviśyatāṃ yathānyāyaṃ sthāneṣu rucireṣu ca \|\| 11 \|\|*

*dhanyo'smyanugṛhīto'smi yadyūyaṃ svayamāgatāḥ \|*  
*maṃtrāhūtā yathā kṛcchrātsarvasatreṣu gacchatha \|\| 12 \|\|*

11-12. “O excellent Suras, welcome to you all; please do me a favour. Be pleased to be seated in the comfortable and pleasant seats in due order.

I am blessed and contented that you have all taken the trouble to come yourselves in the same manner as you take pains to go to all the Sattras on being invoked by Ṃantras.”

## \|\| 1.180.13 \|\|

*devā ūcuḥ \|*  
*yena yaccātra kartavyaṃ tacchīghraṃ vada padmaja \|*  
*yajñe tava mahābhāga tasya tattvaṃ samādiśa \|\| 13 \|\|*

The Devas said:

13\. O Lotus-born One, tell us quickly as to who has to do what part of the job on hand.

## \|\| 1.180.14 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*viśvakarmandrutaṃ gaccha yajñamaṇḍapasiddhaye \|*  
*patnīśālāṃ tataścaiva yajñavedīstathaiva ca \|\| 14 \|\|*

Brahmā said:

14\. O Viśvakarman, hurry up and complete the construction of the Yajña Maṇḍapa, The Patnīśālās (rooms for womenfolk and domestic activities) and Yajñavedis (sacrificial altars) should be erected.

## \|\| 1.180.15 \|\|

*kuṇḍāni caiva sarvāṇi yathāsthāneṣu kāraya \|*  
*yajñapātrāṇi sarvāṇi grahāśca camasāstathā \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. Make all the Kuṇḍas (holy pits) in their respective places. All the utensils, ladles, bowls etc., for the Yajña should be kept ready.

## \|\| 1.180.16 \|\|

*yūpāśca yatpramāṇena kartavyāḥ sacaṣālakāḥ \|*  
*pacanārthaṃ tathā gartāḥ kartavyā yatpramāṇataḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. The Yūpas (sacrificial posts) should be fixed along with Caṣālakas (wooden rings on the top). They should be of the proper size. For the purpose of cooking the oven pits should be dug with the proper sizes and dimensions.

## \|\| 1.180.17 \|\|

*iṣṭikānāṃ sahasrāṇi daśa cāṣṭaśatāni ca \|*  
*kartavyāni tvayā śīghraṃ cayanānīti satvaram \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. Ten thousand eight hundred Iṣṭakas (bricks) should be got ready quickly. Twigs should be stacked immediately.

## \|\| 1.180.18 \|\|

*tathā hiraṇmayaścāpi puruṣaḥ kārya eva hi \|*  
*tathetyuktā tatastvaṣṭā śīghrācchīghrataraṃ yayau \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. The golden image of the Puruṣa should be made there itself.

Saying "So it shall be” Tvaṣṭṛ hastened out.

## \|\| 1.180.19 \|\|

*tatastu padmajaḥ prāha devācāryaṃ bṛha spatim \|*  
*bṛhaspate tvamānīhi yajñārhānṛtvijo'khilān \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. Then the Lotus-born Lord spoke to Bṛhaspati, the preceptor of Devas: “O Bṛhaspati, do fetch all the Ṛtviks qualified for the performance of the Yajña.

## \|\| 1.180.20 \|\|

*yāvatṣoḍaśasaṃkhyāśca nānyasyaitaddhi yujyate \|*  
*tvayā śakra sadā kāryā śuśrūṣā ca dvijanmanām \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. They should be sixteen in number. It is not proper to entrust this task to anyone else. O Śakra, you must always serve and attend to the Brāhmaṇas.

## \|\| 1.180.21 \|\|

*hastapādāvamarddaśca śrāṃtānāṃ pṛṣṭhamarddanam \|*  
*dhanādhyakṣa tvayā deyā dakṣiṇā kālasaṃbhavā \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. The massaging of their hands and feet should be done. If they are very tired their backs should be massaged duly. O Kubera, O presiding deity of wealth, the monetary gifts should be made at the proper time.

## \|\| 1.180.22 \|\|

*suvastrāṇi hiraṇyaṃ ca tathānyadvāpi vāṃchitam \|*  
*tvayā viṣṇo sadā kāryaṃ kṛtyākṛtyaparīkṣaṇam \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. They can be given excellent garments, gold and all other things desired.

O Viṣṇu, supervision of what is to be done and what is not to be done is your duty.

## \|\| 1.180.23 \|\|

*yuktaṃ kṛtamatho naiva sāvadhānena sarvadā \|*  
*lokapālāśca ye sarve rakṣaṃtu sakalā diśaḥ \|*  
*bhūtapretapiśācānāṃ praveśaṃ rākṣasodbhavam \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. You must attentively examine always whether the proper things have been duly completed or not.

May all the Guardians of the Quarters keep watch over all directions. The entry of goblins, ghosts and vampires as well as Rākṣasas should be checked.

## \|\| 1.180.24 \|\|

*yo yaṃ kāmayate kāmaṃ kiṃcidvastraṃ dhanaṃ ca vā \|*  
*vicārya tasya taddeyaṃ sarvayajñādhipena tu \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. If anyone expresses any desire to have anything, say cloth or cash, the superintendent of all the Yajñas should give them the respective things after due consideration.

## \|\| 1.180.25 \|\|

*ādityā vasavo rudrā viśvedevā marudgaṇāḥ \|*  
*bhavaṃtu pariveṣṭāro bhoktukāmajanasya ca \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. Ādityas, Vasus, Rudras, Viśvedevas and groups of Maruts shall be the ones serving food to the people who are desirous of taking meal.”

## \|\| 1.180.26-27 \|\|

*etasminnaṃtare prāpto viśvakarmā tvarānvitaḥ \|*  
*abravītpaṃkajabhavaṃ saṃsiddho yajñamaṇḍapaḥ \|\| 26 \|\|*

*sarvamanyatsamādiṣṭaṃ yattvayoktaṃ caturmukha \|\| 27 \|\|*

26-27. In the meantime, Viśvakarman hurriedly came there and announced to the Lotus-born Lord: “The parlour for the Yajña and everything else commanded by you is fully provided (is ready), O Four-faced Lord.”

## \|\| 1.180.28-29 \|\|

*tato bṛhaspatiḥ prāha samabhyetya pitāmaham \|*  
*samānītā mayā deva brāhmaṇā yajñakarmaṇi \|\| 28 \|\|*

*viprāḥ ṣoḍaśasaṃkhyāśca ṛtvikkarmaṇi yojaya \|*  
*svayaṃ parīkṣya deveśa yajñakarmaprasiddhaye \|\| 29 \|\|*

28-29. Then Bṛhaspati came and told Lord Pitāmaha: “O Lord, Brāhmaṇas to perform the rites of Yajña have been brought by me. The Brāhmaṇas are sixteen in number. Employ them as Ṛtviks, O Lord of Devas. Test them yourself so that the Yajña rite can be faultless.”

## \|\| 1.180.30 \|\|

*tato brahmā svayaṃ dṛṣṭvā tānparīkṣya prayatnataḥ \|*  
*ṛtviktve ca niyojyātha tataścakre tadarhaṇam \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. Then Brahmā saw them and tested them himself carefully. Then he employed them as Ṛtviks and duly honoured them.

## \|\| 1.180.31 \|\|

*ṛṣaya ūcuḥ \|*  
*ṛtvijāṃ caiva sarveṣāṃ sūta nāmāni kīrtaya \|*  
*yena yo vihitastatra padārthaḥ sūta taṃ vada \|\| 31 \|\|*

The sages said:

31\. O Sūta, do enumerate the names of all the Ṛtviks. Do mention which of them carried out which task.

## \|\| 1.180.32 \|\|

*sūta uvāca \|*  
*bhṛgurhautre tatastena vṛto brāhmaṇasattamāḥ \|*  
*maitrāvaruṇasaṃjñastu tathaiva cyavano muniḥ \|\| 32 \|\|*

Sūta said:

32\. Bhṛgu was chosen by him for the office of Hautra, O excellent Brāhmaṇas. Sage Cyavana was named for the post of Maitrāvaruṇa.

## \|\| 1.180.33 \|\|

*acchāvāko marīciśca grāvastudgālavo muniḥ \|*  
*pulastyaśca tathā 'dhvaryuḥ prasthātātriśca saṃsthitaḥ \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. Marīci became Acchāvāka priest, Sage Gālava was the Priest Grāvastut (Eulogiser of the rock). Pulastya was Adhvaryu. Atri remained as Prasthātṛ.

## \|\| 1.180.34 \|\|

*tatra raibhyo munirneṣṭā tatronnetā sanātanaḥ \|*  
*brahmā ca nārado gargo brāhmaṇācchaṃsireva ca \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. Sage Raibhya was the priest Neṣṭṛ. Sanātana was Unnetṛ. Nārada was Brahmā priest. Garga was the priest Brāhmaṇācchaṃsi.

## \|\| 1.180.35 \|\|

*āgnīdhraśca bharadvājo hotā pārāśarastathā \|*  
*tathaiva tatra kṣetre ca udgātā gobhilo muniḥ \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. Bharadvāja was the priest Agnidhra. Parāśara was the Hotṛ. Sage Gobhila was the Udgātṛ in that holy spot.

## \|\| 1.180.36 \|\|

*tathaiva kauthumo jajñe prastautā yajñakarmaṇi \|*  
*śāṃḍilyaḥ pratiharttā ca subrahmaṇyastathāṃgirāḥ \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. Kauthuma became the priest Prestautṛ in the Yajña rite. Śāṇḍilya was the Pratihartṛ priest and Aṅgiras was the priest Subrahmaṇya.

## \|\| 1.180.37 \|\|

*tasya yajñasya siddhyarthamityete ṣoḍaśartvijaḥ \|*  
*vastrābharaṇaśobhāḍhyā vinayena kṛtāśca te \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. These sixteen Ṛtviks collaborated for the fulfilment of the Yajña. They were respectfully rendered splendid through garments and ornaments.

## \|\| 1.180.38 \|\|

*tataḥ kṛtvā svayaṃ brahmā sarveṣāmarhaṇakriyām \|*  
*gṛhyoktena vidhānena tataḥ provāca sādaram \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. After honouring everyone personally in the manner laid down in the Gṛhya Sūtras, Brahmā respectfully spoke to them:

## \|\| 1.180.39 \|\|

*eṣo'ha śaraṇaṃ prāpto yuṣmākaṃ dvijasattamāḥ \|*  
*anugṛhṇīta māṃ sarve dīkṣāyai yajñakarmaṇaḥ \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. “O excellent Brāhmaṇas, I seek refuge in you all. Do bless me for the initiation in the Yajña rite.”

## Chapter 181 - Greatness of Gāyatrī Tīrtha

## \|\| 1.181.1-2 \|\|

*sūta uvāca \|*  
*etasminnaṃtare sarvernāgarairbrāhmaṇottamaiḥ \|*  
*preṣito madhyagastatra gartātīrthasamudbhavaḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

*rere madhyaga gatvā tvaṃ brūhi taṃ kupitāmaham \|*  
*vipravṛtti prahaṃtāraṃ nītimārgavivarjitam \|\| 2 \|\|*

Note: This chapter describes how, due to the mischief of Nārada, god Brahmā had to marry a Brahmanised Vaiśya girl without the knowledge of his first wife Sāvitrī.

Sūta said:

1-2. In the meantime, a Madhyaga (a go-between) hailing from Gartātīrtha was sent by all the excellent Brāhmaṇas, the Nāgaras: “O Madhyaga (Nāgara), go to and tell that Kupitāmaha (Evil Pitāmaha) who has destroyed the means of sustenance of the Brāhmaṇas and who has forsaken the path of justice and fairplay.

## \|\| 1.181.3 \|\|

*etatkṣetraṃ pradattaṃ naḥ pūrveṣāṃ ca dvijanmanām \|*  
*maheśvareṇa tuṣṭena pūrite sarpaje bile \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. ‘This holy spot was granted to the Brāhmaṇas—our ancestors, by serpents.

## \|\| 1.181.4 \|\|

*tasya dattasya cādyaiva pitāmahaśataṃ gatam \|*  
*paṃcottaramasandigdhaṃ yāvattvaṃ kupitāmaha \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. Ending with you, O evil Pitāmaha, one hundred five different Pitāmahas have gone by since the time when that gift was made. There is no doubt about it.

## \|\| 1.181.5 \|\|

*na kenāpi kṛto'smākaṃ tiraskāro yathā'dhunā \|*  
*tvāṃ muktvā pāpakarmāṇaṃ nyāyamārgavivarjitam \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. With the exception of a being of sinful activities who strays away from the path of justice, contempt was never shown to us as is being done now.

## \|\| 1.181.6 \|\|

*nāgarairbrāhmaṇairbāhyaṃ yo'tra yajñaṃ samācaret \|*  
*śrāddhaṃ vā sa hi vadhyaḥ syātsarveṣāṃ ca dvijanmanām \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. He who is outside the clan of Nāgara Brāhmaṇas and performs Śrāddha or Yajña here should be killed by all other Brāhmaṇas.

## \|\| 1.181.7 \|\|

*na tasya jāyate śreyastatsamutthaṃ kathaṃcana \|*  
*etatproktaṃ tadā tena yadā sthānaṃ dadau hi naḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. When he (Śiva) granted us this holy place it was assured by him that he (the outsider) would not derive any benefit at all therefrom.

## \|\| 1.181.8 \|\|

*tasmādyatkuruṣe yajñaṃ brāhmaṇairnāgaraiḥ kuru \|*  
*nānyathā lapsyase kartuṃ jīvadbhirnāgarairdvijaiḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. Hence, whatever Yajña you perform, get the same done by the Nāgara Brāhmaṇas. Otherwise, you will not get an opportunity to perform it as long as the Nāgara Brāhmaṇas are alive.’”

## \|\| 1.181.9-10 \|\|

*evamuktastato gatvā madhyago yatra padmajaḥ \|*  
*yajñamaṇḍapadūrastho brāhmaṇaiḥ parivāritaḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

*yatproktaṃ nāgaraiḥ sarvaiḥ saviśeṣaṃ tadā hi saḥ \|*  
*tacchrutvā padmajaḥ prāha sāṃtvapūrvamidaṃ vacaḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

9-10. On being told thus, the Madhyaga went to the place where the Lotus-born One was present, a bit away from the Yajña pavilion, surrounded by Brāhmaṇas. What was said by all those Nāgaras, he told him with special emphasis. On hearing it the Lotus-born One spoke these words in a conciliatory tone:

## \|\| 1.181.11-13 \|\|

*mānuṣaṃ bhāvamāpanna ṛtvigbhiḥ parivāritaḥ \|*  
*tvayā satyamidaṃ proktaṃ sarvaṃ madhyagasattama \|\| 11 \|\|*

*kiṃ karomi vṛtāḥ sarve mayā te yajñakarmaṇi \|*  
*ṛtvijo'dhvaryu pūrvā ye pramādena na kāmyayā \|\| 12 \|\|*

*tasmādānaya tānsarvānatra sthāne dvijottamān \|*  
*anujñātastu tairyena gacchāmi makhamaṇḍape \|\| 13 \|\|*

11-13. Brahmā had adopted human guise and was surrounded by the Ṛtviks. (He said:) “O excellent Madhyaga, everything said by you is true. What shall I do? All these have been already chosen by me for the performance of Yajña rites—all these Ṛtviks, Adhvaryus and others. They have been chosen by mistake not wilfully.

Hence bring all those excellent Brāhmaṇas here to this holy spot, so that with their permission I shall go to the pavilion of the Makha.”

## \|\| 1.181.14 \|\|

*madhyaga uvāca \|*  
*tvaṃ devatvaṃ parityajya mānuṣaṃ bhāvamāśritaḥ \|*  
*tatkathaṃ te dvijaśreṣṭhāḥ samāgacchaṃti teṃ'tikam \|\| 14 \|\|*

Madhyaga said:

14\. You have set aside your divinity and have adopted human guise and features. Therefore, how can those excellent Brāhmaṇas come near you?

## \|\| 1.181.15 \|\|

*śreṣṭhā gāvaḥ paśūnāṃ ca yathā padmasamudbhava \|*  
*viprāṇāmiha sarveṣāṃ tathā śreṣṭhā hi nāgarāḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. O Lotus-born One, just as cows are the most excellent ones among all animals, so also the Nāgaras are the most excellent ones among Brāhmaṇas.

## \|\| 1.181.16 \|\|

*tatmāccedvāṃchasi prāptiṃ tvametāṃ yajñasaṃbhavām \|*  
*tadbhaktyānāgarānsarvānprasādaya pitāmaha \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. Hence, if you desire the acquisition of the benefit arising from this Yajña, O Pitāmaha, propitiate all the Nāgaras with devotion due to them.

## \|\| 1.181.17 \|\|

*sūta uvāca \|*  
*tacchrutvā padmajo bhīta ṛtvigbhiḥ parivāritaḥ \|*  
*jagāma tatra yatrasthā nāgarāḥ kupitā dvijāḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

Sūta said:

17\. On hearing it, the Lotus-born God became afraid. Surrounded by the Ṛtviks he went to that place where the angry Nāgara Brāhmaṇas were present.

## \|\| 1.181.18 \|\|

*praṇipatya tataḥ sarvānvinayena samanvitaḥ \|*  
*provāca vacanaṃ śrutvā kṛtāṃjalipuṭaḥ sthitaḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. With great humility, he bowed down to all of them. Standing with palms joined in deference, he spoke these words:

## \|\| 1.181.19-23 \|\|

*jānāmyahaṃ dvijaśreṣṭhāḥ kṣetre'sminhāṭa keśvare \|*  
*yuṣmadbāhyaṃ vṛthā śrāddhaṃ yajñakarma tathaiva ca \|\| 19 \|\|*

*kalibhītyā mayā'nītaṃ sthāne'sminpuṣkaraṃ nijam \|*  
*tīrthaṃ ca yuṣmadīyaṃ ca nikṣepo' yaṃsamarpitaḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

*ṛtvijo'mī samānītā guruṇā yajñasiddhaye \|*  
*ajānatā dvijaśreṣṭhā ādhikyaṃ nāgarātmakam \|\| 21 \|\|*

*tasmācca kṣamyatāṃ mahyaṃ yataśca varaṇaṃ kṛtam \|*  
*eteṣāmeva viprāṇāmagniṣṭomakṛte mayā \|\| 22 \|\|*

*etacca māmakaṃ tīrthaṃ yuṣmākaṃ pāpanāśanam \|*  
*bhaviṣyati na sandehaḥ kalikāle'pi saṃsthite \|\| 23 \|\|*

19-23. “O excellent Brāhmaṇas, I do know that in this holy spot of Hāṭakeśvara, Śrāddha and Yajña rites performed by one excluding you all, are futile.

Due to the fear of Kali, my Tīrtha, Puṣkara has been brought by me to this holy spot. This has been dedicated to you all as a deposit.

These Ṛtviks have been brought by Guru (i.e. Bṛhaspati), O excellent Brāhmaṇas, without knowing the superiority of the Nāgaras.

Hence, the fact of my selecting them, my choice of these Brāhmaṇas, for the performance of Agniṣṭoma may be excused.

This Tīrtha of mine shall undoubtedly be destructive of your sins even during the advent of the Kali age.”

## \|\| 1.181.24 \|\|

*brāhmaṇā ūcuḥ \|*  
*yadi tvaṃ nāgarairbāhyaṃ yajñaṃ cātra kariṣyasi \|*  
*tadanye'pi surāḥ sarve tava mārgānuyāyi naḥ \|*  
*bhaviṣyanti tathā bhūpāstatkāryo na makhastvayā \|\| 24 \|\|*

The Brāhmaṇas said:

24\. If you perform the Yajña here excluding the Nāgaras, other Suras also are likely to follow your way. So also the kings of the earth. Hence, the Makha should not be performed by you.

## \|\| 1.181.25 \|\|

*yadyevamapi deveśa yajñakarma kariṣyasi \|*  
*avamanya dvijānsarvākṣipraṃ gacchāsmadaṃtikāt \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. In spite of this, O Lord of Devas, if you are bent upon the performance of the Yajña rites disregarding all of us, the Brāhmaṇas, then go away from our vicinity.

## \|\| 1.181.26 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*adyaprabhṛti yaḥ kaścidyajñamatra kariṣyati \|*  
*śrāddhaṃ vā nāgarairbāhyaṃ vṛthā tatsaṃbhaviṣyati \|\| 26 \|\|*

Brahmā said:

26\. From now onwards if anyone performs Yajña or Śrāddha here excluding the Nāgaras, it shall become futile.

## \|\| 1.181.27 \|\|

*nāgaro'pi ca yo nyatra kaścidyajñaṃ kariṣyati \|*  
*etatkṣetraṃ parityajya vṛthā tatsaṃbhaviṣyati \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. If a Nāgara too leaves this holy spot and performs Yajña elsewhere, it will become futile.

## \|\| 1.181.28 \|\|

*maryādeyaṃ kṛtā viprā nāgarāṇāṃ mayā'dhunā \|*  
*kṛtvā prasādamasmākaṃ yajñārthaṃ dātumarhatha \|*  
*anujñāṃ vidhivadviprā yena yajñaṃ karomyaham \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. O Brāhmaṇas, this line of demarcation has been made unto the Nāgaras. Hence, be pleased to accord due permission to us, O Brāhmaṇas, so that I can perform the Yajña.

## \|\| 1.181.29 \|\|

*sūta uvāca \|*  
*tatastairbrāhmaṇaistuṣṭairanujñātaḥ pitāmahaḥ \|*  
*cakāra vidhivadyajñaṃ ye vṛtā brāhmaṇāśca taiḥ \|\| 29 \|\|*

Sūta said:

29\. Thereupon, Pitāmaha was permitted by those Brāhmaṇas who became pleased. He duly performed the Yajña through the Brāhmaṇas who had been already selected.

## \|\| 1.181.30 \|\|

*viśvakarmā samāgatya tato mastakamaṇḍanam \|*  
*cakāra brāhmaṇaśreṣṭhā nāgarāṇāṃ mate sthitaḥ \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. Viśvakarman who stood by the decision of the Nāgaras came there, O excellent Brāhmaṇas, and embellished the head (of Brahmā).

## \|\| 1.181.31 \|\|

*brahmāpi paramaṃ toṣaṃ gatvā nāradamabravīt \|*  
*sāvitrīmānaya kṣipraṃ yena gacchāmi maṇḍape \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. Brahmā became extremely delighted and told Nārada: “Fetch Sāvitrī quickly so that I can go to the pavilion of the sacrifice.”

## \|\| 1.181.32 \|\|

*vādyamāneṣu vādyeṣu siddhakinnaraguhyakaiḥ \|*  
*gandharvairgītasaṃsaktairvedoccāraparairdvijaiḥ \|*  
*araṇiṃ samupādāya pulastyo vākyamabravīt \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. As the musical instruments were played by Siddhas, Kinnaras and Guhyakas, when Gandharvas were absorbed in their songs and Brāhmaṇas were engaged in chanting the Vedas, Pulastya took up the Araṇi and spoke loudly these words:

## \|\| 1.181.33 \|\|

*patnī 3 patnīti viprendrāḥ proccaistatra vyavasthitāḥ \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. “Patnī? Patnī?” (Where is the wife of the Yajamāna?) and the leading Brāhmaṇas were seated in their respective places.

## \|\| 1.181.34 \|\|

*etasminnaṃtare brahmā nāradaṃ munisattamam \|*  
*saṃjñayā preṣayāmāsa patnī cānīyatāmiti \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. In the meantime, Brahmā suggested by gesture to the excellent sage Nārada that his wife should be brought there.

## \|\| 1.181.35 \|\|

*so'pi maṃdaṃ samāgatya sāvitrīṃ prāha līlayā \|*  
*yuddhapriyoṃ'taraṃ vāṃchansāvitryā saha vedhasaḥ \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. Nārada (by nature) liked to provoke quarrels. He wished to create a gap in the relations between Sāvitrī and god Brahmā. So he slowly (leisurely) went to Sāvitrī and spoke playfully:

## \|\| 1.181.36-38 \|\|

*ahaṃ saṃpreṣitaḥ pitrā tava pārśve sureśvari \|*  
*āgaccha prasthitaḥ snātaḥ sāṃprataṃ yajñamaṇḍape \|\| 36 \|\|*

*paramekākinī tatra gacchamānā sureśvari \|*  
*kīdṛgrūpā sadasi vai dṛśyase tvamanāthavat \|\| 37 \|\|*

*tasmādānīyatāṃ sarvā yāḥ kāściddevayoṣitaḥ \|*  
*yābhiḥ parivṛtā devi yāsyasi tvaṃ mahāmakhe \|\| 38 \|\|*

36-38. “O goddess of Suras, I have been sent by my father to you with the message ‘Do come; I have taken my bath and am going to the pavilion of the Yajña.’

But, O goddess of Suras, if you go there alone how will you fare there? You will appear like a helpless lady.

Hence let all the celestial women be brought. O goddess, you will go to the great Makha surrounded by those celestial women.”

## \|\| 1.181.39-40 \|\|

*evamuktvā muniśreṣṭho nārado munisattamaḥ \|*  
*abravītpitaraṃ gatvā tātāṃbā'kāritā mayā \|\| 39 \|\|*

*paraṃ tasyāḥ sthiro bhāvaḥ kiṃcitsaṃlakṣito mayā \|*  
*tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā tato manyusamanvitaḥ \|\| 40 \|\|*

39-40a. After saying this, the excellent sage Nārada went to his father and said: “Father, mother has been called by me. But I have slightly observed her mental predilection to remain unmoved.”

40b. On hearing his words, he (Brahmā)became very angry.

## \|\| 1.181.41-42 \|\|

*pulastyaṃ preṣayāmāsa sāvitryā sannidhau tataḥ \|*  
*gaccha vatsa tvamānīhi sthānaṃ sā śithilātmikā \|*  
*somabhārapariśrāṃtaṃ paśya māmūrdhvasaṃsthitam \|\| 41 \|\|*

*eṣa kālātyayo bhāvi yajñakarmaṇi sāṃpratam \|*  
*yajñayānamuhūrto'yaṃ sāvaśeṣo vyavasthitaḥ \|\| 42 \|\|*

41-42. He sent Pulastya to Sāvitrī: “Dear Son, she is slow by nature. Bring her to this place. See how tired I am bearing the weight of the Soma placed over!

Now there will be too much of delay in the performance of the Yajña rite. Very little time now remains for the Muhūrta (auspicious hour) for the Yajñayāna (procedure of the Yajña).”

## \|\| 1.181.43 \|\|
