*ekākī vicariṣyāmi kumārīvalayaṃ yathā \|\| 87 \|\|*

87\. ‘If there are many there is perpetual quarrel. With two there is mutual clash and struggle. Therefore, I shall move about alone by myself like the single bangle of the daughter.’

## \|\| 1.185.88 \|\|

*tataḥ suptāṃ parityajya tāṃ bhāryāṃ śiśusaṃyutām \|*  
*gato'haṃ dūramadhvānaṃ yatra no vetti sā ca mām \|\| 88 \|\|*

88\. Then as my wife and children were asleep I forsook them and went away to a long distance where she could not find me out.

## \|\| 1.185.89 \|\|

*yatrā'stamitaśāyī ca yalabdhakṛtabhojanaḥ \|*  
*bhramāmi medinīpṛṣṭhe tyaktvā saṃsārabandhanam \|\| 89 \|\|*

89\. I have left off all mundane ties and fetters. I am roaming over the earth taking in whatever is obtained and lying down for sleep whenever the sun sets, wherever it may be.

## \|\| 1.185.90 \|\|

*tato me jñānamāpannamevaṃ viprāḥ śanaiḥśanaiḥ \|*  
*atītānāgataṃ caiva vartamānaṃ viśeṣataḥ \|\| 90 \|\|*

90\. Thereby, O Brāhmaṇas, I slowly acquired wisdom and knowledge of the past, future and the present in particular.

## \|\| 1.185.91 \|\|

*evaṃ me kanyakā jātā gurutve dvijasattamāḥ \|\| 91 \|\|*

91\. Thus my own daughter became my Guru, O excellent Brāhmaṇas.

## \|\| 1.185.92 \|\|

*etadvaḥ sarvamākhyātaṃ yatpṛṣṭo'smi guroḥ kṛte \|*  
*na yuṣmākaṃ puro mithyā kīrtayāmi kathaṃcana \|\| 92 \|\|*

92\. Thus I have narrated everyting that I was asked in regard to my Gurus. I do not narrate anything untrue before you, at any cost.

## \|\| 1.185.93 \|\|

*evaṃ me jñānamutpannaṃ prakāraiḥ ṣaḍbhireva ca \|*  
*ebhirlokottaraṃ jñānaṃ yuṣmatpratyayakārakam \|\| 93 \|\|*

93\. Thus perfect knowledge dawned upon me in six different ways. It is through these that I acquired the perfect superhuman knowledge that caused credence in you all.

## \|\| 1.185.94 \|\|

*sūta uvāca \|*  
*tataste brāhmaṇāḥ sarve papracchustaṃ dvijottamāḥ \|*  
*vānaprasthāśramaṃ tyaktvā bhāryāṃ śiśusamanvitām \|*  
*kva gatastvaṃ tadācakṣva kiyatkālaṃ ca saṃsthitaḥ \|\| 94 \|\|*

Sūta said:

94\. Then, O excellent Brāhmaṇas, all those Brāhmaṇas asked him: “After forsaking the Vānaprastha stage and leaving off your wife and children, where did you go? How long did you stay thus. Tell us.”

## \|\| 1.185.95 \|\|

*atithiruvāca \|*  
*ahaṃ bhītaḥ sahasrāṇi grāmāṇāṃ ca śatāni ca \|*  
*yatrāstamitaśāyī sannanekāni dvijottamāḥ \|*  
*saṃkhyayā rahitānyeva varṣāṇāṃ ca śatāni ca \|\| 95 \|\|*

The guest said:

95\. I was in great fright. I roamed over hundreds and thousands of villages where, O excellent Brāhmaṇas, I practised the Vrata of going to bed (stay at the place) when the sun set. That had no reckoning and hundreds of years passed by.

## \|\| 1.185.96 \|\|

*dṛṣṭāni mukhyatīrthāni tathaivāyatanāni ca \|*  
*dṛṣṭāśca parvatāḥ śreṣṭhā nadyaśca vimalodakāḥ \|\| 96 \|\|*

96\. All important Tīrthas and shrines were visited. Many excellent mountains and rivers of pure waters were seen.

## \|\| 1.185.97-98 \|\|

*svayameva mayā jñāto vārāṇasyāṃ sthitena ca \|*  
*yajñaḥ paitāmaho bhāvī sthāne'sminmāmake yataḥ \|\| 97 \|\|*

*tato'haṃ satvaraṃ prāptaḥ kautukena dvijottamāḥ \|*  
*kīdṛśaḥ sa makho bhāvī yatra yajvā pitāmahaḥ \|\| 98 \|\|*

97-98. While I was in Vārāṇasī, I myself came to know that the Yajña pertaining to Brahmā was about to be begun in the holy spot of mine. So, O excellent Brāhmaṇas, I have come here eagerly to know how that Makha will be performed, where Pitāmaha himself is Yajvan (performer of a sacrifice).

## \|\| 1.185.99 \|\|

*sūta uvāca \|*  
*etasminnaṃtare prāptāḥ sarve devāḥ savāsavāḥ \|*  
*vāsudevaṃ puraskṛtya tathā caiva maheśvaram \|\| 99 \|\|*

Sūta said:

99\. In the meantime, all the Devas, including Vāsava, came there keeping Vāsudeva and Maheśvara ahead of them.

## \|\| 1.185.100 \|\|

*kamāntaraṃ samāsādya pulastyādyāstathartvijaḥ \|*  
*brahmāpi svayamāyāto mṛgacarmadharastathā \|\| 100 \|\|*

100\. So also Pulastya and other Ṛtviks came there for the sake of other rites. Brahmā too came there wearing the skin of an antelope.

## \|\| 1.185.101-102 \|\|

*tataste tuṣṭimāpannāstasya jñānena tena ca \|*  
*procuśca varadāstubhyaṃ sarva eva divaukasaḥ \|\| 101 \|\|*

*tasmādvaraya bhadraṃ te prārthayasva yathepsitam \|*  
*avaśyaṃ tava dāsyāmo yadyapi syātsudurlabham \|\| 102 \|\|*

101-102. Then all those Heaven-dwellers became pleased with his wisdom and perfect knowledge. They all said: “All of us shall grant you boon. Hence do choose a boon. Welfare unto you. Request for whatever is desired by you. Surely, we shall grant you the same even if it is very rare.”

## \|\| 1.185.103 \|\|

*atithiruvāca \|*  
*yadi tuṣṭāḥ surā mahyaṃ prayacchaṃti varaṃ mama \|*  
*anenaiva śarīreṇa devatvaṃ prārthayāmyaham \|\| 103 \|\|*

Atithi (The guest) said:

103\. If the Suras are pleased with me and they will grant me the boon I request for this that I must attain Devahood with this self-same body.

## \|\| 1.185.104 \|\|

*yajñabhāgasamopetaṃ tathānyeṣāṃ divaukasām \|*  
*viśeṣeṇa suraśreṣṭhāḥ sthānaṃ copari saṃsthitam \|\| 104 \|\|*

104\. Also like other Heaven-dwellers I must have an equal share in Yajñas. O excellent Suras, a position above them too.

## \|\| 1.185.105 \|\|

*devā ūcuḥ \|*  
*nūnaṃ tvaṃ vibudho bhūtvā devaloke nivatsyasi \|*  
*aneneva śarīreṇa yajñabhāgavivarjitaḥ \|\| 105 \|\|*

The Devas said:

105\. Certainly you will become a Vibudha (Deva) and live in the world of Devas with this self-same body but you will not get a share in Yajña.

## \|\| 1.185.106 \|\|

*yacchāmo yadi te vipra yajñāṃśaṃ mānuṣasya bhoḥ \|*  
*aprāmāṇyaṃ śruterbhāvi tava dattena tena ca \|\| 106 \|\|*

106\. O Brāhmaṇa, if we were to give a part of the fruit of the Yajña to you, a human being, the Vedas are likely to become invalid. It is against the injunction of the Vedas to give it to you.

## \|\| 1.185.107 \|\|

*atithiruvāca \|*  
*devatvena na me kāryaṃ yajñāṃśarahitena ca \|*  
*tadahaṃ sādhayiṣyāmi yathā muktirbhaviṣyati \|\| 107 \|\|*

The guest said:

107\. I have nothing to do with that Deva-hood devoid of a share in Yajña. Therefore, I shall practise that which will yield salvation.

## \|\| 1.185.108-110 \|\|

*tacchrutvā padmajaḥ prāha sarvāndevānkṛtāṃjaliḥ \|*  
*śṛṇvaṃtu devatāḥ sarvā yadbravīmi hitaṃ vacaḥ \|\| 108 \|\|*

*mamāyaṃ brāhmaṇo yajñe dūrādeva samāgataḥ \|*  
*nāgarastu viśeṣeṇa pātraṃ jñānasamudbhavam \|\| 109 \|\|*

*pratijñātastathā sarvairvaro'sya vibudhairyataḥ \|*  
*tasmātpradīyatāmasmai yadabhīṣṭaṃ surottamāḥ \|\| 110 \|\|*

108-110. On hearing it the Lotus-born Lord spoke to all the Devas with palms joined in reverence: “May all the deities listen to the beneficial advice that I offer to you.

This Brāhmaṇas has come from a distant place to take part in my Yajña. Moreover as a Nāgara he is a worthy recipient. He is endowed with perfect knowledge.

Since a boon has been promised to him by all the Vibudhas, O excellent Suras, let whatever is desired by him be given to him.”

## \|\| 1.185.111 \|\|

*maheśvara uvāca \|*  
*yathā'sya jāyate tṛptiryajñabhāgādhikā sadā \|*  
*tathāhaṃ kathayiṣyāmi śṛṇvaṃtu vibudhottamāḥ \|\| 111 \|\|*

Maheśvara said:

111\. I shall tell you a means whereby he will have perpetual satisfaction more than what can be derived from share in Yajña. May all the excellent Vibudhas listen.

## \|\| 1.185.112 \|\|

*ya eṣa kriyate yajñastasya nātho hariḥ smṛtaḥ \|*  
*etasmātkāraṇātproktaḥ sa devo yajñapūruṣaḥ \|\| 112 \|\|*

112\. Hari is proclaimed as the Lord of Yajña that is being performed. For this reason, that Lord is called Yajñapuruṣa (Divine being of Yajña).

## \|\| 1.185.113 \|\|

*adyaprabhṛti yatkiṃcicchrāddhaṃ martye bhaviṣyati \|*  
*daivaṃ vā paitṛkaṃ vā'pi tasya cāṃte vyavasthitaḥ \|\| 113 \|\|*

113\. From now onwards, whenever a Yajña pertaining to Devas or Pitṛs is to be performed in the human world, its conclusion shall be decided thus.

## \|\| 1.185.114 \|\|

*etasya nāma saṃkīrtya paścācca yajñapūruṣam \|*  
*saṃkīrtya bhojanaṃ deyaṃ brāhmaṇasya dvijottamāḥ \|\| 114 \|\|*

114\. O excellent Brāhmaṇas, after uttering this Brāhmaṇa’s name, the mane of Yajñapuruṣa should be glorified. Food should be served then.

## \|\| 1.185.115-117 \|\|

*tenāsya bhavitā tṛptiryajñāṃtā'bhyadhikā sadā \|*  
*adattvāsya kṛtaṃ śrāddhaṃ yatkiṃcitprabhaviṣyati \|\| 115 \|\|*

*tadyāsyatyakhilaṃ vyarthaṃ tathā bhasmahutaṃ yathā \|*  
*vaiśvadevāṃtamāsādya yaścainaṃ pūjayiṣyati \|\| 116 \|\|*

*viṣṇunāmasamopetaṃ bhaviṣyati tadakṣayam \|*  
*dattaṃ svalpamapi prāyaḥ śraddhāpūtena cetasā \|\| 117 \|\|*

115-117. Thereby he will have more satisfaction than from a share in Yajña. If any Śrāddha is performed without offering this, it shall become entirely futile like oblations offered in the ash (instead of in the sacrificial fire).

If at the end of the Vaiśvadeva, the devotee honours him along with the name of Viṣṇu that rite shall have everlasting benefit. Even the least thing that is offered with the mind sanctified by perfect faith shall in general become everlasting.

## \|\| 1.185.118 \|\|

*śrāddhe vā vaiśvadeve vā yaścainaṃ nārcayiṣyati \|*  
*saṃprāptaṃ vyarthatāṃ tasya tacca sarvaṃ bhaviṣyati \|\| 118 \|\|*

118\. If any person does not worship him in the course of Śrādda or Vaiśvadeva, everything shall be futile in respect to the same.

## \|\| 1.185.119 \|\|

*asmiṃstuṣṭiṃ gate sarve surā yāsyaṃti saṃmudam \|*  
*pitaraśca tamāyāṃti vimukhe saṃmukhe tathā \|\| 119 \|\|*

119\. If he is pleased all the Suras will become pleased. Even the Pitṛs with averted face before will come face to face with him.

## \|\| 1.185.120 \|\|

*tacchrutvā vibudhāḥ sarve maheśvaravacastadā \|*  
*tatheti muditāḥ procurbrahmaviṣṇupurassarāḥ \|\| 120 \|\|*

120\. On hearing the words of Maheśvara all the Vibudhas (Devas) said joyously, “So be it”. The Vibudhas with Brahmā and Viṣṇu at the head acclaimed Maheśvara’s words.

## \|\| 1.185.121 \|\|

*tataḥprabhṛti saṃjātā pūjā cātithisaṃbhavā \|*  
*tasmātsarvaprayatnena pūjā kāryā'titheḥ sadā \|*  
*yajñe pūruṣayajñasya na caikasya kathaṃcana \|\| 121 \|\|*

121\. Ever since then the reception and worship of Atithis (guests) came into vogue. Hence the adoration of guests and not merely that of the Yajñapuruṣa should always be practised by all efforts in the course of a Yajña.

## \|\| 1.185.122 \|\|

*atithiruvāca \|*  
*atrāsti māmakaṃ tīrthaṃ mayā yatra tapaḥ kṛtam \|*  
*hāṭakeśvaraje kṣetre purukāle dvijottamāḥ \|\| 122 \|\|*

The Atithi said:

122\. Here there is my Tīrtha where penance has been performed by me for a long time in the holy spot of Hāṭakeśvara, O excellent Brāhmaṇas.

## \|\| 1.185.123 \|\|

*aṃgārakeṇa saṃyuktā caturthī syādyadā tithiḥ \|*  
*sāṃnidhyaṃ tatra kāryaṃ ca sarvairdevaiśca taddine \|\| 123 \|\|*

123\. On the fourth lunar day when it coincides with a Tuesday, all the Devas should be present there.

## \|\| 1.185.124 \|\|

*kuryāttatraiva yaḥ snānaṃ tasminnahani saṃsthite \|*  
*sarvatīrthaphalaṃ tasya jāyatāṃ vaḥ prasādataḥ \|\| 124 \|\|*

124\. If a person takes his holy bath there on that day, let him get the benefit of all the Tīrtha with your favour.

## \|\| 1.185.125 \|\|

*tathāstviti tataḥ sarve'tithiṃ procuḥ surottamāḥ \|*  
*etasminnaṃtare prāha pulastyarṣiḥ pitāmaham \|\| 125 \|\|*

125\. “So it shall be”, said all the excellent Suras to the Atithi. In the meantime Sage Pulastya said to Pitāmaha:

## \|\| 1.185.126-127 \|\|

*pulastya uvāca \|*  
*ṛtvijaḥ sakalā devāḥ saṃsthitāḥ kautukānvitāḥ \|*  
*uttiṣṭhaṃtu ca te śīghraṃ yajñakarmaprasiddhaye \|\| 126 \|\|*

*etasminnaṃtare sarve tasya vākyapraṇoditāḥ \|*  
*utthitā ṛtvijo ye ca svāni sthānāni bhejire \|*  
*tataḥ pravavṛte yajñaḥ sapunardvijasattamāḥ \|*  
*kurvatā yajñakarmāṇi homapūrvāṇi yāni ca \|\| 127 \|\|*

Pulastya said:

126-127. The Ṛtviks and all the Devas are sitting wonderstruck. Let them rise up quickly for the performance of the rites of Yajña.

In the meantime, all the Ṛtviks rose up and resorted to their own respective places. Then, O excellent Brāhmaṇas, the Yajña was resumed with the performance of Homa.

## Chapter 186 - Importance of an Atithi

## \|\| 1.186.1-3 \|\|

*ṛṣaya ūcuḥ \|*  
*bhūya eva mahābhāga vada māhātmyamuttamam \|*  
*atitheḥ kṛtyamasmākaṃ vistareṇa ca sūtaja \|\| 1 \|\|*

*sūta uvāca \|*  
*śṛṇvantu munayaḥ sarve māhātmyamidamuttamam \|*  
*yena saṃśrutamātreṇa naśyetpāpaṃ dinodbhavam \|\| 2 \|\|*

*yanmayā ca śrutaṃ pūrvaṃ sakāśātsvapituḥ śubham \|\| 3 \|\|*

The sages said:

1-3. O highly esteemed Sūtaja, do narrate further unto us the excellent greatness of Atithi in its entire detail.

## \|\| 1.186.4 \|\|

*gṛhasthānāṃ paro dharmo nānyo'styatithipūjanāt \|*  
*atitherna ca doṣosti tasyātikramaṇena ca \|\| 4 \|\|*

Sūta said:

May all the sages listen to this excellent greatness. Merely by listening to it the sin of day will perish.

This splendid greatness was heard by me from my father.

4\. There is no greater duty of householders than worship of a guest. There is no fault attributed to an Atithi, if there be transgression on his part.

## \|\| 1.186.5 \|\|

*atithiryasya bhagnāśo gṛhātpratinivartate \|*  
*sa dattvā duṣkṛtaṃ tasmai puṇyamādāya gacchati \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. If an Atithi goes back disappointed from a house actually he hands over his sin to him (the householder) and takes away his merits.

## \|\| 1.186.6 \|\|

*satyaṃ śaucaṃ tapo'dhītaṃ dattamiṣṭaṃ śataṃ samāḥ \|*  
*tasya sarvamidaṃ naṣṭamatithiṃ yo na pūjayet \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. If anyone does not honour a guest, everything good in him perishes such as truth, personal purity, power of penance, acquisition of learning, gifts made, and the performance of a Yajña for a hundred years.

## \|\| 1.186.7 \|\|

*dūrādatithayo yasya gṛhamāyāṃti nirvṛtāḥ \|*  
*sa gṛhastha iti proktaḥ śeṣāśca gṛharakṣiṇaḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. Only he can be called a (real) Gṛhastha (householder), to whose house eager and joyous guests flock together. All the rest are Gṛharakṣiṇaḥ (watchmen of the house).

## \|\| 1.186.8 \|\|

*na purākṛtapuṇyānāṃ narāṇāmiha bhūtale \|*  
*trīnetānpratihanyaṃte śrāddhaṃ dānaṃ śubhā giraḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. The following three are never disallowed in the house of men who have performed meritorious deeds earlier: Śrāddha, Dāna and splendidly pleasing words.

## \|\| 1.186.9 \|\|

*tuṣṭe'tithau gṛhasthasya tuṣṭāḥ syuḥ sarvadevatāḥ \|*  
*vimukhe vimukhāḥ sarvā bhavaṃti ca na saṃśayaḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. If the guest is pleased with the householder, all the Devas are also pleased with him. If he is displeased (keeps his face averted), all the Devas are also displeased.

## \|\| 1.186.10 \|\|

*tasmāttoṣayitavyaśca gṛhasthena sadā'tithiḥ \|*  
*apyātmanaḥ pradānena yadīcchetpuṇyamātmanaḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. Hence, a guest must always be satisfied by a householder even by sacrificing himself if he wishes for his own good.

## \|\| 1.186.11 \|\|

*trividhastvatithiḥ prokto gṛhasthānāṃ dvijottamāḥ \|*  
*tasyāhaṃ vacmi vaḥ kālaṃ śṛṇudhvaṃ susamāhitāḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. O excellent Brāhmaṇas, guests of householders are of three types. I shall tell you the time when they appear. Listen with attention.

## \|\| 1.186.12 \|\|

*śrāddhīyo vaiśvadevīyaḥ sūryoḍhaśca tṛtīyakaḥ \|*  
*ye cānye bhojanārthīyāste sāmānyāḥ prakīrtitā \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. (They are:) Śrāddhīya, Vaiśvadevīya and Sūryoḍha the third. The others are ordinary ones. At best they can be mentioned as Bhojanārthīyas (seekers of meal).

## \|\| 1.186.13 \|\|

*sāṃkalpe vihite śrāddhe pitṝṇāṃ bhojanodbhave \|*  
*samāgacchati yaḥ kāle tasmiñchrāddhīya eva saḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. Śrāddhīya is that guest who comes at the proper time to partake of the food when the Śrāddha of the Pitṛs has been concluded in the manner resolved upon.

## \|\| 1.186.14 \|\|

*dūrādhvānaṃ pathi śrāṃtaṃ vaiśvadevāṃta āgatam \|*  
*atithiṃ taṃ vijānīyānnātithiḥ pūrvamāgataḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. That guest should be considered Vaiśvadevīya, who has traversed a great distance, has become weary and arrives at the conclusion of Vaiśvadeva rite and not one who has come before time.

## \|\| 1.186.15 \|\|

*priyo vā yadi vā dveṣyo mūrkhaḥ paṃḍita eva vā \|*  
*vaiśvadeve tu saṃprāptaḥ so'tithiḥ svargasaṃkramaḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. A guest who arrives at the conclusion of the Vaiśvadeva is one who transports one to heaven. He may be a beloved one or one worthy of being hated, an illiterate one or a great scholar.

## \|\| 1.186.16 \|\|

*na pṛcchedgotracaraṇaṃ na sthānaṃ vedameva ca \|*  
*dṛṣṭvā yajñopavītaṃ ca bhojayettaṃ prabhaktitaḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. The host should not ask him about his Gotra or Pravara, place of nativity or the Veda of special study. After seeing the sacred thread, the host shall feed him with devotion.

## \|\| 1.186.17 \|\|

*śrāddhe vā vaiśvadeve vā yadyāgacchati nātithiḥ \|*  
*ghṛtāhutiṃ tato dadyāttannāmnā ca havirbhuji \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. If the (invited) Atithi does not come at the time of Śrāddha or Vaiśvadeva, the host should utter his name and offer ghee Āhuti in the sacred fire.

## \|\| 1.186.18 \|\|

*aśaktyā bhojyadānasya deyaṃ bhaktyā tataḥ param \|*  
*tasyānnamapi tu stokaṃ yena tuṣṭiṃ pragacchati \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. If the host is incapable of offering full food, he should give him some little food with great devotion whereby he shall be satisfied.

## \|\| 1.186.19 \|\|

*tathānyaśca tṛtīyastu sūryoḍho'tithirucyate \|*  
*kṛte tu bhojane yastu rātrau vā cādhigacchati \|*  
*tasya śaktyā pradātavyaṃ sasyaṃ ca gṛhamedhinā \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. The third type of Atithi is called Sūryoḍha (carried by the Sun i.e. the evening guest) if he arrives after the host has taken food or even at night. To him the householder should offer some vegetable dish within his capacity.

## \|\| 1.186.20 \|\|

*sūryoḍho yasya saṃprāpto gṛhātpūjāṃ vinā vrajet \|*  
*nirāśaḥ pātakaṃ tasya nijaṃ dattvā prayāti saḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. After arriving, if the Sūryoḍha guest is forced to depart without being honoured, such a poor disappointed man hands over his own sin before leaving.

## \|\| 1.186.21 \|\|

*tṛṇāni bhūmirudakaṃ vākcaturthī ca sūnṛtā \|*  
*etānyapi satāṃ gehe nocchidyaṃte kadācana \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. These things are not short in the house of good people: grass, place (to study), water and pleasing words (i.e. a guest should be offered something).

## \|\| 1.186.22 \|\|

*svāgatenāgnayastṛptiṃ gṛhasthasya prayāṃti ca \|*  
*āsanena vrajettuṣṭiṃ svayaṃbhūḥ prapitāmahaḥ \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. By extending welcome the fires of the householder attain satisfaction. By offering a seat the Self-existing Greatgrandfather becomes satisfied.

## \|\| 1.186.23 \|\|

*argheṇa śaṃbhuḥ pādyena sarve devāḥ savāsavāḥ \|*  
*bhojyadānena viṣṇuḥ syātsarvadevamayo'tithiḥ \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. Śaṃbhu is pleased if he is given Arghya and all the Devas including Vāsava, if Pādya is offered to him. Viṣṇu shall become pleased if food is offered to the guests. Hence the Atithi is full of all the Devas.

## \|\| 1.186.24 \|\|

*tasmātpūjyaḥ sadā viprā bhojanīyo viśeṣataḥ \|*  
*nāmāpyuccārya bhojyo'nyo brāhmaṇo gṛhamedhinā \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. Hence, O Brāhmaṇas, the other Brāhmaṇas (guest) should be hououred always, fed in particular or at least after uttering the name.

## Chapter 187 - Greatness of Rākṣasaprāpya Śrāddha

## \|\| 1.187.1-3 \|\|

*sūta uvāca \|*  
*caturthe divase prāpte tato yajñasamudbhave \|*  
*ṛtvigbhiryājñikaṃ karma prārabdhaṃ tadanaṃtaram \|\| 1 \|\|*

*somapānādikaṃ sarvaṃ paśorhiṃsādikaṃ tathā \|*  
*paśorgudaṃ samādāya prasthātā ca vyadhārayat \|\| 2 \|\|*

*ekāṃte sadaso madhye homārthaṃ dvijasattamāḥ \|*  
*tasminvyākulatāṃ yāte brāhmaṇaḥ kaścidāgataḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

Sūta said:

1-3. When the fourth day of the Yajña rite dawned, the sacrificial rite was duly started by the Ṛtviks with Somapāna, cutting of the animal etc.

The Prasthātṛ priest (i.e. Atri) took the Guda (anus) of the scrificial animal and placed it in an isolated place in the middle of the assembly, O excellent Brāhmaṇas, for the sake of Homa (later). While he was engrossed (in his work), a certain Brāhmaṇa came there.

## \|\| 1.187.4 \|\|

*yuvā tatra praviṣṭastu māṃsa bhakṣaṇalālasaḥ \|*  
*tato gudaṃ paśordṛṣṭvā bhakṣayāmāsa cotsukaṃ \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. The young man (Brāhmaṇa) who entered thus there was desirous of eating meat. On seeing the anus of the sacrificial animal he eagerly and enthusiastically began to eat it.

## \|\| 1.187.5 \|\|

*etasminnaṃtare prāptaḥ prasthātā tasya saṃnidhau \|*  
*bhakṣamāṇaṃ samālokya taṃ śaśāpa tataḥ param \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. In the meantime, the Prasthātṛ came near him. On seeing him tasting (the meat) he cursed him:

## \|\| 1.187.6-8 \|\|

*dhigdhikpāpasamācāra homārthaṃ yadgudaṃ dhṛtam \|*  
*tattvayā dūṣitaṃ laulyādyajñavighnakaraṃ kṛtam \|\| 6 \|\|*

*ucchiṣṭena mayā homaḥ kartavyo naiva sāṃpratam \|*  
*rākṣasānāmidaṃ karma yattvayā samanuṣṭhitam \|\| 7 \|\|*

*tasmāttvaṃ mama vākyena rākṣaso bhava mā ciram \|\| 8 \|\|*

6-8. “Fie upon you, O sinful one! The anus (meat) that was kept for the purpose of Homa has been defiled by your voracious greed. You have thus caused an obstacle in the Yajña.

It is not proper now for me to perform the Homa with what is left after being eaten. What has been done by you is an act of Rākṣasas. Ere long you shall be a Rākṣasa on my word.”

## \|\| 1.187.9-10 \|\|

*etasminneva kāle tu hyūrdhvakeśo'bhavaddhi saḥ \|*  
*raktākṣaḥ śaṃkukarṇaśca kṛṣṇadanto'tibhairavaḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

*lamboṣṭho vikarālāsyo māṃsamedovivarjitaḥ \|*  
*tvagasthisnāyuśeṣaśca \|cāmuṇḍākṛtireva ca \|\| 10 \|\|*

9-10. Instantly, at the very moment he was transformed into one with hairs standing upright, red eyes, spike-like ears, black teeth and terrible appearance. His face was hideous. The lips were found hanging down. He had only the skin, the bone and the sinews left with flesh and fat missing. His form was terrible.

## \|\| 1.187.11 \|\|

*sa ca viśvāvasurnāma pulastyasya suto muniḥ \|*  
*maṃtrapūtasya māṃsasya bhakṣaṇārthaṃ samāgataḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. He happened to be the sage named Viśvāvasu, the son of Pulastya. He had come there for tasting the meat sanctified through Mantras

## \|\| 1.187.12 \|\|

*vedavedāṃgatattvajaḥ pautrastu parameṣṭhinaḥ \|*  
*taṃ dṛṣṭvā rākṣasākāraṃ vitresuḥ sarvato dvijāḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. He was the grandson of Parameṣṭhin Brahmā and a through master of topics in the Vedas and Vedāṅgas.

The Brāhmaṇas all round trembled with fear on seeing him like a Rākṣasa with hideous features.

## \|\| 1.187.13 \|\|

*rākṣoghnāni ca sūktāni jajapuścāpare tathā \|*  
*keciccharaṇamāpannā viṣṇo rudrasya cāpare \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. Some repeated the Sūtras expected to destroy Rākṣasas. Some of them sought refuge in Viṣṇu and others in Rudra.

## \|\| 1.187.14 \|\|

*pitāmahasya cānye tu gāyatryāḥ śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ \|*  
*rakṣarakṣeti jalpanto bhayasaṃtrastamānasāḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. With the minds agitated with fright, they prattled, “Save us, save us”, and sought refuge in Pitāmaha and others in Gāyatrī.

## \|\| 1.187.15 \|\|

*so'pi dṛṣṭvā tadātmānaṃ gataṃ rākṣasatāṃ dvijāḥ \|*  
*bāṣpapūrṇekṣaṇo dīnaḥ pitāmahamupādravat \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. O Brāhmaṇas, on seeing himself turned into a Rākṣasa, he became highly distressed. He rushed to Pitāmaha with the eyes filled with tears.

## \|\| 1.187.16 \|\|

*sa praṇamya tato vākyaṃ kṛtāṃjaliruvāca tam \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. After bowing down he spoke these words with palms joined in reverence:

## \|\| 1.187.17-19 \|\|

*pautro'haṃ tava deveśa pulastyasya suto dvijaḥ \|*  
*nīto rākṣasatāmadya prasthātrā kopato vibho \|\| 17 \|\|*

*jihvālaulyena deveśa paśorgudamajānatā \|*  
*bhakṣitaṃ tanmayā deva homārthaṃ yatprakalpitam \|\| 18 \|\|*

*tasmānmānuṣatāprāptyai mama dehe dayāṃ kuru \|*  
*rākṣasatvaṃ yathā yāti tathā nītirvidhīyatām \|\| 19 \|\|*

17-19. “O Lord of Devas, I am a Brāhmaṇa and the son of Pulastya. Hence your grandson. O great Lord, I have been turned into a Rākṣasa today by the Prasthātṛ in his rage.

Due to covetousness of the tongue and being ignorant that it was reserved and kept aside for the sake of Homa, I tasted the meat from the anus of the sacrificial animal.

Hence take pity on my body and bless it with acquisition of human form. Let some means be employed so that (my) Rākṣasa-hood can be dispelled.”

## \|\| 1.187.20 \|\|

*tacchrutvā jalpitaṃ tasya dayāṃ kṛtvā pitāmahaḥ \|*  
*pratiprasthātaraṃ sāmavākyametaduvāca ha \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. On hearing his pleading, Pitāmaha took pity on him. he then spoke the following conciliatory words:

## \|\| 1.187.21 \|\|

*bālo'yaṃ mama pautrastu kṛtyākṛtyaṃ na vetti ca \|*  
*tasmāttvaṃ rākṣasaṃ bhāvaṃ harasvāsya dvijottama \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. “My grandson is only a boy. He does not know what should be done and what should not be done. Hence, O excellent Brāhmaṇa take away the Rākṣasa-hood of (this son).”

## \|\| 1.187.22-24 \|\|

*tacchrutvā sa muniḥ prāha prāyaścittaṃ makhe tava \|*  
*anena janitaṃ deva gudaṃ dūṣayatā vibho \|\| 22 \|\|*

*tasmādeṣa mayā śapto yajñavighnakaro mama \|*  
*nāhamasya hariṣyāmi rākṣasatvaṃ kathaṃcana \|\| 23 \|\|*

*narmaṇāpi mayā proktaṃ kadācinnānṛtaṃ vacaḥ \|\| 24 \|\|*

22-24. On hearing it, the sage said: “O Lord, an occasion for performing expiatory rite in this Makha of yours has been created by him by defiling the anus meat.

Hence this man, the creator of ān obstacle to the Yajña, has been cursed by me. I will not at all take away the Ṛākṣasa-hood from him. A lie has never been uttered by me even as a joke.”

## \|\| 1.187.25 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*prāyaścittaṃ kariṣye'haṃ yajñasyāsya prasiddhaye \|*  
*dakṣiṇā gauryathoktā ca kṛtvā homaṃ vidhānataḥ \|*  
*tvamasya rākṣasaṃ bhāvaṃ harasva mama vākyataḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

Brahmā said:

25\. I shall perform the expiatory rite for the due completion of this Yajña. I shall offer monetary gifts and cows as laid down and perform the Homa in accordance with the injunctions. Do take away his Rākṣasa-hood at my instance.

## \|\| 1.187.26 \|\|

*so'bravīcchītalo vahniryadi syāduṣṇaguḥ śaśī \|*  
*tanme syādanyathā vākyaṃ vyāhṛtaṃ prapitāmaha \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. He said: “O Prapitāmaha, if fire becomes cool and the moon hot-rayed (like the sun), then the statement (curse) uttered by me shall become otherwise.”

## \|\| 1.187.27 \|\|

*tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā jñātvā caiva tu niścitam \|*  
*viśvāvasuṃ vidhiḥ prāha tato rākṣasarūpiṇam \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. On hearing his words and realizing his determination, Vidhi said to Viśvāvasu in the form of Rākṣasa:

## \|\| 1.187.28 \|\|

*tvaṃ vatsānena rūpeṇa tiṣṭha tāvadvaco mama \|*  
*kuruṣva te prayacchāmi yena sthānamanuttamam \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. “O dear one, stay in this form till I tell you again. Do as I tell you so that I can offer an excellent position to you.

## \|\| 1.187.29 \|\|

*camatkārapurasyāsya paścimasthānamāśritāḥ \|*  
*santyanye rākṣasāstatra maryādāyāṃ vyavasthitāḥ \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. There are other Rākṣasas resorting to the western region of this Camatkārapura. They have confined themselves to the limits of decorum.

## \|\| 1.187.30 \|\|

*laṃkāyāṃ rākṣasāścaiva prārthayanto'tra sadgatim \|*  
*te cāgatya tamuddeśaṃ tapaḥ kurvaṃti suvratāḥ \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. The Rākṣasas in Laṅkā aspire for the excellent state (Mokṣa). They come to that spot and perform penance adopting good Vratas.

## \|\| 1.187.31-34 \|\|

*tatra prabhutvamātiṣṭha nāgarāṇāṃ hite sthitaḥ \|*  
*rākṣasā bahavaḥ saṃti kūṣmāṃḍāśca piśācakāḥ \|\| 31 \|\|*

*ye cānye rākṣasāḥ kecidduṣṭabhāvasamāśritāḥ \|*  
*tatra gacchaṃti ye sarve nigṛhṇaṃti ca tatkṣaṇāt \|\| 32 \|\|*

*bhūtāḥ pretāḥ piśācāśca kūṣmāṃḍāśca viśeṣataḥ \|*  
*nāgaraṃ tu puro dṛṣṭvā tadbhayādyāṃti dūrataḥ \|\| 33 \|\|*

*tadgaccha putra tatra tvaṃ sarveṣāmadhipo bhava \|*  
*rākṣasānāṃ mayā dattaṃ tava rājyaṃ ca sāṃpratam \|\| 34 \|\|*

31-34. Accept the Lordship there and act in a way beneficial to the Nāgaras. There are many Rākṣasas, Kūṣmāṇḍas, Piśācakas and many other Rākṣasas of evil intention.

All these Bhūtas, Pretas, Piśācas, Kūṣmāṇḍas and others catch hold of all those who go there. But on seeing a Nāgara in front, they go away due to the fear thereof. Hence, Son, go there and be the Lord of all the Rākṣasas. This is the Kingdom given to you by me now.”

## \|\| 1.187.35 \|\|

*rākṣasa uvāca \|*  
*ādhipatye sthitasyaivaṃ rākṣasānāṃ pitāmaha \|*  
*kiṃ mayā tatra bhoktavyaṃ tebhyo deyaṃ ca kiṃ vada \|\| 35 \|\|*

Rākṣasa said:

35\. O Pitāmaha, tell me, what should be eaten by me there and what should be given to them after becoming the Lord of those Rākṣasas.

## \|\| 1.187.36 \|\|

*rājñā caiva yato deyaṃ bhṛtyānāṃ bhojanaṃ vibho \|*  
*tanmamācakṣva deveśa dayāṃ kṛtvā mamopari \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. O Lord, this is in view of the fact that food should be given to the attendants by a king. Hence, O Lord of Devas, take pity on me and tell this.

## \|\| 1.187.37 \|\|

*na karoti ca yo rājā \|bhṛtyavargasya poṣaṇam \|*  
*rauravaṃ narakaṃ yāti sa evaṃ hi śrutaṃ mayā \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. Indeed this has been heard by me that a king who does not duly maintain with food the group of his attendants goes to the Raurava Naraka.

## \|\| 1.187.38 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*yacchrāddhaṃ dakṣiṇāhīnaṃ tilairdarbhairvivarjitam \|*  
*tatsarvaṃ te mayā dattaṃ yadyapi syātsutīrthagam \|\| 38 \|\|*

Brahmā said:

38\. All that Śrāddha devoid of monetary gifts, gingelly seeds and Darbha grass has been given to you even if it has been performed at excellent Tīrthas.

## \|\| 1.187.39 \|\|

*yacchrāddhaṃ sūkaraḥ paśyennārī vātha rajasvalā \|*  
*kauleyako'tha vāleyastatsarvaṃ te bhaviṣyati \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. If a pig, a woman in her monthly course, a dog or a donkey looks at a Śrāddha it shall be yours entirely.

## \|\| 1.187.40 \|\|

*vidhihīnaṃ tu yacchrāddhaṃ darbhervā mūlavarjitaiḥ \|*  
*vitasteradhikairvāpi tatsarvaṃ te bhaviṣyati \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. If the Śrāddha is offered flouting the injunctions laid down, or if Darbha grass used is longer than a Vitasti (a span) or devoid of the root, it shall be entirely yours.

## \|\| 1.187.41 \|\|

*tilaṃ vā tailapakvaṃ vā śūkadhānyamathāpi vā \|*  
*na yatra dīyate śrāddhe tatte śrāddhaṃ bhaviṣyati \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. If gingelly seeds, pies etc., fried in oil or Śūka cereal (barley etc.) are not given in a Śrāddha, that shall be yours.

## \|\| 1.187.42 \|\|

*asnātairyatkṛtaṃ śrāddhaṃ yaccādhautāṃbaraiḥ kṛtam \|*  
*tailābhyaṃgayutaiścaiva tatte sarvaṃ bhaviṣyati \|\| 42 \|\|*

42\. If the Śrāddha is performed by persons who have smeared themselves with oil, who have not bathed and who have not worn washed clothes, that shall be yours entirely.

## \|\| 1.187.43 \|\|

*yadvā māhiṣiko bhuṃkte śvitrī vā kunakho'pi vā \|*  
*kuṣṭhī vātha dvijo bhuṃkte tatte śrāddhaṃ bhaviṣyati \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. If the Brāhmaṇa fed in a Śrāddha is a Māhiṣika (husband of an unchaste woman), a Śvitrī (one suffering from white leprosy) or a Kuṣṭhin (leper), that Śrāddha shall be entirely yours.

## \|\| 1.187.44 \|\|

*hīnāṃgo vā'tha yadbhuṃkte'dhikāṃgo vātha niṃditaḥ \|*  
*mahāvyādhigṛhīto vā cauro vārddhuṣiko'pi vā \|*  
*yatra bhuṃkte'thavā śrāddhe tatte śrāddhaṃ bhaviṣyati \|\| 44 \|\|*

44\. If the person fed in a Śrāddha is one deficient in one limb, one having a superficial limb, one who is censured, afflicted with a fell disease, a thief or one who practises usury, that Śrāddha shall be yours.

## \|\| 1.187.45 \|\|

*śyāvadantastu yadbhuṃkte yadbhuṃkte vṛṣalīpatiḥ \|*  
*vinagno vātha yadbhuṃkte tatte śrāddhaṃ bhaviṣyati \|\| 45 \|\|*

45\. If the person fed is one with black teeth or a husband of a Śūdra woman, a Vinagna (excessively hypocritical one), that Śrāddha shall be yours.

## \|\| 1.187.46 \|\|

*yo yajño dakṣiṇāhīno yaścāśaucayutaiḥ kṛtaḥ \|*  
*brahmacaryavihīnastu tatphalaṃ te bhaviṣyati \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. You will get the benefit of that Yajña which is without monetary gifts, which is performed by those polluted by death of kinsmen and by those without celibacy.

## \|\| 1.187.47 \|\|

*yasminnaivātithiḥ pūjyaḥ śrāddhe vā yajñakarmaṇi \|*  
*saṃprāpte vaiśvadevāṃte tatte sarvaṃ bhaviṣyati \|\| 47 \|\|*

47\. If an Atithi is not duly honoured in a Śrāddha or Yajña rite on coming at the conclusion of Vaiśvadeva rite it shall be entirely yours.

## \|\| 1.187.48 \|\|

*āvāhanātparaṃ yatra maunaṃ na śrāddhadaścaret \|*  
*brāhmaṇo vā'tha bhoktā ca tatte śrāddhaṃ bhaviṣyati \|\| 48 \|\|*

48\. If after inviting a Brāhmaṇa, the person offering Śrāddha does not observe silence, or if the Brāhmaṇa who takes food does not observe silence, that Śrāddha will be yours.

## \|\| 1.187.49 \|\|

*mṛnmayeṣu ca pātreṣu yaḥ śrāddhaṃ kurute naraḥ \|*  
*bhinnapātreṣu vā yacca tatte sarvaṃ bhaviṣyati \|\| 49 \|\|*

49\. If a man performs Śrāddha in pots of clay or broken utensils, that shall be yours entirely

## \|\| 1.187.50 \|\|

*pratyakṣalavaṇaṃ yatra takraṃ vā vikṛtaṃ bhavet \|*  
*jātīpuṣpapradānaṃ ca tatte sarvaṃ bhaviṣyati \|\| 50 \|\|*

50\. If salt is openly displayed, if the buttermilk gets spoiled or if Jātī flower is offered, that shall be yours entirely.

## \|\| 1.187.51 \|\|

*yajamāno dvijo vātha brahmacaryavivarjitaḥ \|*  
*tacchrāddhaṃ te mayā dattaṃ tripātreṇa vivarjitam \|\| 51 \|\|*

51\. If the householder or the Brāhmaṇa does not observe celibacy in a Śrāddha (i.e. on the Śrāddha day) that is offered to you. One without three deserving persons (or three pots) is also offered to you.

## \|\| 1.187.52-53 \|\|

*āyasena tu pātreṇa yatrānnaṃ ca pradīyate \|*  
*tacchrāddhaṃ te mayā dattaṃ tathānyadapi hīyate \|\| 52 \|\|*

*maṃtrakriyābhyāṃ yatkicidrātrau dattaṃ hutaṃ tathā \|*  
*sakrāṃtisomaparvabhyāṃ vyati riktaṃ tu kutsitam \|\| 53 \|\|*

52-53. If the food is offered in an iron utensil, that Śrāddha is offered to you by me. If a rite is devoid of Mantras and proper and requisite activities it is despicable. Except in the case of Saṅkrānti and lunar eclipse, whatever is offered at night is despicable. If a Homa is performed at night it is despicable.

## \|\| 1.187.54 \|\|

*ityuktvā virarāmāśu brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ \|*  
*rākṣasaḥ so'pi tatrāpi lebhe sthānaṃ tu rākṣasam \|\| 54 \|\|*

54\. After saying thus Brahmā, the grandfather of the worlds, stopped abruptly. That Rākṣasa duly obtained the position of Rākṣasas at that place.

## Chapter 188 - The Groups of Mothers Cursed

## \|\| 1.188.1-2 \|\|

*sūta uvāca \|*  
*tatastu paṃcame cāhni saṃjāte te dvijottamāḥ \|*  
*śvetadhautāṃbarāḥ sarve susnātāḥ śucayaḥ sthitāḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

*cakruḥ sarvāṇi karmāṇi pulastyena prabodhitāḥ \|*  
*sadomadhye gatāścaiva ṛtvigvaraṇapūrvakāḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

Sūta said:

1-2. Afterwards when the fifth day dawned, those excellent Brāhmaṇas remained pure and clean after their excellent ablutions and were clad in their white, well-washed garments. They went to the centre of the assembly. As instructed by Pulastya, they ritualistically summoned the Ṛtviks and performed all the rites.

## \|\| 1.188.3 \|\|

*adhvaryuṇā samādiṣṭānpraiṣānprocuryathā kramam \|*  
*homārthaṃ dīptavahnau ca ṛtvigbhiḥ susamāhitaiḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. When the sacred fire was kindled for the performance of Homa by the Ṛtviks with the greatest concentration, they uttered in due order the Praiṣa Mantras (those uttered at the time of the crushing and squeezing of Soma) as commanded by the Aadhvaryu \[Adhvaryu\].

## \|\| 1.188.4 \|\|

*etasminneva kāle tu hyudgātrā karma yojitam \|*  
*śaṃkubhiḥ kriyate yacca sāma gītiprasūcitam \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. At this same time, the Udgātṛ proceeded with the rite indicated by the singing of the Sāman passages and usually performed with the Śaṅkus (posts).

## \|\| 1.188.5 \|\|

*saptāvartaṃ dvijaśreṣṭhāḥ sadomadhyagatena ca \|*  
*yatrā'gacchaṃti te sarve devā yajñāṃśalālasāḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. O excellent Brāhmaṇas, the Udgātṛ came to the centre of the assembly seven times and here all the Devas eager to partake of their share in the Yajña gathered together.

## \|\| 1.188.6 \|\|

*somapānakṛte caiva viśeṣeṇa mudānvitāḥ \|*  
*prārabdhe somabhakṣye'tha gīte codgātṛnirmite \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. They came joyously especially for the sake of imbibing Soma. The Udgātṛ began the song and the imbibing of the Soma started.

## \|\| 1.188.7 \|\|

*āgatā kanyakā caikā sāmagītisamutsukā \|*  
*śaṃkukarṇanajaṃ citraṃ vāṃchamānā vicakṣaṇā \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. A certain girl came there eager to hear the Sāman songs. She wished to observe cleverly the wonderful way in which the Śaṅku (the rod that crushes Soma) was moved about.

## \|\| 1.188.8 \|\|

*chandogasya sutā śreṣṭhā devaśarmābhidhasya ca \|*  
*audumbarīti nāmnā sā sāmaśravaṇalālasā \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. She was the excellent daughter of the Chandoga (reciter of the Sāman Mantras) named Devaśarman. Her name was Auduṃbarī. She was very eager to listen to the Sāman songs.

## \|\| 1.188.9-10 \|\|

*udgātāraṃ ca sadasi vacanaṃ vyājahāra sā \|*  
*yathāyathā pravartaṃte śaṃkavaḥ sāmasūcitāḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

*dakṣiṇāgnau drutaṃ gatvā kuru homaṃ yathoditam \|*  
*yena tvaṃ mucyase pāpānna cedvyartho bhaviṣyati \|\| 10 \|\|*

9-10. She spoke these words to the Udgātṛ in the assembly itself: “As the Śaṅku begins to move according to the indication of the Sāman songs, perform the Homa in the manner mentioned in the fire called Dakṣiṇa. Thereby alone you will be rid of sins. If not, the Yajña becomes futile.”

## \|\| 1.188.11 \|\|

*tasyāstadvacanaṃ śrutvā sābhiprāyaṃ dvijottamāḥ \|*  
*tataḥ sa cintayāmāsa yāvattadvyāhṛtaṃ vacaḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. O excellent Brāhmaṇas, on hearing her worḍs that contained a special hint, he pondered over the words uttered by her.

## \|\| 1.188.12 \|\|

*tataḥ papraccha tāṃ kanyā mudgātā vismayānvitaḥ \|*  
*kutastvamasi cā'yātā sutā kasya vadasva me \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. Then the Udgātṛ was surprised. He asked the girl: “From where have you come? Whose daughter are you? Tell me.”

## \|\| 1.188.13 \|\|

*audumbaryuvāca \|*  
*parvatasya sutā cāsmi vikhyātā devaśarmaṇaḥ \|*  
*jātismarā mahābhāga prāptā gandharvalokataḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

Auduṃbarī said:

13\. (Originally) I was the daughter of Parvata (a Gandharva). (Now) I am the well-known daughter of Devaśarman. O highly esteemed one. I have come over here from the Gandharva world and I can remember the events of previous births.

## \|\| 1.188.14 \|\|

*udgātovāca \|*  
*gandharvasya sutā kasya kena śaptāsi putrike \|*  
*kadā te bhavitā mokṣo mānuṣatvasya kīrttaya \|\| 14 \|\|*

Udgātṛ said:

14\. Of which Gandharva are you the daughter, O my dear girl? By whom were you cursed? When will you be rid of the human state? Narrate everything.

## \|\| 1.188.15 \|\|

*audumbaryuvāca \|*  
*nāradaḥ parvataścaiva gandharvau viditau janaiḥ \|*  
*parvatasya sutā cāsmi śaptāhaṃ nāradena hi \|\| 15 \|\|*

Auduṃbarī said:

15\. The two Gandharvas, Nārada and Parvata, are known to all the people. I was the daughter of Parvata and cursed by Nārada.

## \|\| 1.188.16 \|\|

*vipaṃcīṃ vādayansvairaṃ dṛṣṭaḥ sa munisattamaḥ \|*  
*ajānaṃtyā ca tānānāṃ viśeṣaṃ mūrcchanodbhavam \|*  
*mayā sa hasito'tīva tānabhaṃgatayā gataḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. When I saw him, the excellent sage was playing on his lute in a carefree way. I was not conversant with the particular Mūrcchanā and the Tāna arising therefrom as he played and so I laughed derisively. That made a wrong note in the Tāna.

## \|\| 1.188.17-18 \|\|

*tataḥ sa kupito mahyaṃ dadau śāpaṃ dvijottamaḥ \|*  
*mithyāpahasito yasmādahaṃ śāpamato'rhasi \|\| 17 \|\|*

*mānuṣāṇāmayaṃ dharmastasmāttvaṃ mānuṣī bhava \|*  
*mayā prasāditaḥ so'tha pitrā sārdhaṃ munīśvaraḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

17-18. Thereupon, the excellent Brāhmaṇa became angry and cursed me: “I have been laughed at derisively without any reason. Hence, you deserve this curse. What you did is the way of human beings. Hence, you become a human being.”

Then that leading sage was pacified by me along with my father:

## \|\| 1.188.19-23 \|\|

*śāpāṃtaṃ kuru me nātha bāliśāyā viśeṣataḥ \|*  
*mānuṣatvaṃ ca me bhūyātsusthāne sukule vibho \|\| 19 \|\|*

*susthāne cāṃtakālaśca brāhmaṇasya niveśane \|*  
*tato'haṃ tena saṃproktā camatkārapureṃ śubhe \|\| 20 \|\|*

*devaśarmā tu vipreṃdraḥ kulīnaḥ sarvaśāstravit \|*  
*tasya tu brāhmaṇī nāmnā satyabhāmeti viśrutā \|\| 21 \|\|*

*tasyā garbhaṃ samāsādya mānuṣatvaṃ samācara \|*  
*yadā paitāmaho yajñastasminkṣetre bhaviṣyati \|\| 22 \|\|*

*udgātuḥ samaye tasya śaṃkoścaiva viparyaye \|*  
*tadā tu sa tvayā vācyo hyasthāne śaṃkurāhitaḥ \|*  
*sarvadevasabhā madhye tadā mokṣo bhaviṣyati \|\| 23 \|\|*

19-20a. “O Lord, do lay down the limit of the period of the curse. I was very childish, no doubt. Yet, O Lord, let my birth as a human being be in an excellent family, at a good holy place. Let the death too occur at a good place in the house of a Brāhmaṇa.”

20b-23. Thereupon, I was told by him: “O splendid lady, in Camatkārapura there is a leading Brāhmaṇa of a noble family named Devaśarman. He is a master of all the Śāstras. His wife is a well-known Brāhmaṇa lady named Satyabhāmā. Enter her womb for your human birth. At the time when Pitāmaha performs a Yajña in that holy spot there shall be the turn of the Udgātṛ and he may place the Śaṅku wrongly. Then he should be told by you, ‘The Śaṅku has been placed wrongly.’ You shall do this in the assembly of all the Devas. Your release (from the curse) shall take effect then.”

## \|\| 1.188.24 \|\|

*imāṃ me daivikīṃ kāṃtāṃ tanuṃ paśya dvijottama \|*  
*vimānaṃ paśya cāyātaṃ pitrā saṃpreṣitaṃ mama \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. O excellent Brāhmaṇa, look at this divine refulgent body of mine; See that the aerial chariot too sent by my father has come.

## \|\| 1.188.25 \|\|

*udgātovāca \|*  
*tuṣṭo'haṃ te viśālākṣi yajñasyā'vighnakārake \|*  
*na vṛthā darśanaṃ me syādviśeṣāddevasaṃbhave \|*  
*varaṃ varaya mattastvaṃ tasmādaudumbarīpsitam \|\| 25 \|\|*

Udgātṛ said:

25\. O lady of wide eyes, you have prevented an obstacle to this Yajña. Visiting me shall not go in vain especially in a rite concerning the gods. Hence, O Auduṃbarī, choose a boon from me.

## \|\| 1.188.26 \|\|

*audumbaryuvāca \|*  
*yadi me yacchasi varaṃ santuṣṭo brāhmaṇottama \|*  
*sarveṣāmeva devānāṃ purataśca dadasva tam \|\| 26 \|\|*

Auduṃbarī said:

26\. O excellent Brāhmaṇa, if you are pleased and wish to grant me a boon, do grant it in the presence of all the Devas.

## \|\| 1.188.27 \|\|

*adyaprabhṛti yaḥ kaścidyajñaṃ bhūmau samācaret \|*  
*tasminsadasi madhyasthā mūrtiḥ kāryā yathā mama \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. From now onwards if anyone performs a Yajña on the earth, an idol resembling me. should be kept in the middle of the assembly.—

## \|\| 1.188.28 \|\|

*tato matpurataścaiva kāryaṃ śakupracāraṇam \|*  
*svargasthāyā bhavettuṣṭirmama tena kṛtena ca \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. Then the movement of the Śaṅku should be made before me. If that is done, I shall be pleased even as I stay in my heavenly abode.

## \|\| 1.188.29-31 \|\|

*sūta uvāca \|*  
*tasyāstadvacanaṃ śrutvā udgātā tāmathābravīt \|*  
*adyaprabhṛti yaḥ kaścidyajñamatra kariṣyati \|\| 29 \|\|*

*sadomadhye tu tāṃ sthāpya pūjayitvā vilepanaiḥ \|*  
*vastrairābharaṇaiścaiva gandhapuṣpānulepanaiḥ \|\| 30 \|\|*

*tataḥ śaṃkupracāraṃ tu kariṣyati tadagrataḥ \|*  
*etadvākyaṃ mayā proktaṃ sarvadevasamā game \|\| 31 \|\|*

Sūta said:

29-31. On hearing her words the Udgātṛ said to her: “Henceforth whoever wishes to perform a Yajña here shall install her (that idol) in the middle of the assembly, adore it with. unguents, garments, ornaments, sweet scents, flowers and then move the Śaṅku in front of the image. This statement is made by me in the assembly of all the Devas.

## \|\| 1.188.32-34 \|\|

*nānyathā bhāvi bhadraṃ te tvaṃ saṃtoṣaṃ paraṃ vraja \|*  
*tvayā virahitaṃ bhadre sadaḥkarma kariṣyati \|\| 32 \|\|*

*vṛthā bhāvi ca tatsarvaṃ yathā bhasmahutaṃ tathā \|*  
*yā nārī sadaso madhye phalaistvāṃ pūjayiṣyati \|\| 33 \|\|*

*phalephale koṭiguṇaṃ tasyāḥ śreyo bhaviṣyati \|*  
*saphalāśca diśaḥ sarvā bhaviṣyaṃti na saṃśayaḥ \|\| 34 \|\|*

32-34. No good shall happen to you otherwise. Do attain the greatest joy. O fair lady, if anyone performs the rite in the assembly without you, all that shall be futile as though one has performed the Homa in ashes.

If any woman adores you in the center of the assembly by means of fruits, her welfare shall be crore-times more on each of the fruits. All the quarters shall be fruitful undoubtedly.

## \|\| 1.188.35 \|\|

*vastramābharaṇaṃ yā ca puṣpadhūpādikaṃ tathā \|*  
*tubhyaṃ dāsyati tatsarvaṃ tasyāḥ koṭiguṇaṃ phalam \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. If she offers you garments, ornaments, flowers, incense etc. all those things shall have a crore-tīme more benefit.

## \|\| 1.188.36 \|\|

*paraṃ tāvatpratīkṣasva mā vimānaṃ samāruha \|*  
*devi kenāpi kāryeṇa tava pūjāṃ samācare \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. But wait. Do not get into the aerial chariot. O goddess, with some end in view, I shall perform your worship.”

## \|\| 1.188.37 \|\|

*devā ūcuḥ \|*  
*yuktaṃ tvayā dvijaśreṣṭha vacanaṃ samudāhṛtam \|*  
*asmākamapi vākyena satyametadbhaviṣyati \|\| 37 \|\|*

The Devas said:

37\. O excellent Brāhmaṇa, proper words have been uttered by you. At our instance too this shall be true.

## \|\| 1.188.38 \|\|

*sūta uvāca \|*  
*udgātrā saitamuktā ca tiṣṭhatiṣṭhetyathoditā \|*  
*devī varavimānena gṛhītā sāṃ'bare sthitā \|\| 38 \|\|*

Sūta said:

38\. That goddess who was asked by the Udgātṛ to wait, stayed in the firmament, still carried by the aerial chariot.

## \|\| 1.188.39-40 \|\|

*etasminneva kāle tu devaśarmasutā'bhavat \|*  
*devī nagaramadhyasthāṃ sarvā nāryo dvijottamāḥ \|\| 39 \|\|*

*kutūhalātsamāyātāstasyā darśanalālasāḥ \|*  
*kācitphalāni cādāya kācidvastrāṇi bhaktitaḥ \|*  
*yathārhaṃ pūjitā tābhiḥ sarvābhiśca dvijottamāḥ \|\| 40 \|\|*

39-40. At the same time the daughter of Devaśarman became a goddess, O excellent Brāhmaṇas. All the women within the city came there out of curiosity, desirous of seeing her. Some had brought fruits with devotion and some garments. O excellent Brāhmaṇas, she was duly adored by all of them.

## \|\| 1.188.41 \|\|

*śrutvā svaduhituḥ so'pi devaśarmā samāyayau \|*  
*sapatnīkaḥ prahṛṣṭātmā vismayotphullalocanaḥ \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. On hearing the news of his daughter, Devaśarman too joyously came there along with his wife. His eyes beamed with wonder.

## \|\| 1.188.42 \|\|

*so'pi yāvatpraṇāmaṃ ca tasyāścakre dvijo ttamāḥ \|*  
*sapatnīkastadā proktvā niṣiddhastu tathā tayā \|\| 42 \|\|*

42\. O excellent Brāhmaṇas, when he too paid homage to her along with his wife, he was prevented by her who said thus:

## \|\| 1.188.43-44 \|\|

*tātatāta namaskāraṃ mā me kuru sahāṃbayā \|*  
*prāptā svargagatirnāma mama nāśaṃ prayā syati \|\| 43 \|\|*

*tiṣṭhātraiva sapatnīko yāvadadya dinaṃ vibho \|*  
*tvāmādāya sapatnīkaṃ yāsyāmi tridivālayam \|*  
*anenaiva śarīreṇa yācayitvā suro ttamān \|\| 44 \|\|*

43-44. “O father, father, do not bow down to me along with my mother. My acquisition of the heavenly goal will get endangered.

O my holy Lord, stay here with your wife for the whole of the day. After requesting the excellent Suras for that purpose, I shall go to the heavenly abode taking you along with your wife with this self-same physical body.”

## \|\| 1.188.45 \|\|

*tatastau harṣitau tatra pitarau hi vyavasthitau \|*  
*prekṣamāṇau sutāyāstāṃ pūjāṃ janavinirmitām \|*  
*manyamānau tadātmānamadhikaṃ sarva dehinām \|\| 45 \|\|*

45\. Then, the parents became delighted. They stayed there observing the adoration of their daughter by the people. They considered themselves superior to all embodied beings.

## \|\| 1.188.46 \|\|

*tasya ye svajanāḥ kecitsarve te'pi dvijottamāḥ \|*  
*śaṃsamānā sutāṃ tāṃ tu tatsamīpaṃ vyavasthitāḥ \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. O excellent Brāhmaṇas, all her kinsmen praised the girl and waited near her.

## \|\| 1.188.47 \|\|

*etasminnaṃtare prāpto bhṛguryatra pitāmahaḥ \|*  
*niṣkramya sadasastasmātkṛtāñjaliruvāca tam \|\| 47 \|\|*

47\. In the meantime, Bhṛgu came out of the assembly to the place where Pitāmaha was present and spoke to him with palms joined in reverence:

## \|\| 1.188.48-49 \|\|

*udgātrā deva cātmīyo mārgaḥ śrutivivarjitaḥ \|*  
*vihitaḥ kanyakāṃ dhṛtvā sadomadhye sureśvara \|\| 48 \|\|*

*devatvaṃ jalpitaṃ tasyā nāgaryāḥ surasaṃnidhau \|*  
*somapānaṃ tathā kurmo vayaṃ tatra tayā saha \|\| 49 \|\|*

48-49. “O Lord, the Udgātṛ has deviated from the Śruti-prescribed procedure by keeping a girl in the middle of the assembly, O Lord of Suras.

In the presence of the Suras, he has announced the divinity of that Nāgara woman (by saying). ‘We shall drink the Soma juice there along with her.’”

## \|\| 1.188.50 \|\|

*tato vidhistamānīya papraccha dvijasattamāḥ \|*  
*kā'sau kanyā kimarthaṃ ca sadomadhye dhṛtā tvayā \|\| 50 \|\|*

50\. Then Vidhi summoned him and asked him thus, O excellent Brāhmaṇas: “Who is this girl? Why was she kept in the middle of the assembly by you?”

## \|\| 1.188.51-53 \|\|

*so'bravīcchāpabhraṣṭeyaṃ gandharvī brāhmaṇālaye \|*  
*avatīrṇā vidheryajñe mukti rasyāḥ prakīrtitā \|\| 51 \|\|*

*nāradena purā deva kopena ca tathā mudā \|*  
*tasyā deva varo datto mayā tuṣṭena sāṃpratam \|\| 52 \|\|*

*śaṃkupracāraṃ no bāhyaṃ tava saṃpatsyate kvacit \|*  
*devaiḥ sarvaiḥ samānītā pratiṣṭhāṃ prapitāmaha \|\| 53 \|\|*

51-53. He said: “She is a Gandharvī who had fallen down on account of a curse. She was born in a Brāhmaṇa household. Her liberation from the curse was proclaimed at the Yajña of Vidhi by Nārada earlier. O Lord, he had cursed her angrily but I was satisfied and granted the boon now. The movement of the Śaṅku will never be beyond your ken. O Prapitāmaha, she has been duly glorified by all the Devas.”

## \|\| 1.188.54-55 \|\|

*etasminnaṃtare prāptāḥ kailāsācca dvijottamāḥ \|*  
*śrutvā cauduṃbarījātaṃ māhātmyaṃ dharaṇītale \|\| 54 \|\|*

*yajñe paitāmahe caiva hāṭakeśvarasaṃbhave \|*  
*kṣetre puṇyatame tatra pūjārthaṃ dvijasattamāḥ \|\| 55 \|\|*

54-55. In the meantime, on hearing the glory of Auduṃbarī on the earth in the sacrifice performed by Pitāmaha at the sacred-most Kṣetra of Hāṭakeśvara, the delighted Mātṛs came there from Kailāsa for the sake of worshipping.

## \|\| 1.188.56-57 \|\|

*hṛṣṭā mātṛgaṇā ye ca aṣṭaṣaṣṭipramāṇataḥ \|*  
*pūjyaṃte ye ca gandharvaiḥ siddhaiḥ sādhyairmarudgaṇaiḥ \|\| 56 \|\|*

*pṛthakpṛthagvidhai rūpairlokavismayakārakaiḥ \|*  
*nṛtyaṃtyaśca hasaṃtyaśca gāyaṃtyaśca tathāparāḥ \|\| 57 \|\|*

56-57. The Mothers too who number sixty-eight aṅd who are adored by Gandharvas, Siddhas, Sādhyas and groups of Maruts also came there. They had several forms which caused wonder and dismay in the world. Others also came dancing, laughing and singing.

## \|\| 1.188.58 \|\|

*tāsāṃ kolāhalaṃ śrutvā brahmaviṣṇupuraḥsarāḥ \|*  
*vismayaṃ paramaṃ prāptāḥ sarve devāḥ savāsavāḥ \|\| 58 \|\|*

58\. On hearing the uproar all the Devas, including Vāsava with Brahmā and Viṣṇu as their leaders became highly surprised.

## \|\| 1.188.59 \|\|

*kimetaditi jalpaṃtaḥ protthitā yajñamaṃḍapāt \|*  
*etasminnaṃtare prāptāḥ sarvāstā yatra padmajaḥ \|\| 59 \|\|*

59\. “What is this?” said they and rose up from the Yajña pavilion. In the meantime, all (the Mātṛgaṇas) came there where the Lotus-born Lord was present.

## \|\| 1.188.60-65 \|\|

*praṇamya śirasā hṛṣṭāstataḥ procustu sādaram \|*  
*vayamevaṃ samāyātāḥ śrutvā te yajñamuttamam \|\| 60 \|\|*

*āmaṃtritāśca deveśa vāyunā jagadāyunā \|*  
*yajñabhāgā na cāsmākaṃ vidyaṃte yajñakarmaṇi \|\| 61 \|\|*

*etānyeva dinānīha nāyātāstena padmaja \|*  
*auduṃbarīṃ vayaṃ śrutvā hyapūrvāṃ tena saṃgatāḥ \|\| 62 \|\|*

*sā dṛṣṭvā pūjitā'smābhiḥ praṇipātapuraḥsaram \|\| \|*  
*parvatasya sutā yasmādgandharvasya mahātmanaḥ \|\| 63 \|\|*

*sarvakāmapradā strīṇāṃ sarvadevaiḥ pratiṣṭhitā \|*  
*sthānaṃ darśaya cāsmākaṃ tvaṃ deva prapitāmaha \|\| 64 \|\|*

*aṣṭaṣaṣṭipramāṇaśca gaṇo'smākaṃ vyavasthitaḥ \|*  
*tacchrutvā padmajo jñātvā saṃkīrṇaṃ yatamaṃḍapam \|*  
*vyāptaṃ devagaṇaiḥ sarvaistrayastriṃśatpramāṇakaiḥ \|\| 65 \|\|*

60-65a. Lowering their head, they bowed down joyously and spoke respectfully: ‘We have come thus on hearing about your excellent Yajnā (Yajña?), O Lord of Devas, we have been invited by Vāyu, the very life of the universe. But we have no authorized share in the Yajña rites. Therefore, O Lotus-born One, we did not come on the earlier days. But on hearing about Auduṃbarī of unprecedented (fame) we have gathered here.

Since she was the daughter of the noble-souled Parvata, we met her and adored her with due obeisance. She grants all desires unto women. She has been glorified by all the Devas. O Lord Prapitāmaha, do show our seats. Our group numbers sixty-eight.

65bc. The Lotus-born Lord heard it and recollected how limited the Yajña pavilion was and how it was already filled by the group of the Devas numbering thirty-three.

## \|\| 1.188.66 \|\|

*tato madhyagamāhūya sa tadā nagarodbhavam \|*  
*śrutādhyayanasaṃpannaṃ vṛhaspatimivāparam \|*  
*abravīcchlakṣṇayā vācā tyaktā maunaṃ pitāmahaḥ \|\| 66 \|\|*

66\. Then, Pitāmaha summoned the Madhyaga hailing from the Nāgara community. He was accomplished in Vedic study. He was another Bṛhaspati as it were. He (Brahmā) abandoned the vow of silence and spoke to the Madhyaga in gentle and polished words:

## \|\| 1.188.67-69 \|\|

*tvaṃ gatvā mama vākyena viprānnāgarasaṃbhavān \|*  
*prabrūhi gotramukhyāṃśca hyaṣṭaṣaṣṭipramāṇataḥ \|\| 67 \|\|*

*ete mātṛgaṇāḥ prāptā aṣṭaṣaṣṭipramāṇakāḥ \|*  
*ekaika gotramukhyāśca ekaikasya pramāṇataḥ \|\| 68 \|\|*

*svesve bhūmivibhāge ca sthānaṃ yacchatu sāṃpratam \|*  
*etatsāhāyyakaṃ kāryaṃ bhavadbhirmama nāgarāḥ \|*  
*prasādaṃ pracuraṃ kṛtvā yena tuṣṭiṃ prayāṃti ca \|\| 69 \|\|*

67-69. “Do go and tell the Nāgara Brāhmaṇas on my behalf, especially the leaders of the Gotras numbering sixty-eight: ‘These Mothers have come and they number sixty-eight, a matching number of one for one. Each of them should give a seat in his own respective plot of land. O Nāgaras, this assistance should be extended to me by you all. This great favour on your part shall make them delighted.”

## \|\| 1.188.70 \|\|

*tataḥ sa satvaraṃ gatvā tānsamāhūya nāgarān \|*  
*provāca vinayopetaḥ praṇipatya tataḥ param \|\| 70 \|\|*

70\. He hastened thither and summoned the Nāgaras. He humbly bowed down to them and spoke (as instructed).

## \|\| 1.188.71 \|\|

*tacchrutvā nāgarāḥ sarve saṃtoṣaṃ paramaṃ gatāḥ \|*  
*ekaikasya gaṇasyaiva daduḥ sthānaṃ nijaṃ tadā \|\| 71 \|\|*

71\. On listening to it, all the Nāgaras became glad. Each of them gave the Mātṛs his own seat.

## \|\| 1.188.72 \|\|

*tatastāḥ mātaraḥ sarvāḥ praṇipatya pitāmaham \|*  
*tadanantaramevātha gāyatrīṃ bhaktipūrvakam \|\| 72 \|\|*

72\. Then all the Mothers bowed down to Pitāmaha and then to Gāyatrī with due devotion.

## \|\| 1.188.73 \|\|

*viprasaṃsūcite sthāne sarvāścaiva vyavasthitāḥ \|*  
*pūjitāstarpitāścaiva balibhirvividhairapi \|\| 73 \|\|*

73\. All of them settled in the seats indicated by the Brāhmaṇas. They were adored and propitiated through various kinds of balis (offerings).

## \|\| 1.188.74 \|\|

*tato gāyanti tā hṛṣṭā nṛtyaṃti ca hasaṃti ca \|*  
*tarpitā brāhmaṇendraiśca procuśca tadanantaram \|\| 74 \|\|*

74\. On being propitiated by the leading Brāhmaṇas they were delighted. They began to sing, laugh and dance. Thereafter they said:

## \|\| 1.188.75-76 \|\|

*na yāsyāmo paraṃ sthānaṃ sthāsyāmotraiva sarvadā \|*  
*īdṛśā yatra viprendrāḥ sarve bhaktisamanvitāḥ \|\| 75 \|\|*

*īdṛśaṃ ca mahākṣetraṃ hāṭakeśvarasaṃbhavam \|*  
*etasminneva kāle tu sāvitrī tatra saṃsthitā \|\| 76 \|\|*

75-76a. “We will not go to any other place. We will stay here itself always, where such devout leading Brāhmaṇas are present. And such a fine place is the holy spot of Hāṭakeśvara.”

76b. At the same time Sāvitrī happened to come there.

## \|\| 1.188.77-78 \|\|

*praṇipatya dvijaiḥ sarvairgacchamānā nivāritā \|*  
*mā devayajanaṃ gaccha sāvitri pativallabhe \|\| 77 \|\|*

*brahmaṇā pariṇītāsti gāyatrīti varāṃganā \|\| 78 \|\|*

77-78. All the Brāhmaṇas bowed to her but when she proceeded ahead they stopped her: “O Sāvitrī who are beloved of your husband, do not go to the Devayajana (the place of the Yajña unto the Devas). The excellent lady Gāyatrī has been taken as wife by Brahmā.”

## \|\| 1.188.79 \|\|

*tacchrutvā vacanaṃ teṣāṃ sāvitrī bhrāṃtalocanā \|*  
*duḥkhaśokasamopetā bāṣpavyākulalocanā \|\| 79 \|\|*

79\. On hearing those words, Sāvitrī became distressed. Due to confusion her eyes began to roll with tears welling up and agitating them.

## \|\| 1.188.80 \|\|

*dṛṣṭvā tā nṛtyamānāśca gāyamānāstathaiva ca \|*  
*utkūrdatīrdharāpṛṣṭhe saṃtoṣaṃ paramaṃ gatāḥ \|\| 80 \|\|*

80\. She saw (the Mothers) dancing, singing, leaping and jumping on the ground with great delight.

## \|\| 1.188.81-84 \|\|

*śaśāpātha ca sāvitrī bāṣpagadgadayā girā \|*  
*sapatnyā mama yatpūjāṃ kṛtvā vai susamāgatāḥ \|\| 81 \|\|*

*na praṇāmaḥ kṛto'smākaṃ mama duḥkhena duḥkhitāḥ \|*  
*tasmānnaivāparaṃ sthānaṃ gamiṣyatha kathaṃcana \|\| 82 \|\|*

*nāgarāṇāṃ ca no pūjā kadācitprabhaviṣyati \|*  
*na prāsādo'tha yuṣmākaṃ kadācitsaṃbhaviṣyati \|\| 83 \|\|*

*śītakāle tu śītena hyuṣṇakāle ca raśmibhiḥ \|*  
*varṣākāle tu toyena kleśaṃ yāsya tha bhūriśaḥ \|\| 84 \|\|*

81-84. Then Sāvitrī cursed them in stuttering convulsive words choked with tears: “You have adored my co-wife and occupied this place. You did not bow down to me. So, you shall be distressed even as I am distressed. You will never go to another place. Nāgaras too will never be adored? You will never get a palace erected at any time. You will undergo suffering due to coldness in winter, through hot rays in summer season and due to water in rainy season.”

## \|\| 1.188.85 \|\|

*evamuktvā tato devī sā tatraiva vyavasthitā \|*  
*nāgarāṇāṃ varastrībhiḥ sarvābhiḥ parivāritā \|\| 85 \|\|*

85\. After saying this, the goddess settled there itself surrounded by all the Nāgara women.

## \|\| 1.188.86-87 \|\|

*saṃbodhyamānā satataṃ sustrīṇāṃ ceṣṭitena ca \|*  
*etasminneva kāle tu bhagavāṃstīkṣṇadīdhitiḥ \|\| 86 \|\|*

*astaṃ gato mahāñchabdaḥ prasthito yajñamaṃḍape \|*  
*yājñikānāṃ tu viprāṇāṃ sumahāñchāstrasaṃbhavaḥ \|\| 87 \|\|*

86-87. Good ladies addressed her always with gestures (of good will).

At the same time, the Hot-rayed Lord (Sun) set. There was great noise and shouting in the Yajña pavilion as the Brāhmaṇas engaged in the Yajña rites discussed the scriptures.

## Chapter 189 - The Antecedents of Audumbarī

## \|\| 1.189.1-3 \|\|

*sūta uvāca \|*  
*atha yāvacca tāḥ śaptā mātaro dvijasattamāḥ \|*  
*sāvitryā tāstu gaṃdharvyaḥ prāptāḥ sā yatra tiṣṭhati \|\| 1 \|\|*

*tataḥ praṇamya tā ūcuḥ sarvā dīnataraṃ vacaḥ \|*  
*vayaṃ samāgatā devi sarvāstava makhe yataḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

*yajñabhāgaṃ labhiṣyāma auduṃbaryāḥ prasādataḥ \|*  
*na cāsmābhiḥ parijñātā sāvitrī cātra tiṣṭhati \|\| 3 \|\|*

Sūta said:

1-3. O excellent Brāhmaṇas, after the Mothers had been cursed by Sāvitrī, Gandharvīs came to the place where she (Audumbarī) was present.

After bowing down to her, they spoke these piteous words: “O goddess, we came to your Makha thinking that with Audumbarī’s favour we shall get a share in the Yajña offerings. It was not known to us that Sāvitrī was present here.

## \|\| 1.189.4 \|\|

*daurbhāgyadoṣasaṃpannā nāgarībhiḥ samāvṛtā \|*  
*asmākaṃ sukhamārgo'yaṃ nṛtyagītasamudbhavaḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. She was much distressed by the misfortune and was surrounded by the Nāgara women.

It is a happy way with us to dance and to sing.

## \|\| 1.189.5 \|\|

*tatkurvāṇāstato rātrau śaptā gāṃdharvasattame \|*  
*strīṇāṃ duḥkhena duḥkhārtā jāyaṃte sarvayoṣitaḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. O foremost one among Gandharvīs, we were doing the very same at night and so were cursed: ‘All women become distressed on seeing the distress of fellow-women (but you were not distressed at my grief).’

## \|\| 1.189.6-7 \|\|

*yūyamānaṃditāḥ sarvāḥ sapatnyā mama cotsave \|*  
*tāṃ praṇamya prapūjyādya nāhaṃ saṃbhāṣitāpi ca \|\| 6 \|\|*

*viśeṣānnṛtyagītaṃ ca prārabdhaṃ mama cāgrataḥ \|*  
*tasmādvyomagati rnaiva bhavatīnāṃ bhaviṣyati \|\| 7 \|\|*

6-7. You were delighted in the festival of my co-wife. You bowed down to her and adored her but did not even talk to me. You started unusual dancing and singing before me. Hence, you will not have the power to move through the sky.

## \|\| 1.189.8 \|\|

*asminsthāne sadā dīnāstathā'śrayavivarjitāḥ \|*  
*saṃtiṣṭhadhvaṃ na vaḥ pūjāṃ kariṣyaṃti ca mānavāḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. Men will not adore you. You will remain in this spot perpetually distressed without a support (or roof over you).

## \|\| 1.189.9 \|\|

*dīnānāmasamarthānāṃ yātrākṛtyeṣu sarvadā \|*  
*tasyāstadvacanaṃ devi nānyathā saṃbhaviṣyati \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. In the rites connected with pilgrimage of the indigent and the distressed you will always remain, but men will not adore you.’ O goddess, those words of hers cannot become untrue.

## \|\| 1.189.10 \|\|

*audumbaryāḥ pūjanāya gatvā tasyai nivedyatām \|*  
*sā hi vyapanayedduḥkhaṃ dhruvaṃ sā hi prakāmadā \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. (We thought) ‘Let us go to adore Audumbarī and tell her this incident. She will remove our misery certainly. She is indeed the bestower of all desires.’

## \|\| 1.189.11 \|\|

*tenā'tra sahasā prāptā yāvannaṣṭamanorathāḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. Having lost our hope otherwise, we have therefore, come here suddenly.’

## \|\| 1.189.12 \|\|

*tasmātkuruṣva kalyāṇi yathāsmākaṃ gatirbhavet \|*  
*māhātmyaṃ tava varddheta trailokye'pi carācare \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. Hence, O lady granting welfare, do something so that we will have the power of movement. Your greatness will become enhanced in all the three worlds consisting of mobile and immobile beings.”

## \|\| 1.189.13 \|\|

*audumbaryuvāca \|*  
*kā śaktirvidyate'smākaṃ kṛtaṃ sāvitrisaṃbhavam \|*  
*anyathā kartumevādya sarvairapi surāsuraiḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

Audumbarī said:

13\. What power do we have to alter what is brought about by Sāvitrī even with the help of all Suras and Asuras?

## \|\| 1.189.14 \|\|

*tathāpi śaktito devyo yatiṣyāmi hitāya vaḥ \|*  
*aṣṭaṣaṣṭiṣu gotreṣu bhavatyaḥ saṃniyojitāḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. Still I shall endeavour, O fair ladies, to the extent of my power for your welfare. You have been entrusted to the Brāhmaṇas of sixty-eight Gotras.

## \|\| 1.189.15 \|\|

*pitāmahena tuṣṭena tatra pūjāmavāpsyatha \|*  
*yūyaṃ rātrau ca saṃjñābhirhāsyapūrvābhireva ca \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. Pitāmaha who was pleased has done so and you will get due honour there. At night you can indicate the same by means of your laughter.

## \|\| 1.189.16-19 \|\|

*adyaprabhṛti yasyātra nāgarasya tu maṃdire \|*  
*vṛddhiḥ saṃpatsyate kācidvi śeṣānmaṃḍapodbhavā \|\| 16 \|\|*

*tathā yā yoṣitaḥ kāścitpuradvāraṃ sametya ca \|*  
*adṛṣṭahāsyamādhyāya kṣapiṣyaṃti baliṃ tataḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

*tena vo bhavitā tṛptirdevānāṃ ca yathā makhaiḥ \|*  
*yāḥ punarna kariṣyaṃti pūjāmetāṃ mayoditām \|\| 18 \|\|*

*yuṣmākaṃ nagare tāsāṃ suputro nāśamāpsyati \|*  
*yuṣmākamapamāne na sadā rogī bhaviṣyati \|\| 19 \|\|*

16-19. From now onwards you can become satisfied through the following means: If there is a grand festival (such as sacred thread ceremony or marriage etc.) in the house of any of the Nāgaras for which they will erect a pavilion, so also if women come to the city gate and offer Bali after due meditation without noticing (your) laughter, the satisfaction you thus receive will be like that of the Devas through Makhas.

If any women do not perform the adoration cited by me unto you all, in that city, their sons will perish. By insulting you, they will always be sickly.

## \|\| 1.189.20 \|\|

*tasmāttiṣṭhadhvamatraiva rakṣārthaṃ nagarasya ca \|*  
*śāpavyājena yuṣmākaṃ varo'yaṃ samupasthitaḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. Hence stay here itself for according protection to the city. Under the guise of a curse, this has become a boon unto you all.

## \|\| 1.189.21 \|\|

*etasminnaṃtare prāpto devaśarmā dvijottamāḥ \|*  
*gaṃdharvaḥ parvato jātaḥ svapatnyā sahitastadā \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. In the meantime, O excellent Brāhmaṇas, Devaśarman who came there along with his wife became the Gandharya named Parvata.

## \|\| 1.189.22 \|\|

*yadā caudumbarī śaptā nāradena surarṣiṇā \|*  
*mānuṣī bhava kruddhena tadā saṃprārthitastayā \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. When Audumbarī had been cursed by the angry celestial sage Nārada saying “Be a human girl”, he was requested by her thus:

## \|\| 1.189.23-24 \|\|

*madarthaṃ mānuṣo bhūtvā tatā tvaṃ cānayā saha \|*  
*sṛja māṃ mānuṣīṃ ceva yena gacchāmi no bhuvi \|\| 23 \|\|*

*viṇmūtrasaṃyute garbhe sarvadoṣasamanvite \|*  
*tataḥ sā kṛpayā tasyāḥ satpatnyā devaśarmaṇaḥ \|\| 24 \|\|*

23-24a. “O father, become a human being for my sake along with her (my mother) and procreate me as a human girl so that I can avert (being within the human womb). The womb is defiled by faeces and urine. It is full of all defects.”

24b. Thereupon, out of pity, the excellent wife of Devaśarman (descended).

## \|\| 1.189.25 \|\|

*avatīrṇā dharāpṛṣṭhe vānaprasthāśrame tataḥ \|*  
*evaṃ sā pañcamī rātristasya yajñasya sattamāḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. The Gandharva descended on the earth and was in the Vānaprastha stage (when Audumbarī was born).

Thus, O excellent ones, the fifth night of the Yajña passed off.

## \|\| 1.189.26-30 \|\|

*utsavena manojñena caudumbaryā vyatikramāt \|*  
*pratyūṣe ca tato jāte yadā tena visarjitā \|\| 26 \|\|*

*audumbarī tadā prāha parvataṃ janakaṃ nijam \|*  
*kalye'trāvabhṛtho bhāvī vidhiyajñasamudbhavaḥ \|\| 27 \|\|*

*sarvatīrthamayastasminsnānaṃ na syāttataḥ param \|*  
*yāsyāmaḥ svagṛhānbhūyaḥ sarvairdevaiḥ samanvitāḥ \|\| 28 \|\|*

*anenaiva vimānena trayo vāpi yathāsukham \|*  
*mamāpi ca varo jāto yaḥ śāpānnāradodbhavāt \|\| 29 \|\|*

*yajñabhāgo mayā prāpto devānāmapi durlabhaḥ \|*  
*paurṇamāsīdine prāpte viśeṣātstrījanaiḥ kṛtaḥ \|\| 30 \|\|*

26-27a. There was charming festivity though there was a disturbance from Audumbarī. When it dawned and she was sent off, Audumbarī said to her father Parvata:

27b-30. “In the morning, there shall be the Avabhṛtha (valedictory bath) pertaining to the Yajña of Vidhi. There shall be the presence of all the Tīrthas therein. We can also have our bath therein. Then we shall go home along with all the Devas.

We three shall go in this serial chariot happily. Actually, the curse of Nārada has been a blessing to me. because I got a Devas. It was obtained on the full-moon day as offered by the womenfolk.”

## Chapter 190 - Origin of Yakṣma Tīrtha

## \|\| 1.190.1-3 \|\|

*sūta uvāca \|*  
*evaṃ kratuḥ sa saṃjātaḥ pañcarātraṃ dvijottamāḥ \|*  
*hāṭakeśvaraje kṣetre sarvakāma samṛddhimān \|\| 1 \|\|*

*viprāṃśca bhikṣukāṃścaiva dīnāṃdhāṃśca viśeṣataḥ \|*  
*samāptau tasya yajñasya saṃtarpya sakalāṃstataḥ \|*  
*ṛtvijo dakṣiṇābhistānyathoktāndvijasattamān \|\| 2 \|\|*

*tataḥ sa cānayāmāsa nāgarānbrāhmaṇottamān \|*  
*cātuścaraṇasaṃpannāñchrutismṛti samanvitān \|\| 3 \|\|*

Sūta said:

1-3. Thus, O excellent Brāhmaṇas, that Kratu lasted for five days in the holy place of Hāṭakeśvara with everything desirable achieved in plenty.

The Brāhmaṇas, mendicants, distressed ones, blind ones and the Ṛtviks were fully propitiated with Dakṣiṇā. At the conclusion of the Yajña (Brahmā) summoned the excellent Nāgara Brāhmaṇas well-versed in all the four Vedas and experts in both Śrutis and Smṛtis.

## \|\| 1.190.4-8 \|\|

*kṛtāṃjalipuṭo bhūtvā tatastānprāha sādaram \|*  
*yadbhūmau tu mayā tīrthaṃ puṣkaraṃ saṃniveśitam \|\| 4 \|\|*

*kalikālasya bhītena dvitīyaṃ brāhmaṇottamāḥ \|*  
*yena no nāśamabhyeti mlecchairapi samāśritam \|\| 5 \|\|*

*hāṭakeśvaradevasya prabhāvena mahātmanaḥ \|*  
*kalikāle ca samprāpte tīrthānyāyatanāni ca \|\| 6 \|\|*

*mlecchaiḥ spṛṣṭānyasaṃdigdhaṃ prayāgādīni kṛtsnaśaḥ \|*  
*yajñastu vihitastena bhayāyaṃ tatkṛtena ca \|\| 7 \|\|*

*tasmādvadatha kiṃ dānaṃ yuṣmadbhūmeśca niṣkraye \|\| \|*  
*prayacchāmi ca yajñasya yena me syātphalaṃ dvijāḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

4-8. With palms joined in reverence, he spoke to them respectfully: “O excellent Brāhmaṇas, afraid of the Kali Age, a second Puṣkara has been established by me with the favour of Lord Hāṭakeśvara on the earth so that it will not be destroyed by the attack of Mlecchas.

At the advent of the Kali Age, Prayāga and all other Tīrthas and shrines are undoubtedly defiled by Mlecchas. That was why this Yajña has been performed by me.

Hence tell me, what gift shall I offer to you by way of cost of your plots of land. O Brāhmaṇas, thereby I can obtain the benefit of the Yajña.”

## \|\| 1.190.9 \|\|

*brāhmaṇā ūcuḥ \|*  
*yadi yacchasi cāsmākaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ yajñasaṃbhavām \|*  
*tadasmākaṃ svavāsena sthānaṃ naya pavitratām \|\| 9 \|\|*

The Brāhmaṇas said:

9\. If you are ready to offer to us the Dakṣiṇā due for the Yajña, then make our holy spot sacred by residing here yourself.

## \|\| 1.190.10 \|\|

*yadetadbhavatā cātra puṣkaraṃ tīrthamuttamam \|*  
*sthāpitaṃ tasya no brūhi māhātmyaṃ surasattama \|*  
*yena snānādikāḥ sarvāḥ kriyāḥ kurmaḥ pitāmaha \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. O Pitāmaha, O most excellent one among Suras, tell us the greatness of the excellent Tīrtha named Puṣkara established by you here so that we can perform the rites of ablution etc.

## \|\| 1.190.11-12 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*etattīrthaṃ mayā sṛṣṭamaṃtarikṣasthitaṃ sadā \|*  
*kiṃ na śrutaṃ purāṇeṣu bhavadbhirdvijasattamāḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

*pṛthivyāṃ naimiṣaṃ tīrthamantarikṣe ca puṣkaram \|*  
*trailokye tu kurukṣetraṃ viśeṣeṇa vyavasthitam \|\| 12 \|\|*

Brahmā said:

11-12. O excellent Brāhmaṇas, has not it been heard by you in the Purāṇas that this Tīrtha perpetually set up in the firmament is created by me?

Naimiṣa is specifically set up on the earth, Puṣkara in the firmament and Kurukṣetra in all the three worlds.

## \|\| 1.190.13 \|\|

*tadyuṣmākaṃ hitārthāya paṃcarātraṃ dharātale \|*  
*āgamiṣyatyasaṃdigdhaṃ mama vākyapraṇoditam \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. Undoubtedly, urged by my words, all these three will come down to the earth for five days.

## \|\| 1.190.14 \|\|

*kārtikyāṃ śuklapakṣe tu hyekādaśyāṃ dine sthite \|*  
*yāvatpaṃcadaśī tāvattithiḥ pāpapraṇāśinī \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. This period beginning from the eleventh lunar day in the bright half of the month of Kārttika till the fifteenth day (Full-moon day) is destructive of all sins.

## \|\| 1.190.15 \|\|

*paṃcarātrasya madhye tu yaḥ snānaṃ ca kariṣyati \|*  
*śrāddhaṃ vā śraddhayā yuktastasya syādakṣayaṃ hi tat \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. If anyone performs the ablution or Śrāddha rite with due faith during those five days that shall have everlasting benefit.

## \|\| 1.190.16 \|\|

*aha tu paṃcarātraṃ tadbrahmalokādupetya ca \|*  
*saṃśrayaṃ tu kariṣyāmi tīrthe'traiva dvijottamāḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. O excellent Brāhmaṇas, I shall come from Brahmaloka and resort to this Tīrtha during these five days.

## \|\| 1.190.17 \|\|

*brāhmaṇā ūcuḥ \|*  
*tava mūrtiṃ kariṣyāmaḥ sthāne'tra prapitāmaha \|*  
*tasyāṃ saṃkramaṇaṃ nityaṃ tasmātkāryaṃ tvayāvibho \|\| 17 \|\|*

The Brāhmaṇas said:

17\. O Prapitāmaha, we shall install your image in this holy spot. O Lord, pass into it and stay permanently.

## \|\| 1.190.18 \|\|

*tīrthaṃ caiva sadāpya'tra samāgacchatu cāṃbarāt \|*  
*lokānāṃ pāpanāśāya tathā tvaṃ kartumarhasi \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. Let the Tīrtha come here from the sky forever for the purpose of destroying the sins of the people. It behoves you to do so.

## \|\| 1.190.19 \|\|

*eṣā no dakṣiṇā deva yajñasyaiva samudbhavā \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. This is the Dakṣiṇā, O Lord, due for the Yajña.

## \|\| 1.190.20 \|\|

*evaṃ kṛte suraśreṣṭha saphalaḥ syātkratustava \|*  
*pratijñā ca tathā satyā tasmāddānāya nirmitā \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. O excellent one among Suras, if it is done so your Kratu shall be fruitful and your promise for making the gift shall become truthfully fulfilled.

## \|\| 1.190.21 \|\|

*śrībrahmovāca \|*  
*mantrāhūtaṃ tataḥ śreṣṭhaṃ nabhomārgāddvijottamāḥ \|*  
*hāṭakeśvaraje kṣetre puṣkaraṃ cāgamiṣyati \|\| 21 \|\|*

Śrī Brahmā said:

21\. On being invoked through the Mantras, O excellent Brāhṃaṇas, the sacred Puṣkara shall arrive at the holy spot of Hāṭakeśvara.

## \|\| 1.190.22-23 \|\|

*aghamarṣaṃ japaṃścaiva yaḥ kariṣyati toyagaḥ \|*  
*mama mūrteḥ puraḥ sthitvā pailamantrapuraḥsaram \|\| 22 \|\|*

*japiṣyati dvijaśreṣṭhāḥ savanānāṃ catuṣṭayam \|*  
*brahmalokātsamāgatya praśroṣyā mi ca taddvijāḥ \|\| 23 \|\|*

22-23. A devotee should repeat the Aghamarṣaṇa Mantra standing in water before my image. O excellent Brāhmaṇas, he should then repeat the four Savana Mantras beginning with Paila Mantra. Arriving here from Brahmaloka, I shall listen to it.

## \|\| 1.190.24 \|\|

*sūta uvāca \|*  
*atha te nāgarāḥ sarve puṣpadānaprapūrvakam \|*  
*anujñāṃ pradadustuṣṭā yajñaphalasamāptaye \|\| 24 \|\|*

Sūta said:

24\. Then all those Nāgaras gave the Anujñā (formal permission to conclude) after handing over the flowers so that the benefit of the Yajña could be obtained.

## \|\| 1.190.25 \|\|

*etasminnaṃtare prāptaḥ pulastyo'dhvaryusattamaḥ \|*  
*yatra sthāne sthito brahmā nāgaraiḥ parivāritaḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. In the meantime Pulastya, the excellent Adhvaryu, came to the place where Brahmā was present surrounded by the Nāgaras.

## \|\| 1.190.26 \|\|

*abravīcca samāptaste yataḥ saṃpūrṇadakṣiṇaḥ \|*  
*prāyaścittairvirahito yathā nānyasya kasyacit \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. He said: “Your Yajña has been concluded with the full complement of the Dakṣiṇās but without the Prāyaścitta (expiatory) rites unlike that of any other devotee.

## \|\| 1.190.27 \|\|

*ataḥ paraṃ karmaśeṣaṃ kiṃcidasti pitāmaha \|*  
*vāruṇeṣṭirjapaścaiva tatkariṣyāmi sāṃpratam \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. Hereafter, O Pitāmaha, a couple of rites still remain, namely Vāruṇeṣṭi and Japa. I shall perform it now.

## \|\| 1.190.28 \|\|

*tathā cā'vabhṛthasnānaṃ prakartavyaṃ tvayā saha \|*  
*tasmāduttiṣṭha gacchāmo yatra toyavyavasthitam \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. Further, the valedictory bath should be performed together with you. So get up, we shall go to the place where there is the arrangement for water.

## \|\| 1.190.29 \|\|

*yeneṣṭivāruṇīṃ tatra kurmo viprairyathocitaiḥ \|*  
*caturbhirbrahmapūrvaiśca mayā cāgnīdhrahotṛbhiḥ \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. Thereby, we shall perform the Vāruṇī Iṣṭi through qualified Brāhmaṇas. They are four in number including me beginning with Brahmā. The Āgnīdhra and Hotṛ are the others.

## \|\| 1.190.30 \|\|

*yathāvahnau tathā toye mantravattadbhavaṃśubham \|*  
*hūyate saṃvidhānenayajñapātraiḥ sama nvitam \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. As in the fire so in the water the auspicious rite is to be performed with Mantras. The Homa is performed in accordance with the injunctions along with the Yajña utensils.

## \|\| 1.190.31 \|\|

*varuṇasya pratuṣṭyarthaṃ snānaṃ kāryaṃ tvayaiva ca \|*  
*ṛtvigbhiḥ sahitenaiva sarvāriṣṭapraśāṃtaye \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. For pleasing Varuṇa and to suppress all disasters, the holy bath should be taken by you accompanied by the Ṛtviks.

## \|\| 1.190.32 \|\|

*yastatra samaye snānaṃ kariṣyati tvayā saha \|*  
*anyo'pi mānavaḥ kaścidvipāpmā sa bhaviṣyati \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. Any other man who takes his bath at that time along with you shall become free from sins.

## \|\| 1.190.33 \|\|

*yānīha saṃti tīrthāni trailokye sacarācare \|*  
*vāruṇīmiṣṭimāsādya tāni yāṃti ca saṃnidhau \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. All the Tīrthas existing in all the three worlds consisting of the mobile and immobile beings come near it at the time of Vāruṇī Iṣṭi.

## \|\| 1.190.34 \|\|

*tasmātsarvaprayatnena dīkṣitena samanvitam \|*  
*tatra snānaṃ prakartavyaṃ jalamadhye tu sārthibhiḥ \|*  
*brāhmaṇaiḥ kṣatriyairvaiśyaiḥ sarvairava bhṛthotsave \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. Hence, all the followers should assiduously take bath in the water along with the Dīkṣita (one initiated) in the festivity connected with Avabhṛtha, whether these participants are Brāhmaṇas, Kṣatriyas or Vaiśyas.

## \|\| 1.190.35 \|\|

*tasmādvisarjayādyaitānbrāhmaṇāṃstāvadeva ca \|*  
*ete'pi ca kariṣyaṃti snānaṃ tatra tvayā saha \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. Hence, send now these Brāhmaṇas too. They too will take their bath there along with you.”

## \|\| 1.190.36 \|\|

*sūta uvāca \|*  
*tacchrutvā prasthito brahmā jyeṣṭhakuṇḍataṭaṃ śubham \|*  
*gāyatryā sahito hṛṣṭaḥ kṛtakṛtyatvamāgataḥ \|\| 36 \|\|*

Sūta said:

36\. On hearing it, Brahmā started towards the splendid shore of the Jyeṣṭhakuṇḍa. He was pleased and contented. He was accompanied by Gāyatrī.

## \|\| 1.190.37 \|\|

*atha tadvacanaṃ śrutvā surāḥ sarve tathā dvijāḥ \|*  
*pulastyaśca śubhārthāya snānārthaṃ prasthitāstadā \|*  
*brahmaṇā sahitā hṛṣṭāḥ putradārasamanvitāḥ \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. Then, on bearing his words, all the Suras and Brāhmaṇas and Pulastya started with the intention of taking the ablution to get the auspicious benefit along with Brahmā. They were accompanied by their sons and wives. They were joyous.

## \|\| 1.190.38 \|\|

*atha saṃkīrṇatā jātā samaṃtājjyeṣṭhapuṣkare \|*  
*snānārthamāgatairlokairūrdhvabāhubhireva ca \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. (Due to the limitedness of space of the Tīrtha) a great confusion was caused at Jyeṣṭha Puṣkara by people who had come there for bath with their hands raised up.

## \|\| 1.190.39 \|\|

*na tatra lakṣyate brahmā na tatkarma ca vāruṇam \|*  
*kriyamāṇairdvijaistatra vyāpte bhūmi tale'khile \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. Neither Brahmā nor the Vāruṇa rite could be perceived there as the entire ground was covered by the Brāhmaṇas performing the rite.

## \|\| 1.190.40 \|\|

*athāṃte karmaṇastasya brahmā prāha śatakratum \|*  
*hitārthaṃ sarvalokasya vinayāvanataṃ sthitam \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. Then at the end of the rite, Brahmā said to Śatakratu who was modestly standing nearby What he said was for the sake of the welfare of all the world:

## \|\| 1.190.41 \|\|

*na māṃ jñāsyati dūrasthā janāḥ snānārthamāgatāḥ \|*  
*majjamānaṃ jale puṇye sammarde'smiñjalodbhave \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. “The people have come for bathing from far away and as there is great rush of people at the waterfront, they will not be able to see me taking a plunge into the meritorious waters.

## \|\| 1.190.42 \|\|

*tasmānnāgaṃ samāruhya nijaṃ vṛtraniṣūdana \|*  
*eṇasya kṛṣṇasārasya vaṃśāṃte carma nyasya ca \|\| 42 \|\|*

42\. Hence climb on to your elephant, O Slayer of Vṛtra, Place the skin (hide) of Eṇa or Kṛṣṇasāra at the tip of a bamboo.

## \|\| 1.190.43 \|\|

*tatastatsnānavelāyāṃ kṣeptavyaṃ salile tvayā \|*  
*yena lokaḥ samasto'yaṃ vetti kālaṃ tu snānajam \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. At the time of the bath, you must cast it down into the water so that all the people may know the exact time for bathing.

## \|\| 1.190.44 \|\|

*snānaṃ ca kurute śreyaḥ saṃprāpnoti yathoditam \|*  
*dūrastho'pi suvṛddho'pi bālo'pi ca samāgataḥ \|*  
*snānajaṃ labhate śreyaḥ saṃdṛṣṭe'pi yathoditam \|\| 44 \|\|*

44\. Everyone who has come, whether he is old or a mere child, if he stands far away, can take bath and obtain the benefit cited as the result of the bath even by seeing it.”

## \|\| 1.190.45 \|\|

*sūta uvāca \|*  
*bāḍhamityeva saṃprocya satvaraṃ prayayau hariḥ \|\| 45 \|\|*

Sūta said:

45\. Hari (Indra) said, “So it shall be done”, and hastened thereto,

## \|\| 1.190.46 \|\|

*tato nāgaṃ samāruhya dhṛtvā vaṃśaṃ kare nije \|*  
*mṛgacarmāgrasaṃyuktaṃ toyamadhye vyavasthitaḥ \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. Then he stood in the middle of the water riding on the elephant and holding in his hand the bamboo staff at the tip of which there was the antelope skin.

## \|\| 1.190.47 \|\|

*etatkarmāvasāne sa snātukāme pitāmahe \|*  
*taccarma prākṣipattoye svayameva śatakratuḥ \|\| 47 \|\|*

47\. At the conclusion of this rite, when Pitāmaha was about to take his bath, Śatakratu himself cast that skin into the water.

## \|\| 1.190.48 \|\|

*etasminnantare devāḥ sarve gandharvaguhyakāḥ \|*  
*mānuṣāśca viśeṣeṇa snātāstatra samāhitāḥ \|\| 48 \|\|*

48\. In the meantime, all the Devas, Gandharvas, Guhyakas and human beings took their bath with great concentration.

## \|\| 1.190.49 \|\|

*etasminnantare brahmā śakraṃ provāca sādaram \|*  
*kṛtasnānaṃ suraiḥ sārdhaṃ vinayāvanataṃ sthitam \|\| 49 \|\|*
