49\. In the meantime, Brahmā respectfully (eagerly) spoke to Śakra who had taken his bath along with the Suras and who stood near him modestly:

## \|\| 1.190.50 \|\|

*sahasrākṣaṃ tvayā kaṣṭaṃ manmakhe vipulaṃ kṛtam \|*  
*ānītā ca tathā patnī gāyatrī ca sumadhyamā \|\| 50 \|\|*

Brahmā said:

50\. O Thousand-eyed One, you have painfully exerted yourself much in my Makha. Gāyatrī, the slender-waisted wife, was brought (by you).

## \|\| 1.190.51 \|\|

*tasmādvaraya bhadraṃ te yaṃ varaṃ manasi sthitam \|*  
*sarvaṃ te'haṃ pradāsyāmi yadyapi syātsudurlabham \|\| 51 \|\|*

51\. Hence, choose your boon. I shall grant you everything even if it be very rare to be obtained. Welfare unto you.

## \|\| 1.190.52 \|\|

*indra uvāca \|*  
*yadi tuṣṭo'si me deva yadi deyo varo mama \|*  
*yadi tvāṃ prārthayāmyadya bhūyāttu tādṛśaṃ vibho \|\| 52 \|\|*

Indra said:

52\. O Lord, if you are pleased with me, if a boon has to be granted to me, O Lord, let what I request for, be so.

## \|\| 1.190.53 \|\|

*varṣevarṣe tu yaḥ kuryātsaṃprāpte'smindine śubhe \|*  
*mṛgacarma samādāya vaṃśāgre yo mahīpatiḥ \|\| 53 \|\|*

53\. Every year when this auspicious day arrives, the king should hold a bamboo staff with antelope-skin piece. He will be free from sins.

## \|\| 1.190.54 \|\|

*nāgapravaramāruhya svayameva pitāmaha \|*  
*yathā'haṃ prakṣipettoye sa syātpāpavivarjitaḥ \|\| 54 \|\|*

54\. O Pitāmaha, he shall ride on an excellent elephant like me. He should then throw the antelope-skin piece. He will be free from sins.

## \|\| 1.190.55 \|\|

*ajeyaḥ sarvaśatrūṇāṃ sarvavyasanavarjitaḥ \|*  
*ye kariṣyaṃti ca snānamanena mṛgacarmaṇā \|\| 55 \|\|*

55\. He will be devoid of all vices and be invincible to enemies. The people who take their bath along with this piece of antelope-skin, shall be sinless.

## \|\| 1.190.56 \|\|

*sārdhamanye'pi ye lokā api pāpasamanvitāḥ \|*  
*teṣāṃ varṣakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ tvatprasādātpraṇaśyatu \|\| 56 \|\|*

56\. The other people too, even if they are sinful, shall get the sins incurred in the course of a year destroyed.

## \|\| 1.190.57 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*etatsarvaṃ sahasrākṣa tava vākyamasaṃśayam \|*  
*bhaviṣyati na saṃdehaḥ sarvametanmayoditam \|\| 57 \|\|*

Brahmā said:

57\. O Thousand-eyed One, everything mentioned by you shall undoubtedly take effect. All these are as good as mentioned by me.

## \|\| 1.190.58-59 \|\|

*yo rājā śraddhayā yukto deśasyāsya samudbhavaḥ \|*  
*ānartasya gajārūḍho mṛgacarma kṣipiṣyati \|\| 58 \|\|*

*atra kuṇḍe madīye tu māṃ saṃpūjya taṭasthitam \|\| \|*  
*sarvalokahitārthāya saṃprāpte pratipaddine \|\| 59 \|\|*

58-59. A king born in this land of Ānarta should ride on an elephant with great faith. He should throw the antelope-skin piece into this Kuṇḍa of mine after worshiping (my image) situated on the bank, for the welfare of all the worlds, on the first lunar day.

## \|\| 1.190.60 \|\|

*samāpte kutape kāle vijayī sa bhaviṣyati \|*  
*kārtikyāṃ ca vyatītāyāṃ dvitīye'hni vyavasthite \|\| 60 \|\|*

60\. The Kutapa period (eighth Muhūrta) should have been over then and the second lunar day should have come after the Kārttikī is over.

## \|\| 1.190.61 \|\|

*tathā tatkālamāsādya ye kariṣyaṃti mānavāḥ \|*  
*snānaṃ tacca dine'traiva varṣapāpavivarjitāḥ \|*  
*ādhivyādhivimuktāśca te bhaviṣyaṃtyasaṃśayam \|\| 61 \|\|*

61\. Men who take their bath at that time here itself shall be rid of the sins of a year. Undoubtedly they will be freed from ailments and mental anguish.

## \|\| 1.190.62 \|\|

*sūta uvāca \|*  
*etasminnaṃtare prāpto yakṣmākhyo dāruṇo gadaḥ \|*  
*acikitsyo'pi devānāṃ tathā dhanvaṃtarerapi \|\| 62 \|\|*

Sūta said:

62\. In the meantime, a terribly fell disease named Yakṣman (Tuberculosis) spread there. Even the Devas and Dhanvantari too could not cure it.

## \|\| 1.190.63 \|\|

*nīlāṃbaradharaḥ kṣāmo dīno daṇḍasamāśritaḥ \|*  
*kṣutkurvañchleṣmaṇā tāvatkṛcchrātsaṃdhārayanpadam \|\| 63 \|\|*

63\. He was clad in blue clothes. He was lean and wretched in appearance. He had the support of a staff. With Śleṣman (phlegm) he coughed. He put forward his foot-step with very great difficulty.

## \|\| 1.190.64 \|\|

*tataśca praṇato bhūtvā vākyametaduvāca saḥ \|\| 64 \|\|*

64\. After bowing he spoke these words:

## \|\| 1.190.65 \|\|

*yakṣmovāca \|*  
*tava yajñamahaṃ śrutvā dūrādeva pitāmaha \|*  
*kṣutkṣāmakaṃṭhaścāyātaḥ samāptāvadya kṛcchrataḥ \|\| 65 \|\|*

Yakṣman said:

65\. O Pitāmaha, I heard about your Yajña from very far. With very great difficulty, I have come here with my throat parched through hunger.

## \|\| 1.190.66 \|\|

*dakṣeṇāhaṃ purā sṛṣṭaścaṃdrārthaṃ kupitena ca \|*  
*rohiṇīṃ sevamānasya saṃtyaktānyāsutasya ca \|\| 66 \|\|*

66\. I was created by Dakṣa formerly, when he became angry with Candra who resorted only to Rohiṇī (one of his daughters) to the exclusion of other daughters (of Dakṣa).

## \|\| 1.190.67 \|\|

*tato māheśvarādeśāttena tuṣṭena tasya ca \|*  
*pakṣamekaṃ kṛtaṃ mahyaṃ tasyāsvādanakarmaṇi \|\| 67 \|\|*

67\. Then Candra propitiated Maheśvara at whose bidding one fortnight was assigned to me to swallow and taste him (Candra).

## \|\| 1.190.68-70 \|\|

*anyapakṣe na kiṃcicca yena tṛptiḥ prajāyate \|*  
*yajñasyaiva tu sarvasya tarpayitvā dvijottamam \|\| 68 \|\|*

*tatastadvacanaṃ grāhyaṃ tarpito'hamasaṃśayam \|*  
*paurṇamāsyāṃ tato deva yasya yajñasya kṛtsnaśaḥ \|\| 69 \|\|*

*yasya no brāhmaṇo brūte yajñasyāṃte pratarpitaḥ \|*  
*tarpito'smīti tattasya vṛthā syādyajñajaṃ phalam \|*  
*yadi koṭiguṇaṃ dattamapi śraddhāsamanvitam \|\| 70 \|\|*

68-70. I do not have anything in the other fortnight whereby I can become satisfied. In every Yajña, the householder shall propitiate the excellent Brāhmaṇa. The Brāhmaṇa should utter “I am propitiated” and the householder should hear it doubtlessly. O Lord, that should be on the Full-moon day when the entire Yajña is concluded. If the Brāhmaṇa does not say “I have been propitiated” at the conclusion of the Yajña, the Yajña will be futile for him, even if a crore times more is given with great faith.

## \|\| 1.190.71 \|\|

*etacchrutvā tvayā deva paṭhyamānaṃ śrutāviha \|*  
*tasmātsamyaksthite yajñe brāhmaṇaṃ tarpayeta vai \|\| 71 \|\|*

71\. This, O Lord, you must have heard recited in the Śruti. Hence, when the Yajña is properly finished the Brāhmaṇas should be propitiated.

## \|\| 1.190.72 \|\|

*pratyakṣaṃ me yathā tṛptirannenaiva prajāyate \|*  
*tvatprasādātsuraśreṣṭha tathā nītirvidhīyatām \|\| 72 \|\|*

72\. O Suraśreṣṭha (foremost among Suras), my satisfaction will result only through cooked food with your favour. Kindly employ some means whereby it shall take effect.

## \|\| 1.190.73 \|\|

*sūta uvāca \|*  
*tacchrutvā padmajastasya pathyaṃpathyaṃ vaco'khilam \|*  
*śrutiṃ pramāṇatāṃ nītvā tato vacanamabravīt \|\| 73 \|\|*

Sūta said:

73\. On hearing all his entirely wholesome words holding Śruti as authority, the Lotus-born Lord spoke these words:

## \|\| 1.190.74-76 \|\|

*adyaprabhṛti vai viprāḥ sāgnayaḥ syurdharātale \|*  
*taiḥ sarvairvaiśvadevāṃte balirdeyastathākhilaḥ \|\| 74 \|\|*

*dattvā'nyebhyotha devebhyastava tṛptirbhaviṣyati \|*  
*tava pakṣe dvitīye tu satyametanmayoditam \|\| 75 \|\|*

*ye viprāstu baliṃ dadyurvaiśvadevāṃta āgate \|*  
*na teṣāmanvaye cāpi tvayā sevyo'tra kaścana \|\| 76 \|\|*

74-76. “From now onwards all the Brāhmaṇas on the earth who maintain sacrificial fires, should offer a Bali (of rice) at the end of Vaiśvadeva.

They must make offering to you after giving to the other Devas. Thereby you will become satisfied in the second fortnight. It is the truth that has been mentioned by me.

If the Brāhmaṇas offer Bali at the conclusion of Vaiśvadeva, you must not cling to anyone in his family.”

## \|\| 1.190.77 \|\|

*yakṣmovāca \|*  
*tīrthe'smiṃstāvake deva sadāhaṃ tapasi sthitaḥ \|*  
*tiṣṭhāmi yadi vādeśastāvako jāyate mama \|\| 77 \|\|*

Yakṣman said:

77\. O Lord, I shall always stay in your Tīrtha performing penance if only you command (permit) me.

## \|\| 1.190.78 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*yadyevaṃ kuru cānyatra tvamāśramapadaṃ nijam \|*  
*saṃprāpya bhūmideśe ca kañcidyadabhirocate \|*  
*arthayitvā dvijānetānyathā yajñakṛte mayā \|\| 78 \|\|*

Brahmā said:

78\. If it has to be so, you request these Brāhmaṇas, in the manner I had requested them for the sake of the Yajña. You can get a plot of land you may like. Thereon you do build your hermitage.

## \|\| 1.190.79 \|\|

*sūta uvāca \|*  
*tacchrutvā prārthayāmāsa camatkārapurodbhavān \|*  
*tebhyaḥ prāpya tato bhūmiṃ cakārāthāśramaṃ nijam \|\| 79 \|\|*

Sūta said:

79\. On hearing it, he requested the residents of Camatkārapura. After receiving a plot of land from them he built his own hermitage.

## \|\| 1.190.80 \|\|

*tatra yaḥ kurute snānaṃ pratipaddivase sthite \|*  
*sūryavāreṇa mucyeta yakṣmaṇā sevito'pi vā \|\| 80 \|\|*

80\. He who takes his bath on the first lunar day coinciding with a Sunday, shall be rid of tuberculosis if he is assailed by it.

## \|\| 1.190.81-82 \|\|

*adyāpi dṛśyate cātra pratyayastasya saṃbhave \|*  
*sarveṣāmāhitāgnīnāṃ nāgarāṇāṃ viśeṣataḥ \|*  
*kali kāle'pi saṃprāpte na yakṣmā saṃprajāyate \|\| 81 \|\|*

*tathā catuṣpadānāṃ ca teṣāṃ gṛhanivāsinām \|*  
*na tasya bheṣajāni syurna maṃtrā na cikitsakāḥ \|\| 82 \|\|*

81-82. Even today there is a proof of this in the case of those who preserve the sacred fires and the Nāgaras in particular. Even in the Kali Age, Yakṣman does not assail them or cattle staying in their house. There is no other remedy for it—neither medicine nor Mantras nor physicians.

## Chapter 191 - Occurrence of Evil Omens

## \|\| 1.191.1-3 \|\|

*ṛṣaya ūcuḥ \|*  
*sūtaputra tvayā proktaṃ sāvitrī nāgatā ca yat \|*  
*kauṭilyena samāyuktairāhūtā vacanaistathā \|*  
*pulastyena punaścaiva prasaktā gṛhakarmaṇi \|\| 1 \|\|*

*tatastu brahmaṇā kopādgāyatrī ca samāhṛtā \|*  
*devairvipreśce sā'tīva śaṃsitā bhāryatāṃ gatā \|\| 2 \|\|*

*sāvitrī ca kathaṃ jātā tāṃ jñātvā yajñamaṇḍape \|*  
*patnīśālāṃ praviṣṭāṃ ca sarvaṃ no vistarādvada \|\| 3 \|\|*

The sages said:

1-3. O Sūtaputra, It has been said by you that Sāvitrī did not come there though called by Pulastya with words deceptive in intention. She became engaged in domestic chores.

Then Gāyatrī was summoned by Brahmā angrily. She was praised very much by the Devas and Brāhmaṇas. She then became his wife.

What happened to Sāvitrī after knowing that she entered the Patnīśālā in the Yajñamaṇḍapa? Tell everything in detail.

## \|\| 1.191.4 \|\|

*sūta uvāca \|*  
*sāvitrī vaśagaṃ kāṃtaṃ jñātvā viśvāsamāgatā \|*  
*sthirā bhūtvā tadā sarvā devapatnīḥ samānayat \|\| 4 \|\|*

Sūta said:

4\. Sāvitrī thought her husband to be under her control and so was complacent. Steadying herself she fetched the wives of all the Devas.

## \|\| 1.191.5-6 \|\|

*gaurī lakṣmīḥ śacī medhā tathā caivāpyarundhatī \|*  
*svadhā svāhā tathā kītirbuddhiḥ puṣṭiḥ kṣamā dhṛtiḥ \|*  
*tathā cānyāśca bahavo hyapsarobhiḥ samanvitāḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

*ghṛtācī menakā raṃbhā urvaśī ca tilottamā \|*  
*apsarāṇāṃ gaṇāḥ sarve samājagmurdvijottamāḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

5-6. They were Gaurī, Lakṣmī, Śacī, Medhā, Arundhatī, Svadhā, Svāhā, Kīrti, Buddhi, Puṣṭi, Kṣamā, Dhṛti and many others accompanied by celestial damsels. Ghṛtācī, Menakā, Raṃbhā, Urvaśī, Tilottamā, all the groups of celestial damsels came there, O excellent Brāhmaṇas.

## \|\| 1.191.7 \|\|

*sā tābhiḥ sahitā devīpūrṇahastābhireva ca \|*  
*saṃprahṛṣṭamanobhiśca prasthitā maṇḍapaṃ prati \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. Accompanied by all of them who were delighted in their minds and whose hands were full (with fruits, presents etc.) she started towards the pavilion.

## \|\| 1.191.8 \|\|

*vādyamāneṣu vādyeṣu gītadhvaniyuteṣu ca \|*  
*gandharvāṇāṃ pramukhyānāṃ kinnarāṇāṃ viśeṣataḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. The musical instruments were played to the accompaniment of singing by leading Gandharvas and Kinnaras.

## \|\| 1.191.9 \|\|

*prasthitā sā mahābhāgā yāvattadyajñamaṇḍapam \|*  
*tāvattasyāstadā cakṣuḥ prāsphuraddakṣiṇaṃ muhuḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. That lady of great esteem went as far as the Yajña pavilion. By that time her right eye began to throb frequently.

## \|\| 1.191.10 \|\|

*apasavyaṃ mṛgāścakrustathānye'pi khagādayaḥ \|*  
*viparyastena saṃyāti śabdānkurvaṃti cāsakṛt \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. The beasts, the birds etc., flew and moved about anticlockwise. They moved backwards frequently making all sorts of noises.

## \|\| 1.191.11 \|\|

*dakṣiṇāni tathā'ṅgāni sphuramāṇāni vai muhuḥ \|*  
*tasyā manasi saṃkṣobhaṃ janayati nirargalam \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. The right limbs throbbing frequently agitated her mind continuously.

## \|\| 1.191.12 \|\|

*tāśca devastriyaḥ sarvā nṛtyaṃti ca hasaṃti ca \|*  
*gāyaṃti ca yathotsāhaṃ tasyāḥ pārśve vyavasthitāḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. But all the celestial women continued to dance and laugh and sing enthusiastically at her sides.

## \|\| 1.191.13-14 \|\|

*na jānaṃti ca saṃkṣobhaṃ tathā śakunajaṃ hṛdi \|*  
*anyonyasparddhayā sarvā gītanṛtyaparāyaṇāḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

*ahaṃpūrvamahaṃpūrvaṃ praviśāmi mahāmakhe \|*  
*ityautsukyasamopetāstā gacchaṃti tadā pathi \|\| 14 \|\|*

13-14. They were not aware of the excitement in the heart (of Sāvitrī) as a result of the ill omens. All of them were engaged in singing and dancing vying with one another. They went ahead saying “I will enter first; I will enter first in the great Makha.” They were too enthusiastic.

## Chapter 192 - Greatness of Sāvitrī

## \|\| 1.192.1-3 \|\|

*sūta uvāca \|*  
*atha śrutvā mahānādaṃ vādyānāṃ samupasthitam \|*  
*nāradaḥ sammukhaḥ prāyājjñātvā ca jananīṃ nijām \|\| 1 \|\|*

*praṇipatya sa dīnātmā bhūtvā cāśrupariplutaḥ \|*  
*prāha gadgadayā vācā kaṇṭhe bāṣpasamāvṛtaḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

*ātmanaḥ śāparakṣārthaṃ tasyāḥ kopavivṛddhaye \|*  
*kalipriyastadā vipro devastrīṇāṃ puraḥ sthitaḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

Sūta said:

1-3. On hearing the loud report of the musical instruments approaching, Nārada knew that it was his own mother. So he came face to face with her.

He was extremely distressed and completely drenched in tears. His words were choked in his throat due to tears. He bowed down and spoke falteringly. Standing before the celestial ladies, the Brāhmaṇa who was fond of quarrels wanted to increase her anger but at the same time wanted to save himself from being cursed.

## \|\| 1.192.4 \|\|

*meghagambhīrayā vācā praskhalaṃtyā padepade \|*  
*mayā tvaṃ devi cāhūtā pulastyena tataḥ param \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. Though he faltered at every word, his voice was as majestic as the rumbling of a cloud: “O goddess, you were invited by me and also by Pulastya thereafter.

## \|\| 1.192.5 \|\|

*strīsvabhāvaṃ samāśritya dīkṣākāle'pi nāgatā \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. But due to the predominance of natural womanly procrastination you did not come even at the time of the initiation (to the sacrifice).

## \|\| 1.192.6 \|\|

*tato vidheḥ samādeśācchakreṇānyā samāhṛtā \|*  
*kācidgopasamudbhūtā kumārī deva rūpiṇī \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. Then at the behest of Vidhi, another woman was brought by Śakra, a virgin hailing from a cowherd community but having the exquisite divine form.

## \|\| 1.192.7 \|\|

*govaktreṇa praveśyātha guhyamārgeṇa tatkṣaṇāt \|*  
*ākarṣitā mahābhāge samānītātha tatkṣaṇāt \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. She was forced into the mouth of a cow, O highly esteemed lady, and immediately pulled through the anus. Soon she was brought here.

## \|\| 1.192.8 \|\|

*sā viṣṇunā vivāhārthaṃ tataścaivānumoditā \|*  
*īśvareṇa kṛtaṃ nāma gāyatrī ca tavānugam \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. Then she was approved by Viṣṇu for the rite of marriage, imitating your name, the name Gāyatrī was given to her by Īśvara.

## \|\| 1.192.9 \|\|

*brāhmaṇaiḥ sakalaiḥ proktaṃ brāhmaṇīti bhavatviyam \|*  
*asmākaṃ vacanādbrahmankuru hastagrahaṃ vibho \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. ‘Let her be a Brāhmaṇa lady.’ So declared all the Brāhmaṇas and said, ‘O Lord Brahmā, grasp her hand, (in marriage).’

## \|\| 1.192.10 \|\|

*devaiḥ sarvaiḥ sa samproktastatastāṃ ca varānanām \|*  
*tataḥ patnyutthadharmeṇa yojayāmāsa satvaram \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. So said all the Devas too. Then (Brahmā) immediately employed her with all the duties of a ‘Patnī’ (wife at the side of the person performing Yajña).

## \|\| 1.192.11 \|\|

*kiṃ vā te bahunoktena patnīśālāṃ samāgatā \|*  
*raśanā yojitā tasyā gopyāḥ kaṭyāṃ sureśvari \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. Why should there be too much of talk? She came into the Patnīśālā (the inner chamber of Yajña). The sacred Raśanā (girdle) was tied round the waist of that cowherd-lass, O goddess of Suras.

## \|\| 1.192.12 \|\|

*taddṛṣṭvā garhitaṃ karma niṣkrāṃto yajñamaṇḍapāt \|*  
*amarṣa vaśamāpanno na śakto vīkṣituṃ ca tām \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. On seeing this censurable activity, I could not tolerate it at all. I was unable to see her. I came out of the Yajña pavilion.

## \|\| 1.192.13 \|\|

*etajjñātvā mahābhāge yatkṣamaṃ tatsamācara \|*  
*gaccha vā tiṣṭha vā tatra maṇḍape dharmavarjite \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. O highly esteemed lady, now that you have come to know of this, do what suits this occasion. Either go away or stay in that pavilion devoid of piety.”

## \|\| 1.192.14 \|\|

*tacchrutvā sā tadā devī sāvitrī dvijasattamāḥ \|*  
*pramlānavadanā jātā padminīva himāgame \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. On hearing it, O excellent Brāhmaṇas, Goddess Sāvitrī’s face became pallid like a lotus-pond when snow begins to fall.

## \|\| 1.192.15 \|\|

*lateva cchinnamūlā sā cakrīva priyavicyutā \|*  
*śuciśuklāgame kāle sarasīva gatodakā \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. She resembled a creeper the root of which has been cut, a ruddy goose separated from her loving mate or like a dried lake at the advent of the bright summer season.

## \|\| 1.192.16 \|\|

*prakṣīṇacandralekheva mṛgīva mṛgavarjitā \|*  
*seneva hatabhūpālā satīva gatabhartṛkā \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. She was like a digit of the waning moon or like a hind bereft of her stag, or like an army with the king killed or like a chaste lady whose husband has gone away.

## \|\| 1.192.17 \|\|

*saṃśuṣkā puṣpamāleva mṛtavatsaiva saurabhī \|*  
*vaimanasyaṃ paraṃ gatvā niścalatvamupasthitām \|*  
*tāṃ dṛṣṭvā devapatnyastā jagadurnāradaṃ tadā \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. Further, she was like a garland of flowers that has faded or a mother cow with the calf dead. On seeing her sitting motionless in an absent-minded state, the wives of the Devas said to Nārada:

## \|\| 1.192.18 \|\|

*dhigdhikkalipriya tvāṃ ca rāge vairāgyakārakam \|*  
*tvayā kṛtaṃ sarvametadvidhestasya tathāntaram \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. “Fie upon you, O (Sage) fond of quarrels! You cause estrangement where there is affectionate intimacy! The change in the (behaviour) of Vidhi has been wholly brought about by you.”

## \|\| 1.192.19 \|\|

*gauryuvāca \|*  
*ayaṃ kalipriyo devi brūte satyānṛtaṃ vacaḥ \|*  
*anena karmaṇā prāṇānbibhartyeṣa sadā muniḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

Gaurī said:

19\. O goddess, he is very fond of quarrels and speaks half truths and half lies. This sage sustains his life only through this type of activity always.

## \|\| 1.192.20 \|\|

*ahaṃ tryakṣeṇa sāvitri purā proktā muhurmuhuḥ \|*  
*nāradasya munervākyaṃ na śraddheyaṃ tvayā priye \|*  
*yadi vāṃchasi saukhyāni mama jātāni pārvati \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. O Sāvitrī, I was repeatedly warned beforehand by the Three-eyed Lord: “O dear Pārvatī, if you desire that I should be happy, you must not pay heed to the words of Nārada at all.”

## \|\| 1.192.21 \|\|

*tataḥprabhṛti naivāhaṃ śraddadhe'sya vacaḥ kvacit \|*  
*tasmādgacchāmahe tatra yatra tiṣṭhati te patiḥ \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. Ever since then I have not given any credence to his words at all. Hence, let us go where your husband is present.

## \|\| 1.192.22 \|\|

*svayaṃ dṛṣṭvaiva vṛttāṃtaṃ kartavyaṃ yatkṣamaṃ tataḥ \|*  
*nātrāsya vacanādadya sthātavyaṃ tatra gamyatām \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. Only after seeing for ourselves all the matter on hand we should do what is befitting. We must not tarry here merely because he says so. We shall go there.

## \|\| 1.192.23-26 \|\|

*sūta uvāca \|*  
*gauryā stadvacanaṃ śrutvā sāvitrī harṣavarjitā \|*  
*makhamaṇḍapamuddiśya praskhalantī padepade \|\| 23 \|\|*

*prajagāma dvijaśreṣṭhāḥ śūnyena manasā tadā \|*  
*pratibhāti tadā gītaṃ tasyā madhuramapyaho \|\| 24 \|\|*

*karṇaśūlaṃ yathā'yātamasakṛddvijasattamāḥ \|*  
*vandhyavādyaṃ yathā vādyaṃ mṛdaṃgānakapūrvakam \|\| 25 \|\|*

*pretasaṃdarśanaṃ yadvanmartyaṃ tatsā mahāsatī \|*  
*vīkṣituṃ na ca śakroti gacchamānā tadā makhe \|\| 26 \|\|*

Sūta said:

23-26. On hearing the words of Gaurī, Sāvitrī lost all delight, O excellent Brāhmaṇas. Her mind was void as it were. She proceeded towards the Yajña pavilion faltering at every step.

Even sweet music appeared jarring to her ears as it came continuously, O excellent Brāhmaṇas. The sound of the instruments of music like Mṛdaṅga, Ānaka etc. appeared like a barren, discordant note.

While she proceeded to the place of Yajña the great chaste lady could not bear to see the human concourse. It appeared as though she was looking at corpses.

## \|\| 1.192.27 \|\|

*śṛṃgāraṃ ca tathāṃgāraṃ manyate sā tanusthitam \|*  
*vāṣpapūrṇekṣaṇā dīnā prajagāma mahāsatī \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. She thought of the various articles of make-up on her body as though they were burning charcoal. Thus the great chaste lady went along in greater distress with her eyes filled with tears.

## \|\| 1.192.28 \|\|

*tataḥ kṛcchrātsamāsādya saivaṃ taṃ yajñamaṃḍapam \|*  
*kṛcchrātkārāgṛhaṃ tadvadduṣprekṣyaṃ dṛkpathaṃ gatam \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. With very great difficulty she reached the Yajña pavilion that fell within the range of her sight It appeared to her as a prison house very repulsive to look at.

## \|\| 1.192.29 \|\|

*atha dṛṣṭvā tu saṃprāptāṃ sāvitrīṃ yajñamaṇḍapam \|*  
*tatkṣaṇācca caturvaktraḥ saṃsthito'dhomukho hriyā \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. Seeing that Sāvitrī had reached the Yajṅa pavilion the Four-faced Lord stood immediately with face turned down due to shame.

## \|\| 1.192.30 \|\|

*tathā śambhuśca śakraśca vāsudevastathaiva ca \|*  
*ye cānye vibudhāstatra saṃsthitā yajñamaṃḍape \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. Same was the plight of Śaṃbhu, Śakra, Vāsudeva and all other Devas who happened to be in that Yajña pavilion.

## \|\| 1.192.31 \|\|

*te ca brāhmaṇaśārdūlāstyaktvā vedadhvaniṃ tataḥ \|*  
*mūkībhāvaṃ gatāḥ sarve bhayasaṃtrastamānasāḥ \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. The tiger-like (eminent) Brāhmaṇas stopped their Vedic chant abruptly. They were so frightened that they remained perfectly dumb.

## \|\| 1.192.32 \|\|

*atha saṃvīkṣya sāvitrī sapatnyā sahitaṃ patim \|*  
*kopasaṃraktanayanā paruṣaṃ vākyamabravīt \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. Seeing her husband in the company of her co-wife, Sāvitrī became furious with the eyes turned red. She spoke these harsh words:

## \|\| 1.192.33 \|\|

*sāvitryuvāca \|*  
*kimetadyujyate kartuṃ tava vṛddha tamākṛte \|*  
*ūḍhavānasi yatpatnīmetāṃ gopasamudbhavām \|\| 33 \|\|*

Sāvitrī said:

33\. O you wretch of senile features, is it proper on your part that you should get a cowherdlass as your wife?

## \|\| 1.192.34 \|\|

*ubhayoḥ pakṣayoryasyāḥ strīṇāṃ kāṃtā yathepsitāḥ \|*  
*śaucācāraparityaktā dharmakṛtyaparāṅmukhāḥ \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. On both the sides (paternal and maternal) of that girl, the women have anyone they fancied as their husbands. They have cast off their cleanliness and decorum. They are averse to righteous activities.

## \|\| 1.192.35-38 \|\|

*yadanvaye janāḥ sarve paśudharmaratotsavāḥ \|*  
*sodaryāṃ bhaginīṃ tyaktvā jananīṃ ca tathā parām \|\| 35 \|\|*

*tasyāḥ kule prasevaṃte sarvāṃ nārīṃ janāḥ parām \|*  
*yathā hi paśavo'śnaṃti tṛṇāni jalapānagāḥ \|\| 36 \|\|*

*viṇmūtraṃ kevalaṃ cakrurbhārodvahanameva ca \|*  
*tadvadasyāḥ kulaṃ sarvaṃ takramaśrāti kevalam \|\| 37 \|\|*

*kṛtvā mūtrapurīṣaṃ ca janmabhogavivarjitam \|*  
*nānyajjānāti kartavyaṃ dharmaṃ svodarasaṃ śrayāt \|\| 38 \|\|*

35-38. All the people in her family became enthusiastically happy in brutish way of sexual indulgence and dalliance. The men carnally approach all other women except perhaps their uterine sisters and mothers.

Just as animals go on grazing and chewing grass and drinking water, passing urine and discarding dung and meekly bearing burdens, so also the whole set of her family knows nothing except imbibing buttermilk to fill their belly. Evacuating the bowels and emptying their bladders is their sole duty without any superior enjoyment, in the course of their lives. They have no other duty except concern for their bellies.

## \|\| 1.192.39 \|\|

*antyajā api no karma yatkurvanti vigarhitam \|*  
*ābhīrāstacca kurvaṃti tatkimetattvayā kṛtam \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. Such despicable activities as even Śūdras eschew, these Ābhīras do not hesitate to carry on. What is it that you have done now!

## \|\| 1.192.40-42 \|\|

*avaśyaṃ yadi te kāryaṃ bhāryayā parayā makhe \|*  
*tvayā vā brāhmaṇī kāpi prakhyātā bhuvanatraye \|\| 40 \|\|*

*noḍhā vidhe vṛthā muṇḍa nūnaṃ dhūrto'si me mataḥ \|*  
*yattvayā śaucasaṃtyaktā kanyābhāvapradūṣitā \|\| 41 \|\|*

*prabhuktā bahubhiḥ pūrvaṃ tathā gopakumārikā \|*  
*eṣā prāptā supāpāḍhyā veśyājanaśatādhikā \|\| 42 \|\|*

40-42. If at all you had the necessity of another wife in the course of the Yajña, why was not a Brāhmaṇa lady well-known in all the three worlds married by you? O Vidhi, I consider you a bald-headed useless person of roguish propensities, since you took a Cowherd-lass for wife, whose virginity has been defiled, who has already been enjoyed earlier by many, who is extremely sinful excelling even a hundred harlots!

## \|\| 1.192.43 \|\|

*antyajātā tathā kanyā kṣatayoniḥ prajāyate \|*  
*tathā gopakumārī ca kācittādṛkprajāyate \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. A girl with, ruptured hymen becomes a Śūdra woman. Any of the Cowherd-lasses also becomes so.

## \|\| 1.192.44 \|\|

*mātṛkaṃ paitṛkaṃ vaṃśaṃ śvāśuraṃ ca prapātayet \|*  
*tasmādetena kṛtyena garhitena dharātale \|\| 44 \|\|*

44\. Such a woman (bride) will cause the downfall of the ancestors on her mother’s, father’s and father-in-law’s sides by this despicable deed on the earth.

## \|\| 1.192.45 \|\|

*na tvaṃ prāpsyasi tāṃ pūjāṃ tathā nye vibudhottamāḥ \|*  
*anena karmaṇā caiva yadi me sti ṛtaṃ kvacit \|\| 45 \|\|*

45\. If at all I have any truth (Ṛta) left with me, I aver that on account of this sinful act you and the other Devas will never get any honoured adoration.

## \|\| 1.192.46 \|\|

*pūjāṃ ye ca kariṣyaṃti bhaviṣyaṃti ca nirdhanāḥ \|*  
*kathaṃ na lajjitosi tvametatkurvanvigarhitam \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. Those who adore (you) will become poverty-stricken. How is it that you are not at all ashamed to do this despicable deed?

## \|\| 1.192.47 \|\|

*putrāṇāmatha pautrāṇāmanyeṣāṃ ca divaukasām \|*  
*ayogyaṃ caiva viprāṇāṃ yadetatkṛtavānasi \|\| 47 \|\|*

47\. What you have committed is something not proper to your sons, grandsons and the other heaven-dwellers as well as Brāhmaṇas.

## \|\| 1.192.48 \|\|

*atha vā naiṣa doṣaste na kāmavaśagā narāḥ \|*  
*lajjaṃti ca vijānaṃti kṛtyākṛtyaṃ śubhāśubham \|\| 48 \|\|*

48\. Or, perhaps this is not your fault. Men subject to the control of Kāma are shameless. They do not know what should be done and what should not be done, what is auspicious and what is not auspicious.

## \|\| 1.192.49 \|\|

*akṛtyaṃ manyate kṛtyaṃ mitraṃ śatruṃ ca manyate \|*  
*śatruṃ ca manyate mitraṃ janaḥ kāmavaśaṃ gataḥ \|\| 49 \|\|*

49\. A man under the influence of Kāma considers what should not be done as his duty. He considers his friend as his enemy and vice versa.

## \|\| 1.192.50 \|\|

*dyūtakāre yathā satyaṃ yathā cauraṃ ca sauhṛdam \|*  
*yathā nṛpasya no mitraṃ tathā lajjā na kāminām \|\| 50 \|\|*

50\. Just as there is no honesty in a gamester, no fraternity in a thief and there is no (real) friend to a king, so also there is no sense of shame in lustful men.

## \|\| 1.192.51 \|\|

*api syācchītalo vahniścaṃdramā dahanātmakaḥ \|*  
*kṣārābdirapi miṣṭaḥ syānna kāmī lajjate dhruvam \|\| 51 \|\|*

51\. Even fire may get cool. The moon may become ñery and the briny sea may become sweet in taste, but certainly a lustful man does not feel ashamed.

## \|\| 1.192.52 \|\|

*na me syāddukhametaddhi yatsāpatnyamupasthitam \|*  
*sahasramapi nārīṇāṃ puruṣāṇāṃ yathā bhavet \|\| 52 \|\|*

52\. I do not feel distressed that ī have to put up with a co-wife. Thousands of men and women do have it.

## \|\| 1.192.53 \|\|

*kulīnānāṃ ca śuddhānāṃ svajātyānāṃ viśeṣataḥ \|*  
*tvaṃ kuruṣva parāṇāṃ ca yadi kāmavaśaṃ gataḥ \|\| 53 \|\|*

53\. If you are that lustful, you marry other noble ladies of purity and belonging to your caste.

## \|\| 1.192.54 \|\|

*etatpunarmahadduḥkhaṃ yadābhīrī vigarhitā \|*  
*veśyeva naṣṭacāritrā tvayoḍhā bahubhartṛkā \|\| 54 \|\|*

54\. This is the most painful grief that an Ābhīrī who is as much censured as a harlot, has given up feminine modesty and has many husbands, has been married by you.

## \|\| 1.192.55 \|\|

*tasmādahaṃ prayāsyāmi yatra nāma na te vidhe \|*  
*śrūyate kāmalubdhasya hriyā parihṛtasya ca \|\| 55 \|\|*

55\. Hence, O Vidhi, I shall go to that place where even your name is never heard, because you are greedy and lustful as well as bereft of shame.

## \|\| 1.192.56 \|\|

*ahaṃ viḍaṃbitā yasmādatrānīya tvayā vidhe \|*  
*purato devapatnīnāṃ devānāṃ ca dvijanmanām \|*  
*tasmātpūjāṃ na te kaścitsāṃprataṃ prakariṣyati \|\| 56 \|\|*

56\. O Vidhi, after fetching me here, I have been ridiculed by you in front of the wives of Devas, Devas and Brāhmaṇas. So, no one will perform your worship now.

## \|\| 1.192.57-58 \|\|

*adya prabhṛti yaḥ pūjāṃ maṃtrapūjāṃ kariṣyati \|*  
*tava martyo dharāpṛṣṭhe yathānyeṣāṃ divaukasām \|\| 57 \|\|*

*bhaviṣyati ca tadvaṃśo daridro duḥkhasaṃyutaḥ \|*  
*brāhmaṇaḥ kṣatriyo vāpi vaiśyaḥ śūdropi cālaye \|\| 58 \|\|*

57-58. From now onwards, if any man on the earth worships you in a temple with or without Mantras as in the case of other heaven-dwellers, his lineage will become destitute and miserable, whether he is a Brāhmaṇa or a Kṣatriya, a Vaiśya or a Śūdra.

## \|\| 1.192.59 \|\|

*eṣā'bhīrasutā yasmānmama sthāne vigarhitā \|*  
*bhaviṣyati na saṃtānastasmādvākyānmamaiva hi \|\| 59 \|\|*

59\. Since this despised daughter of an Abhīra has been put in my place, she will never raise a family as per my words.

## \|\| 1.192.60 \|\|

*na pūjāṃ lapsyate loke yathānyā devayoṣitaḥ \|\| 60 \|\|*

60\. She will never be offered worship as in the case of other goddesses.

## \|\| 1.192.61 \|\|

*kariṣyati ca yā nārī pūjā yasyā api kvacit \|*  
*sā bhaviṣyati duḥkhāḍhyā vaṃdhyā daurbhāgyasaṃyutā \|\| 61 \|\|*

61\. A woman who worships her at any place will become miserable, unfortunate and barren.

## \|\| 1.192.62 \|\|

*pāpiṣṭhā naṣṭacāritrā yathaiṣā paṃcabhartṛkā \|*  
*vikhyātiṃ yāsyate loke yathā cāsau tathaiva sā \|\| 62 \|\|*

62\. She will become the most sinful with her chastity violated like this woman with five (i.e. many) husbands. She will be notorious like this woman.

## \|\| 1.192.63-64 \|\|

*etasyā anvayaḥ pāpo bhaviṣyati niśācara \|*  
*satyaśaucaparityaktāḥ śiṣṭasaṃgavivarjitāḥ \|\| 63 \|\|*

*aniketā bhaviṣyaṃti vaṃśe'syā goprajīvinaḥ \|*  
*evaṃ śaptvā vidhiṃ sādhvī gāyatrīṃ ca tataḥ param \|\| 64 \|\|*

63-64. The members of the family of this woman shall become sinful night-stalkers. Those who maintain themselves through cows in her family shall be devoid of honesty and cleanliness. They will not have association with good people. They will never have a permanent residence.

Thus, she cursed Vidhi and Gāyatrī thereafter.

## \|\| 1.192.65-68 \|\|

*tato devagaṇānsarvāñchaśāpa ca tadā satī \|*  
*bhobhoḥ śakra tvayānītā yadeṣā paṃcabhartṛkā \|\| 65 \|\|*

*tadāpnuhi phalaṃ samyakchubhaṃ kṛtvā guroridam \|*  
*tvaṃ śatrubhirjito yuddhe baṃdhanaṃ samavāpsyasi \|\| 66 \|\|*

*kārāgāre ciraṃ kālaṃ saṃgamiṣyatyasaṃśayam \|*  
*vāsudeva tvayā yasmādeṣā vai paṃcabhartṛkā \|\| 67 \|\|*

*anumoditā vidheḥ pūrvaṃ tasmācchapsyāmyasaṃśayam \|*  
*tvaṃ cāpi parabhṛtyatvaṃ saṃprāpsyasi sudurmate \|\| 68 \|\|*

65-67a. Then, the chaste lady cursed all the groups of Devas; “O Śakra, since this woman of five (many) husbands was brought by you and apparently you thus did good to your preceptor, you will as a result thereof be bound and put in bondage after being defeated by your enemies.

Undoubtedly, you will be in prison for a long time.

67b-68. O Vāsudeva, earlier you approved this woman of five husbands as fit for Vidhi. So, I shall curse you too without hesitation. O wicked-minded one, you will undergo the state of being a servant of another.

## \|\| 1.192.69 \|\|

*samīpastho'pi rudra tvaṃ karmaitadyadupekṣase \|*  
*niṣedhayasi no mūḍha tasmācśṛṇu vaco mama \|\| 69 \|\|*

69\. O foolish Rudra, though close at hand you were indifferent to this act. You did not stop it. So listen to my words:

## \|\| 1.192.70 \|\|

*jīvamānasya kāṃtasya mayā tadvirahodbhavam \|*  
*saṃsevitaṃ mṛtāyāṃ te dayitāyāṃ bhaviṣyati \|\| 70 \|\|*

70\. The grief of separation from a living husband which I experience now, will be yours after the death of your wife.

## \|\| 1.192.71-72 \|\|

*yatra yajñe praviṣṭeyaṃ garhitā paṃcabhartṛkā \|*  
*bhavānapi havirvahne yattvaṃ gṛhṇāsi laulyataḥ \|\| 71 \|\|*

*tathānyeṣu ca yajñeṣu samyakchaṃkāvivarjitaḥ \|*  
*tasmādduṣṭasamācāra sarvabhakṣo bhaviṣyasi \|\| 72 \|\|*

71-72. O Vahni (Fire-god), you accepted Havis out of greed in that Yajña where this despised woman of five husbands entered as also in other Yajñas without the least hesitation. So, your conduct has become defiled. You will become omnivorous.

## \|\| 1.192.73 \|\|

*svadhayā svāhayā sārdhaṃ sadā duḥkhasamanvitaḥ \|*  
*naivāpsyasi paraṃ saukhyaṃ sarvakālaṃ yathā purā \|\| 73 \|\|*

73\. As before, you will never have long standing happiness along with Svāhā and Svadhā. You will be miserable!

## \|\| 1.192.74-75 \|\|

*ete ca brāhmaṇāḥ sarve lobhopahatacetasaḥ \|*  
*homaṃ prakurvate ye ca makhe cāpi vigarhite \|\| 74 \|\|*

*vittalobhena yatraiṣā niviṣṭā pañcabhartṛkā \|*  
*tathā ca vacanaṃ proktaṃ brāhmaṇīyaṃ bhaviṣyati \|\| 75 \|\|*

74-75. All the Brāhmaṇas had been greedy in their minds. Due to the covetousness for wealth, they performed Homa in the despised Yajña where this woman of five husbands had entered and also said, ‘She will become a Brāhmaṇī’.

## \|\| 1.192.76 \|\|

*daridropahatāstasmādvṛṣalīpatayastathā \|*  
*vedavikrayakartāro bhaviṣyatha na saṃśayaḥ \|\| 76 \|\|*

76\. Hence, all these will be assailed by poverty and will become paramours of Vṛṣalīs (Śūdra women or harlots). They will undoubtedly sell the Vedas.

## \|\| 1.192.77 \|\|

*bhobho vittapate vittaṃ dadāsi makhaviplave \|*  
*tasmādyatte'khilaṃ vittamabhogyaṃ saṃbhaviṣyati \|\| 77 \|\|*

77\. O Lord of wealth, you distributed monetary gifts in this miserable Makha. Hence, all your wealth will be unfit for consumption and enjoyment.

## \|\| 1.192.78-79 \|\|

*tathā devagaṇāḥ sarve sāhāyyaṃ ye samāśritāḥ \|*  
*atra kurvaṃti doṣāḍhye yajñe vai pāṃcabhartṛke \|\| 78 \|\|*

*saṃtānena parityaktāste bhaviṣyaṃti sāṃpratam \|*  
*dānavaiśca parābhūtā duḥkhaṃ prāpsyati kevalam \|\| 79 \|\|*

78-79. All the groups of the Devas who extended their cooperation and assistance in a defective Yajña pertaining to one with five husbands, will be devoid of progeny. They will be attacked and defeated by Dānavas and will meet with misery.

## \|\| 1.192.80 \|\|

*etasyāḥ pārśvataścānyāścatasro yā vyavasthitāḥ \|*  
*ābhīrīti sapa tnīti proktā dhyānapraharṣitāḥ \|\| 80 \|\|*

80\. Four others are settled at her side. They are also mentioned as Ābhīrī and Sapatnī (co-wife) and they are delighted in their meditation.

## \|\| 1.192.81 \|\|

*mama dveṣaparā nityaṃ śivadūtīpurassarāḥ \|*  
*tāsāṃ parasparaṃ saṃgaḥ kadācicca bhaviṣyati \|\| 81 \|\|*

81\. With Śivadūtī as their leader they are always engaged in hating me. They will not have mutual association.

## \|\| 1.192.82 \|\|

*nānyenātra nareṇāpi dṛṣṭimātramapi kṣitau \|*  
*parvatāgreṣu durgeṣu cāgamyeṣu ca dehinām \|*  
*vāsaḥ saṃpatsyate nityaṃ sarvabhogavivarjitaḥ \|\| 82 \|\|*

82\. They will not have any contact with any other man on the earth, not even a visual contact. Their residence shall be confined to unsealable tops of mountains, very impassable to all the embodied beings, devoid of all pleasures and enjoyments.”

## \|\| 1.192.83 \|\|

*sūta uvāca \|*  
*evamuktvā'tha sāvitrīkopopahatacetasā \|*  
*visṛjya devapatnīstāḥ sarvā yāḥ pārśvataḥ sthitāḥ \|\| 83 \|\|*

Sūta said:

83\. After saying thus the extremely infuriated Sāvitrī dismissed all the Deva-wives who were staying at her sides.

## \|\| 1.192.84 \|\|

*udaṅmukhī pratasthe ca vāryamāṇāpi sarvataḥ \|*  
*sarvābhirdevapatnībhirlakṣmīpūrvābhirevaca \|\| 84 \|\|*

84\. She started towards the north though prevented by all the Deva-wives, including Lakṣmī, from all sides.

## \|\| 1.192.85 \|\|

*tatra yāsyāmi no yatra nāmāpi kila vai yataḥ \|*  
*śrūyate kāmukasyāsya tatra yāsyāmyahaṃ drutam \|\| 85 \|\|*

85\. (She said to herself:) ‘I will go there where even the name of this lascivious person is not to be heard. I will certainly go there.’

## \|\| 1.192.86 \|\|

*ekaścaraṇayornyasto vāmaḥ parvatarodhasi \|*  
*dvitīyena samārūḍhā tasyāgasya tathopari \|\| 86 \|\|*

86\. She placed one of her feet, the left one, at the ridge of the mountain. With the second she climbed on to the top of the mountain.

## \|\| 1.192.87 \|\|

*adyāpi tatpadaṃ vāmaṃ tasyāstatra pradṛśyate \|*  
*sarvapāpaharaṃ puṇyaṃ sthitaṃ parvatarodhasi \|\| 87 \|\|*

87\. Even today her left footprint is visible there. It is impressed on the ridge of the mountain. It is meritorious and it is destructive of all sins.

## \|\| 1.192.88 \|\|

*api pāpasamācāro yastaṃ pūjayate naraḥ \|*  
*sarvapātakanirmuktaḥ sa yāti paramaṃ padam \|\| 88 \|\|*

88\. A man may be of sinful conduct, but if he worships that footprint, he will be rid of all sins and he will attain the greatest position.

## \|\| 1.192.89 \|\|

*yo yaṃ kāmamabhi dhyāya tamarcayati mānavaḥ \|*  
*avaśyaṃ samavāpnoti yadyapi syātsudurlabham \|\| 89 \|\|*

89\. A man may worship it with any desire in his mind. He will surely attain it even if it is very rare.

## \|\| 1.192.90 \|\|

*sūta uvāca \|*  
*evaṃ tatra sthitā devī sāvitrī parvatā śrayā \|*  
*apamānaṃ mahatprāpya sakāśātsvapatestadā \|\| 90 \|\|*

Sūta said:

90\. Thus, after meeting with great insult from her own husband, Goddess Sāvitrī settled there on the (top of the) mountain.

## \|\| 1.192.91 \|\|

*yastāmarcayate samyakpaurṇamāsyāṃ viśeṣataḥ \|*  
*sarvānkāmānavāpnoti sa manovāṃchitāṃ stadā \|\| 91 \|\|*

91\. He who adores her scrupulously, especially on a Full-moon day, attains all wishes desired mentally by him.

## \|\| 1.192.92 \|\|

*yā nārī kurute bhaktyā dīpadānaṃ tadagrataḥ \|*  
*raktataṃtubhirājyena śrūyatāṃ tasya yatphalam \|\| 92 \|\|*

92\. Listen to the benefit of Dīpadāna (offering of a lamp) by a woman devoutly in front of her, with ghee and red wicks.

## \|\| 1.192.93 \|\|

*yāvantastaṃtavastasya dahyaṃte dīpa saṃbhavāḥ \|*  
*muhūrtāni ca yāvaṃti ghṛtadīpaśca tiṣṭhati \|*  
*tāvajjanmasahasrāṇi sā syātsaubhāgyabhāṃginī \|\| 93 \|\|*

93\. She will enjoy conjugal felicity for as many thousands of births as there are threads burning in the lamp and Muhūrtas during which the ghee lamp burns.

## \|\| 1.192.94 \|\|

*putrapautrasamopetā dhaninī śīla maṃḍanā \|\|*  
*na durbhagā na vandhyā ca na ca kāṇā virūpikā \|\| 94 \|\|*

94\. She will be blessed with sons and grandsons as well as wealth. She will never be unlucky, barren, one-eyed or hideous in features.

## \|\| 1.192.95 \|\|

*yā nṛtyaṃ kurute nārī vidhavāpi tadagrataḥ \|*  
*gītaṃ vā kurute tatra tasyāḥ śṛṇuta yatphalam \|\| 95 \|\|*

95\. Listen to the benefit attained by a woman, even if she be a widow, who dances or sings songs before her.

## \|\| 1.192.96 \|\|

*yathāyathā nṛtyamānā svagātraṃ vidhunoti ca \|*  
*tathātathā dhunotyeva yatpāpaṃ prakṛtaṃ purā \|\| 96 \|\|*

96\. As and when she makes movements of the body while dancing, she actually sheds off the sin perpetrated earlier.

## \|\| 1.192.97 \|\|

*yāvanto jantavo gītaṃ tasyāḥ śṛṇvaṃti tatra ca \|*  
*tāvaṃti divi varṣāṇi sahasrāṇi vasecca sā \|\| 97 \|\|*

97\. She will stay in heaven for as many thousands of years as there are creatures listening to her songs.

## \|\| 1.192.98 \|\|

*sāvitrīṃ yā samuddiśya phaladānaṃ karoti sā \|*  
*phalasaṃkhyāpramāṇāni yugāni divi modate \|\| 98 \|\|*

98\. If any woman makes gifts of fruits with Sāvitrī in view, she rejoices in heaven for as many Yugas as there are fruits.

## \|\| 1.192.99 \|\|

*miṣṭānnaṃ yacchate yaśca nārīṇāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ \|*  
*tasyā dakṣiṇamūrtau ca bhartrāḍhyānāṃ dvijottamāḥ \|*  
*sa ca sikthapramāṇāni yugā ni divi modate \|\| 99 \|\|*

99\. O excellent Brāhmaṇas, if a man offers sweetmeat especially to women having husbands, in the presence of her Dakṣiṇāmūrti (image on the right side, or on the right side of the image), he rejoices in heaven for as many Yugas as there are grains of cooked rice.

## \|\| 1.192.100 \|\|

*yaḥ śrāddhaṃ kurute tatra samyakchraddhāsamanvitaḥ \|*  
*rasenaikena sasyena tathaikena dvijottamāḥ \|*  
*tasyāpi jāyate puṇyaṃ gayāśrāddhena yadbhavet \|\| 100 \|\|*

100\. If anyone performs Śrāddha there with perfect faith offering one Rasa (juice) and one Sasya (vegetable dish), he will attain the merit that accrues from Gayāśrāddha.

## \|\| 1.192.101-102 \|\|

*yaḥ karoti dvijastasyā dakṣiṇāṃ diśamāśritaḥ \|*  
*sandhyopāsanamekaṃ tu svapatnyā kṣipitairjalaiḥ \|\| 101 \|\|*

*sāyaṃtane ca saṃprāpte kāle brāhmaṇasattamāḥ \|*  
*tena syādvaṃditā saṃdhyā samyagdvādaśavārṣikī \|\| 102 \|\|*

101-102. A Brāhmaṇa (person) should turn to the southern direction (of the goddess) and perform at least one Sandhyā prayer by means of waters poured by his wife at the evening time, O excellent Brāhmaṇas. Thereby he gets as much benefit as though he performed Sandhyā prayer for twelve years.

## \|\| 1.192.103 \|\|

*yo japedbrāhmaṇastasyāḥ sāvitrīṃ purataḥ sthitaḥ \|*  
*tasya yatsyātphalaṃ viprāḥ śrūyatāṃ tadvadāmi vaḥ \|\| 103 \|\|*

103\. O Brāhmaṇas, do listen to the benefit of the Brāhmaṇas who performs the Japa of Sāvitrī Mantra in front of her. I shall narrate it.

## \|\| 1.192.104 \|\|

*daśabhirjjanmajanitaṃ śatena ca purā kṛtam \|*  
*triyuge tu sahasreṇa tasya naśyati pātakam \|\| 104 \|\|*

104\. If he recites the Mantra ten times, the sins he committed during that birth perish. If he recites it a hundred times, all the sins committed formerly perish and if he recites the Mantra a thousand times, all the sins committed in three Yugas perish.

## \|\| 1.192.105 \|\|

*tasmātsarvaprayatnena camatkārapuraṃ prati \|*  
*gatvā tāṃ pūjayeddevīṃ stotavyā ca viśeṣataḥ \|\| 105 \|\|*

105\. Hence one should assiduously go to Camatkārapura and worship that goddess. She should be specially prayed to and eulogized.

## \|\| 1.192.106 \|\|

*sāvitryā idamākhyānaṃ yaḥ paṭhecchṛṇuyācca vā \|*  
*sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ sukhabhāgatra jāyate \|\| 106 \|\|*

106\. He who reads or listens to this story of Sāvitrī shall be rid of all sins and become happy here.

## \|\| 1.192.107 \|\|

*etadvaḥ sarvamākhyātaṃ yatpṛṣṭo'haṃ dvijottamāḥ \|*  
*sāvitryāḥ kṛtsnaṃ māhātmyaṃ kiṃ bhūyaḥ pravadāmyaham \|\| 107 \|\|*

107\. Thus, O excellent Brāhmaṇas, what I was asked has been completely narrated to you all, regarding the greatness of Sāvitrī. What more shall I narrate to you?

## Chapter 193 - Gāyatrī Grants Boons

## \|\| 1.193.1-2 \|\|

*ṛṣaya ūcuḥ \|*  
*evaṃ gatāyāṃ sāvitryāṃ sakopāyāṃ ca sūtaja \|*  
*kiṃ kṛtaṃ tatra gāyatryā brahmādyaiścāpi kiṃ suraiḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

*etatsarvaṃ samācakṣva paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi naḥ \|*  
*kathaṃ śāpānvitā devāḥ saṃsthitāstatra maṇḍape \|\| 2 \|\|*

The sages said:

1-2. O Sūtaja, when the furious Sāvitrī departed in this manner, what was done by Gāyatrī and the Suras including Brahmā? Do narrate all this. We are curious to know. How did the Devas who were cursed, continue to stay there in the pavilion?

## \|\| 1.193.3 \|\|

*sūta uvāca \|*  
*gatāyāmatha sāvitryāṃ śāpaṃ dattvā dvijottamāḥ \|*  
*gāyatrī sahasotthāya vākyametadudairayat \|\| 3 \|\|*

Sūta said:

3\. O excellent Brāhmaṇas, when after cursing them Sāvitrī went away, Gāyatrī got up immediately and uttered these words:

## \|\| 1.193.4 \|\|

*sāvitryā yadvacaḥ proktaṃ tanna śakyaṃ kathaṃcana \|*  
*anyathā kartumevātha sarvairapi surāsuraiḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. “The words that Sāvitrī uttered cannot at all be altered even by the Suras and Asuras.

## \|\| 1.193.5 \|\|

*mahāsatī mahābhāgā sāvitrī sā pativratā \|*  
*pūjyā ca sarvadevānāṃ jyeṣṭhā śreṣṭhā ca sadgaṇaiḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. That highly virtuous, great, chaste lady Sāvitrī is senior-most and most superior (to all) in auspicious qualities. She is worthy of worship to all Suras.

## \|\| 1.193.6 \|\|

*paraṃ strīṇāṃ svabhāvo'yaṃ sarvāsāṃ surasattamāḥ \|*  
*api sahyo vajrapātaḥ sapatnyā na punaḥ kathā \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. But, O excellent Suras, this is the nature of all women. The blow of a thunderbolt can be endured but not the (bitter) story of a co-wife.

## \|\| 1.193.7 \|\|

*matkṛte ye'tra śapitā sāvitryā brāhmaṇāḥ surāḥ \|*  
*teṣāmahaṃ kariṣyāmi śaktyā sādhāraṇāṃ svayam \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. On account of me, Brāhmaṇas and Suras have been cursed by Sāvitrī. By means of my power I shall myself make their plight a very normal one.

## \|\| 1.193.8 \|\|

*apūjyo'yaṃ vidhiḥ proktastayā maṃtrapuraḥsaraḥ \|*  
*sarveṣāmeva varṇānāṃ viprādīnāṃ suro ttamāḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. O excellent Suras, Vidhi (god Brahmā) has been declared by her as unworthy of being worshipped with Mantras for all the castes beginning with Brāhmaṇas.

## \|\| 1.193.9 \|\|

*brahmasthāneṣu sarveṣu samaye dharaṇītale \|*  
*na brahmaṇā vinā kiṃcitkṛtyaṃ siddhimupaiṣyati \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. On the entire surface of the earth in all the seats of Brahmā, no holy rite can attain perfection without Brahmā.

## \|\| 1.193.10 \|\|

*kṛṣṇārcane ca yatpuṇyaṃ yatpuṇyaṃ liṃga pūjane \|*  
*tatphalaṃ koṭiguṇitaṃ sadā vai brahmadarśanāt \|*  
*bhaviṣyati na sandeho viśeṣātsarvaparvasu \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. A sight of Brahmā always yields a crore times more benefit than that of the worship of Kṛṣṇa and of Liṅga, undoubtedly, especially on all Parvan days.

## \|\| 1.193.11 \|\|

*tvaṃ ca viṣṇo tayā prokto martyajanma yadā'psyasi \|*  
*tatrāpi parabhṛtyatvaṃ pareṣāṃ te bhaviṣyati \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. O Viṣṇu, you have been told by her that when you take human incarnation, you will undergo the state of being a servant to others.

## \|\| 1.193.12 \|\|

*tatkṛtvā rūpadvitayaṃ tatra janma tvamāpsyasi \|*  
*yattayā kathito vaṃśo mamāyaṃ gopasaṃjñitaḥ \|*  
*tatra tvaṃ pāvanārthāya ciraṃ vṛddhimavāpsyasi \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. There you will adopt two distinct forms and take incarnation there. She had referred to my family known by the name Cowherd. You will be brought up there in such a family for a long time in order to sanctify it.

## \|\| 1.193.13 \|\|

*ekaḥ kṛṣṇābhidhānastu dvitīyo'rjunasaṃjñitaḥ \|*  
*tasyātmano'rjunākhyasya sārathyaṃ tvaṃ kariṣyasi \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. One form will be known by the name Kṛṣṇa and the other by the name Arjuna. You will act as the charioteer of your own self named Arjuna,

## \|\| 1.193.14 \|\|

*tenākṛtye'pi raktāste gopā yāsyaṃti ślāghyatām \|*  
*sarveṣāmeva lokānāṃ devānāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. Thereby, those cowherds will attain a praise-worthy status in spite of their fondness for misdemeanour. They will be praised by all the people and more particularly by Devas.

## \|\| 1.193.15 \|\|

*yatrayatra ca vatsyaṃti madvaṃ śaprabhavānarāḥ \|*  
*tatratatra śriyo vāso vane'pi prabhaviṣyati \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. Wherever men of my community stay there shall be the presence of Śrī (fortune and prosperity) even if it be a forest.

## \|\| 1.193.16 \|\|

*bhobhoḥ śakra bhavānukto yattayā kopayuktayā \|*  
*parājayaṃ ripoḥ prāpya kārā gāre patiṣyati \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. O Śakra, haven’t you been told by that enraged lady that you will be imprisoned after being defeated by your enemy?

## \|\| 1.193.17-19 \|\|

*tanmuktiṃ te svayaṃ brahmā madvākyena kariṣyati \|\| 17 \|\|*

*tataḥ praviṣṭaḥ saṃgrāme na parājayamāpsyasi \|*  
*tvaṃ vahne sarvabhakṣaśca yatprokto ruṣṭayā tayā \|\| 18 \|\|*

*tadamedhyamapi prāyaḥ spṛṣṭaṃ te'rccirbhiragrataḥ \|*  
*medhyatāṃ yāsyati kṣipraṃ tataḥ pūjāmavāptyasi \|\| 19 \|\|*

17-18a. At my instance, Brahmā himself will bring about your release therefrom. Thereafter, even in a battlefield you will not meet with defeat.

18b-19. O Vahni, in your case, the enraged lady has averred that you will be omnivorous. But even the filthy rubbish will soon gain in purity and sacredness when it is touched by your flames and you will be adored.

## \|\| 1.193.20 \|\|

*svāhā nāma ca bhāryā yā devānsantarpayiṣyati \|*  
*svadhā cā'pi pitṝnsarvānmama vākyādasaṃśayam \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. At my instance undoubtedly your wife named Svāhā will propitiate the Devas and Svadhā will propitiate all the Pitṛs.

## \|\| 1.193.21 \|\|

*yadrudra priyayā sārdhaṃ viyogaḥ kathitastayā \|*  
*tasyāḥ śreṣṭha tarā cānyā tava bhāryā bhaviṣyati \|*  
*gaurīnāmeti vikhyātā himācalasutā śubhā \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. O Rudra, separation from your beloved has been given to you (in the curse). But another better and more excellent lady will become your wife. She will be the splendid daughter of Himācala famous by the name of Gaurī.”

## Chapter 194 - Description of Tīrthas

## \|\| 1.194.1-2 \|\|

*sūta uvāca \|*  
*evaṃ sā tānvarāndattvā sarveṣāṃ śāpabhāginām \|*  
*maunavrataparā bhūtvā niviṣṭā'tha dharātale \|\| 1 \|\|*

*tato devagaṇāḥ sarve tāpasāśca maharṣayaḥ \|*  
*sādhusādhviti tāṃ procya tataḥ procuridaṃ vacaḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

Sūta said:

1-2. After granting the boons thus to all those victims of the curse, she (Gāyatrī) observed the vow of silence and sat on the ground.

Then all the groups of Devas, sages and great ascetics exclaimed: “Excellent! Excellent!” And spoke these words to her:

## \|\| 1.194.3 \|\|

*etāṃ devīprasādena brāhmaṇānāṃ viśeṣataḥ \|*  
*pūjayiṣyaṃti martye'tra sarve lokāḥ samāhitāḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. “With the special favour of the Brāhmaṇas, all the people will adore this goddess with great concentration in this human world.

## \|\| 1.194.4 \|\|

*brahmāṇaṃ pūjayitvā tu paścādenāṃ sureśvarīm \|*  
*pūjayiṣyaṃti ye martyāste tu yāṃti parāṃ gatim \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. Those men who worship this goddess of Suras after worshipping Brahmā, will attain the greatest goal.

## \|\| 1.194.5-6 \|\|

*yā kanyā patisaṃyogaṃ saṃprāpyātra samāhitā \|*  
*tataḥ pādapraṇāmaṃ ca gāyatryāśca kariṣyati \|*  
*patiṃ prajāpatiṃ prāpya sā bhaviṣyatyasaṃśayam \|\| 5 \|\|*

*sarvakāmasukhopetā dhanadhānyasamanvitā \|*  
*yā nārī durbhagā vaṃdhyā bhaviṣyati ca śobhanā \|\| 6 \|\|*

5-6. A girl who, after getting a husband, bows down to the feet of Gāyatrī with great concentration and mental purity will undoubtedly be happy as though a Prajāpati has been obtained as her husband. She will be blessed with all happiness and realization of desires. A barren woman or one disliked by her husband will turn into a splendid lady.”

## \|\| 1.194.7-8 \|\|

*ṛṣaya ūcuḥ \|*  
*yadetadbhavatā proktaṃ gate paṃcottare śate \|*  
*padmajānāṃ haraḥ prādādetatkathamanutta mam \|\| 7 \|\|*

*brāhmaṇebhyaḥ sa saṃtuṣṭaḥ kiṃvā'nyo'sti maheśvaraḥ \|*  
*etaṃ naḥ saṃśayaṃ bhūyo yathāvadvaktumarhasi \|\| 8 \|\|*

The sages said:

7-8. You had said that Hara gave this when one hundred five Padmajas (Brahmās) had gone and that he was pleased and gave this excellent thing to the Brāhmaṇas. How is it? Or is there another Maheśvara? It behoves you to clear this doubt of ours.

## \|\| 1.194.9 \|\|

*āyuṣyaṃ śaṃkarasyāpi yatpramāṇaṃ tathā hareḥ \|*  
*brahmaṇo'pi samācakṣva paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi naḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. Do tell us the life span of Śaṅkara as well as that of Hari. Mention that of Brahmā too. We are very much interested in it.

## \|\| 1.194.10 \|\|

*sūta uvāca \|*  
*ahaṃ vaḥ kīrtayiṣyāmi vistareṇa dvijottamāḥ \|*  
*trayāṇāmapi cāyuṣyaṃ yatpramāṇaṃ vyavasthitam \|\| 10 \|\|*

Sūta said:

10\. O excellent Brāhmaṇas, I shall speak to you all in detail, the life span of all the three (deities).

## \|\| 1.194.11 \|\|

*nimeṣasya caturbhāgastruṭiḥ syāttaddvayaṃ lavaḥ \|*  
*lavadvayaṃ kalā proktā kāṣṭhā tu daśapaṃcabhiḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. Truṭi is a fourth part of Nimeṣa. Two Nimeṣas make one Lava. Two Lavas make one Kalā and fifteen Kalās make one Kāṣṭhā

## \|\| 1.194.12 \|\|

*triṃśatkāṣṭhāṃ kalāmāhuḥ kṣaṇastriṃśatkalo mataḥ \|*  
*muhūrtamānaṃ mauhūrtā vadaṃti dvādaśakṣaṇam \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. They say that thirty Kāṣṭhās make one Kalā and thirty Kalās make one Kṣaṇa. Those who are conversant with Muhūrtas say that a Muhūrta consists of twelve Kṣaṇas.

## \|\| 1.194.13 \|\|

*triṃśanmuhūrtamuddiṣṭamahorātraṃ manīṣibhiḥ \|*  
*māsastriṃśadahorātrairdvau māsāvṛtusaṃjñitaḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. Learned men say that thirty Muhūrtas make one day and night. Thirty Ahorātras (day and night) make one month. The period of time consisting of two months is called a Ṛtu (season).

## \|\| 1.194.14 \|\|

*ṛtutrayaṃ cāyanaṃ ca ayane dve tu vatsaram \|*  
*daivikaṃ ca bhavettacca hyahorātraṃ dvijottamāḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. Three Ṛtus make one Ayana (Transit of the Sun). Two Ayanas make one Vatsara (year). That becomes one day of Devas, O excellent Brāhmaṇas.

## \|\| 1.194.15-16 \|\|

*uttaraṃ cāyanaṃ tatra dinaṃ rātristathā'param \|*  
*lakṣaiḥ saptadaśākhyaistu manuṣyāṇāṃ ca vatsaraiḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

*aṣṭāviṃśatibhiścaiva sahasraistu tathā paraiḥ \|*  
*ādyaṃ kṛtayugaṃ caiva tadbha viṣyati saddvijāḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

15-16. Uttarāyaṇa (Northern transit) is the day and the other one (i.e. Dakṣiṇāyana) is the night (of Devas). One million seven hundred twenty-eight thousand human years will make the first, Kṛtayuga, O excellent Brāhmaṇas.

## \|\| 1.194.17 \|\|

*tato dvādaśabhirlakṣaiḥ ṣoḍaśānāṃ sahasrakaiḥ \|*  
*tretāyugaṃ samādiṣṭaṃ dvitīyaṃ dvijasattamāḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. The period consisting of one million two hundred ninety-six thousand years is mentioned as the second, Tretā Yuga, O excellent Brāhmaṇas.

## \|\| 1.194.18 \|\|

*dvāparaṃ cāṣṭabhirlakṣaistṛ tīyaṃ parikīrtitam \|*  
*catuḥṣaṣṭisahasraistu yathāvatparisaṃkhyayā \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. Dvāpara, the third Yuga, is mentioned as consisting of eight hundred sixty-four thousand Years.

## \|\| 1.194.19 \|\|

*caturlakṣaṃ samādiṣṭaṃ yugaṃ kalisamudbhavam \|*  
*dvātriṃśatā sahasraistu caturthaṃ tadvidurbudhāḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. Kali yuga, the fourth one, consists of four hundred thirty-two thousand years. So say learned men.

## \|\| 1.194.20 \|\|

*caturyugasahasreṇa dinaṃ paitāmahaṃ bhavet \|*  
*teṣāṃ triṃśaddinairmāso māsairdvādaśabhirvatsaro bhavet \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. A thousand four-Yuga periods make one day of Pitāmaha; thirty such days make one month and twelve months a year.

## \|\| 1.194.21 \|\|

*brahmā teṣāṃ śataṃ yāvatsa jīvati pitāmahaḥ \|*  
*sāṃprataṃ cāṣṭavarṣīyaḥ ṣaṇmāsaścaiva saṃsthitaḥ \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. Brahmā, the grandfather, lives for such one hundred years. Now his age is eighty years and six months.

## \|\| 1.194.22 \|\|

*pratipaddivasasyāsya prathamasya tathā gatam \|*  
*yāmadvayaṃ śukravāre vartamāne mahātmanaḥ \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. Of the first Pratipad day of this noble-souled one two Yāmas have passed by the current Friday.

## \|\| 1.194.23 \|\|

*brahmaṇo varṣamātreṇa dinaṃ vaiṣṇavamucyate \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. One year of Brahmā is mentioned as one day of Viṣṇu.

## \|\| 1.194.24 \|\|

*sopi varṣaśataṃyāvadātmamānena jīvati \|*  
*paṃcapacāśadādiṣṭāstasya jātasya vatsarāḥ \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. He also lives for a hundred years according to his reckoning. It has been proclaimed that fifty-five years have passed by since his nativity.

## \|\| 1.194.25 \|\|

*tithayaḥ paṃca yāmārddhaṃ somavāreṇa saṃgatam \|*  
*vaiṣṇavena tu varṣeṇa dinaṃ māheśvaraṃ bhavet \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. Five Tithis (lunar days) and half of a Yāma have passed by this Monday. A year of Viṣṇu makes one day of Maheśvara.

## \|\| 1.194.26-29 \|\|

*śivo varṣaśataṃ yāvattena rūpeṇa ca sthitaḥ \|*  
*yāvaducchvasitaṃ vaktraṃ sadāśivasamudbhavam \|\| 26 \|\|*

*paścācchaktiṃ samabhyeti yāvanniśvasitaṃ bhavet \|*  
*niśvāsocchvasitānāṃ ca sarveṣāmeva dehinām \|\| 27 \|\|*

*brahmaviṣṇuśivānāṃ ca gandharvoragarakṣasām \|*  
*ekaviṃśatsahasrāṇi śataiḥ ṣaḍbhiḥ śatāni ca \|\| 28 \|\|*

*ahorātreṇa coktāni pramāṇe dvija sattamāḥ \|*  
*ṣaḍbhirucchvāsaniśvāsaiḥ palamekaṃ pravartate \|\| 29 \|\|*

26-29. Śiva lives in that form for a hundred years. He stays till Sadāśiva’s mouth (face) takes an Ucchvasita (inhalation) when there is Niśvasita (exhalation) he merges into Śakti.

In the case of all embodied beings such as Brahmā, Viṣṇu, Śivas, Gandharvas, Uragas, Rākṣasas etc., O excellent Brāhmaṇas, the number of inhalations and exhalations is twenty-one thousand six hundred in the course of a day and night. Six Ucchvāsas and Niśvāsas constitute one Pala.

## \|\| 1.194.30 \|\|

*nāḍī ṣaṣṭipalā proktā tāsāṃ ṣaṣṭyā dinaṃ niśā \|*  
*niśvāsocchvasitānāṃ ca parisaṃkhyā na vidyate \|*  
*sadāśivasamutthānāmetasmātso'kṣayaḥ smṛtaḥ \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. Nāḍī is mentioned as consisting of sixty Palas. Sixty Nāḍīs make one day and night. There is no limit to the Niśvāsa and Ucchvāsa of Sadāśiva. Hence, he is remembered as everlasting.

## \|\| 1.194.31 \|\|

*anye'pi ye pragacchaṃti brahmajñānasamanvitāḥ \|*  
*akṣayāste'pi jāyaṃte satyametanmayoditam \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. Others too who attain the realization of Brahman become everlasting. It is the truth that has been mentioned by me.

## \|\| 1.194.32-34 \|\|

*ṛṣaya ūcuḥ \|*  
*yadyevaṃ sūtaputrātra brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ \|*  
*ātmavarṣaśate pūrṇe yāṃti nāśamasaṃśayam \|\| 32 \|\|*

*tatkathaṃ mānuṣāṇāṃ ca martyalokelpajīvinām \|*  
*kathayaṃti ca ye muktiṃ vidvāṃsaścaiva sūtaja \|\| 33 \|\|*

*nūnaṃ teṣāṃ mṛṣā vādo mokṣamārgasamu dbhavaḥ \|\| 34 \|\|*

The sages said:

32-34. O Sūtaputra, if Brahmā, Viṣṇu and Maheśvara undoubtedly undergo death when their hundred years are complete, how is it that learned men say that men with lives of short duration in the mortal world attain Mukti (release)? Certainly, their contention regarding the path of salvation is false.

## \|\| 1.194.35 \|\|

*sūta uvāca \|*  
*anādinidhanaḥ kālaḥ saṃkhyayā parivarjitaḥ \|*  
*asaṃkhyātā gatā mokṣaṃ brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ \|\| 35 \|\|*

Sūta said:

35\. There is neither beginning nor end to Kāla (Time). It cannot be delimited. Innumerable Brahmās, Viṣṇus and Maheśvaras have come and gone having attained Mokṣa.

## \|\| 1.194.36 \|\|

*nije varṣaśate pūrṇe vālukāreṇavo yathā \|*  
*nijamānena yā śraddhā brahmajñānasamudbhavā \|*  
*teṣāṃ cenmānuṣāṇāṃ ca tanmuktiḥ syādasaṃśayam \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. They are numerous like sand particles. When their allotted span of hundred years is complete, they attain salvation. If men have faith as a result of realization of Brahman they will have salvation undoubtedly.

## \|\| 1.194.37 \|\|

*yathaite daṃśamaśakā mānuṣāṇāṃ ca kīṭakāḥ \|*  
*jāyaṃte ca mriyaṃte ca gaṇyaṃte naiva kutracit \|*  
*indrādīnāṃ tathā martyāḥ saṃbhāvyā jagatītale \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. In the eyes of human beings, flies and mosquitoes are considered very insignificant creatures. Similar are human beings on the surface of the earth in the eyes of Indra and other gods.

## \|\| 1.194.38 \|\|

*devānāṃ ca yathā martyāḥ kīṭasthāne ca saṃsthitāḥ \|*  
*tathā devā api jñeyā brahmaṇo'vyaktajanmanaḥ \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. Just as human beings are like (lit. in the position of) insects (to gods) so even gods (are to) Brahmā of unmanifest origin.

## \|\| 1.194.39 \|\|

*brahmaṇastu yathā devāḥ kīṭasthāne vyavasthitāḥ \|*  
*tathā brahmāpi viṣṇośca kīṭasthāne vyavasthitaḥ \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. Just as Devas remain in the status of worms and insects for Brahmā, so Brahmā also remains in the status of insects in regard for Viṣṇu.

## \|\| 1.194.40 \|\|

*pitāmaho yathā viṣṇoḥ kīṭasthāne vyavasthitaḥ \|*  
*tathā sa śivaśaktibhyāṃ pīrajñeyo dvijo ttamāḥ \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. Just as Pitāmaha remains in the status of worms and insects for Viṣṇu, O excellent Brāhmaṇas, so also he (Viṣṇu) is to be considered by Śiva and Śakti.

## \|\| 1.194.41 \|\|

*yathā viṣṇuḥ kṛmirjñeyastābhyāmeva dvijottamāḥ \|*  
*sadāśivasya vijñeyau tathā tau kṛmirūpakau \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. O excellent Brāhamṇas, just as Viṣṇu should be considered as a worm by them both (i.e. Śiva and Śakti) so also they both should be considered like insects by Sadāśiva.

## \|\| 1.194.42 \|\|

*evaṃ ca vividhairyajñaiḥ śraddhā pūtena cetasā \|*  
*brahmajñānātparaṃ yāṃti sadāśivasamudbhavam \|\| 42 \|\|*

42\. In this manner, when Brahman is realized through the mind sanctified by means of faith after various kinds of Yajñas, people attain the great Sadāśiva.

## \|\| 1.194.43 \|\|

*agniṣṭomādibhiryajñaiḥ kṛtaiḥ saṃpūrṇadakṣiṇaiḥ \|*  
*tadarthaṃ te divaṃ yāṃti bhuktvā bhogānpṛthagvidhān \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. Those people who perform Agniṣṭoma and other Yajñas with the full complement of Dakṣiṇās for the sake of heavenly pleasures, do go to heaven and enjoy various kinds of pleasures.

## \|\| 1.194.44 \|\|

*kṣaye ca punarāyāṃti sukṛtasya mahītale \|*  
*brahmajñānātparaṃ prāpya punarjanma na vidyate \|\| 44 \|\|*

44\. When merit gets exhausted they return to the earth. But if one attains the greatest Absolute (Mokṣa) through the realization of Brahman there is no rebirth.

## \|\| 1.194.45 \|\|

*tasmātsarvaprayatnena tatrābhyāsaṃ samā caret \|*  
*janmabhirbahubhiḥ paścācchanairmuktimavāpnuyāt \|\| 45 \|\|*

45\. Hence, by all means, one should have repeated practice in the spiritual path in the course of many births. Later gradually one attains salvation.

## \|\| 1.194.46 \|\|

*ekajanmani saṃprāpto leśo jñānasya tasya ca \|*  
*dvitīye dviguṇastasya tṛtīye trigu ṇo bhavet \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. The Leśa (modicum) of spiritual knowledge acquired by one in the course of one life will be doubled in the second birth and trebled in the third birth.

## \|\| 1.194.47 \|\|

*ekottaro bhavedevaṃ sadā janmanijanmani \|\| 47 \|\|*

47\. In the course of every life, this process will go on increasing one by one.

## \|\| 1.194.48 \|\|

*ṛṣaya ūcuḥ \|*  
*brahmajñānasya saṃprāptirmartyānāṃ jāyate katham \|*  
*etannaḥ sarvamācakṣva yadi tvaṃ vetsi sūtaja \|\| 48 \|\|*

The sages said:

48\. O Sūtaja, if you do know it, expound to us how men attain the realization of Brahman.

## \|\| 1.194.49 \|\|

*sūta uvāca \|*  
*kā śaktirmama vaktavye jñāne martyasamudbhave \|*  
*svayameva na yo vetti sa parasya vadetkatham \|\| 49 \|\|*

Sūta said:

49\. What power do I have in the matter of expounding human realizations! How can one who does not know himself explain it to others?

## \|\| 1.194.50 \|\|

*upadeśaḥ paraṃ yo me pitrā datto dvijottamāḥ \|*  
*tamahaṃ vaḥ pravakṣyāmi brahmajñānasamudbhavam \|\| 50 \|\|*

50\. But, O excellent Brāhmaṇas, I shall narrate unto you the instruction imparted to me by my father in regard to the knowledge of Brahman.

## \|\| 1.194.51 \|\|

*hāṭakeśvaraje kṣetre hyasti tīrthadvayaṃ śubham \|*  
*kumārikābhyāṃ vihitaṃ brahmajñānapradaṃ nṛṇām \|\| 51 \|\|*

51\. There are two auspicious Tīrthas in the holy spot of Hāṭakeśvara. They were created by two virgins and they (the Tīrthas) accord the knowledge of Brahman to men.

## \|\| 1.194.52-55 \|\|

*brāhmaṇyā caiva śūdryā ca kumārībhyāṃ vinirmitam \|*  
*aṣṭamyāṃ ca caturdaśyāṃ yastābhyāṃ snānamācaret \|\| 52 \|\|*

*paścātpūjayate bhakttyā prasiddhe siddhipāduke \|*  
*sugupte gartamadhyasthe kumāryā paripūjite \|\| 53 \|\|*

*tasya saṃvatsarasyānte brahmajñānaṃ prajāyate \|*  
*śaktyā vinihite te ca svadarśanavivṛddhaye \|\| 54 \|\|*

*lokānāṃ muktikāmānāṃ brahmajñānasukhāvahe \|*  
*mama tāto gatastatra tataśca jñānavānsthitaḥ \|\| 55 \|\|*

52-55. The Tīrthas were created by a Brāhmaṇa girl and a Śūdra girl. A devotee shall perform the rite of holy ablution in those Tīrthas on the eighth and fourteenth lunar days. Then he should adore devoutly the well-known Siddhi-Pādukās (Sandals of Spiritual achievement). They are well-protected and concealed in the centre of the Gartā (deep chasm, pit) and are adored by the two virgins. They have been deposited there along with (or by) Śakti for the purpose of enhanced self-vision. By the end of the year, the devotee shall realize Brahman. They give the delight of the realization of Brahman unto the people desirous of salvation. My father went there and therefore remained one equipped with that knowledge.

## \|\| 1.194.56 \|\|

*tasyādeśādahaṃ tatra gataḥ saṃvatsaraṃ sthitaḥ \|*  
*pāduke pūjayāmāsa tato jñānaṃ ca saṃsthitam \|\| 56 \|\|*

56\. At his behest I (too) went there and stayed there for a year and adored the sandals. Therefore, the knowledge too was gained.

## \|\| 1.194.57 \|\|

*yatkiñcidvā śrutaṃ loke purāṇāgryaṃ vyavasthitam \|*  
*vartamānaṃ bhaviṣyacca tadahaṃ vedmi bho dvijāḥ \|\| 57 \|\|*

57\. O Brāhmaṇas, I know whatever I learn by listening to the excellent Purāṇa and whatever is current and whatever is likely to happen in the future.

## \|\| 1.194.58 \|\|

*tatprasādādasaṃdigdhaṃ pramāṇaṃ cātra saṃsthitam \|*  
*muktvaikaṃ vedapaṭhanaṃ sūtatvaṃ ca yato mayi \|\| 58 \|\|*

58\. It is undoubtedly the result of his favour that the means of valid knowledge is present (in him) here because I have been (handicapped by) the state of being a Sūta (chainoteer \[charioteer?\] caste) and therefore excluded from the study of the Vedas.

## \|\| 1.194.59 \|\|

*tasyāpi vedmi sarvārthaṃ bhartṛyajño yathā muniḥ \|*  
*asmādatraiva gacchadhvaṃ yadi mukteḥ prayojanam \|\| 59 \|\|*

59\. I know the entire meaning thereof (i.e. of the Vedas) like Sage Bhartṛyajña. Hence go to this place alone, if your purpose is to achieve salvation.

## \|\| 1.194.60 \|\|

*kimetaiḥ svargadaiḥ satraiḥ punarāvṛttikārakaiḥ \|*  
*ārādhayadhvaṃ te gatvā pāduke siddhide nṛṇām \|*  
*yena saṃvatsarasyānte brahmajñānaṃ prajāyate \|\| 60 \|\|*

60\. Of what avail are these Sattras that bestow heavenly pleasures but cause the return therefrom? After going there propitiate those two sandals that bestow Siddhi. Thence, the realization of Brahman shall be effected by the end of the year.

## \|\| 1.194.61 \|\|

*ṛṣaya ūcuḥ \|*  
*sādhusādhu mahābhāga hyupadeśaḥ kṛto mahān \|*  
*tena saṃtāritāḥ sarve vayaṃ saṃsārasāgarāt \|\| 61 \|\|*

The sages said:

61\. Excellent! Excellent! O highly esteemed one, you have given a very great advice. We have been redeemed from the ocean of worldly existence thereby.

## \|\| 1.194.62 \|\|

*yāsyāmo'pi vayaṃ tatra satre dvādaśavārṣike \|*  
*samāpte'sminna saṃdehaḥ sarve ca kṛtaniścayāḥ \|\| 62 \|\|*

62\. At the conclusion of this Sattra extending over twelve years, we have decided to go there. There is no doubt about it.

## Chapter 195 - Story of the Daughter of Chāndogya

## \|\| 1.195.1-3 \|\|

*ṛṣaya ūcuḥ \|*  
*śūdrī ca brāhmaṇī cāpi ye tvayā parikīrtite \|*  
*hāṭakeśvaraje kṣetre tīrthadvayamanuttamam \|\| 1 \|\|*

*tatkathaṃ tatra saṃjātaṃ kena vā tadvinirmitam \|*  
*etacca sarvamācakṣva vistareṇa mahāmate \|\| 2 \|\|*

*pādukābhyāṃ samutpattiḥ śrutā'smābhiḥ purā tava \|*  
*vada taccāpi māhātmyaṃ tābhyāṃ caiva samudbhavam \|\| 3 \|\|*

The sages said:

1-3. O highly intelligent one, a Śūdra girl and another, a Brāhmaṇa girl, were cited by you as having created two excellent Tīrthas in the holy spot of Hāṭakeśvara.

How did the pair of Tīrthas originate there? By whom was it effected? Describe this in full details. The origin of the sandals has already been heard by us earlier from you. Yet narrate it too as well as the greatness thereof.

## \|\| 1.195.4 \|\|

*sūta uvāca \|*  
*purāsīnnāgaro vipraśchāṃdogya iti viśrutaḥ \|*  
*yasyā'nvaye'pi viprendrāśchāndogyā iti viśrutāḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

Sūta said:

4\. Formerly, there was a well-known Nāgarā Brāhmaṇa by the name Chāndogya and all the leading Brāhmaṇas in his family lineage were also well-known an Chāndogyas.

## \|\| 1.195.5 \|\|

*sāmavedavidastasya gṛhasthāśramadharmiṇaḥ \|*  
*paścime vayasi prāpte kanyā jātā suśobhanā \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. He was conversant with the Sāmaveda and he righteously followed the duties of a householder. An excellent daughter was born to him in his old age.

## \|\| 1.195.6 \|\|

*sarvairapi guṇairyuktā sarvalakṣaṇa lakṣitā \|*  
*saptaraktā trigaṃbhīrā pañcasūkṣmā'bṛhatkaṭiḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. She was fully equipped with all the good qualities and marked with splendid features. She was reddish (in complexion) in seven of her limbs and had three parts characterized with depth. Five of her parts were very subtle and her waist was not very large.

## \|\| 1.195.7 \|\|

*padmapatraviśālākṣī laṃbakeśī suśobhanā \|*  
*biṃboṣṭhī hrasvalomā ca pūrṇacandrasamaprabhā \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. Her eyes were large and resembled the petals of a lotus. She appeared very splendid with long hanging tresses of hair. She had lips resembling a Biṃba fruit. Her hair on the body were short and she had lustre of the full Moon.

## \|\| 1.195.8-9 \|\|

*tasyā nāma pitā cakre brāhmaṇīti dvijottamāḥ \|*  
*yasmātsā brāhmaṇairdattā maṇḍapānte supūjitaiḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

*paścime vayasi prāpte apatyarahitasya ca \|*  
*vavṛdhe sā ca tanvaṅgī candralekhā yathā tathā \|\| 9 \|\|*

8-9. The father named her Brāhmaṇī, O excellent Brāhmaṇas, because she had been given to him by the Brāhmaṇas adored duly at the extremities of the Maṇḍapa.

Though he had no child for a long time, he was blessed with one in the later stage of his life. The slender-bodied girl grew up like the digit of the Moon.

## \|\| 1.195.10 \|\|

*śuklapakṣe tu saṃprāpte janalocanatuṣṭidā \|*  
*yasminnahani saṃjātā chāndogyasya mahātmanaḥ \|*  
*ānartādhipatestasmiṃstādṛgrūpā sutā'bhavat \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. The girl grew like the Moon in the bright half of a month. She gave delight to the eyes of the people. The Lord of Ānarta too had a daughter having the same features on the same day when this girl was born to the noble-souled Chāndogya.

## \|\| 1.195.11 \|\|

*yasyāḥ kāyaprabhaugheṇa sarvaṃ tatsūtikāgṛham \|*  
*niśāgame'pi saṃjātaṃ ratnaughairiva suprabham \|*  
*tatastasyāḥ pitā nāma cakre ratnavatīti ca \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. The lying-in chamber became brightly illumined by clusters of gems as it were even during the nights due to the refulgence of the body of that girl. Therefore, the father named her Ratnavatī.

## \|\| 1.195.12 \|\|

*atha sakhyaṃ samāpannā brāhmaṇyā saha sā śubhā \|*  
*nairantaryeṇa tābhyāṃ ca viyogo naiva jāyate \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. The splendid girl had the companionship of the Brāhmaṇa girl continuously without any separation whatsoever.

## \|\| 1.195.13-14 \|\|

*ekāśanaṃ tathā śayyā ekānnena ca bhojanam \|*  
*aṣṭame'bde ca saṃjāte pitā tasyā dvijottamāḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

*vivāhaṃ cintayāmāsa pradānāya vare tathā \|*  
*sā jñātvā ceṣṭitaṃ tasya piturduḥkhasamanvitā \|\| 14 \|\|*

13-14. They shared the same bed and meals. They had the same type of food. O excellent Brāhmaṇas, when she became eight years old, her father thought about her marriage. He wanted to give her to a deserving bridegroom. On coming to know of this, the girl became miserable.

## \|\| 1.195.15 \|\|

*sakhyā viyogabhītā ca proce ratnavatī tadā \|*  
*aśrupūrṇekṣaṇā dīnā bāṣpagadgadayā girā \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. Afraid of the imminent separation from her companion, Ratnavatī became very distressed. With eyes filled with tears, she spoke in words choked and faltering due to tears:

## \|\| 1.195.16 \|\|

*sakhi tāto vivāhaṃ me prakariṣyati sāṃpratam \|*  
*vivāhitāyāśca sakhyaṃ na bhaviṣyati karhicit \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. “Dear friend, my father will celebrate my marriage now. After being married, I will no longer have your companionship.”

## \|\| 1.195.17 \|\|

*vajrapātopamaṃ vākyaṃ tasyāḥ śrutvā sakhī ca sā \|*  
*ruroda kaṇṭhamāśliṣya snehavyākulitendriyā \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. These words were like a blow of thunderbolt unto her. On hearing them, the companion wept clinging to her neck. Her affection caused the excitement of all her limbs and senses.

## \|\| 1.195.18 \|\|

*atha tadruditaṃ śrutvā mātā tasyā mṛgāvatī \|*  
*sasaṃbhramā samāgatya vākyametaduvāca ha \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. On hearing her lamentation, Mṛgāvatī, her mother, came there in great bewilderment and spoke these words:

## \|\| 1.195.19 \|\|

*kimarthaṃ rudyate putri kena te vipriyaṃ kṛtam \|*  
*karomi nigrahaṃ yena tasyādyaiva durātmanaḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. “O daughter, why do you cry? Who has been unpleasant to you? Now itself I shall punish that ill-natured fellow.”

## \|\| 1.195.20 \|\|

*ratnavatyuvāca \|*  
*śṛṇu me supriyātīva brāhmaṇī prāṇasaṃmatā \|*  
*vivāhaṃ prāpya kalyāṇī prayāsyati patergṛham \|\| 20 \|\|*

Ratnavatī said:

20\. Listen. Brāhmaṇī is my dearest friend. She is on a par with my very vital life. The splendid girl will marry and go to the abode of her husband.

## \|\| 1.195.21 \|\|

*anayā rahitāhaṃ ca na jīvāmi kathaṃcana \|*  
*etasmātkāraṇāddevi prarodimi suduḥkhitā \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. I will not be able to survive the separation from her. It is for this reason that I cry in distress.

## \|\| 1.195.22-23 \|\|

*mṛgāvatyuvāca \|*  
*yadyevaṃ putri yatra tvaṃ prayāsyasi patergṛhe \|*  
*tasya rājñastu yo vipraḥ paurohitye vyavasthitaḥ \|\| 22 \|\|*

*tasya putrāya dāsyāmi sakhīmenāṃ tava priyām \|*  
*tatrāpi yena te saṃgo bhaviṣyatyanayā saha \|\| 23 \|\|*

Mṛgāvatī said:

22-23. O my daughter, if it is so (a way-out is possible) I will cause this dear companion of yours to be given in marriage to the son of the Brāhmaṇa engaged as the priest of the king to whose house you will be going as a bride. Thereby, your association with her can still continue.

## \|\| 1.195.24 \|\|

*evamuktvā tato rājñī chādogyaṃ dvijasattamam \|*  
*samānīyābravīdenaṃ vinayāvanatā sthitā \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. After saying thus the queen summoned the excellent Brāhmaṇa Chāndogya and spoke to him politely:

## \|\| 1.195.25-28 \|\|

*iyaṃ tava sutā brahmansutāyā mama supriyā \|*  
*na viyogaṃ sahatyasyā muhūrtamapi bhāminī \|\| 25 \|\|*

*tathā tava sutāyāśca suteyaṃ mama supriyā \|*  
*tasmātkuru vaco mahyaṃ yacca vakṣyāmi suvrata \|\| 26 \|\|*

*yasya me dīyate kanyā kadācinnṛpateriyam \|*  
*purodhāstasya yo viprastasmai deyā nijā sutā \|\| 27 \|\|*

*yena na syānmitho bhedastābhyāṃ dvijavarottama \|*  
*ekasthāne sthitābhyāṃ ca prasā dāttava sattama \|\| 28 \|\|*

25-28. “O holy Brāhmaṇa, this daughter of yours is the dearest friend of my daughter. The splendid maiden cannot endure her separation even for a short while.

Similarly, my daughter is the dearest friend of your daughter, Hence, O Brāhmaṇa of excellent Vratas, follow my words which I am going to speak now.

Your daughter should be. given to the Brāhmaṇa engaged as the priest of the king who is likely to be offered the hand of my daughter some time hereafter.

Thereby, O excellent one among Brāhmaṇas, both of them will be staying in the same place with your favour. There will no longer be any separation between them.”

## \|\| 1.195.29-30 \|\|

*chāṃdogya uvāca \|*  
*nāgaro nāgaraṃ muktvā yo'nyasmai saṃprayacchati \|*  
*kanyakāṃ yaḥ pragṛhṇāti vivāhārthaṃ kathaṃcana \|\| 29 \|\|*

*sa paṃktidūṣakaḥ pāpānnāgaro na bhavediha \|*  
*tasmānnāhaṃ pradāsyāmi kathaṃcinnijakanyakām \|*  
*anyasmai nāgaraṃ muktvā niścayo'yaṃ mayā kṛtaḥ \|\| 30 \|\|*

Chāndogya said:

29-30. If a Nāgara gives his daughter in marriage to someone other than a Nāgara and if one (a Nāgara) accepts another (non-Nāgara) girl then he shall become sinful and a Paṅkti-Dūṣaka (a fallen defiler of the row of meal-takers). He will cease to be a Nāgara. So, I will not give ṃy daughter in marriage to anyone except a Nāgara. This decision has been made by me.

## \|\| 1.195.31 \|\|

*brāhmaṇyuvāca \|*  
*nāhaṃ patiṃ prayāsyāmi kumārī brahmacāriṇī \|*  
*deyā priyā sakhī yatra tāvadyāsyāmi tatra ca \|\| 31 \|\|*

Brāhmaṇī said:

31\. I will not have anyone as my husband. I will remain a virgin maintaining celibacy. I will go to that place where my dearest friend is likely to be given in marriage.

## \|\| 1.195.32 \|\|

*yadi tāta balānmahyaṃ vivāhaṃ tvaṃ kariṣyasi \|*  
*viṣaṃ vā bhakṣayiṣyāmi sādhayiṣyāmi pāvakam \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. O my father, if you compel me to marry anyone, I will take poison or jump into fire.

## \|\| 1.195.33 \|\|

*śastreṇa vā haniṣyāmi svadehaṃ tāta niścayam \|\| \|*  
*evaṃ jñātvā tu tāta tvaṃ yatkṣamaṃ tatsamācara \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. Or, O my father, it is certain that I will kill myself with some weapon. Know this well, O father, and do what you are competent to do.

## \|\| 1.195.34 \|\|

*sūta uvāca \|*  
*tasyāstaṃ niścayaṃ jñātvā sa vipro duḥkhasaṃyutaḥ \|*  
*strīhatyāpāpa bhītastu tāṃ tyaktvā svagṛhaṃ yayau \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. Realizing that determination on her part, the Brāhmaṇa became extremely vexed. He did not force her, because he was afraid of killing a lady, which is a sin, if caused forcibly. He abandoned her there and went to his own abode,

## \|\| 1.195.35 \|\|

*sāpi reme tayā sārdhaṃ ratnavatyā dvijottamāḥ \|*  
*saṃhṛṣṭahṛdayā nityaṃ saṃtyaktapitṛsauhṛdā \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. She diverted herself in the company of Ratnavatī, O excellent Brāhmaṇas. Though she had to deny herself the affection of a father, she remained delighted in her heart.

## \|\| 1.195.36 \|\|

*yauvanaṃ sā tu saṃprāptā rūpeṇāpratimā bhuvi \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. She attained the prime of her youth. She became unrivalled in the beauty of form ail over the earth.

## Chapter 196 - Bṛhadbala Proceeds to the city of Ānarta

## \|\| 1.196.1-3 \|\|

*sūta uvāca \|*  
*atha tāṃ yauvanopetāṃ svasutāṃ prekṣya pārthivaḥ \|*  
*anaupamyena rūpeṇa saṃyuktāṃ varavarṇinīm \|*  
*ānartaścintayāmāsa kanyakāṃ pradadāmyaham \|\| 1 \|\|*

*anarhāya ca yo dadyā dvarāya nijakanyakām \|*  
*kāryakāraṇalobhena narakaṃ sa pragacchati \|\| 2 \|\|*

*evaṃ ciṃtayatastasya mahānkālo vyavasthitaḥ \|*  
*na paśyati ca tadyogyaṃ kaṃcidvaramanuttamam \|\| 3 \|\|*

Sūta said:

1-3. Seeing that his daughter had attained prime of youth with unrivalled beauty of form and excellent complexion, King Ānarta thought about the matter of giving his daughter away in marriage.

He was aware that a person who gives his daughter in marriage to an undeserving person out of temptation for some gain goes to hell.

He thought thus for a long time but could not meet with an excellent and deserving bridegroom.

## \|\| 1.196.4 \|\|

*atha saṃpreṣayāmāsa sarvabhūtāśrayeṣu ye \|*  
*citrakarmaṇi vikhyātānnarāṃścitrakarāṃstadā \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. He sent for men famous in the art of painting portraits and objects among all living beings (and said to them):

## \|\| 1.196.5-6 \|\|

*gacchadhvaṃ mama vākyena sarvā nbhūmitale nṛpān \|*  
*likhitvā paṭṭamadhye tu darśayadhvaṃ tataḥ param \|\| 5 \|\|*

*sutāyā mama yenā'sau dṛṣṭvā'bhīṣṭaṃ narādhipam \|*  
*patyarthaṃ varayetsādhvī mama doṣo bhavenna hi \|\| 6 \|\|*

5-6. “Go ahead at my behest. Draw the portraits of men all over the earth on canvas and show them (to me). Better show them to my daughter so that the chaste girl can select some suitable king as her husband, lest there should be any blame on me.”

## \|\| 1.196.7 \|\|

*tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā sarve citrakarāstadā \|*  
*prasthitā dharaṇīpṛṣṭhe pārthivānāṃ gṛheṣu ca \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. On hearing his words, all the painters set out and visited various kings all over the world in their own palaces.

## \|\| 1.196.8 \|\|

*te likhitvā mahīpālā nyauvanasthānvayo'nvitān \|*  
*rūpaudāryaguṇopetāndarśayāmāsuragrataḥ \|*  
*ratnavatyāḥ krameṇaiva tasya bhūpasya śāsanāt \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. After painting the portraits of kings of suitable age and prime of youth endowed with handsome features and liberalmindedness, they showed them to Ratnavatī one by one at the behest of the king.

## \|\| 1.196.9 \|\|

*atha teṣāṃ tu sarveṣāṃ madhye rājā vṛhadbalaḥ \|*  
*daśārṇādhipatirbhavyaḥ patyarthaṃ ca vṛtastayā \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. Among them all, Bṛhadbala, the splendid overlord of Daśārṇa land, was chosen by her as her husband.
