O king, if a man wishes for an excellent virgin of good conduct and comely features, O king, Śrāddha should be performed by him on the Dvitīyā (second) day,

## \|\| 1.219.4 \|\|

*yo vāṃchati naro'śvāṃśca vāyuvegasamāñjave \|*  
*tṛtīyādivase śrāddhaṃ tena kāryaṃ vipaścitā \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. Śrāddha should be performed on the Tṛtīyā (third) day by a learned man who wishes for horses having the speed similar to that of wind.

## \|\| 1.219.5 \|\|

*yo vāṃchati paśūnmukhyānkupyākupyadhanāni ca \|*  
*caturthyāṃ tena kartavyaṃ śrāddhaṃ pitṛpratuṣṭaye \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. Śrāddha should be performed for the propitiation of the Pitṛs on the Caturthī day by a person who wishes for animals of great utility and wealth as well as precious and best metals.

## \|\| 1.219.6 \|\|

*putrānvāṃchati yo'bhīṣṭānsuśīlānvaṃśamaṃḍanān \|*  
*pañcamyāṃ tena kartavyaṃ sadā śrāddhaṃ narādhipa \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. O king, Śrāddha should always be performed on Pañcamī (fifth day) by a person who wishes for covetable sons of good conduct, the very ornaments unto the whole family.

## \|\| 1.219.7 \|\|

*yaḥ śrāddhaṃ vaṃśajairdattaṃ paralokagato nṛpa \|*  
*vāṃchate tena kartavyaṃ ṣaṣṭhyāṃ śrāddhaṃ vipaścitā \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. Śrāddha should be performed on the ṣaṣṭhī (sixth) day, O king, by one who desires that his descendants should offer Śrāddha unto himself when he goes to the other world.

## \|\| 1.219.8 \|\|

*kṛṣisiddhiṃ ya iccheta graiṣmikīṃ śāradīmapi \|*  
*saptamyāṃ yujyate tasya śrāddhaṃ kartuṃ na saṃśayaḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. It is undoubtedly proper to perform Śrāddha on the Saptamī (seventh) day if one wishes for perfect agricultural produce in the seasons of summer as well as of autumn.

## \|\| 1.219.9 \|\|

*ya icchetpaṇyasaṃsiddhiṃ vyavahārasamudbhavām \|*  
*aṣṭamyāṃ yujyate śrāddhaṃ tasya kartuṃ narādhipa \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. O king, it is proper to perform Śrāddha on the Aṣṭamī (eighth) day, if a man wishes for perfect success in mercantile activities and business dealings.

## \|\| 1.219.10 \|\|

*navamyāṃ śrāddhakṛnnānā catuṣpadagaṇāllaṃbhet \|*  
*saubhāgyaṃ roganāśaṃ ca tathā vallabhasaṃgamam \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. He who performs Śrāddha on the Navamī (ninth) day shall obtains herds of quadrupeds, conjugal felicity, destruction of ailments and union with those whom he loves.

## \|\| 1.219.11 \|\|

*daśamīdivase śrāddhaṃ yaḥ karoti samāhitaḥ \|*  
*tasya syādvāṃchitā siddhiḥ sarvakṛtyeṣu sarvadā \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. If a devotee performs Śrāddha on the Daśamī day with great concentration, he will attain the desired perfection in all his activities always.

## \|\| 1.219.12 \|\|

*ekādaśyāṃ dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ śrāddhakartā labhennaraḥ \|*  
*tathā bhūpaprasādaṃ ca yaccānyanmanasi sthitam \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. A man who performs Śrāddha on the Ekādaśī (eleventh) day gets wealth, food-grain, favour of the king and whatever else he may have desired in his mind.

## \|\| 1.219.13 \|\|

*yaḥ karoti ca dvādaśyāṃ śrāddhaṃ śraddhāsamanvitaḥ \|*  
*putrāṃstu pravarāṃścaiva sa paśūnvāṃchitāllaṃbhet \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. He who performs on the Dvādaśī day Śrāddha with great faith, obtains excellent sons and the desired cattle wealth.

## \|\| 1.219.14 \|\|

*yo vāṃchati naro muktiṃ pitṛbhiḥ saha cātmanaḥ \|*  
*asaṃtānaśca yastasya śrāddhe proktā trayodaśī \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. If a man desires his salvation along with his Pitṛs but has no progeny, Śrāddha on the Trayodaśī (thirteenth) day is recommended in his case.

## \|\| 1.219.15 \|\|

*saṃtānakāmo yaḥ kuryāttasya vaṃśakṣayo bhavet \|*  
*na saṃtānavivṛddhayai ca tasya proktā trayodaśī \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. If a man desirous of (further) progeny performs Śrāddha on the Trayodaśī day, his family becomes extinct. Trayodaśī is not at all conducive to the increase of progeny.

## \|\| 1.219.16 \|\|

*śrāddhakarmaṇi rājeṃdra śrutireṣā purātanī \|*  
*api naḥ sa kule bhūyādyo no dadyāttrayodaśīm \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. In respect to Śrāddha rite, O great king, this is the ancient Śruti: “Let such a son be born in our family who may have no occasion to perform the Śrāddha on the Trayodaśī day.”

## \|\| 1.219.17 \|\|

*pāyasaṃ madhusarpirbhyāṃ varṣāsu ca maghāsu ca \|*  
*maghātrayodaśīyoge pāyasena yajetpitṝn \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. During rainy season, if the constellation is Maghā and Maghā coincides with Trayodaśī, the devotee performs Śrāddha offering milk-pudding along with honey and ghee. He should worship the Pitṛs with milk pudding.

## \|\| 1.219.18-21 \|\|

*pitarastasya necchaṃti tadvarṣaṃ śrāddhasatkriyām \|*  
*puṇyātiśayabhītena piṃḍadānaṃ nirākṛtam \|\| 18 \|\|*

*śakreṇa taddine putramaraṇaṃ darśitaṃ bhayam \|*  
*yeṣāṃ ca śastramṛtyuḥ syādapamṛtyurathāpi vā \|\| 19 \|\|*

*upasargamṛtānāṃ ca viṣamṛtyumupeyuṣām \|*  
*vahninā tu pradagdhānāṃ jalamṛtyu mupeyuṣām \|\| 20 \|\|*

*sarpavyālahatānāṃ ca śṛṃgairudbandhanairapi \|*  
*ekoddiṣṭaṃ prakartavyaṃ caturdaśyāṃ narādhipa \|\| 21 \|\|*

18-21. His Pitṛs do not desire the holy rite of Śrāddha that year.

Śakra who was afraid of excess of merit discarded the offering of balls of rice. He has shown fear of the death of one’s son performing the Śrāddha on that day. (That means only a ṣonless person should perform a Śrāddha on that day).

O king, Ekoddiṣṭa (with only one Brāhmaṇa in view) should be performed on the Caturdaśī day (fourteenth) in the following cases: if the ancestors die due to weapons, have premature death, if they die due to divine calamity, person etc. if they are burnt in fire, if they are drowned in water, if they are killed by serpent, python or tiger, if they die due to being torn by horns or if they commit suicide by hanging themselves.

## \|\| 1.219.22 \|\|

*teṣāṃ tasminkṛte tṛptistatastatpakṣajā bhavet \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. If that Śrāddha is performed on that day they will have satisfaction for the whole of that fortnight.

## \|\| 1.219.23 \|\|

*sarve kāmāḥ puraḥ proktā yuṣmākaṃ ye mayā nṛpa \|*  
*amāvāsyādine śrāddhāttānāpnoti na saṃśa yaḥ \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. By performing Śrāddha on the Amāvāsyā day one obtains all those desired things which I have earlier mentioned to you all, O king. There is no doubt therein.

## \|\| 1.219.24 \|\|

*etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ kāmyaśrāddhaphalaṃ nṛpa \|*  
*yacchrutvā vāṃchitānkāmānsarvānāpnoti mānavaḥ \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. Thus I have fully narrated the benefit of Kāmya Śrāddhas to you. On hearing this a man realizes all his desires.

## Chapter 220 - Importance of Gajacchāyā

## \|\| 1.220.1-3 \|\|

*ānarta uvāca \|*  
*trayodaśyāṃ kṛte śrāddhe kasmādvaṃśakṣayo bhavet \|*  
*etanme sarvamācakṣva vistarāttvaṃ mahā mune \|\| 1 \|\|*

*bhartṛyajña uvāca \|*  
*eṣā medhyatamā rājanyugādiḥ kalisaṃbhavā \|*  
*snāne dāne jape home śrāddhe jñeyā tathā'kṣayā \|\| 2 \|\|*

*asyāṃ cettu gajacchāyā tithau rājanprajāyate \|*  
*tadā'kṣayaṃ maghāyoge śrāddhaṃ saṃjāyate dhruvam \|\| 3 \|\|*

Ānarta said:

1-3. Why does the family become extinct if Śrāddha is performed on the Trayodaśī day? O great sage, tell me the reason in detail entirely.

## \|\| 1.220.4 \|\|

*yaḥ kṣīraṃ madhunā yuktaṃ tasminnahani yacchati \|*  
*pitṝnuddiśya yo māṃsaṃ dadyādvādhrīṇasaṃ ca yaḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

Bhartṛyajña said:

O king, this Yugādi day marking (the beginning of) Kali Age is highly sacred. It has everlasting benefit in regard to holy ablution, Dāna, Japa, Homa and Śrāddha. This should be noted.

O king, if on this Tithi (i.e. Trayodaśī) in conjunction with Maghā constellation, the Sun is in Hasta (i.e. zodiac Virgo) it is called Gajacchāyā. The Śrāddha, then shall have everlasting benefit.

4\. He who offers milk along with honey on that day with the Pitṛs in view and he who offers the meat of Vādhrīṇasa (rhinoceros) are both on a par with each other.

## \|\| 1.220.5-6 \|\|

*vādhrīṇasasya māṃsena tṛptirdvādaśavārṣikī \|*  
*triḥpibaṃtviṃdriyakṣīṇaṃ śvetaṃ vṛddhamajāpatim \|\| 5 \|\|*

*taṃ tu vādhrīṇasaṃ vidyātsarvayūthādhipaṃ tathā \|*  
*khaḍgamāṃsaṃ ca vā dadyāttṛptirdvādaśavārṣikī \|*  
*saṃjāyate na saṃdehasteṣāṃ vākyaṃ na me mṛṣā \|\| 6 \|\|*

5-6. The satisfaction derived through (the meat of) rhinoceros extends to twelve years. It drinks three times more than elderly (aged) goat that has grown feeble in its sense-organs. It is such a leader of herd that one should know a Vādhrīṇasa (obscure).

Alternatively, one can offer the meat of a Khaḍga (a species of rhinoceros). They (Pitṛs) will have satisfaction lasting twelve years. There is no doubt. My words are not untrue.

## \|\| 1.220.7 \|\|

*āsīdrathaṃtare kalpe pūrvaṃ pārthivasattamaḥ \|*  
*sitāśvo nāma pāṃcāladeśīyaḥpitṛbhaktimān \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. Formerly, in the Rathantara Kalpa, there was an excellent king named Sitāśva. He hailed from Pāñcāla Deśa. He was extremely devoted to the Pitṛs.

## \|\| 1.220.8 \|\|

*madhunā kālaśākena khaḍgamāṃsena kevalam \|*  
*sa hi śrāddhaṃ trayodaśyāṃ kuru te pāyasena ca \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. He used to perform Śrāddha on the Tryodaśī day with honey, Kālaśāka (kind of greens), the meat of a Khaḍga (rhino) and milk pudding.

## \|\| 1.220.9 \|\|

*somavaṃśaṃ samuddiśya śrāddhaṃ yacchati bhaktitaḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. He used to offer Śrāddha devoutly with the (entire) lunar race in view.

## \|\| 1.220.10 \|\|

*atha tairbāhmaṇaiḥ sarvaiḥ sa bhūyaḥ kautukānvitaiḥ \|*  
*kasyacittvatha kālasya pṛṣṭo bhuktvā yathecchayā \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. Once, all the Brāhmaṇas took their food as much as they wanted. They were urged by curiosity and they asked the king.

## \|\| 1.220.11 \|\|

*śrāddhādanaṃtaraṃ rājandṛṣṭvā taṃ śraddhayā'nvitam \|*  
*pādāvamarddanaparaṃ praṇipātapuraḥ saram \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. After the Śrāddha they found him extremely faithful and engaged in massaging their feet and bowing to them duly.

## \|\| 1.220.12 \|\|

*brāhmaṇā ūcuḥ \|*  
*kṛtvā śrāddhaṃ mahārāja pradātavyā'tha dakṣiṇā \|*  
*brāhmaṇebhyastataḥ śrāddhaṃ pitṝṇāṃ copatiṣṭhati \|\| 12 \|\|*

The Brāhmaṇas said:

12\. O great king, after the performance of the Śrāddha, Dakṣiṇā (gift) should be offered to the Brāhmaṇas. Then the Śrāddha (the benefit thereof) reaches the Pitṛs.

## \|\| 1.220.13 \|\|

*sā tvayā kalpitā'smākaṃ vitīrṇādyāpi no nṛpa \|*  
*kupyākupyaṃ parityajya tāṃ dehi nṛpa mā ciram \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. That has been arranged by you, O king, but not given to us till now. Leave off both precious and non-precious metals and give the Dakṣiṇā to us quickly.

## \|\| 1.220.14 \|\|

*bhartṛyajña uvāca \|*  
*tacchrutvā ca nṛpaḥ prāha saṃprahṛṣṭena cetasā \|*  
*dhanyo'smyanugṛhīto'smi viprairadya na saṃśayaḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

Bhartṛyajña said:

14\. On hearing it, the king said with a delighted mind: “I am blessed. A great favour has been shown to me by the Brāhmaṇas.

## \|\| 1.220.15 \|\|

*ye vāṃchaṃti mamābhīṣṭaṃ śrāddhe bhuktvā'tha paitṛke \|*  
*tasmādbrūta mahābhāgā yuṣmabhyaṃ kiṃ dadāmyaham \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. It is a blessing that the Brāhmaṇas request me for what they desire after partaking of the food at the Śrāddha pertaining to the Pitṛs. Hence, O highly esteemed ones, tell me what shall I offer to you all?

## \|\| 1.220.16 \|\|

*vara nnāgānmadonmattānbhadrajātisamudbhavān \|*  
*kiṃ vā saptipradhānāṃśca manomārutaraṃhasaḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. Shall I give you excellent elephants in the height of their rut, belonging to the breed called Bhadra? Or shall I give you very valuable horses having the speed of mind and wind?

## \|\| 1.220.17 \|\|

*kiṃ vā sthānāni citrāṇi grāmāṇi nagarāṇi ca \|*  
*pitṝnuddiśya yatkiṃcinnādeyaṃ vidyate yataḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. Shall I give you plots of various kinds, villages and cities? I say this because I have nothing which is not worthy of being given with the Pitṛs in view.”

## \|\| 1.220.18 \|\|

*brāhmaṇā ūcuḥ \|*  
*nāsmākaṃ vājibhiḥ kāryaṃ na ratnairna ca hastibhiḥ \|*  
*na deśairgrāmamukhyairvā nānyenāpi ca kenacit \|\| 18 \|\|*

The Brāhmaṇas said:

18\. We have nothing to do with horses, gems, elephants etc. We have nothing to do with lands, big villages or anything else similar to it.

## \|\| 1.220.19-20 \|\|

*yadarthena mahārāja pṛṣṭosmābhiryato bhavān \|*  
*tasmānno dakṣiṇāṃ dehi saṃdehaghnāṃ tapottama \|\| 19 \|\|*

*yāṃ pṛcchāmo vayaṃ sarve kautūhalasamāhitāḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

19-20. O great king, O excellent king, give us the Dakṣiṇā that destroys doubts and for the sake of which you had been requested by us and we put questions incited by our curiosity.

## \|\| 1.220.21 \|\|

*rājovāca \|*  
*upadeśādhikāro'sti brāhmaṇānāṃ mahātmanām \|*  
*dātuṃ naiva grahītuṃ ca nī cajātyasya vaidikāḥ \|\| 21 \|\|*

The king said:

21\. Noble-souled Brāhmaṇas alone have the right for instructing others, O followers of the Vedas. A person of lower caste has no right either to give or to receive.

## \|\| 1.220.22 \|\|

*so'haṃ rājā na sarvajño yo yacchāmi dvijottamāḥ \|*  
*upadeśaṃ hi yuṣmabhyaṃ sarvajñebhyo vicakṣaṇāḥ \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. I am a mere king. I am not omniscient, O excellent Brāhmaṇas, so that I can impart instructions to you all who are yourselves omniscient, O wise ones.

## \|\| 1.220.23 \|\|

*brāhmaṇā ūcuḥ \|*  
*guruśiṣyasamuttho'yamupadeśo mahīpate \|*  
*prārthayāmo vayaṃ kiṃcinmā bhayaṃ tvaṃ samāviśa \|\| 23 \|\|*

The Brāhmaṇas said:

23\. This activity of imparting instruction is based on (the relationship of) preceptor and disciple. We are only requesting for something. Do not become over-frightened

## \|\| 1.220.24 \|\|

*vayaṃ ca praśnamekaṃ hi pṛcchāmo yadi bhūpate \|*  
*brūṣe kautukayuktānāṃ sarveṣāṃ ca dvijanmanām \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. If you can speak out to all of us, the Brāhmaṇas, who are roused by curiosity, O king, we shall put a question.

## \|\| 1.220.25 \|\|

*tasmādvada mahābhāga yadi jānāsi tattvataḥ \|*  
*na cedguhyatamaṃ kiṃcitpṛcchāmastvāṃ kutūhalāt \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. Hence tell us, O highly esteemed one, if you know really and if it is not something to be kept as a great secret. We are asking you out of curiosity.

## \|\| 1.220.26 \|\|

*rājovāca \|*  
*yadi vaḥ saṃśayo viprā yuṣmatpraśnamasaṃśayam \|*  
*kathayiṣyābhi cedguhyaṃ tadvaddhvaṃ gapla jvarāḥ \|\| 26 \|\|*

The king said:

26\. If you have any doubt, O Brāhmaṇas, I shall undoubtedly reply to your question even if it is something kept as secret. So, speak out unreservedly.

## \|\| 1.220.27-28 \|\|

*brāhmaṇā ūcuḥ \|*  
*anneṣu ca vicitreṣu lehyeṣu vividheṣu ca \|*  
*amṛteṣveṣu sarveṣu tathā peyeṣu pārthiva \|\| 27 \|\|*

*tasmādadya dine brūhi madhu yacchasi garhitam \|*  
*vartate ca yathā'bhakṣyaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ viśeṣataḥ \|\| 28 \|\|*

The Brāhmaṇas said:

27-28. There are diverse kinds of foodstuffs. There are various types of lambatives, O king; all beverages are nectarlike. Still on this day you offer Madhu (honey, wine) that is despised and is something not worthy of being taken in by the Brāhmaṇas in particular.

## \|\| 1.220.29 \|\|

*tathā vicitra māseṣu saṃsthiteṣu narādhipa \|*  
*khaṅgamāṃsaṃ nirāsvādaṃ kasmādyacchasi kevalam \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. Although there are many types of meat preparations, why do you serve the tasteless meat of rhinoceros (Khaḍga)?

## \|\| 1.220.30 \|\|

*saṃti śākāni rājendra pāvanīyāni sarvaśaḥ \|*  
*suṣṭhu svādu karāṇyatra vyañjanārthaṃ mahīpate \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. O great king, there are vegetable dishes entirely sacred. All of them are highly tasty and can be had as side dishes.

## \|\| 1.220.31 \|\|

*kālaśākaṃ sakaṭukaṃ mukhā'dhijanakaṃ mahat \|*  
*kasmādyacchasi cāsmākaṃ bhaktyā paramayā yutaḥ \|*  
*na śrāddhe pratiṣedhaśca prakartavyaḥ kathaṃcana \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. Why then do you serve this kālaśāka variety of vegetable which is very pungent and which causes mouth sore? Yet you are endowed with very great devotion!

A partaker of food must not refuse anything served at the Srāddha.

## \|\| 1.220.32 \|\|

*na ca tyājyaṃ samucchiṣṭaṃ tena bhuṃjāmahe tataḥ \|*  
*tadatra kāraṇenaiva guruṇā bhāvyameva hi \|*  
*yena tvaṃ yacchasi prāya etatsiddhirbhavetsthitā \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. Nor should he (partaker of food) leave off anything as Ucchiṣṭa. Hence we eat everything. So there must be a weighty reason in this matter since you insist on these. Perhaps this is conducive to Siddhi.

## \|\| 1.220.33-34 \|\|

*tasmātkathaya naḥ sarvaṃ paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi naḥ \|*  
*niḥsvāditaṃ yathā dadyādīdṛkchrāddhe vigarhitam \|\| 33 \|\|*

*yathā tvaṃ nṛpaśārdūla śraddhayā saṃprayacchasi \|\| 34 \|\|*

33-34. Hence tell us everything. We are very eager to hear why a tasteless thing that too very despicable, should be offered, O tiger among kings, as you offer it with great faith?

## \|\| 1.220.35 \|\|

*tacchrutvā vacanaṃ teṣāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ mahātmanām \|*  
*sa vailakṣyasmitaṃ prāha salajjaṃ pṛthivīpatiḥ \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. On hearing those words of those noble-souled Brāhmaṇas, the king replied shame-faced by displaying a feeble smile attended with mental chagrin.

## \|\| 1.220.36 \|\|

*guhyametanmahābhāgā asmākaṃ yadi saṃsthitam \|*  
*avācyamapi vakṣyāmi śṛṇudhvaṃ susamāhitāḥ \|\| 36 \|\|*

The king said:

36\. Although this is a great secret kept in our heart, although it cannot be divulged, yet I shall speak. Listen with great concentration.

## \|\| 1.220.37 \|\|

*ahamāsaṃ purā pāpo lubdhakaścānya janmani \|*  
*nihaṃtā sarvajaṃtūnāṃ tathā bhakṣayitā punaḥ \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. In an earlier birth, I was a sinful hunter, killing all sorts of creatures and eating them indiscriminately.

## \|\| 1.220.38-40 \|\|

*paryaṭāmi tadāraṇye dhanuṣā mṛgayārataḥ \|*  
*siṃho vyāghro gajendro vā śarabho vā dvijo ttamāḥ \|\| 38 \|\|*

*madbāṇagocaraṃ prāpto na jīvatyapi karhicit \|*  
*kasyacittvatha kālasya bhramamāṇo mahītale \|\| 39 \|\|*

*saṃprāpto'haṃ mahābhāgā agni veśasya sanmuneḥ \|*  
*āśrame samanuprāpto niśīthe kṣutpipāsitaḥ \|\| 40 \|\|*

38-40. I used to roam about with my bow in the forest engaged in hunting. O excellent Brāhmaṇas, neither a lion, nor a tiger, neither a huge elephant nor a Śarabha remained alive once it became the target of my arrows.

Once I was roaming about on the earth, O highly esteemed ones. It was midnight and I was afflicted with hunger and thirst. I happened to come to the hermitage of Agniveśa, an excellent sage.

## \|\| 1.220.41 \|\|

*tāvattatra saśiṣyāṇāṃ śrāddhakarmavidhiṃ vadan \|*  
*saṃsthito veṣṭitaḥ śiṣyaiḥ samantāddvijasattamāḥ \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. O excellent Brāhmaṇas, he was surrounded by his disciples to whom he was explaining the procedure of the rite of Śrāddha.

## \|\| 1.220.42 \|\|

*agniveśa uvāca \|*  
*ṛkṣe pitrye yadā candro haṃsaścāpi kare vrajet \|*  
*trayodaśī tu sā cchāyā vijñeyā kuñjarodbhavā \|\| 42 \|\|*

Agniveśa said:

42\. When the Moon is in the Pitṛya (Maghā) constellation and the Sun is in Hasta and it is the thirteenth day, it should be known as Gajacchāyā.

## \|\| 1.220.43 \|\|

*pitrye yadāsthitaścendurhaṃsaścāpi kare sthitaḥ \|*  
*tithirvaiśravaṇī yā ca sā cchāyā kuñjarasya ca \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. When the Moon is in Maghā and the Sun is in Hasta Nakṣatra and the Tithi is Vaiśravaṇī or Trayodaśī it is Gajacchāyā.

## \|\| 1.220.44 \|\|

*saiṃhikeyo yadā caṃdraṃ grasate parvasaṃdhiṣu \|*  
*hasticchāyā tu sā jñeyā tasyāṃ śrāddhaṃ samācaret \|\| 44 \|\|*

44\. When Saiṃhikeya (Rāhu) swallows the Moon at the Parvasandhis (i.e. Full Moon) that should be known as Gajacchāyā and one should perform Śrāddha on that day.

## \|\| 1.220.45 \|\|

*tasyāṃ yaḥ kurute śrāddhaṃ jalairapi prabhaktitaḥ \|*  
*yāvaddvādaśa varṣāṇi pitarastasya tarpitāḥ \|\| 45 \|\|*

45\. If a person performs Śrāddha then, with great devotion, even with mere water, his Pitṛs will be propitiated for twelve years.

## \|\| 1.220.46 \|\|

*vanaspatigate some yā cchāyā pūrvatomukhī \|*  
*gajacchāyā tu sā jñeyā pitṝṇāṃ dattamakṣayam \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. When the Moon is in Vanaspati (i.e. during the New-Moon day) and the shadow is towards the East, that should be known as Gajacchāyā. Whatever is offered to Pitṛs then becomes everlasting in benefit.

## \|\| 1.220.47-48 \|\|

*sā bhavecca na sandehaḥ puṇyadā paitṛkī tithiḥ \|*  
*tasyāṃ śrāddhaṃ prakartavyaṃ saṃbhārāḥ saṃbhṛtāśca ye \|\| 47 \|\|*

*prabhāte tu na sandehaḥ pitṝṇāṃ paritṛptaye \|*  
*śākaistathaiṃgudairbilvairbadaraiścirbhaṭairapi \|\| 48 \|\|*

47-48. There is no doubt therein. The Tithi pertaining to Pitṛs shall accord merit. Śrāddha should be performed then. The requisites gathered together in the morning shall undoubtedly be conducive to the satisfaction of the Pitṛs. They may be greens, Iṅguda fruits, Bilvas, Badaras and Cirbhaṭas.

## \|\| 1.220.49 \|\|

*yadannaṃ puruṣo'śnāti tadannāstasya devatāḥ \|*  
*bāḍhamityeva te procya gatāḥ svaṃsvaṃ niketanam \|\| 49 \|\|*

49\. Whatever the man eats, the deities too shall have the same diet.

They (disciples) said “So it is” and went to their respective abodes.

## \|\| 1.220.50 \|\|

*sarve śiṣyā mahābhāgāḥ nārāyaṇapurogamāḥ \|*  
*agniveśyo'pi suṣvāpa samāmantrya dvijottamān \|\| 50 \|\|*

50\. All the blessed disciples with Nārāyaṇa as the leader went to their abodes. Agniveśa bade the excellent Brāhmaṇas good-bye and went to sleep.

## \|\| 1.220.51 \|\|

*tena saṃkathyamānaṃ ca rātrau tacca śrutaṃ mayā \|*  
*ahaṃ cāpi kariṣyāmi prātaḥ śrāddhamasaṃśayam \|\| 51 \|\|*

51\. What was being expounded by him at night was heard by me and I resolved that I would perform Śrāddha in the morning.

## \|\| 1.220.52-53 \|\|

*nihatya khaḍgamādāya tasya māṃsaṃ supuṣkalam \|*  
*tathā madhu samādāya kālaśākaṃ viśeṣataḥ \|\| 52 \|\|*

*svajātīyebhya ādāya tarpayiṣyāmi tānpitṝn \|\| 53 \|\|*

52-53. ‘I would kill a Khaḍga (rhinoceros) and bring its copious and splendid meat, then honey as well as Kālaśāka from my kinsmen. Thereby, I shall propitiate the Pitṛs.’

## \|\| 1.220.54-55 \|\|

*evaṃ niścitya manasā prasupto'haṃ dvijottamāḥ \|*  
*tataḥ prabhāte vimale prodgate ravimaṇḍale \|\| 54 \|\|*

*madhujālāni bhūrīṇi gṛhītāni mayā tataḥ \|*  
*kālaśākaṃ tathā labdhaṃ svecchayā dvijasattamāḥ \|\| 55 \|\|*

54-55. After deciding thus mentally I went to sleep, O excellent Brāhmaṇas. When it dawned and the bright sun rose up, I collected together honeycombs and Kālaśāka in plenty.

## \|\| 1.220.56 \|\|

*tataḥ sarvaṃ samādāya śrapitaṃ tatkṣaṇānmayā \|*  
*snātvā ca nijavargāṇāṃ pitṝnuddiśya cātmanaḥ \|*  
*pradattaṃ lubdhakānāṃ ca bhaktipūrvaṃ dvijottamāḥ \|\| 56 \|\|*

56\. Bringing everything together I cooked everything immediately. O excellent Brāhmaṇas, after taking my bath, everything was offered devoutly to the hunters with the Pitṛs of our class in view.

## \|\| 1.220.57 \|\|

*evaṃ mayā purā dattaṃ pitṝ nuddiśya tānnijān \|*  
*nānyatkiṃcinmayā dattaṃ kadācitkasyacidvijāḥ \|\| 57 \|\|*

57\. Thus everything was offered by me with my Pitṛs in view. Nothing was offered by me to any one at any time, O Brāhmaṇas.

## \|\| 1.220.58 \|\|

*tataḥ kālena mahatā mṛtyuṃ prāpto'smyahaṃ dvijāḥ \|*  
*taddānasya prabhāvena pārthivīṃ yonimāśritaḥ \|\| 58 \|\|*

58\. After a long time, I met with my death, O Brāhmaṇas. Thanks to the power of that Dāna, I was born in a royal family.

## \|\| 1.220.59-60 \|\|

*evaṃ jātismaratvaṃ ca sañjātaṃ me dvijottamāḥ \|*  
*te ca me tarpitāstena khaḍgamāṃsena mākṣikaiḥ \|\| 59 \|\|*

*saṃprāptāḥ paramāṃ prītiṃ tato dvāśavārṣikīm \|*  
*etasmātkāraṇācchrāddhaṃ prakaromi dvijottamāḥ \|\| 60 \|\|*

59-60. I had the power of remembering the previous birth, O excellent Brāhmaṇas. They, the Pitṛs, who were propitiated with the meat of Khaḍga and honey, attained great pleasure extending to twelve years. It is for this reason, O excellent Brāhmaṇas, that I perform the Śrāddha regularly.

## \|\| 1.220.61 \|\|

*khaḍgamāṃsena madhunā kālaśākena bhūriśaḥ \|*  
*vidhihīnaṃ dvijairhīnaṃ tiladarbhairvivarjitam \|\| 61 \|\|*

61\. I perform it through honey, Kālaśāka and the meat of Khaḍga usually. No regular procedure was observed. No Brāhmaṇas presided. Gingelly seeds and Darbha grass were not used.

## \|\| 1.220.62-63 \|\|

*mayā tadvihitaṃ śrāddhaṃ tasyaitatphalamāgatam \|*  
*sāṃprataṃ vidhinā samyagbrāhmaṇairvedapāragaiḥ \|\| 62 \|\|*

*upaviṣṭaiḥ karomyeva yacchrāddhaṃ śraddhayānvitaḥ \|*  
*darbhaistilaiḥ samopetaṃ mantravacca dvijottamāḥ \|\| 63 \|\|*

62-63. Such a Śrāddha was performed by me. This has been the result thereof Now-a-days I am performing the Śrāddha perfectly in accordance with the injunctions under the aegies of Brāhmaṇas who have mastered the Vedas. They are honourably seated and I perform the Śrāddha with great faith, making use of Darbha and gingelly seeds. O excellent Brāhmaṇas, Mantras too are chanted.

## \|\| 1.220.64-65 \|\|

*no jānāmi phalaṃ kiṃ vā sāṃprataṃ ca bhaviṣyati \|*  
*tasmādevaṃ parijñāya yūyaṃ caiva dvijottamāḥ \|\| 64 \|\|*

*saṃtarpayadhvaṃ ca pitṝnnijāngajadine sthite \|*  
*chāyāyāṃ caiva jātāyāṃ kuñjarasya dvijottamāḥ \|\| 65 \|\|*

64-65. I do not know what the benefit will be now. Hence, O excellent Brāhmaṇas, understand this and do propitiate your Pitṛs on the Gaja day (i.e. Gajacchāyā) when the shadow of the elephant falls?

## \|\| 1.220.66 \|\|

*yena saṃjāyate tṛptiḥ pitṝṇāṃ dvādaśābdikī \|*  
*yuṣmākaṃ ca gatiḥ śreṣṭhā yathā jātā mamādhunā \|\| 66 \|\|*

66\. Thereby the Pitṛs will have satisfaction extending over twelve years. You too will have the perfect attainment of the goal as in my case now.

## \|\| 1.220.67 \|\|

*bhartṛyajña uvāca \|*  
*tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā sarve te brāhmaṇottamāḥ \|*  
*saṃtuṣṭāḥ sādhuvādāṃśca dadustasya mahīpateḥ \|\| 67 \|\|*

Bhartṛyajña said:

67\. On hearing his words, all those excellent Brāhmaṇas became pleased. They congratulated the king.

## \|\| 1.220.68 \|\|

*tataḥprabhṛti cakruste śrāddhāni dvijasattamāḥ \|*  
*trayodaśyāṃ nabhasyasya kṛṣṇāyāṃ bhaktitatparāḥ \|\| 68 \|\|*

68\. Ever since then, those excellent Brāhmaṇas devoutly performed the Śrādḍha on the Trayodaśī day of the dark half of Nabhasya.

## \|\| 1.220.69 \|\|

*madhunā kālaśākena khaḍgamāṃsena tarpitāḥ \|*  
*prāpnuvaṃti parāṃ siddhiṃ vimānavaramāsthitāḥ \|\| 69 \|\|*

69\. Propitiated through honey, Kālaśāka and the meat of Khaḍga, the Pitṛs attained great Siddhi seated on excellent aerial chariots.

## \|\| 1.220.70 \|\|

*spardhaṃte sahitā daivaiḥ pitaraśca viśeṣataḥ \|*  
*vaṃśajena pradattasya prabhāvātsurasattamāḥ \|\| 70 \|\|*

70\. Thanks to the power of what was offered by the descendants, the Pitṛs began to vie with the excellent Suras.

## \|\| 1.220.71 \|\|

*śrāddhārthaṃ saṃparijñāya mantraṃ cakruḥ parasparam \|*  
*ādityā vasavo rudrā nāsatyāvapi pārthiva \|\| 71 \|\|*

71\. The Devas understood the purpose of the Śrāddhas and consulted one another, O king; the Devas viz. Ādityas, Vasus, Rudras and the Nāsatyas consulted one another.

## \|\| 1.220.72 \|\|

*yathā na bhavati śrāddhaṃ tasminnahani bhūtale \|*  
*yatprabhāvādvayaṃ sarve mānuṣaiḥ śrāddhamāśritaiḥ \|*  
*na yāmo'bhibhavasthānaṃ tasmācchapsyāmahe ca tān \|\| 72 \|\|*

72\. They did not want the Śrāddha to be performed on that day. They thought, ‘Thanks to the power thereof, we are being subjected to a clash and discomfiture with the men who resort to Śrāddha. So we shall curse them.

## \|\| 1.220.73 \|\|

*adyaprabhṛti yaḥ śrāddhaṃ trayodaśyāṃ kariṣyati \|*  
*kanyāsaṃsthe sahasrāṃśau tasya syādvaṃśasaṃkṣayaḥ \|\| 73 \|\|*

73\. From now onwards, if anyone performs Śrāddha on the Trayodaśī when the Thousand-rayed One (Sun) is in Virgo, his family shall become extinct.’

## \|\| 1.220.74-76 \|\|

*iti śāpena devānāṃ nirdagdheyaṃ mahātithiḥ \|\| 74 \|\|*

*tataḥprabhṛti naitasyā kriyate śrāddhamuttamam \|*  
*yaḥ pramādena kurute tasya syādvaṃśa saṃkṣayaḥ \|\| 75 \|\|*

*yena bhītā na kurvaṃti cchāyāyāṃ kuñjarasya ca \|*  
*viśeṣeṇa gajacchāye tatra piṇḍo'yamāhṛtaḥ \|\| 76 \|\|*

74-76. Thus the great Tithi was burnt (ruined) by the curse of the Devas. Ever since then this excellent Śrāddha is not being performed on this day. If anyone inadvertently performs it, his family will become extinct. So, frightened due to this, people do not perform Śrāddha on the Gajacchāyā day. Only rice-ball offering is pursued on the Gajacchāyā day.

## Chapter 221 - Things Worthy of Being Offered in Śrāddha

## \|\| 1.221.1 \|\|

*bhartṛyajña uvāca \|*  
*etasmātkāraṇātkaścittasminnahani pārthiva \|*  
*dadāti naiva ca śrāddhaṃ pitṝnuddiśya karhicit \|*  
*vaṃśacchedabhayādrājansatyametanmayoditam \|\| 1 \|\|*

Bhartṛyajña said:

1\. It is for this reason, O king, that no one performs that Śrāddha on that day with Pitṛs in view. They are afraid of the extinction of the family. O king, it is the truth that has been spoken by me.

## \|\| 1.221.2 \|\|

*śrāddhaṃ vināpi dātavyaṃ taddine madhunā saha \|*  
*pāyasaṃ brāhmaṇāgryebhyaḥ saghṛtaṃ tṛptikāraṇāt \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. Without performance of Śrāddha, one should give on that day to prominent Brāhmaṇas, milk-pudding along with honey and ghee to their satisfaction.

## \|\| 1.221.3 \|\|

*khaḍgamāṃsaṃ kālaśākaṃ māṃsaṃ vādhrīṇasodbhavam \|*  
*pradeyaṃ brāhmaṇebhyaśca tatsamaṃtādudāhṛtam \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. The meat of rhinoceros like Khaḍga and Vādhrīṇasa as well as Kālaśāka should be given to Brāhmaṇas. It has been spoken by all.

## \|\| 1.221.4 \|\|

*triḥpibaśceṃdriyakṣīṇaḥ sarvayūthānugastathā \|*  
*eṣa vādhrīṇasaḥ proktaḥ pitṝṇāṃ tṛptidaḥ sadā \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. Vādhrīṇasa is said to be that rhinoceros which is followed by all the herds. It is feeble in all its sense-organs but drinks three times more (water) than others. It accords satisfaction to the Pitṛs always.

## \|\| 1.221.5 \|\|

*tasyābhāve'pi dātavyaṃ kṣīraudanamanuttamam \|*  
*tasminnahani viprebhyaḥ pitṝṇāṃ tuṣṭaye nṛpa \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. If it is not available, excellent milk and cooked rice should be given to Brāhmaṇas on that day, O king, for the satisfaction of the Pitṛs.

## \|\| 1.221.6 \|\|

*tasyābhāve'pi dātavyaṃ jalaṃ tilavimiśritam \|*  
*sadarbhaṃ sahiraṇyaṃ ca hiraṇyaśakalānvitam \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. If that is not available, water mixed with gingelly seeds should be given along with Darbha grass, and a gold coin or at least a bit of gold.

## \|\| 1.221.7-10 \|\|

*yacchreyo jāyate puṃsaḥ pakṣaśrāddhena pārthiva \|*  
*kṛtena tatphalaṃ kṛtsnaṃ tasminnahani pārthiva \|\| 7 \|\|*

*pitṝnuddiśya cā'jyena madhunā pāyasena ca \|*  
*kālaśākena madhunā khaḍgamāṃsena vā nṛpa \|\| 8 \|\|*

*śrāddhaṃ vināpi dattena śrutireṣā purātanī \|*  
*tasmātsarvaprayatnena pitryarkṣye samupasthite \|*  
*trayodaśyāṃ nabhasyasya hastage dinanāyake \|\| 9 \|\|*

*daridreṇāpi dātavyaṃ hiraṇyaśakalānvitam \|*  
*toyaṃ tilairyutaṃ rājanpitṝṇāṃ tuṣṭimicchatā \|\| 10 \|\|*

7-10. The benefit that one gets by means of performing Pakṣaśrāddha (fortnightly Śrāddha) shall be obtained, O king, by merely offering, without Śrāddha, milk pudding mixed with ghee and honey, Kālaśāka or the meat of Khaḍga mixed with honey. So says the traditional Śruti.

Hence, with all effort, even a poor man should give water mixed with gingelly seeds and a bit of gold if he wishes for (securing) the satisfaction of the Pitṛs. It shall be offered on the day when the constellation is that which is special to the Pitṛs (viz. Maghā) on the thirteenth day of Nabhasya when the Sun is in Hasta.

## \|\| 1.221.11 \|\|

*ānarta uvāca \|*  
*māṃsaṃ vigarhitaṃ vipra yataḥ śāstre nigadyate \|*  
*tasmāttatkriyate kena śrāddhaṃ kīrtaya me'khilam \|\| 11 \|\|*

Ānarta said:

11\. O Brāhmaṇa, it is mentioned in the Śāstra, that meat is despicable. Why is then Śrāddha offered with it? Tell me entirely.

## \|\| 1.221.12 \|\|

*svamāṃsaṃ paramāṃsena yo vardhayati nirdayaḥ \|*  
*sa nūnaṃ narakaṃ yāti proktametanmaharṣibhiḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. A ruthless fellow who nourishes his own flesh by means of the flesh of others shall certainly fall in hell. This has been said by the great sages.

## \|\| 1.221.13 \|\|

*tvaṃ ca tasya prabhāvaṃ me prajalpasi dvijo ttama \|*  
*viśeṣācchrāddhakṛtye ca tadevaṃ mama saṃśayaḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. But, O excellent Brāhmaṇa, you praise its efficacy especially in the Śrāddha rite. Hence this doubt of mine.

## \|\| 1.221.14 \|\|

*bhartṛyajña uvāca \|*  
*satyametanmahābhāga māṃsaṃ sadbhirvigarhitam \|*  
*śrāddhe prayujyate yasmāttatte'haṃ vacmi kāraṇam \|\| 14 \|\|*

Bhartṛyajña said:

14\. It is true, O highly esteemed one, that meat is despised by good men. Yet why is it employed in the Śrāddha rite? I shall tell you.

## \|\| 1.221.15 \|\|

*yadā cāraṃbhitā sṛṣṭirbrahmaṇā lokakāriṇā \|*  
*saṃpūjya ca pitṝndevānnāṃdīmukhapuraḥsarān \|*  
*tadā khaḍgaḥ samutpannaḥ pūrvaṃ vādhrīṇasaśca yaḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. When the act of creation was started by Brahmā, the creator of the worlds, after duly adoring the Pitṛs and Devas beginning with Nāndīmukhas, Khaḍga and Vādhrīṇasa were born.

## \|\| 1.221.16 \|\|

*tato ye pitaro divyā ye ca mānuṣasambhavāḥ \|*  
*jagṛhuste tataḥ sarve balibhūtamivātmanaḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. Thereupon, the Pitṛs of divine origin as well as of human origin, caught hold of them as though they constituted their oblation.

## \|\| 1.221.17 \|\|

*tānuvāca tato brahmā etau tu pitaro mayā \|*  
*yuṣmabhyaṃ kalpitau samyagbalibhūtau pragṛhyatām \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. Then Brahmā spoke to them: “O Pitṛs, these two have been created by me for your sake. They are the excellent oblation. Let them be accepted.

## \|\| 1.221.18-19 \|\|

*etābhyāṃ paramā prītiryuṣmabhyaṃ saṃbhaviṣyati \|*  
*mama vākyādasaṃdigdhaṃ parametau naro bhuvi \|\| 18 \|\|*

*naiva saṃprāpsyate pāpaṃ yuṣmadarthaṃhanannapi \|*  
*tasmātsarvaprayatnena dātavyaṃ bhūtimicchatā \|\| 19 \|\|*

18-19. Through these two, you will have great delight at my instance. But by killing them for your sake no man on earth shall incur sin. Hence one who wishes for prosperity, shall offer these with all effort.

## \|\| 1.221.20 \|\|

*khaḍgavādhrīṇasodbhūtaṃ māṃsaṃ śrāddhe sutṛptidam \|*  
*tau cāpi paramau divyau svargaṃ lokaṃ gamiṣyataḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. The meat obtained from Khaḍga and Vādhrīṇasa accords excellent satisfaction in Śrāddha rite. These two also are extremely divine (in quality) and will go over to the heavenly world.

## \|\| 1.221.21 \|\|

*śrāddhadasya paraṃ śreyo bhaviṣyati sudurlabham \|*  
*pitṝṇāṃ cākṣayā tṛptirbhaveddvādaśavārṣikī \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. A person who offers the Śrāddha will have great welfare that is usually very rare. The Pitṛs too will have endless satisfaction extending to twelve years.”

## \|\| 1.221.22 \|\|

*etasmātkāraṇācchastaṃ māṃsamābhyāṃ narādhipa \|*  
*tasminnahani nānyatra viniyogo'sya kīrtitaḥ \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. For this reason, O king, the meat of these two is esteemed well on that day. Its use on other occasions is not prescribed.

## \|\| 1.221.23 \|\|

*rohitāśva uvāca \|*  
*aprāptakhaḍgamāṃsasya tathā vādhrīṇasasya ca \|*  
*kathaṃ śrāddhaṃ bhavedvipra pitṝṇāṃ tṛptikā rakam \|\| 23 \|\|*

Rohitāśva said:

23\. O Brāhmaṇa, if one does not get the meat of either Khaḍga or Vādhrīṇasa, how should he perform Śrāddha which will cause satisfaction to the Pitṛs?

## \|\| 1.221.24 \|\|

*mārkaṇḍeya uvāca \|*  
*madhunā saha dātavyaṃ pāyasaṃ pitṛtuṣṭaye \|*  
*tena vai vārṣikī tṛptiḥ pitṝṇāṃ copajāyate \|\| 24 \|\|*

Mārkaṇḍeya said:

24\. Milk pudding should be given along with honey for the satisfaction of Pitṛs. Thereby Pitṛs get satisfaction lasting for a year.

## \|\| 1.221.25 \|\|

*ājaṃ ca piśitaṃ rājañchiśumārasamudbhavam \|*  
*māṃsaṃ pratuṣṭaye proktaṃ vatsaraṃ māsavarjitam \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. The meat of goat and that got from Śiśumāra (alligator) is said to accord satisfaction for a year less by one month (i.e. for eleven months), O king.

## \|\| 1.221.26 \|\|

*tadabhāve varāhasya daśamāsapratuṣṭidam \|*  
*māṃsaṃ proktaṃ mahārāja pitṝṇāṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. In the circumstance of its non-availability the meat of a boar is to be offered, which is said as according satisfaction to Pitṛs for ten months. There is no doubt about it.

## \|\| 1.221.27 \|\|

*āraṇyamahiṣotthena tṛptiḥ syānnavamāsikī \|*  
*ruroścaivāṣṭamāsotthā eṇasya saptamāsikā \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. There shall be satisfaction for nine months from the meat of wild buffalo; the meat of Ruru deer accords eight month’s satisfaction and that of Eṇa (deer) seven month’s satisfaction.

## \|\| 1.221.28 \|\|

*śambarormāsaṣaṭkaṃ ca śaśakasya tu pañcakam \|*  
*catvāraḥ śallakasyoktāstrayo vā taittirasya ca \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. Śaṃbara deer accords six month’s satisfaction; rabbit, five months; Śallaka (porcupine) four months and Taittira bird three months.

## \|\| 1.221.29 \|\|

*māsadvayaṃ ca matsyasya māsamekaṃ kapiñjale \|*  
*nānyeṣāṃ yojayenmāṃsaṃ pitṛkārye kathaṃcana \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. The meat of fish accords satisfaction for two months and that of Kapiñjala bird for one month; the meat of other animals or birds should not be used at all in the rites of Pitṛs.

## \|\| 1.221.30 \|\|

*eteṣāmeva māṃsāni pāvanāni nṛpottama \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. O excellent king, the meat of only these beings is holy and pure.

## \|\| 1.221.31 \|\|

*ānarta uvāca \|*  
*kasmādete pavitrāḥ syuryeṣāṃ māṃsaṃ pracoditam \|*  
*śrāddhe ca tanmamācakṣva yathāvaddvijasattama \|\| 31 \|\|*

Ānarta said:

31\. Why are these living beings considered holy? Why has the meat of these beings been recommended in Śrāddha rite? Tell me this truthfully, O excellent Brāhmaṇa.

## \|\| 1.221.32 \|\|

*bhartṛyajña uvāca \|*  
*sṛṣṭiṃ prakurvatā tena paśavo lokakāriṇā \|*  
*khaḍgavādhrīṇasādīnāṃ paścātsṛṣṭāḥ svayaṃbhuvā \|\| 32 \|\|*

Bhartṛyajña said:

32\. After Khaḍga, Vādhrīṇasa etc., animals were created by the Self-born Lord, the creator of the worlds, in the course of creation.

## \|\| 1.221.33 \|\|

*ekādaśapramāṇena tataścānye nṛpottama \|*  
*ajaśca prathamaṃ sṛṣṭaḥ sa tathā medhyatāṃ gataḥ \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. They are of eleven sizes, O excellent king. Then the other things were created. It was goat that was created at the outset and it was considered sacred (worth sacrificing).

## \|\| 1.221.34 \|\|

*tathaite prathamaṃ sṛṣṭāḥ paśavo'tra narādhipa \|*  
*sasyāni sṛjatā tena tilāḥ pūrvaṃ ca nirmitāḥ \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. Similarly all those created at the outset were sacred. Gingelly seeds were created by him when he started creation of the vegetable kingdom.

## \|\| 1.221.35-36 \|\|

*śrāddhārthaṃ vrīhayaḥ sṛṣṭā vanyeṣu ca priyaṃgavaḥ \|*  
*godhūmāśca yavāścaiva māṣā mudrāśca vai nṛpa \|\| 35 \|\|*

*nīvārāścāpi śyāmākāḥ pravakṣyāmi yathākramam \|*  
*tṛptiṃ māṃsena vāñchaṃti māṃsaṃ māṃsena varjitam \|\| 36 \|\|*

35-36. For the purpose of Śrāddha, Vrīhis (grain) were created. Among wild grains Priyaṅgu was created. I shall mention them in order: Wheat, barley, pulses, green gram, Nīvāra and Śyāmāka were created thus. But they desire and feel satisfied with meat. The meat should not be mixed with other meat (i.e. it should not be that of carnivorous animals).

## \|\| 1.221.37 \|\|

*puṣpajātyo yadā sṛṣṭāstadā prākchatapatrikā \|*  
*sṛṣṭā tena ca mukhyā sā śrāddhakarmaṇi sarvadā \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. When creation of the flowering species was started, Śatapatrikā was created by him. It is very important in Śrāddha rite always.

## \|\| 1.221.38 \|\|

*dhātūni sṛjatā tena rūpyaṃ sṛṣṭaṃ svayaṃbhuvā \|*  
*tena tadvihitaṃ śrāddhe dakṣiṇāyāṃ pratṛptaye \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. While creating minerals silver was created by the Self-born Lord. Therefore, it is recommended as Dakṣiṇā in Śrāddha for the (Pitṛ’s) satisfaction.

## \|\| 1.221.39 \|\|

*rājateṣu ca pātreṣu yaddvijebhyaḥ pradīyate \|*  
*pitṛbhyastasya naivā'nto yugānte'pi prajāyate \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. Whatever is given to the Brāhmaṇas in silver vessels, is of everlasting benefit to Pitṛs. It lasts till the end of the Yuga.

## \|\| 1.221.40 \|\|

*abhāve rūpyapātrāṇāṃ nāmāpi parikīrtayet \|*  
*tuṣyaṃti pitaro rājankīrtanādapi vai yataḥ \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. If silver vessels are not available, a performer of Śrāddha should mention them by name, since, O king, the Pitṛs are pleased by their glorification.

## \|\| 1.221.41 \|\|

*rasāṃśca sṛjatā tena madhu sṛṣṭaṃ svayaṃbhuvā \|*  
*tena tacchasyate śrāddhe pitṝṇāṃ tuṣṭidāyakam \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. While creating juices (liquids), honey was created by the Self-born Lord. Therefore it is recommended in Śrāddha rite. It accords satisfaction to Pitṛs.

## \|\| 1.221.42 \|\|

*yacchrāddhaṃ madhunā hīnaṃ tadrasaiḥ sakalairapi \|*  
*miṣṭānnairapi saṃyuktaṃ tatpitṝṇāṃ na tṛptaye \|\| 42 \|\|*

42\. If a Śrāddha is bereft of honey, it cannot be conducive to the satisfaction of Pitṛs even if all other juices and sweet dishes are present.

## \|\| 1.221.43 \|\|

*aṇumātramapi śrāddhe yadi na syāddhi mākṣikam \|*  
*nāmāpi kīrtayettasya pitṝṇāṃ tuṣṭaye yataḥ \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. If even a very little quantity of honey is not available, a householder should announce it by name because then it provides satisfaction to Pitṛs.

## \|\| 1.221.44 \|\|

*śākāni sṛjatā tena brahmaṇā parameṣṭhinau \|*  
*kālaśākaṃ puraḥ sṛṣṭaṃ tena tattṛptidāyakam \|\| 44 \|\|*

44\. While creating greens and vegetables Kālaśāka was created at the outset by Brahmā, the Parameṣṭhin. Hence it gives satisfaction.

## \|\| 1.221.45 \|\|

*kālaṃ hi sṛjatā tena kutapaḥ prāgvinirmitaḥ \|*  
*tasmātkutapa kāle ca śrāddhaṃ kāryaṃ vijānatā \|*  
*ya icchecchāśvatīṃ tṛptiṃ pitṝṇāmātmanaḥ sukham \|\| 45 \|\|*

45\. While creating Kāla (Time, auspicious hours) Kutapa (eighth Muhūrta of the day i.e. around midday) was created by him at the outset. Hence Śrāddha should be performed then by a sensible one who wishes for the permanent satisfaction of the Pitṛs and his own happiness.

## \|\| 1.221.46 \|\|

*vīrudhaḥ sṛjatā tena vidhinā nṛpasattama \|*  
*darbhāstu prathamaṃ sṛṣṭāḥ śrāddhārhāstena te smṛtāḥ \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. While creating creepers, O excellent king, Darbha was first created by Vidhi. Hence, it is remembered as worthy of the Śrāddha rites.

## \|\| 1.221.47 \|\|

*śrāddhārhānbrāhmaṇāṃstena sṛjatā padmayoninā \|*  
*dauhitrāḥ prathamaṃ sṛṣṭāḥ śrāddhārhāstena te smṛtāḥ \|\| 47 \|\|*

47\. While creating Brāhmaṇas eligible for Śrāddha rites, sons of daughters were created at the outset by the Lotus-born Lord. Therefore, they are remembered as worthy of the Śrāddha rites.

## \|\| 1.221.48 \|\|

*api śaucaparityaktaṃ hīnāṃgādhikameva vā \|*  
*dauhitraṃ yojayecchrāddhe pitṝṇāṃ parituṣṭaye \|\| 48 \|\|*

48\. A son of daughter even if he be devoid of purity and cleanliness, even if he be deficient in limbs or has surplus, still one should include him (son of daughter) in the Śrāddha rite for pleasing the Pitṛs.

## \|\| 1.221.49 \|\|

*paśūnvisṛjatā tena pūrvaṃ gāvo vinirmitāḥ \|*  
*tena tāsāṃ payaḥ śastaṃ śrāddhe sarpirviśeṣataḥ \|\| 49 \|\|*

49\. While creating animals (cattle), cows were created by him first. Therefore, their milk is recommended in Śrāddha rite and Ghee from them is specially recommended.

## \|\| 1.221.50 \|\|

*tasmācchrāddhe ghṛtaṃ śastaṃ pradattaṃ pitṛtuṣṭaye \|\| 50 \|\|*

50\. Hence ghee is praised in the course of Śrāddha rite. If it is offered, it is contributory to the satisfaction of Pitṛs.

## \|\| 1.221.51 \|\|

*prajāśca sṛjatā tena pūrvaṃ dṛṣṭā dvijottamāḥ \|*  
*tasmātpraśastāste śrāddhe pitṛtṛptikarāḥ sadā \|\| 51 \|\|*

51\. While creating mankind excellent Brāhmaṇas were created by him at the outset. Hence they are always esteemed in Śrāddha rite. They cause delight and satisfaction unto the Pitṛs.

## \|\| 1.221.52 \|\|

*devāṃśca sṛjatā tena viśvedevāḥ kṛtāḥ puraḥ \|*  
*tena te prathamaṃ pūjyāḥ pravṛtte śrāddhakarmaṇi \|\| 52 \|\|*

52\. While creating Devas, the Viśvedevas were created at the outset by him. Hence when Śrāddha rites are performed, they are to be worshipped at the outset.

## \|\| 1.221.53 \|\|

*te rakṣaṃti tataḥ śrāddhaṃ yathāvatparitarpitāḥ \|*  
*chidrāṇi nāśayaṃti sma śrāddhe pūrvaṃ prapūjitāḥ \|\| 53 \|\|*

53\. Worshipped at the outset in Śrāddha they protect the entire Śrāddha rite. They destroy all vulnerable loopholes.

## \|\| 1.221.54 \|\|

*etairmukhyatamaiḥ sṛptaiḥ phūrā śrāddhaṃ vinirmitam \|*  
*svayaṃ pitāmahenaiva tato devā vinirmitāḥ \|\| 54 \|\|*

54\. After creating these important ones at the beginning, Śrāddha was created by Pitāmaha himself. Then Devas were created.

## \|\| 1.221.55-58 \|\|

*tena te sarvalokeṣu gatāḥ khyātiṃ purā nṛpa \|\| 55 \|\|*

*etacchrādsya satratvaṃ mayā te parikīrtitam \|*  
*pitṝṇāṃ paramaṃ guhyaṃ dattasyākṣayakārakam \|\| 56 \|\|*

*yaścaitatkīrtayecchrāddhe kriyamāṇe nṛpottama \|*  
*viprāṇāṃ bhokttukāmānāṃ tacchrāddhaṃ tvakṣayaṃ bhavet \|\| 57 \|\|*

*yaścaitackṛṇuyādrājansamyakchraddhāsamanvitaḥ \|*  
*vihitasya bhavetpuṇyaṃ yacchrāddhasya tadāpnuyāt \|\| 58 \|\|*

55-58. Therefore, O excellent king, they became well-known in all the worlds. Thus the entire details of Śrāddha rite have been described to you. It is a great esoteric secret of the Pitṛs. If performed, it has endless benefit. If one recites this (discourse), O excellent king, when a Śrāddha is being performed, when the Brāhmaṇas are about to partake of their food, that Śrāddha has everlasting benefit. O king, he who listens to this with perfect faith shall obtain that benefit which is attained when Śrāddha is performed.

## Chapter 222 - Decision Regarding Caturdaśī Śrāddha

## \|\| 1.222.1-3 \|\|

*bhartṛyajña uvāca \|*  
*yeṣāṃ ca śastramṛtyuḥ syādapamṛtyurathāpi vā \|*  
*upasargānmṛtānāṃ ca viṣamṛtyumupeyuṣām \|\| 1 \|\|*

*vahninā ca pradagdhānāṃ jalamṛtyumupeyuṣām \|*  
*sarpavyāghrahatānāṃ ca śṛṃgairudbandhanairapi \|\| 2 \|\|*

*śrāddhaṃ teṣāṃ prakartavyaṃ caturdaśyāṃ narādhipa \|*  
*teṣāṃ tasminkṛte tṛptistatastatpakṣajā bhavet \|\| 3 \|\|*

Bhartṛyajña said:

1-3. O king, Śrāddha should be performed on the Caturdaśī (fourteenth) day in the case of those who meet with their death in the following manner: premature death, killed by weapons, supernatural calamities, being poisoned, burnt by fire, drowned in water, bitten by serpents, or mauled by tigers, bruised by horns and hanging from trees etc. When Srāddha is performed they will have satisfaction extending over a fortnight.

## \|\| 1.222.4 \|\|

*ānarta uvāca \|*  
*kasmācchastrahatānāṃ ca proktā śrāddhe caturdaśī \|*  
*nānyeṣāṃ divase tatra saṃśayo'yaṃ vadasva me \|\| 4 \|\|*

Ānarta said:

4\. How is it that the Tithi Caturdāsī \[Caturdāśī?\] is recommended for offering Śrāddha unto those killed by weapons and not for others? This is my doubt. Kindly explain.

## \|\| 1.222.5 \|\|

*ekoddiṣṭaṃ na śaṃsaṃti sapiṇḍīkaraṇaṃ param \|*  
*kasmāttatra prakartavyaṃ vadaitanmama vista rāt \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. They do not approve of Ekoddiṣṭa. Why should Sapiṇḍīkaraṇa (offering rice-balls in ritualistic manner) be carried out? Do tell me this in detail.

## \|\| 1.222.6 \|\|

*kasmānna pārvaṇaṃ tatra kriyate divase sthite \|*  
*pretapakṣe viśeṣeṇa kṛte śrāddhe'khile'pi ca \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. Why is the Pārvaṇa Śrāddha not performed on that day in the Pretapakṣa when all (other) Śrāddhas are performed?

## \|\| 1.222.7 \|\|

*bhartṛyajñauvāca \|*  
*bṛhatkalpe purā rājanhiraṇyākṣo mahāsuraḥ \|*  
*babhūva balavāñchūraḥ sarvadevabhayaṃkaraḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

Bhartṛyajña said:

7\. There was a great Asura formerly in Bṛhatkalpa. He was brave and powerful. He caused great terror among all the Devas.

## \|\| 1.222.8 \|\|

*brahmā pratoṣitastena vidhāya vividhaṃ tapaḥ \|*  
*kṛṣṇapakṣe viśeṣeṇa nabhasye māsi saṃsthite \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. Brahmā was propitiated by him through the performance of various kinds of penance especially during the dark half in the month of Nabhasya (Bhādrapada).

## \|\| 1.222.9 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*parituṣṭosmi te vatsa prārthayasva yathepsitam \|*  
*adeyamapi dāsyāmi tasmātprārthaya mā ciram \|\| 9 \|\|*

Brahmā said:

9\. O dear one, I am pleased with you. Do request for whatever is desired by you. I shall grant it even if it happens to be what should not be given. Hence do request. Do not tarry.

## \|\| 1.222.10 \|\|

*hiraṇyākṣa uvāca \|*  
*bhūtāḥ pretāḥ piśācāśca rākṣasā daityadānavāḥ \|*  
*bubhukṣitāḥ prayācaṃte māṃ nityaṃ padmasaṃbhava \|\| 10 \|\|*

Hiraṇyākṣa said:

10\. O Lotus-born One, the hungry Bhūtas, Pretas, Piśācas, Rākṣasas, Daityas and Dānavas are very hungry always and they beg from me.

## \|\| 1.222.11 \|\|

*pretapakṣe kṛte śrāddhe kanyāsaṃsthe divākare \|*  
*ekasminnahani prāyastṛptiḥ syādvarṣasaṃbhavā \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. If at least on one day Śrāddha is performed in the Pretapakṣa when the Sun is in Virgo, there will generally be the satisfaction lasting for a year.

## \|\| 1.222.12 \|\|

*tattvamadya dinaṃ dehi tebhyaḥ kamalasambhava \|*  
*tena tṛptiṃ gatāḥ sarve sthāsyaṃtyabdaṃ pitāmaha \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. Hence, O Lotus-born One, give one day unto them whereby, O Pitāmaha, they will stay satisfied for a year.

## \|\| 1.222.13-14 \|\|

*śrībrahmovāca \|*  
*yaḥ kaścinmānavaḥ śrāddhaṃ svapitṛbhyaḥ pradāsyati \|*  
*pretapakṣe caturdaśyāṃ nabhasye mā si saṃsthite \|\| 13 \|\|*

*pretānāṃ rākṣasānāṃ ca bhūtādīnāṃ bhaviṣyati \|*  
*mama vākyādasaṃdigdhaṃ ye cānye kīrtitāstvayā \|\| 14 \|\|*

Śrī Brahmā said:

13-14. If any man offers Śrāddha to his Pitṛs on the Caturdāsī \[Caturdāśī?\] (fourteenth) day in the Pretapakṣa, the month being Nabhasya (Bhādrapada), that shall go to Pretas, Rākṣasas, Bhūtas and others mentioned by you. Undoubtedly here is my word for it.

## \|\| 1.222.15 \|\|

*durmṛtyunā mṛtā ye ca saṃgrāmeṣu hatāśca ye \|*  
*ekoddiṣṭe sutairdatte teṣāṃ tṛptirbhaviṣyati \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. In the case of those who die an unnatural and inglorious death and those who are killed in battles, they will have satisfaction if Ekoddiṣṭa is offered by the sons.

## \|\| 1.222.16 \|\|

*evamuktvā tato brahmā tataścādarśanaṃ gataḥ \|*  
*hiraṇyākṣo'pi saṃhṛṣṭaḥ svameva bhavanaṃ yayau \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. After saying thus, Brahmā vanished. Hiraṇyākṣa was delighted and he went to his own abode.

## \|\| 1.222.17 \|\|

*yacca śastrahatānāṃ ca tasminnahani dīyate \|*  
*ekoddiṣṭaṃ naraiḥ śrāddhaṃ tatte vakṣyāmi kāraṇam \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. I shall tell you the reason why Ekoddiṣṭa Śrāddha is offered on that day by men to those who are killed with weapons.

## \|\| 1.222.18 \|\|

*saṃkhye śastrahatā ye ca nirvikalpena cetasā \|*  
*yudhyamānā na te martye jāyate manujāḥ punaḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. Those men who had been fighting with a determined and unhesitating mind but were killed in the battle by means of weapons, are not reborn in the mortal world again.

## \|\| 1.222.19 \|\|

*parāṅmukhāśca hanyaṃte palāyanaparāyaṇāḥ \|*  
*te bhavaṃti narāḥ pretā etadāha pitāmahaḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. Those men who turn away their faces and take to flight from the battlefield and are then killed become Pretas. Pitāmaha said this.

## \|\| 1.222.20-21 \|\|

*sammukhā api ye dainyaṃ hanyamānā vadaṃti ca \|*  
*paścāttāpaṃ ca vā kuryuḥ prahārairjarjarīkṛtāḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

*te'pi pretā bhavantīha manuḥ svāyaṃbhuvo'bravīt \|*  
*kadāciccittacalanaṃ śūrāṇāmapi jāyate \|\| 21 \|\|*

20-21. Manu, the son of the Self-born Lord, said: “Sometimes even the minds of heroic persons may waver and some people may fight face to face but on being assailed make piteous outbursts. On being smashed to pieces they may express regrets too. They too become Pretas.

## \|\| 1.222.22 \|\|

*teṣāṃ bhrāṃtyā dine tatra śrāddhaṃ deyaṃ nijaiḥ sutaiḥ \|*  
*apamṛtyumṛtānāṃ ca sarveṣāmapi dehinām \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. Thanks to their mental confusion (it becomes necessary) that Śrāddha should be performed for them by their sons on that day. Then there are embodied ones dying premature and unnatural deaths.

## \|\| 1.222.23 \|\|

*pretatvaṃ jāyate yasmāttasmācchrāddhasya taddinam \|*  
*śrāddhārhaṃ pārthivaśreṣṭha viśeṣeṇa prakīrtitam \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. Those people become Pretas. Hence, O excellent king, they are to be offered Śrāddha and that day (the 14th day) has been stipulated as befitting the Śrāddha.

## \|\| 1.222.24 \|\|

*ekoddiṣṭaṃ prakartavyaṃ yasmāttatra dine naraiḥ \|*  
*sapiṃḍīkaraṇādūrdhvaṃ tatte vakṣyābhi kāraṇam \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. On that day Ekoddiṣṭa should be performed after Sapiṇḍīkaraṇa. I shall mention the reason thereof.

## \|\| 1.222.25 \|\|

*yadi pretatvamāpannaḥ kadācitsvapitā bhavet \|*  
*tṛptyarthaṃ tasya kartavyaṃ śrāddhaṃ tatra dine nṛpa \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. If, by chance, the father attains the state of Preta, O king, Śrāddha, should be performed for his propitiation.

## \|\| 1.222.26 \|\|

*pitāmahādyāstatrāhni śrāddhaṃ nārhaṃti kutracit \|*  
*atha cedbhrāṃtito dadyāddhiyate rākṣasaistu tat \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. Pitāmahas (grandfathers) and others do not deserve Śrāḍdha on that day. If inadvertently the Śrāddha is performed, it is appropriated by Rākṣasas.

## \|\| 1.222.27 \|\|

*brahmaṇo vacanādrājanbhūtapretaiśca dānavaiḥ \|*  
*tenaikoddiṣṭamevātra kartavyaṃ na tu pārvaṇam \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. At the instance of Brahmā, O king, Bhūtas, Pretas and Dānavas too appropriate the same. Hence only Ekoddiṣṭa is to be performed and not Pārvaṇa (Śrāddha).

## \|\| 1.222.28-30 \|\|

*pitṛpakṣe caturdaśyāṃ kanyāsaṃsthe divākare \|*  
*pitāmaho na gṛhṇāti pitrā tena samaṃ tadā \|\| 28 \|\|*

*na ca tasya pitā rājaṃstathaiva prapitāmahaḥ \|\| 29 \|\|*

*etasmātkāraṇādrājanpārvaṇaṃ na vidhīyate \|*  
*tasminnahani saṃprāpte vyarthaṃ śrāddhaṃ bhavedyataḥ \|\| 30 \|\|*

28-30. The above is in the case of Caturdaśī in the Pitṛpakṣa, when the Sun is in Virgo. Grandfather does not accept it along with the father, nor his father as well as greatgrandfather, O king. For this reason, O king, Pārvaṇa Śrāddha is not performed on that day because that Śrāddha shall be futile.

## \|\| 1.222.31 \|\|

*nānyasthānodbhavairvipraiḥ śrāddhakarmavratāni ca \|*  
*nāgaro nāgaraiḥ kuryādanyathā tadvṛthā bhavet \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. A Nāgara should perform Śrāddha rites and Vratas through Nāgara Brāhmaṇas and not through Brāhmaṇas hailing from other places, Otherwise that will be futile.

## \|\| 1.222.32 \|\|

*anyasthānodbhavairviprairyacchrāddhaṃ kriyate dhruvam \|*  
*saṃpūrṇaṃ vyarthatāṃ yāti nāgarāṇāṃ kriyāparaiḥ \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. The Śrāddha of Nāgaras which is performed through Brāhmaṇas hailing from other places though they may be experts therein (becomes futile).

## \|\| 1.222.33 \|\|

*athācāraparibhraṣṭāḥ śrāddhārhā eva nāgarāḥ \|*  
*valīvardasamāno'pi jñātīyo yadi labhyate \|*  
*kimanyairbahubhirviprairvedavedāṃgapāragaiḥ \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. Even if they do not have good conduct, even if they are fallen, Nāgaras are entitled for Śrāddha. A kinsman may be on a par with bull. If such a kinsman is obtained, of what avail are the many Brāhmaṇas who may have mastered the Vedas and Vedāṅgas.”

## Chapter 223 - Kinds of Sons Eligible to Offer Śrāddha

## \|\| 1.223.1-2 \|\|

*bhartṛyajña uvāca \|*  
*śrāddhārhairbrāhmaṇaiḥ kāryaṃ śrāddhaṃ darśe tu pārvaṇam \|*  
*viparītaṃ na kartavyaṃ śrāddhamekaṃ kathaṃcana \|\| 1 \|\|*

*jārajātāpaviddhādyairyo naraḥ śrāddhamācaret \|*  
*brāhmaṇaistu na saṃdehastacchrāddhaṃ vyarthatāṃ vrajet \|\| 2 \|\|*

Note: What type of son is eligible to perform Śrāddha vide HD IV. pp. 536-37. This Purāṇa gives a brief treatment about eligibility.

Bhartṛyajña said:

1-2. On Darśa (New-Moon) day Pārvaṇa Śrāddha should be performed through Brāhmaṇas (eligible to perform Śrāddha). No Śrāddha should be performed otherwise.

If a man performs a Śrāddha through Brāhmaṇas such as Jāraja (born of a paramour), Apaviddha (rejected or forsaken son) etc. that Śrāddha becomes ineffective. There is no doubt about it.

## \|\| 1.223.3 \|\|

*ānarta uvāca \|*  
*bhayaṃ me sumahajjātamatra yatparikīrtitam \|*  
*jārajātāpaviddhaistu yacchrāddhaṃ vyarthatāṃ vrajet \|\| 3 \|\|*

Ānarta said:

3\. A great fear has caught hold of me, in view of what has been said here, viz. that a Śrāddha offered through Jārajātas and Apaviddhas becomes futile.

## \|\| 1.223.4 \|\|

*manunā dvādaśa proktāḥ kila putrā mahāmate \|*  
*aputrāṇāṃ ca putratvaṃ ye kurvaṃti sadaiva hi \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. O highly intelligent one, Manu has mentioned twelve types of sons who always fulfill the needs of those who have no sons.

Kinds of sons

## \|\| 1.223.5 \|\|

*aurasaḥ kṣetrajaścaiva krayakrītaśca pālitaḥ \|*  
*pratipannaḥ sahoḍhaśca kānīnaścāpi sattama \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. They (kinds of sons) are, O excellent one: Aurasa (a bosom-born legitimate son), Kṣetraja (born of one’s own wife from others), Krayakrīta (bought in a sale) Pālita (one who has been brought up), Pratipanna (accepted, adopted), Sahodha (son conceived even at the time of marriage) and Kānīna (son born of an unmarried girl).

## \|\| 1.223.6 \|\|

*tathānyau kuṇḍagolau ca putrāvapi prakīrtitau \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. Kuṇḍas and Golas are also mentioned as sons (born of adultery when husband is alive or after his death).

## \|\| 1.223.7 \|\|

*śiṣyaśca rakṣito mṛtyostathāśvattho vanāṃtigaḥ \|*  
*kimete naiva kathitā yattvamevaṃ prajalpasi \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. A disciple, one who is saved from death and Aśvattha tree at the outskirts of the forest: why have these not been mentioned when you say like this?

## \|\| 1.223.8 \|\|

*bhartṛyajña uvāca \|*  
*satyametanmahābhāga sarve te dharmataḥ sutāḥ \|*  
*paraṃ yugatraye proktā na kalau kaluṣāpahāḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

Bhartṛyajña said:

8\. O highly-esteemed one, it is true that all these are legally recognised as sons. But that is only in the other Yugas. In Kali Age, they are not dispeller of sins.

## \|\| 1.223.9 \|\|

*tadarthaṃ teṣu santānaṃ tāvanmātraṃ yugeyuge \|*  
*sattvāḍhyānāṃ ca lokānāṃ na kalau cālpamedhasām \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. For that purpose there is this consideration only to that extent in every Yuga in regard to the people equipped with inherent strength but not so in Kali where the people are deficient in intellect.

## \|\| 1.223.10 \|\|

*kalāveva samākhyāto vyavahāraḥ prapā tadaḥ \|*  
*alpasattvā yato lokāstena caiṣa vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. Only in Kali, is such type of dealing mentioned as causing downfall. Since the people are of insufficient strength, this procedure has been laid down.

## \|\| 1.223.11 \|\|

*atra yaḥ saṃkaraṃ kuryādyonestasya phalaṃ śṛṇu \|*  
*brāhmaṇyāṃ brāhmaṇātputro brahmaghnaḥ saṃprajāyate \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. In this matter listen to the result if one causes Saṅkara (mixture of castes) in sexual union. A son born to a Brāhmaṇa lady through adultery with a Brāhmaṇa becomes a Brāhmaṇa-slayer.

## \|\| 1.223.12 \|\|

*sarvādhamānāmadhamo yo vāraḍa iti smṛtaḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. He is the basest of all base people and is remembered as Vāraḍa.

## \|\| 1.223.13 \|\|

*kṣatriyācca tathā sūto vaiśyānmāgadha eva ca \|*  
*śūdrāttathāṃtyajaḥ proktastenaite varjitāḥ sutāḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. A son born of a Kṣatriya (to a Brāhmaṇa lady) is Sūta and that born of a Vaiśya is Māgadha, but one born of a Śūdra is said to be Antyaja. Therefore, these sons are rejected.

## \|\| 1.223.14 \|\|

*eteṣāmapi nirdiṣṭāḥ sapta rājansuputrakāḥ \|*  
*paṃca vaṃśavināśāya pūrveṣāṃ pātanāya ca \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. Among these (twelve), O king, seven are pointed out as good sons and the (latter) five cause destruction to the family and downfall to the ancestors.

## \|\| 1.223.15 \|\|

*aurasaḥ pratipannaśca krītaḥ pālita eva ca \|*  
*śiṣyaśca dattajīvaśca tathāśvatthaśca saptamaḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. They are: Aurasa, Pratipanna, Krīta, Pālita, Śiṣya, Dattajīva (one who was saved) and Aśvattha the seventh.

## \|\| 1.223.16 \|\|

*puṃnāmno narakādghorādrakṣaṃti ca sadā hi te \|*  
*patantaṃ puruṣaṃ tatra tena te śobhanāḥ smṛtāḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. They save the ancestor from falling into the hell named Put. Hence they are remembered as excellent.

## \|\| 1.223.17 \|\|

*kṣetrajaśca sahoḍhaśca kānīnaḥ kuṇḍagolakau \|*  
*paṃcaite pātayaṃtisma pitṝnsvargagatānapi \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. Kṣetraja, Sahoḍha, Kānīna, Kuṇḍa and Golaka: these five cause the downfall of the Pitṛs even if they had gone to heaven.

## \|\| 1.223.18 \|\|

*etasmātkāraṇācchrāddhaṃ jārajātasya tadvṛthā \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. For this reason the Śrāddha offered by a Jārajāta is invalid.

## Chapter 224 - Procedure of Śrāddha

## \|\| 1.224.1-2 \|\|

*ānartauvāca \|*  
*śrutā mayā mahābhāga śrāddhārhā brāhmaṇāśca ye \|*  
*ye ca tyājyāstathā putrā bahavaścaiva suvrata \|\| 1 \|\|*

*sāṃprataṃ kathayā'smākaṃ mantrapūrvaśca yo vidhiḥ \|*  
*gṛhasthena sadā kāryaḥ pitṝṇāṃ parituṣṭaye \|\| 2 \|\|*

Ānarta said:

1-2. O highly esteemed one, I have now heard who those Brāhmaṇas are who are fit for performing Śrāddha and who are to be rejected. I have also heard about the many kinds of sons, O sage of excellent vows.

Now tell us the procedure to be followed always by a householder in order to propitiate the Pitṛs. Describe this along with the Mantras.

## \|\| 1.224.3 \|\|

*bhartṛyajña uvāca \|*  
*praṇamyāmaṃtritā ye ca śrādrārthaṃ brāhmaṇottamāḥ \|*  
*ānīya kutape kāle tānsarvānprārthayedi dam \|\| 3 \|\|*

Bhartṛyajña said:

3\. The excellent Brāhmaṇas who are invited for performing a Śrāddha after due obeisance, should be brought (home) at the time of Kutapa. The householder then requests them all thus:

## \|\| 1.224.4 \|\|

*āgacchaṃtu mahābhāgā viśvedevā mahābalāḥ \|*  
*ye yatra vihitāḥ śrāddhe sāvadhānā bhavaṃtu te \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. “May the highly esteemed and very powerful Viśvedevas be pleased to come in.” Let them give due attention to their respective duties which they have been assigned.

## \|\| 1.224.5 \|\|

*evamabhyarcya tānsarvāṃstataḥ kṛtvā pradakṣiṇām \|*  
*jānunī bhūtale nyasya tataścārghaṃ pradāpayet \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. After adoring them all thus, he should circumambulate them and placing the knees on the ground he should offer the Arghya.

## \|\| 1.224.6 \|\|

*maṃtreṇānena rājeṃdra sapuṣpākṣatacaṃdanaiḥ \|*  
*arghamenaṃ pragṛhṇaṃtu mayā dattaṃ dvijottamāḥ \|*  
*pādaprakṣālanārthāya prakurvaṃtu mama priyam \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. O eminent king, this Arghya along with flowers, rice-grains and sandal-paste is to be offered with the following Mantra: “May excellent Brāhmaṇas accept this Arghya offered by me for the purpose of washing the feet. Let them do what is pleasing to me.”

## \|\| 1.224.7 \|\|

*evamuktvā mahīpṛṣṭhe anulipte tataḥ param \|*  
*sākṣatānprakṣipeddarbhānviśvedevānprakīrtayan \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. After uttering this, he should strew raw rice grains and Darbha grass on the ground which is well cleaned and smeared duly. He should then glorify Viśvedevas.

## \|\| 1.224.8 \|\|

*apasavyaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā darbhāṃstilasamanvitān \|*  
*dviguṇānprakṣipedbhūmau pitṝnuddiśya cātmanaḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. Wearing the sacred thread anticlockwise, he should strew twice the number of Darbhas and gingelly seeds on the ground with his own Pitṛs in view.

## \|\| 1.224.9 \|\|

*evaṃ sarvāḥ kriyāḥ kāryā daivikā savyapūrvikāḥ \|*  
*paitṛkāścāpasavyena muktvā nāṃdīmukhānpitṝn \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. In this manner all the rites of the deities should be performed with the sacred thread worn clockwise (from left shoulder to the right) and all the rites pertaining to the Pitṛs except the Nāndīmukha Pitṛs, with it worn anticlockwise (from right shoulder to the left).

## \|\| 1.224.10 \|\|

*sarve pūrvāmukhāḥ sthāpyā yugmāśca śaktito nṛpa \|*  
*pitaro mātṛpakṣīyāḥ sthāpyāścodaṅmukhāstathā \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. O king, within one’s capacity all the pairs of Pitṛs should be placed Pūrvamukhas (with faces turned to the east). The Pitṛs of the mother’s side should be placed Udaṅmukhas (with faces turned to the north).

## \|\| 1.224.11 \|\|

*ekaikaṃ vā trayo vā'pi syurekaikaṃ vā pṛthakpṛthaka \|*  
*paitṛkānsthāppa cakreṇa pitṝṇāṃ parituṣṭaye \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. Each of them can be placed severally or all in a circle for the satisfaction of the Pitṛs.

## \|\| 1.224.12 \|\|

*ṣaṣṭhyā vibhaktyā tu teṣāmāsanaṃ ca pradāpayet \|*  
*ṛjubhiḥ sākṣatairdarbhaiḥ sodakairdakṣiṇāṃgataḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. Using the genitive case, Āsanas (seats) should be offered to them. The Āsana is to consist of straight Darbha grass mixed with rice-grain and water. The seats should be to the right side.

## \|\| 1.224.13 \|\|

*viṣamau dviguṇairdarbhaiḥ satilairvāmapārśvataḥ \|*  
*pāṇau toyaṃ parikṣipya na darbhāṃstu kathaṃ cana \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. To the left side, twice the number of the Darbhas of unequal lengths should be offered along with gingelly seeds. They should be offered after sprinkling water on the hand (palms) with Darbha grasses. They are not to be handed over at all (?).

## \|\| 1.224.14 \|\|

*yo haste cāsanaṃ dadyācceddārbhaṃ buddhivarjitaḥ \|*  
*pitaro nāsane tatra prakurvaṃti niveśanam \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. If an ignorant person offers seat with the Darbha grass in the hand, the Pitṛs do not accept the seat.

## \|\| 1.224.15 \|\|

*āvāhanaṃ prakartavyaṃ vibhaktyā ca dvitīyayā \|*  
*yenāgacchaṃti te sarve samāhūtāḥ pṛthakpṛthak \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. The Āvāhana (invocation) rite should be performed with the use of the accusative case (e.g. amukam āvāhayāmi). They should be severally invoked and all of them arrive accordingly.

## \|\| 1.224.16 \|\|

*anyayā ca vibhaktyā cetpitṝnāvāhayetkvacit \|*  
*nāgacchaṃti mahābhāgā yadyapi syurbubhukṣitāḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. The highly esteemed Pitṛs never come if the devotee invokes them with the use of any other case-ending (e.g. amukāya āvāhayāmi) even if they are hungry.

## \|\| 1.224.17 \|\|

*viśvedevāsa āgata maṃtreṇānena pārthiva \|*  
*teṣāmāvāhanaṃ kāryamakṣataiśca śiroṃ'tikāt \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. O king, with the Mantra beginning with viśvedevāsa āgatā their invocation should be made with raw rice-grains near the head.

## \|\| 1.224.18 \|\|

*uśaṃtastveti ca tilaiḥ pitṝnāvāhayettataḥ \|*  
*āyaṃtu na iti japettataḥ pārthivasattama \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. Then one should invoke the Pitṛs dropping gingelly seeds and uttering the Mantra uśantastva etc. Thereafter, O excellent king, he should utter the Mantra āyantu naḥ etc.

## \|\| 1.224.19 \|\|

*śanno devīti maṃtreṇa svāhākārasamanvitam \|*  
*pitṝṇāmarghapātreṣu tathaiva ca jalaṃ kṣipet \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. He shall pour water in the Arghyapātras of the Pitṛs uttering the mantra “Śanno devi” etc. along with the word “svāhā”.

## \|\| 1.224.20 \|\|

*yavo'si yavayāsmaddvetyakṣatāṃstatra nikṣipet \|*  
*caṃdanaṃ gaṃdhapuṣpāṇi dhūpaṃ dadyādyathākramam \|*  
*sapavitreṣu hasteṣu dadyādarghyaṃ samāhitaḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. He should drop rice-grains there, uttering the Mantra yavosi yavayāsmadva etc. He should then duly offer sandal-paste, sweet scents, flowers and incense. With great concentration he shall offer Arghya unto the hands adorned with Pavitras. (Rings of Darbha grass).

## \|\| 1.224.21 \|\|

*yā divyā iti mantreṇa svāhākārasamanvitam \|*  
*pitṝṇāmarghapātreṣu tathaiva ca jalaṃ kṣipet \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. Similarly he should pour water into the Arghya vessels of the Pitṛs uttering the Mantra yā divyā etc. along with Svāhākāra.

## \|\| 1.224.22 \|\|

*tilo'si somadaivatyo gosave devanirmitaḥ \|*  
*pratnavadbhiḥ pṛktaḥ svadhayā pitṝnimāṃllokānprīṇāhi naḥ svadheti prakṣipettilān \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. He shall scatter Tila (gingelly seeds) uttering the Mantra beginning with tilosi meaning ‘You are gingelly seeds’ with Soma as the presiding deity. ‘You have been created by the Lord during Gosava sacrifice. You have been mixed with Svadhā by the traditionalists. Delight these Pitṛs, worlds and all of us; Svadhā unto you.’

## \|\| 1.224.23-24 \|\|

*yādivyeti ca mantreṇa tato hyarghyaṃ pradāpayet \|*  
*pitṛpātre samādāya arghyapātrāṇi kṛtsnaśaḥ \|\| 23 \|\|*

*adhomukhaṃ ca tatpātraṃ mantravatsthāpayettataḥ \|*  
*āyuṣkāmastu tattoyaṃ locanābhyāṃ na vīkṣayet \|\| 24 \|\|*

23-24. Then the Arghya is to be offered by uttering the Mantra yādivyā. The devotee then takes all the Arghya Pātras in the Pitṛpātra and places that Pātra with face down uttering the said Mantra. If the devotee desires longevity, he should not look at it with his eyes.

## \|\| 1.224.25 \|\|

*tatastu candanādīni dīpāṃtāni samādadet \|*  
*tataḥ pākaṃ samādāya pṛcchedviprāndvijo ttamān \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. Then he should offer everything beginning with Candana (sandal-paste) and ending with Dīpa (light). Then he holds the cooked food and asks the excellent Brāhmaṇas:

## \|\| 1.224.26 \|\|

*ahamagnau kariṣyāmi homaṃ pitṛsamudbhavam \|*  
*anujñā dīyatāṃ mahyamapasavyāśritasya bhoḥ \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. “I shall consign to the (sacred) fire the Homa pertaining to the Pitṛs. Oh! May the permission be given to me who have resorted to Apasavya (i.e. the sacred thread worn from the right shoulder to the left).

## \|\| 1.224.27 \|\|

*kuruṣveti ca taiḥ prokte gatvāgni śaraṇaṃ tataḥ \|*  
*agnaye kavyavāhanāya svāheti prathamāhutiḥ \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. When they say “Do so”, the performer of the Śrāddha goes to the fire-sanctuary and performs the first Āhuti uttering “Svāhā unto the Agni, the transporter of the Kavya.”

## \|\| 1.224.28 \|\|

*somāya pitṛmate svadheti ca tataḥ param \|*  
*hutamannaṃ ca śeṣaṃ ca śrāddhārhebhyaḥ pradīyate \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. Thereafter, he utters “Svadhā unto Soma comprising the Pitṛs.” The cooked rice is consigned to the fire and the remainder is offered to those who deserve Śrāddha.

## \|\| 1.224.29 \|\|

*iṣṭamannaṃ tato dattvā pātramālabhya saṃjapet \|*  
*viprāṃguṣṭhaṃ samādāya pākamadhye nidhāya ca \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. The thumb of the Brāhmaṇa is held and placed in the centre of the food cooked. After serving the desired food, the devotee utters, holding the vessel:

## \|\| 1.224.30 \|\|

*pṛthivī te pātramādāya vaiṣṇa vyā ca ṛcā tathā \|*  
*svahastena na vai dadyātpratyakṣaṃ lavaṇaṃ tathā \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. “Pṛthivī (the Earth) is thy utensil.” Then the Vaiṣṇavī Ṛk is recited. Salt should not be handed over to him directly with own hand.

## \|\| 1.224.31 \|\|

*svahastena ca yaddattaṃ pratyakṣalavaṇaṃ nṛpa \|*  
*tacchrāddhaṃ vyarthatāṃ yāti dhṛte datterddhabhuktake \|*  
*tṛptāñjñātvā tato viprānagre tvannaṃ parikṣipet \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. If salt is given directly, with the hand, O king, that Śrāddha becomes futile. When half of the food is consumed, ghee is offered (again). After knowing (making it sure) that the Brāhmaṇas are satisfied the devotee (performer of Śrāddha) should serve cooked rice, and serve the food in front.

## \|\| 1.224.32 \|\|

*agnidagdhāśca ye jīvā yepyadagdhāḥ kule mama \|*  
*bhūmau dattena tṛpyaṃtu tṛptā yāṃtu parāṃ gatim \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. (The Mantra is uttered) “Those souls in my family who have been cremated in fire or who have not been so cremated should be satisfied with this food offered on the ground. Let them attain the greatest goal.”

## \|\| 1.224.33 \|\|

*sakṛtsakṛjjalaṃ dattvā gāyatrītritayaṃ japet \|*  
*madhuvāteti saṃkīrtya tataḥ pṛccheddvijottamān \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. After offering water at intervals, the devotee repeats the Gāyatrī Mantra three times. Then he recites the passage beginning with madhu vātā and asks the excellent Brāhmaṇas:

## \|\| 1.224.34 \|\|

*tṛptāḥ stha iti rājendra anujñāṃ prārthayettataḥ \|*  
*bandhūnāṃ bhojanārthāya śeṣasyānnasya bhaktimān \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. “Are you fully satisfied?” O eminent king, he should then with great devotion request them for permission to give the remaining food to the kinsmen.

## \|\| 1.224.35 \|\|

*ucchiṣṭasannidhau paścātpitṛvediṃ samācaret \|*  
*pitṛviprāsanasthānāṃ nocchiṣṭaṃ dvijasannidhau \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. Afterwards, the altar of the Pitṛs is made by the side of the Ucchiṣṭa (leavings of food). In the case of the Brāhmaṇas seated in the place of the Pitṛs there is no Ucchiṣṭa as near the Brāhmaṇas.

## \|\| 1.224.36 \|\|

*tato vediṃ samādhāya paitṛkīṃ dakṣiṇāplavām \|*  
*tasyāṃ darbhānsamādhāya kuryāccaivāvanejanam \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. After arranging the altar pertaining to the Pitṛs sloping to the south, the devotee scatters Darbha grass over it. He shall then sprinkle water over them ritualistically.

## \|\| 1.224.37 \|\|

*vibhaktyā pūrvayā paścātpiṃḍāndadyādyathākramam \|*  
*bhūyo'pyatra jalaṃ dadyātpitṛtīrthena pārthiva \|*  
*sūtraṃ ca pratipiṇḍe vai dayātteṣu pṛthakpṛthak \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. Thereafter, he should offer the rice-balls in due order with due utterance of the case endings as before. He should then offer water with Pītṛ-Tīrtha, O king. Among those rice-balls he should offer sacred thread for each of the Piṇḍas.

## \|\| 1.224.38 \|\|

*yaḥ sūtraṃ pūrvapiṇḍeṣu satataṃ viniyojayet \|*  
*sa virodhaṃ caretteṣāṃ troṭanācca parasparam \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. If the devotee offers only a single sacred thread covering all the Piṇḍas, he will be acting against them. The snapping of the thread may cause mutual discord.

## \|\| 1.224.39 \|\|

*tataḥ saṃpūjayetsarvānpiṃḍānyadvaddvijottamān \|*  
*ācamya prakṣālya tathā hastau pādau ca pārthiva \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. Then, he should adore all the rice-balls as though they were the excellent Brāhmaṇas themselves. Then, O king, he performs Ācamana and washes his own hands and feet.

## \|\| 1.224.40 \|\|

*namaskṛtya pitṝnpaścātsuprokṣitaṃ tataḥ param \|*  
*kṛtvā savyena rājendra yācayitvā varāśiṣaḥ \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. The Pitṛs are then bowed to. Water is sprinkled. This is called Suprokṣita (well-sprinkled). This is done with the sacred thread in the savya position, O leading king. He should then request for excellent blessings.

## \|\| 1.224.41 \|\|

*akṣayyasalilaṃ deyaṃ ṣaṣṭhyā caiva tataḥ param \|*  
*pavitrāṇi samādāya ūrdhvaṃ svadheti kīrtayet \|*  
*astu svadheti tairukte piṃḍopari parikṣipet \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. Then Akṣayya salila (water conducive to everlasting benefit) is offered uttering the genitive case ending. The Pavitras are held up and he utters “Svadhā”. When they say “Let there be Svadhā”, he shall drop them on the Piṇḍas.

## \|\| 1.224.42 \|\|

*tato madhu samādāya pāyasaṃ ca tilodakam \|*  
*ūrjasveti ca mantreṇa pitṝṇāmuparikṣipet o \|\| 42 \|\|*

42\. Then he collects together honey, milk-pudding and water mixed with gingelly seeds. Then he utters the Mantra ūrjasva etc. and drops them on the Pitṛs.

## \|\| 1.224.43 \|\|

*uttānamarghapātraṃ tu kṛtvā dadyācca dakṣiṇām \|*  
*hiraṇyaṃ devatānāṃ ca pitṝṇāṃ rajataṃ tathā \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. The Arghya utensil is held erect and the monetary gift is placed therein—gold in the case of the deities and silver in the case of Pitṛs.

## \|\| 1.224.44-45 \|\|

*tataḥ svastyudakaṃ dadyātpitṛpūrvaṃ ca savyataḥ \|*  
*na strībhirna ca bālena nānye naiva ca kenacit \|\| 44 \|\|*

*śrāddhīyaviprapātraṃ ca svayameva pracālayet \|\| 45 \|\|*

44-45. Then with the sacred thread in the savya position the water conducive to welfare (Svastyudaka) is offered to the Pitṛs. The utensil of the Brāhmaṇas who were fed at the Śrāddha should not be taken away by women, boys or any one else. The devotee (performer of the Śrāddha) himself removes it.

## \|\| 1.224.46-49 \|\|

*tataḥ kṛtāṃjalirbhūtvā prārthayetpārthivottama \|*  
*aghorāḥ pitaraḥ santu asmadgotraṃ vivarddhatām \|\| 46 \|\|*

*dātāro no'bhivardhaṃtāṃ vedāḥ santatireva naḥ \|*  
*śraddhā ca no mā vyagamadbahudheyaṃ ca no'stviti \|\| 47 \|\|*

*annaṃ ca no bahu bhavedatithīṃśca labhemaddi \|*  
*yācitāraśca naḥ santu mā ca yāciṣma kaścana \|\| 48 \|\|*

*etā evāśiṣaḥ santu viśvedevāḥ prīyaṃtāṃ tataḥ \|*  
*svastyarthamudakaṃ dadyātpitṛpūrvaṃ ca savyataḥ \|\| 49 \|\|*

46-49. Then, O excellent king, the devotee stands with palms joined in reverence: “May the Pitṛs be devoid of ferocious qualities. May our family flourish. May those who give us prosper. May the Vedas prosper. May our progeny prosper. Let not our faith disappear. Let us have much to spare. Let cooked rice be abundant. Let us get guests. We may have persons requesting us for things. Let there not be an occasion when we shall have to request others for anything. Let these be the blessings. May the Viśvedevas be pleased.”

Water is to be offered for the sake of Svasti (welfare) with the sacred thread in Savya position.

## \|\| 1.224.50 \|\|

*vājevājeti ca ṛcā visṛjecca tataḥ param \|*  
*āmā vājasyeti pradakṣiṇīkṛtyopaveśayet \|\| 50 \|\|*

50\. Uttering the Ṛk Mantra vāje vāje, the Brāhmaṇas are to be bidden farewell. They are to be seated and circumambulated uttering the Mantra amā vājasya etc.

## \|\| 1.224.51-52 \|\|

*pādāvamardanaṃ kṛtvā āsīmāṃtamanuvrajet \|*  
*baliṃ ca nikṣipettasmādbhojanaṃ ca samācaret \|\| 51 \|\|*

*maunena dṛśyate sūryo yāvattāvannarādhipa \|\| 52 \|\|*

51-52. The feet should be massaged and the Brāhmaṇas are to be followed till the boundary line of the village. The oblation is deposited (in a pond), then the devotee takes food silently, O king, as long as the Sun is visible.

## \|\| 1.224.53 \|\|

*yaścaivāstamite sūrye bhuṃkte ca śrāddhakṛnnaraḥ \|*  
*vyarthatāṃ yāti tacchrāddhaṃ tasmādbhuṃjīta no niśi \|\| 53 \|\|*

53\. If a man performing Śrāddha takes food after the Sun has set, that Śrāddha becomes useless. Hence he should not take food at night.

## Chapter 225 - Procedure of Sapiṇḍīkaraṇa

## \|\| 1.225.1 \|\|

*ānarta uvāca \|*  
*ekoddiṣṭavidhiṃ brūhi mama tvaṃ vadatāṃ vara \|*  
*pārvaṇaṃ tu yathā proktaṃ vistareṇa mahāmate \|\| 1 \|\|*

Note: (v. 15ff) For details of Sapiṇḍīkaraṇa see HD IV, pp. 520-525. Here the treatment is quite sketchy.

Ānarta said:

1\. O most excellent one among the eloquents, do tell me the procedure for the Ekoddiṣṭa in detail. O highly intelligent one, narrate it to me just as you have described in detail the procedure of the Pārvaṇa Śrāddha.

## \|\| 1.225.2-3 \|\|

*bhartṛyajña uvāca \|*  
*trīṇi saṃcayanādarvāktāni tvaṃ śṛṇu sāṃpratam \|*  
*yasminsthāne bhavenmṛtyustatra śrāddhaṃ tu kārayet \|\| 2 \|\|*

*ekoddiṣṭaṃ tato mārge viśrāmo yatra kāritaḥ \|*  
*tataḥ saṃcayanasthāne tṛtīyaṃ śrāddhamiṣyate \|\| 3 \|\|*

Bhartṛyajña said:

2-3. There are three (Śrāddhas) before Sañcayana (collection of bones and remains of cremation). Listen to them now. Śrāddha should be performed at the spot where death takes place. Then Ekoddiṣṭa at the place where the rest was given (made) on the way. Then the third Śrāddha is recommended at the place where Sañcayana (collection of bones and ashes) is made.

## \|\| 1.225.4 \|\|

*prathame'hni dvitīyehni pañcame saptame tathā \|*  
*navame daśame caiva nava śrāddhāni tāni ca \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. Then the Śrāddhas are performed on the first, second, fifth, seventh, ninth and tenth days. Thus there are nine Śrāddhas.

## \|\| 1.225.5-6 \|\|

*vaitariṇyāśca saṃprāptau pretastṛptimavāpnuyāt \|*  
*ekoddiṣṭaṃ daivahīnamekārghaikapavitrakam \|\| 5 \|\|*

*āvāhanaparityaktaṃ kāryaṃ pārthivasattama \|*  
*tṛptipraśnastathā kāryaḥ svaditaṃ ca sakṛttataḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

5-6. (In view of these) at the time of meeting with Vaitaraṇī, the departed one should become satisfied. The Ekoddiṣṭa is without any deity. Only one Arghya and one Pavitraka. There is no Āvāhana, O excellent king, it should be extended thus. Similarly, the question about satisfaction should be made as Svādita (the utterance of ‘May it be well tested and relished’) once.

## \|\| 1.225.7 \|\|

*abhiramyatāmiti mantreṇa brāhmaṇasya visarjanam \|*  
*acchinnāgramabhinnāgraṃ kuryāddarbhatṛṇadvayam \|*  
*pavitraṃ tadvijānīyādekoddiṣṭe vidhīyate \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. The Brāhmaṇa is taken leave of with the Mantra abhiramyatām etc. Two leaves of Darbha should be taken together. The end of the grass should not be cut or split or separated. This should be known as Pavitra and it is prescribed in Ekoddiṣṭa.

## \|\| 1.225.8 \|\|

*sarvatraiva pitaḥ proktaṃ pitā tarpaṇakarmaṇi \|*  
*pitrye saṃkalpakāle ca piturakṣayyadāpane \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. Everywhere the word Pitaḥ (O father) should be uttered; the word Pitā during the rite of Tarpaṇa (libation); the word Pitre at the time of the Saṅkalpa (utterance of the resolve); the word Pituḥ at the time when everlasting benefit is being caused to be given (Akṣayya Dāpana).

## \|\| 1.225.9 \|\|

*gotraṃ svarāṃtaṃ sarvatra gotre tarpaṇakarmaṇi \|*  
*gotrāya kalpanavidhau gotrasyākṣayyadāpane \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. The word Gotra ends with Svara everywhere. The word is Gotre at the time of the Tarpaṇa rite. At the time of Kalpana (saṃkalpa) the word is Gotrāya and at the time of Akṣayya Dāpana it is Gotrasya.

## \|\| 1.225.10 \|\|

*śarmannarghyādikartavye śarmā tarpaṇakarmaṇi \|*  
*śarmaṇe sasyadāne ca śarmaṇo'kṣayyake vidhau \|\| 10 \|\|*
